tr: 阿尔瓦雷斯·贝尔·布拉沃

en: Find a chest by @D$EndDate$ for @N$ContactName$ in @T$ContactTown$. @l$ChestPos$
tr: 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前， 到 @T$ContactTown$ 为 @N$ContactName$ 找到一个宝箱。 @l$ChestPos$
格雷戈里亚·德卡斯特利亚尔
罗伯特·安德烈亚斯·德鲁德
安东尼奥·克鲁斯·卡萨多
在 @D$EndDate$ 之前于 @T$Town$ 建起一座学校。
普罗斯佩罗·德·科尔多瓦
卡洛斯·哈维尔·莫拉莱斯

en: Capture any town belonging to %3 for %1 by %2 .
tr: 在 %2 之前攻占任意一座属于 %3 的城镇， 以换取 %1 。
劳伦斯·科内利斯·范格拉夫

en: You must get me the things by @D$EndDate$. @l$ChestPos$
tr: 你必须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把东西给我带回来。 @l$ChestPos$
在 @D$EndDate$ 之前于 @T$Town$ 建一座医院。

en: Oh what a wondrous place. Nestled in a bay. Protected by towering cliffs, this is X, I say!
tr: 啊， 多么奇妙的地方。 静静卧在一座海湾里。 高耸的峭壁护着它—— 这就是 X， 我说得没错！
在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把这位旅客带到 @T$TargetTown$ 。
在 @D$EndDate$ 之前， 把现金增加到 @g$GoldGoal$ 。

en: We are also at war with %1.
tr: 我们与 %1 也处在战争之中。

en: Uses Miles Sound System, Copyright 1991-2004 by RAD Game Tools, Inc. MPEG Layer-3 playback supplied with the Miles Sound System from RAD Game Tools, Inc. MPEG Layer-3 audio compression technology licensed by Fraunhofer IIS and THOMSON Multimedia.
tr: Uses Miles Sound System, Copyright 1991-2004 by RAD Game Tools, Inc. MPEG Layer-3 playback supplied with the Miles Sound System from RAD Game Tools, Inc. MPEG Layer-3 audio compression technology licensed by Fraunhofer IIS and THOMSON Multimedia.

en: You must find a package. @l$Pos$ Return it to @N$OwnerName$ in @T$TOWN$ by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 你必须找到那个包裹。 @l$Pos$ 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前送到 @T$TOWN$ 的 @N$OwnerName$ 手里。

en: So be it.<n>Your mission is to capture any town belonging to  %2 by %1.
tr: 就这么定了。<n>你的任务是在 %1 之前攻占任意一座属于 %2 的城镇。

en: So be it. Please start building a hospital in @T$Town$ by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 就这么办。 请在 @D$EndDate$ 之前开始在 @T$Town$ 建起一座医院。

en: %1,<n>I can think of many people I'd rather see. Do we have business to discuss? Come in, if you must.
tr: %1 ，<n>我还想不出有几个人是我更愿意见到的。 我们有事要谈吗？ 你要是非进来不可， 就进来吧。

en: So be it. Deliver @a$Amount$ to @T$DestTown$. The tools must arrive by @D$Date$.
tr: 就这么办。 把 @a$Amount$ 送到 @T$DestTown$ 。 工具必须在 @D$Date$ 前送到。

en: So, that's my last point. You've lost the game!
tr: 好吧， 那就是我的最后一分。 你输了这局！

en: Nice work! The famine in Tortuga is over. It lasted @I$Days$ days.
tr: 干得好！ 托尔图加的饥荒已经结束， 前后持续了 @I$Days$ 天。

en: Deliver @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ to the market in @T$TOWN$ by @D$EndDate$. There, you will receive @g$Price$ per barrel.
tr: 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前， 把 @a$Amount$ 单位的 @G$Goods$ 送到 @T$TOWN$ 的市场。 在那里， 每桶你能拿到 @g$Price$ 。

en: For a lavish feast you need %1 of each of the goods wheat, fruit, meat, rum and wine.
tr: 要办一场奢华的宴席， 你每样都需要 %1 的小麦、 水果、 肉、 朗姆酒和葡萄酒。

en: Search the area between @T$TOWN$ and @T$Town$ for survivors until @D$EndDate$.
tr: 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前， 搜查 @T$TOWN$ 与 @T$Town$ 之间的区域， 寻找幸存者。

en: Tortuga must achieve the status "boom" by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 托尔图加必须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前达到 「繁荣」 状态。

en: My wife is overjoyed that you have found her dog. Take this map showing a hideout containing @a$Amount$ of goods.
tr: 我妻子听说你找回了她的狗， 高兴坏了。 收下这张图—— 这张图标着一处藏身处， 里面有 @a$Amount$ 的货物。

en: So %1 are trumps.<n>Play your first card.
tr: 那 %1 是主牌。<n>打出你的第一张牌。

<ts:0><ts:110><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>LMB<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>选择单位<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>RMB<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>派出单位<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>1..0<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>选择单位

<ts:0><ts:110><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>%1<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>编年史<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>%2<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>日志<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>%3<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>船队列表<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>CTRL<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>海战中的单位规模<n><t>贸易窗口<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>RMB<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>关闭对话框

en: You may now control 2 captains and own 1 permit.
tr: 你现在可以指挥 2 名船长， 并持有 1 张许可证。

en: Then I'm in. %1 are trumps.<n>Here is my first card.
tr: 那我就来。 %1 是主牌。<n>这是我的第一张牌。

en: Thank you. Here are your %1. I am here until %2. You can bring me more goods until then.
tr: 谢谢。 这是你的 %1 。 我会一直在这里待到 %2 。 在那之前你可以再给我送些货来。

en: For a modest feast you need %1 of each of the goods wheat, fruit, meat, rum and wine.
tr: 要办一场简朴的宴席， 你每样都需要 %1 的小麦、 水果、 肉、 朗姆酒和葡萄酒。

en: %1, so you are the %2 my father has told me so much of. I am %3. Will you not join me and tell me of your adventures?
tr: %1 ， 原来你就是 %2 ， 我父亲跟我讲过你好多好多。 我是 %3 。 你愿不愿意过来， 跟我说说你的历险故事？

en: You begin your career with <o:0xFFF2FAAD>%1<o> gold coins and a <o:0xFFF2FAAD>brig<o>(80 tons, max. 16 cannons)
tr: 你将带着<o:0xFFF2FAAD>%1<o> 金币和一艘<o:0xFFF2FAAD>双桅横帆船<o>开始生涯。 （80 吨， 最多 16 门炮）

en: Press a new key to change.
tr: 请按下一个新键来更改。

en: Excellent! You increased the population of @T$TOWN$ to 1,500 within @I$Days$ days.
tr: 太好了！ 你只用了 @I$Days$ 天， 就把 @T$TOWN$ 的人口增加到了一千五百人。

en: You may now control %1 captains and own %2 permits.
tr: 你现在可以指挥 %1 名船长， 并持有 %2 张许可证。

en: You have found the missing package. Bring it to @N$OwnerName$ in @T$TOWN$ by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 你找到了丢失的那个包裹。 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前送到 @T$TOWN$ 的 @N$OwnerName$ 手里。
约翰内斯·艾因斯特曼船长
从英格兰商人那里劫得 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 。
（点击可把货物排除在交易之外）

en: For a medium-sized feast you need %1 of each of the goods wheat, fruit, meat, rum and wine.
tr: 要办一场中等规模的宴席， 你每样都需要 %1 的小麦、 水果、 肉、 朗姆酒和葡萄酒。

en: Deliver @a$Amount$ of tools to the marketplace of @T$DestTown$ by @D$Date$ . You will receive @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>.
tr: 在 @D$Date$ 之前， 把 @a$Amount$ 桶工具送到 @T$DestTown$ 的市场。 每卖出一<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>， 你就能拿到 @g$GoldPerBarrel$ 。

en: Deliver %2 each of wheat, fruit, meat, rum and wine for the wedding banquet with %3 to the market of %4 by %1.
tr: 在 %1 之前， 把小麦、 水果、 肉、 朗姆酒和葡萄酒各 %2 送到 %4 的市场， 供与 %3 举办的婚宴使用。

en: Greetings, @s$USER$. I have a clue for you. If you collect more of these clues, you could find treasure.
tr: 你好， @s$USER$ 。 我有一条线索给你。 若你能找到更多这样的线索， 就有可能发现宝藏。

en: and may now control 2 captains and own 1 permit.
tr: 现在可以指挥 2 名船长， 并持有 1 张许可证。
从西班牙商人那里劫得 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 。

en: I’ve just learned something about the Treaty of Tordesillas.
tr: 我刚了解到一些关于 《托尔德西利亚斯条约》 的事。

en: Welcome, @s$USER$. I have some news for you.
tr: 欢迎， @s$USER$ 。 我有些消息要告诉你。

en: (list of towns changed, route was reset)
tr: （城镇列表已更改， 航线已重置）

en: You begin your career with <o:0xFFF2FAAD>%1<o> gold pieces and a <o:0xFFF2FAAD>pinnace<o> (60 tons, max. 8 cannons).
tr: 你将带着<o:0xFFF2FAAD>%1<o> 枚金币和一艘<o:0xFFF2FAAD>轻型帆船<o> 开始生涯。 （60 吨， 最多 8 门火炮）
在 @D$EndDate$ 之前完成这项任务。

en: I don't have anything for you. Accomplish my last mission, and we'll take it from there.
tr: 我没什么可给你的。 先完成我交给你的最后一个任务， 之后的事之后再说。

en: Good. Your mission is to loot @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ from English traders.
tr: 很好。 你的任务是从英格兰商人手中劫掠 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 。

en: Thank you kindly. Here is the map piece. You can inspect it in your log.
tr: 太感谢你了。 这是你应得的地图碎片。 你可以在日志里查看。

en: %1,<n>my dear friend, I am so happy to see you. I hope you have been well since we last met.
tr: %1 ，<n>我亲爱的朋友， 见到你我真高兴。 希望你自我们上次见面以来一直安好。

en: Here lies the town, overlooking the sound. It guards the bay, for with ships it abounds.
tr: 城镇就在这里， 俯瞰着这片内海。 它守着这座湾， 因为这里的船只多得是。

en: and may now control %1 captains and own %2 permits.
tr: 现在可以指挥 %1 名船长， 并持有 %2 张许可证。
从荷兰商人那里劫得 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 。

en: When you turn a handle, a large horn emits the dulcet tones of a woman singing. Just the thing for sailors at sea for weeks on end.
tr: 你转动把手， 一只大号号角就会发出女子歌唱般悦耳的声响。 对于在海上漂泊数周的水手来说， 再合适不过了。

en: %1,<n><n>A loan of %2 was due on %3. The sum was collected today.<n><n>The treasurer of %4
tr: %1 ，<n><n>一笔 %2 的贷款已于 %3 到期， 这笔钱今天已被收走。<n><n>%4 的财务官

en: Deliver @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ to @T$TOWN$ by @D$Date$. You shall receive @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen> at the market.
tr: 在 @D$Date$ 之前把 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 送到 @T$TOWN$ 。 每桶你都能在市集上拿到 @g$GoldPerBarrel$ 。 <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>

en: This must be a southerly location.
tr: 这必定是更南边的一处地点。

en: Add untraded goods to captain trading
tr: 把未交易的货物加入船长自主交易

en: Deliver @G$Goods$ by @D$EndDate$ to a person in @T$TargetTown$. You will then be paid @g$Price$ for each barrel delivered.
tr: 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前， 把 @G$Goods$ 送到 @T$TargetTown$ 的某个人手里。 每送到一桶， 对方就付你 @g$Price$ 。

en: Good. Your mission is to loot @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ from Spanish traders.
tr: 很好。 你的任务是从西班牙商人手中劫掠 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 。

en: %1,<n>what do you want from me? If you had sailed into town like a true seaman, I would have turned my cannons on you, as you are hostile to my nation.<n><n> But now that you are here, I must behave like a gentleman.
tr: %1 ，<n>你到底想从我这里得到什么？ 换作一个真正的水手， 敢这样开进我的港口， 我早就把炮口对准你了—— 你与我的国家为敌。<n><n>不过既然你已经进来了， 我总得像个绅士那样行事。

en: If I knew you better, I could also offer you missions and Letters of Marque. However, you need a permit in my town for this.
tr: 要是我们更熟一点， 我也能派任务给你、 开具私掠许可证。 不过这需要你在我的城镇里有一份建造许可。

en: Good. Your mission is to loot @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ from Dutch traders.
tr: 很好。 你的任务是从荷兰商人手中劫掠 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 。

en: Your captain has lost the duel and the ship.
tr: 你的船长输掉了决斗， 连船也丢了。
从法国商人那里劫得 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 。

en: To end this scenario, return to Cartagena with your convoy.
tr: 要结束这个剧本， 就带着你的船队返回卡塔赫纳。
我们所需的一切都齐了。

en: You may now control any number of captains and own 10 permits.
tr: 你现在可以指挥任意数量的船长， 并持有 10 张许可证。

en: Good. Your mission is to loot @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ from French traders.
tr: 很好。 你的任务是从法国商人手中劫掠 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 。

en: You begin your career with <o:0xFFF2FAAD>%1<o> gold pieces and a <o:0xFFF2FAAD>sloop<o> (60 tons, max. 14 cannons)
tr: 你将带着<o:0xFFF2FAAD>%1<o> 金币和一艘<o:0xFFF2FAAD>单桅帆船<o>开始生涯。 （60 吨， 最多 14 门炮）

en: A bay holds two islands, one large and one small. The town on the larger, under X must it fall.
tr: 一座湾里有两个岛， 一大一小。 那座坐落在较大岛上的城镇， 就落在 X 之下。

en: The demand for @G$MsgGoods$ is high in: @T$MsgTown0$ and @T$MsgTown1$
tr: @G$MsgGoods$ 在以下城镇需求旺盛： @T$MsgTown0$ 和 @T$MsgTown1$

en: No doubt you'll find him at an inn. But I'm sure he'll help you to find @N$TeacherName$.
tr: 你肯定能在旅店里找到他。 但我敢肯定， 他会帮你找到 @N$TeacherName$ 。

en: Greetings, %1. I have something for you here.
tr: 你好， %1 。 我这里有样东西要给你。

en: The chest contained unusual things including a Dutch kit for growing tulips.
tr: 箱子里装了些不寻常的东西， 包括一套荷兰式的郁金香栽培箱。

en: You must increase supplies of wheat, bricks, cotton, sugar and tobacco to @a$Amount$ each by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 你必须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前， 把小麦、 砖块、 棉花、 糖和烟草的储备各增加到 @a$Amount$ 。

en: I'm glad to see you, @A$USER$. I lost a package on my way here. Could you find it for me?
tr: 很高兴见到你， @A$USER$ 。 我在路上弄丢了一个包裹。 你能替我找找吗？

en: I thank you. Please bring me @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$. You have until @D$Date$ to deliver the goods to the market. There, you will receive @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>.
tr: 多谢你了。 请给我带来 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 。 你要在 @D$Date$ 之前把货物送到市场。 在那里， 每送到一<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>， 你就能拿到 @g$GoldPerBarrel$ 。

en: Greetings, @A$USER$. I can tell you how to find what you are looking for. Hear my clue to the hidden treasure.
tr: 你好， @A$USER$ 。 我可以告诉你如何找到你在找的东西。 听听这条关于隐藏宝藏的线索吧。

en: I don't know any @N$OwnerName$, but I certainly do know where @N$TeacherName$ is. I suppose I could tell you, if I was so inclined. How about you scratch my back and I'll scratch yours?
tr: 我不认识什么 @N$OwnerName$ ， 但我确实知道 @N$TeacherName$ 在哪儿。 我大概可以告诉你， 要是我愿意的话。 这样吧， 你帮我一把， 我也帮你一把， 如何？

en: You have no convoy in the town.
tr: 你在这座城镇里没有船队。
残酷的克里斯蒂安船长

en: @N$ContactName$ can help you to find a teacher to train one of your captains (in waging battle).
tr: @N$ContactName$ 能帮你找到一位老师， 训练你的一名船长 （战斗方面的技艺）。

en: He is happy to teach your young captain all his tricks of the trade.
tr: 他很乐意把你年轻船长的那一套生意门道全都教给他。

en: Sail to towns belonging to @n$FoeNation$ and collect @G$Goods$. Deliver @a$Amount$ to the market in my town by @D$Date$. You will receive @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>.
tr: 驶往属于 @n$FoeNation$ 的城镇去收购 @G$Goods$ 。 在 @D$Date$ 之前把 @a$Amount$ 送到我城镇的市场。 每送到一<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>， 你就能拿到 @g$GoldPerBarrel$ 。

en: The number of captains and permits you are allowed is now unlimited.
tr: 你可指挥的船长数和可持有的许可证数现在都不限上限了。

en: Unfortunately, I have no news for you at the moment. Try again later.
tr: 很遗憾， 我现在没有什么消息要给你。 过些时候再来吧。

en: Hello, @F$FName$ @L$LName$, sit down here beside me and let's have a wee tipple. Then I'll tell you of hidden treasure.
tr: 你好， @F$FName$ @L$LName$ ， 请坐到我旁边来， 我们先喝上一杯。 然后我再告诉你隐藏宝藏的事。

en: Find the survivors of the shipwreck between @T$TOWN$ and @T$Town$ by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前， 找到 @T$TOWN$ 与 @T$Town$ 之间那场海难的幸存者。

en: For @g$Price$, I will tell you where you can find @N$ContactName$.
tr: 给我 @g$Price$ ， 我就告诉你去哪儿找 @N$ContactName$ 。

en: You spend a very pleasant day with %1 and tell her of your adventures.
tr: 你和 %1 愉快地度过了一天， 还跟她讲了自己的冒险经历。

en: You will find him in a town to the northeast.
tr: 你会在东北方向的一座城镇找到他。

en: You have sold your building permit and all your buildings in this town.
tr: 你已经卖掉了建筑许可， 以及在这座城镇里的全部建筑。

en: You lead. Tell me which color you want as the trump suit (choose a card).
tr: 你先出牌。 告诉我要把哪种花色定为主花色 （选一张牌）。

en: The convoy finds your wife adrift on a raft. She says that the pirates abandoned her, as the matter concerned only them and you.
tr: 船队发现你的妻子漂在海上的一块木筏上。 她说海盗把她丢下不管了—— 那件事只关系到他们自己和你。

en: This must be a location in the north.
tr: 这必定是更北边的一处地点。

en: The place must lie in the far northeast.
tr: 那个地方想必在东北方的远处。

en: Well done! Tortuga has the status "boom" once again. You completed this task within @I$Days$ days.
tr: 干得漂亮！ 托尔图加又恢复了 「繁荣」 状态。 你在 @I$Days$ 天内完成了这项任务。

en: An experienced captain is waiting at the inn.
tr: 一位经验丰富的船长正在酒馆等你。

en: %1 of %2 sailors want to join you in your adventures.
tr: %2 名水手中， 有 %1 人想跟你一起去冒险。

en: Should I sign on to this convoy? The previous captain will then retire to the inn.
tr: 要我来接手这支船队吗？ 这样上一任船长就会退下去酒馆歇着。

en: Find and destroy the Spanish treasure fleet. It was last in @T$StartTown$, from there it set sail for @T$DestTown$.
tr: 找到并摧毁西班牙的宝藏船队。 它最后一次停在 @T$StartTown$ ， 此后便驶向 @T$DestTown$ 。

en: and may now control any number of captains and own 10 permits.
tr: 现在可以指挥任意数量的船长， 并持有 10 张许可证。

en: Governor towns like Cartagena receive import goods from Europe.<n>You can usually sell these at a profit to colonial towns, such as Santa Marta, Maracaibo or Gibraltar.<n>Now trade on your own for a while.<n>Your objective is to make @g$GoldGoal$ in cash from trade.
tr: 像卡塔赫纳这样的总督城会收到从欧洲运来的进口货物。<n>你通常能把它们高价卖给殖民城镇， 比如圣玛尔塔、 马拉开波或直布罗陀。<n>接下来自己先做一段时间买卖吧。<n>你的目标是通过贸易赚到 @g$GoldGoal$ 现钱。

en: <n>To make matters appear more official, I will give you a Letter of Marque against @n$HostileNation$.
tr: <n>为了让这件事显得更名正言顺， 我给你一张针对 @n$HostileNation$ 的私掠许可证。

en: Destroy @I$NumConvoys$ military convoys belonging to @n$TargetNation$ by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前摧毁 @I$NumConvoys$ 支属于 @n$TargetNation$ 的军事船队。

en: Convoy @C$Convoy$ has picked up a castaway. Take him to @T$DestTown$.
tr: 船队 @C$Convoy$ 救起了一名遇难者。 把他送到 @T$DestTown$ 。
发现黑胡子船队 （ @I$NumShips$ 艘船）： @l$ConvoyPos$

en: Please deliver @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ to my emissaries in the market. You have until @D$Date$. On delivery, you shall receive @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>.
tr: 请把 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 交给市场里的我的特使。 你有 @D$Date$ 的时间。 交货后， 每送到一<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>， 你就能拿到 @g$GoldPerBarrel$ 。

en: Sit down here beside me and pour me some rum, I have some news for you. On my last journey, I met @N$ContactName$. He was a friend and student of the legendary @N$TeacherName$.
tr: 来， 坐我旁边， 给我倒杯朗姆酒， 我有消息告诉你。 上回出海， 我碰见了 @N$ContactName$ 。 他既是传奇人物 @N$TeacherName$ 的朋友， 也是他的学生。

en: Search the area between @T$TOWN$ and @T$Town$ until @D$EndDate$ to see what became of the settlers.
tr: 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前搜查 @T$TOWN$ 与 @T$Town$ 之间的区域， 弄清那些移民后来怎样了。

en: I am happy to see you, %1.
Please meet my emissary at the market. Hand over @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ by @D$Date$, he will offer you good price.
tr: 请到市场去找我的特使。 在 @D$Date$ 之前交给他 @a$Amount$ 桶 @G$Goods$ ， 他会给你一个好价钱。

en: Your convoy is in the harbor with an unarmed brig and your cash assets amount to %1.
tr: 你的船队已停泊港口， 有一艘未武装的双桅横帆船， 现金资产为 %1 。

en: Oh, I can't believe it. Drunkards have stolen my beautiful ship. They filled it with bottles of rum and made off. Can you help me search for my ship?
tr: 哦， 真是难以置信。 那帮酒鬼偷走了我漂亮的船。 他们把船塞满了朗姆酒瓶， 然后跑掉了。 你能帮我把船找回来吗？

en: Today, an English military convoy attacked your convoy.
tr: 今天， 一支英格兰军事船队袭击了你的船队。

en: Today, a Spanish military convoy attacked your convoy.
tr: 今天， 一支西班牙军事船队袭击了你的船队。

en: Living space is scarce in the town.
tr: 城镇的居住空间日益紧张。

en: Spain set up a harbor here once. You will find wood and bricks, but wheat there is none.
tr: 西班牙曾在这里建过一座港口。 你能找到木料和砖石， 却找不到小麦。

en: <n>To make matters appear more official, I will give you a Letter of Marque against @n$TargetNation$.
tr: <n>为了让这件事显得更名正言顺， 我给你一张针对 @n$TargetNation$ 的私掠许可证。

en: It is good to see you here.
%1,<n>I am so happy you've come to visit me again. I've told all my friends of your adventures. But now you must tell me more, for the girls are longing for more information. Come in quickly.
tr: %1 ，<n>你这么惦记着来看我， 我真高兴。 你的历险故事我已经讲给所有朋友听了。 不过现在你得再多讲一些， 姑娘们都还等着听后续呢。 快进来吧。

en: @N$ContactName$ can help you to find a teacher to train one of your captains (in the art of trading).
tr: @N$ContactName$ 能帮你找到一位老师， 训练你的一名船长 （贸易方面的技艺）。

en: We have everything we need here.
tr: 这里所需的一切我们都有。

en: <n><n>However, if at least one ship in your convoy survives the battle, the captain survives also.
tr: <n><n>不过， 只要你的船队里有至少一艘船在战役中存活， 船长也会活下来。

en: You cannot visit the teacher. Your convoy must have @a$Amount$ of rum on board.
tr: 你无法去拜访老师。 你的船队船上必须装有 @a$Amount$ 的朗姆酒。

en: Today, %1 %2 captured the town of %4 for %3. %5 now has %6 towns in the New World, while %7 has only %8 towns.
tr: 今天， %1・%2 为 %3 攻下了 %4 这座城镇。 %5 在新世界如今有 %6 座城镇， 而 %7 只有 %8 座。
<ts:0><ts:160>城镇视图/海战<t>缩放等级<n>列表中<t>滚动

en: %1,<n>there you are again. Come, I may have some news for you.
tr: %1 ，<n>又见面了。 来， 我也许有些消息要告诉你。

en: Today, a Dutch military convoy attacked your convoy.
tr: 今天， 一支荷兰军事船队袭击了你的船队。

en: I have no other news for you. I bid you good day.
tr: 再没有别的消息要告诉你了祝你顺风。

en: Add towns by clicking on them.
tr: 点击城镇即可将其加入。

en: In a large bay lie some towns, there are three. X refers to the most easterly of these.
tr: 一座大湾里散着几座城镇， 共三座。 X 指的就是其中最东的那座。

en: You begin your career in the Spanish town of %1 in the year %2.<n><n>
tr: 你将在 %2 年， 于西班牙城镇 %1 开始自己的生涯。<n><n>
与西班牙的关系： 敌对

en: You have the luck of the devil!<n>That was my last game, I'm broke.
tr: 你真是鸿运当头！<n>这是我的最后一局， 我输光了。

en: The chest was used to store long French wigs.
tr: 箱子曾用来存放长长的法式假发套。

en: %1 %2 %3 tries his luck in the English town of %4.
tr: %1 %2・%3 到英格兰城镇 %4 碰碰运气。

en: This sextant gives an accurate bearing even in heavy seas. Parts of the sextant are mounted on springs, which helps to reduce any strong vibrations.
tr: 即便在风浪极大的海上， 这具六分仪也能给出准确的方位。 六分仪的部分构件装在弹簧上， 有助于削弱强烈的震动。

en: That's agreed then. Bring @a$Amount$ tools to @T$DestTown$. At the marketplace, you will get @g$GoldPerBarrel$ per <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>. The goods must be delivered by @D$Date$.
tr: 那就说定了。 把 @a$Amount$ 桶工具送到 @T$DestTown$ 。 在市场上， 每一<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>你能拿到 @g$GoldPerBarrel$ 。 货物必须在 @D$Date$ 前送到。

en: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>You have rescued a castaway from @n$DestNation$. @N$Name$ offers you a large reward if you put him ashore at the next town belonging to his nation.
tr: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>你救起一名来自 @n$DestNation$ 的遇难者 @N$Name$ 。 只要你把他送到他所属国家的下一座城镇上岸， 他就给你丰厚酬谢。
高亮显示你自己的建筑

en: Our donation coffers are filled to the brim. Drop by again in a few weeks' time.
tr: 我们的捐赠金库已经满得快要溢出来了。 过几个星期再来吧。

en: Your convoy is now in Santa Marta. Click on the town name to display the town information.<n>You can do this from the sea chart or by entering the town.
tr: 你的船队现在位于圣玛尔塔。 点击城镇名称即可查看城镇信息。<n>你可以在海图上直接这么做， 也可以进入城镇后再看。

en: Improve your reputation with Spain to "friendly".
tr: 把你与西班牙的声望提升到 「友好」。

en: I see you have still not completed my last mission. Complete this job, as I have further work for you.
tr: 看来你还没完成我上一个委托。 把这件事办完， 因为我还有更多活儿交给你。

en: The place lies in the far southwest.
tr: 那个地方在西南方的远处。

en: You cannot visit the teacher. Your convoy must have @a$Amount$ of wine on board.
tr: 你无法去拜访老师。 你的船队船上必须装有 @a$Amount$ 的葡萄酒。

en: All that remains is a lone hat where the pirate captain once sat. He must have been captured and the convoy sunk.
tr: 如今只剩下一顶孤零零的帽子， 原先戴在海盗船长头上。 他多半被抓走了， 船队也沉了。

en: Hello, @s$USER$, I have here a clue to lead you to hidden treasure. Do you want to hear it?
tr: 你好， @s$USER$ 。 我这里有一条能引你找到隐藏宝藏的线索。 想听吗？

en: I must have these things! We do not know the exact spot where the ship sank. @l$ChestPos$ Bring me the chest by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 这些东西我一定要！ 我们不知道船沉的确切位置。 @l$ChestPos$ 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把箱子给我带回来。

en: You can attack this pirate hideout from the sea with a convoy. First you must defeat all ships in the harbor.
tr: 你可以率领一支船队从海上攻击这个海盗藏身处。 你必须先消灭港口里的所有船只。

en: Your rank is too low to assemble another convoy.
tr: 你的等级太低， 无法再组建一支船队。

en: Greetings, %1. %2, a very experienced captain, has offered you his services.
tr: 你好， %1 。 %2 是一位经验丰富的船长， 他愿意为你效力。

en: Search for your wife. You have discovered a useful clue: @l$Pos$
tr: 寻找你的妻子。 你发现了一条有用的线索： @l$Pos$

en: Today, a French military convoy attacked your convoy.
tr: 今天， 一支法国军事船队袭击了你的船队。

en: In a large bay lie some towns, there are three. X refers to the most westerly of these.
tr: 一座大湾里散着几座城镇， 共三座。 X 指的就是其中最西的那座。

en: In a large bay lie some towns, there are three. X refers to the most southern of these.
tr: 一座大湾里散着几座城镇， 共三座。 X 指的就是其中最南的那座。

en: An island far off, small and remote. There is nowhere else for X to denote.
tr: 一座遥远的岛， 又小又偏。 除了它， X 再没有别处可指。

en: In a large bay lie some towns, there are three. X refers to the most westerly of these.
tr: 一座大湾里散着几座城镇， 共三座。 X 指的就是其中最西的那座。

en: In a large bay lie some towns, there are three. X refers to the most westerly of these.
tr: 一座大湾里散着几座城镇， 共三座。 X 指的就是其中最西的那座。

en: In a large bay lie some towns, there are three. X refers to the most westerly of these.
tr: 一座大湾里散着几座城镇， 共三座。 X 指的就是其中最西的那座。

en: That helps us greatly. Search the route between @T$TOWN$ and @T$Town$. You must have completed your search by @D$EndDate$.<n>If you find any survivors, you can put them ashore in @T$SampleTown$.
tr: 这对我们帮助很大。 去搜寻 @T$TOWN$ 到 @T$Town$ 之间的航线吧。 你必须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前完成搜寻。<n>要是找到幸存者， 可以把他们送到 @T$SampleTown$ 上岸。

en: Thank you. I cannot tell you exactly where to find the chest. @l$Pos$ You must search around this area. Return my personal effects by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 谢谢。 可我没法告诉你箱子究竟在哪里。 @l$Pos$ 你得在这一带搜寻。 请在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把我的私人物品送回来。

en: Where did America get its name? I can give you the answer.
tr: 美洲这个名字是怎么来的？ 我能告诉你答案。

en: %1,<n><n>You can buy a building permit for this town. If your reputation in my nation were higher, I would offer you a better price.<n><n>The current price for a building permit is %2.
tr: %1 ，<n><n>你可以为这座城镇购买建筑许可。 如果我在本国的声望再高一些， 就会给你更便宜的价格。<n><n>当前一张建筑许可的价格是 %2 。

en: A convoy belonging to the pirate %1 has attacked a trader from %2.
tr: 属于海盗 %1 的一支船队袭击了一名来自 %2 的商人。

en: <n>Unfortunately, you have no space left in your convoy for this ship. Come back later.
tr: <n>遗憾的是， 你的船队已经没有空位容纳这艘船了。 改日再来吧。

en: So we have a deal. Bring me @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ to the market. I will wait for you there until @D$EndDate$. You must deliver the goods in a single delivery.
tr: 那就这样说定了。 把 @a$Amount$ 单位的 @G$Goods$ 送到市场。 我会一直在那里等你， 直到 @D$EndDate$ 。 你必须一次把货交齐。

en: %1,<n>we have known each other for so long now and my heart yearns for you to be mine alone. Will you not ask my father for my hand in marriage?
tr: %1 ，<n>我们相识至今已经这么久， 我的心日夜盼着你只属于我。 你愿不愿意去向我父亲求婚， 求他把我许配给你？

en: Greetings! The convoy is en route, and soon the first traders will be quaking at our feet! Please come back again later to collect your first share.
tr: 你好！ 船队已经在路上了， 很快第一批商人就会吓得在我们脚下发抖！ 请晚些时候再来领取你的第一笔分红。

en: You must deliver @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ to the market in @T$TOWN$ by @D$Date$. You shall then receive @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>.
tr: 你必须在 @D$Date$ 之前把 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 送到 @T$TOWN$ 的市场。 之后每一<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>都可获得 @g$GoldPerBarrel$ 。

en: Which convoy can you offer me?
tr: 你能给我提供哪支船队？

en: Average for 1 day. Average daily profit %1.
tr: 1 天平均值。 平均每日利润 %1 。

en: %1,<n>you are most welcome to my home. Come in and let's talk awhile.
tr: %1 ，<n>我这里随时欢迎你来。 进来坐会儿， 我们聊聊。

en: A ship in the convoy has sunk
tr: 船队中有一艘船沉没了

en: A ship in the convoy has sunk
tr: 船队中有一艘船沉没了

en: Once long ago did other people here live, with their great temples praise to gods did they give. Above it lies X, up in a corner. You’ll sail to the southwest in vain, I should warn you.
tr: 很久以前曾有别族居住于此， 他们在宏伟的神庙中向众神献上赞颂。 而在它北面的角落里， 就是 X。 我得提醒你， 往西南去航是白费力气。

en: See here, I have marked the last known position on your sea chart. @l$Pos$ Find and destroy this convoy. You have until @D$EndDate$.
tr: 瞧， 我在你的海图上标出了它最后已知的位置。 @l$Pos$ 找到并摧毁这支船队。 你有 @D$EndDate$ 的时间。

en: Have you heard that we have finally learned where pirate %1 has his hideout? %2 %3 is looking for a brave hero to destroy it. Are you up to the job?
tr: 你听说我们终于查清了海盗 %1 的藏身之处吗？ %2 %3 正在招募一位勇敢的英雄去摧毁它。 你愿意接下这份活吗？

en: You will find him in a town in the Western Caribbean.
tr: 你会在加勒比海西部的一座城镇找到他。

en: This ship has no captain and so cannot set sail. Hire a captain for this ship at the inn or add it to an existing convoy.
tr: 这条船没有船长， 无法出海。 在旅店里为它雇一名船长， 或者把它编入一支现有船队。

en: Very good!<n>Now send your convoy back to Cartagena.
tr: 非常好！<n>现在让你的船队返回卡塔赫纳。

en: The chest contained pink soft toys.
tr: 箱子里是粉色的毛绒玩具。

en: %1 %2 %3 tries his luck in the Spanish town of %4.
tr: %1 %2・%3 到西班牙城镇 %4 碰碰运气。

en: This folio contains a multitude of beautiful star charts. A large table specifies precisely when and where each individual star rises and falls.
tr: 这部对开本里收着大量精美的星图。 一张大表精确地列出了每一颗具体的星何时在何地升起、 何时落下。

en: A large piece of rounded glass is mounted on the end of a golden rod. If you hold it over a map, the finest lines are clearly visible even in poor light.
tr: 一根金杆的末端装着一大块打磨成弧形的玻璃。 把它悬在地图上方， 即便光线再差， 也能清楚看见最细的线条。

en: I would like you to build a school in @T$Town$ in order to increase the wealth of the town. In fact, @T$Town$ means nothing to me, but my sister lives there and simply will not accept that there are better towns.
tr: 我希望你能在 @T$Town$ 建一所学校， 好提高这座城镇的富裕程度。 其实 @T$Town$ 对我来说毫无意义， 但我妹妹就住在那儿， 她怎么也不肯承认还有更好的城镇。

en: The convoy finds your wife adrift on a raft. She has enjoyed the adventure but she now wants to return home to her powder boxes as soon as possible.
tr: 船队发现你的妻子漂在海上的一块木筏上。 她很享受这段冒险， 但现在只想尽快回家， 躲进自己的妆盒里不出来。

en: Supply @T$TargetTown$ with goods. The town's status cannot fall below "Boom" before @D$EndDate$.
tr: 向 @T$TargetTown$ 供应货物。 该城镇在 @D$EndDate$ 之前不得跌到 「繁荣」 以下。
一支军事船队正在进攻

en: The town is recovering from an attack.
tr: 这座城镇正在从袭击中恢复。

en: As you know, we are at war. To weaken @n$TargetNation$'s economy, I want you to capture or sink @I$NumShips$ trading ships. Do you accept this mission?
tr: 你知道， 我们正在交战。 为了削弱 @n$TargetNation$ 的经济， 我要你俘获或击沉 @I$NumShips$ 艘商船。 你接受这项任务吗？

en: %1 is personally on the enemy ship. He suggests to your captain that the battle should be decided by a duel.<n><n>To spare the crew, your captain accepts the challenge.
tr: %1 亲自登上了敌船。 他向你的船长提议， 这场战斗应由一场决斗来定胜负。<n><n>为了避免船员伤亡， 你的船长接受了他的挑战。

en: @N$ContactName$ can help you to find a teacher to train one of your captains (in the art of navigation).
tr: @N$ContactName$ 能帮你找到一位老师， 训练你的一名船长 （航海方面的技艺）。

en: The place lies somewhere in the bay of %1.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 的海湾里的某处。

en: Arm your convoy so that it has at least three fully armed and fully manned escort ships that are all of the type frigate or higher.
tr: 为你的船队武装起来， 让它至少有三艘武装齐全、 船员满编， 且等级为巡防舰或更高的护航船。
未装载的货物也可以运送！

en: and the harbor is heavily defended.
tr: 而且港口的防守十分森严。

en: Your convoy is in the harbor with an unarmed sloop and your cash assets amount to %1.
tr: 你的船队已停泊港口， 有一艘未武装的单桅帆船， 现金资产为 %1 。

en: %1 %2 buys a permit to construct buildings in %3.
tr: %1・%2 买下了在 %3 建造房屋的许可。

en: A river from the wilds at the headland divides There lies a town in which you’ll gladly reside.
tr: 一条荒野的河流在海角处注入海峡。 那座宜于居住的城镇， 就在那儿。

en: Once long ago did other people here live, with their great temples praise to the gods did they give. Above it lies X, up in a corner. You’ll sail to the southeast in vain, I should warn you.
tr: 很久以前曾有别族居住于此， 他们在宏伟的神庙中向众神献上赞颂。 而在它北面的角落里， 就是 X。 我得提醒你， 往东南去航是白费力气。

en: An island lies here, as though in a cradle. The land from the north curls around at an angle.
tr: 这里卧着一座岛， 宛如襁褓。 那片陆地自北方伸来， 绕成一个弯角。

en: An island lies here, as though in a cradle. The land from the north curls around at an angle.
tr: 这里卧着一座岛， 宛如襁褓。 那片陆地自北方伸来， 绕成一个弯角。

en: The town in question is @T$TargetTown$. Supply the town with all the goods it needs. I will do my utmost to quell the rumor by @D$EndDate$ for once and for all. Before then, the town cannot fall below the status "Boom".
tr: 那座城镇就是 @T$TargetTown$ 。 请把它需要的各种货物一应供应充足。 我会在 @D$EndDate$ 之前想尽办法彻底平息这个传闻。 在此之前， 城镇等级不能跌到 「繁荣」 以下。

en: Why did you not complete the last mission I gave you?
tr: 你为什么没有完成我上次交给你的任务？

en: I am delighted. However, I regret that I cannot give you much time. Destroy @I$NumConvoys$ military convoys belonging to @n$TargetNation$ by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 我很高兴。 不过很抱歉， 我没法给你太多时间。 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前摧毁 @I$NumConvoys$ 支属于 @n$TargetNation$ 的军事船队。

en: The convoy finds a message in a bottle. It contains a hastily written note: "Rescue me! I think they intend bringing me to this spot!".<n>The note is accompanied by a map showing the location of a particular spot.
tr: 船队发现了一只漂流瓶， 里面塞着一张匆忙写就的字条： "救救我！ 我猜他们打算把我带到这个地点！ "<n>字条还附了一张地图， 标出了某个特定地点的位置。

en: Supply provisions to @T$TOWN$ until @D$EndDate$. The status of the town must not drop below "flourishing economy".
tr: 向 @T$TOWN$ 供应给养物资， 直到 @D$EndDate$ 。 该城镇的经济状况不得跌到 「兴旺」 以下。

en: Your new ship is in the harbor. Your basic crew is already on board.
tr: 你的新船已经在港口里。 基础船员也已经上船了。
Ascaron Ltd. UK 常务董事

en: Let %1 be your new town. You can now enter it just like any other town to erect buildings and set up businesses there.<n>The entire district is not yet available to you, but, if you capture additional towns, I will give you the land you need for this.
tr: 就让 %1 成为你的新城吧。 现在你就能像进出其他城镇一样进出它， 在那里建起建筑、 开办产业。<n>整片辖区暂时还不能归你使用， 但若你攻占更多城镇， 我会把所需的土地交给你。

en: You must put an end to the famine in Tortuga by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 你必须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前结束托尔图加的饥荒。

en: %1,<n>thank you for capturing one of our enemy's towns.
tr: %1 ，<n>谢谢你替我们攻下了一座敌方城镇。

en: %1,<n>I have already given you a mission. Accomplish this mission, as I have more for you to do.
tr: %1 ，<n>我已经给你一件委托了。 把它完成吧， 我还有更多事要交给你。

en: Good. A contact person is waiting for you at the market in @T$TargetTown$. Deliver as much @G$Goods$ as you can get your hands on by @D$EndDate$. You will then be paid @g$Price$ for each barrel you deliver.
tr: 很好。 @T$TargetTown$ 市场的集市上有个接头人在等你。 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前， 尽可能多地把 @G$Goods$ 弄到手送到那里。 之后你每交付一桶， 就能拿到 @g$Price$ 。

en: The %1 buccaneer %2 has destroyed the harbor defenses of the town and looted goods. The status of the town has also fallen.
tr: %1 私掠者 %2 摧毁了这座城镇的港口防御设施并洗劫了货物。 这座城镇的声望也随之一落千丈。

en: You have neither a ship nor a convoy in the town
tr: 你的城镇里既没有船， 也没有船队。

en: You are back in the harbor of Cartagena and your convoy, the "Santa Maria", is selected.<n>As you can see, the convoy already has some goods: cotton, meat and cocoa.<n>Now find the docks in the harbor and click on them, because you want to sell the goods.
tr: 你已经回到卡塔赫纳的港口， 你的船队 「圣玛丽亚号」 也已选定。<n>正如你所见， 船队里已经有了一些货物： 棉花、 肉和可可。<n>现在在港口里找到码头并点击它， 因为你打算把这些货物卖掉。

en: Sell as many goods as you can above the average price and buy new goods. <n>Note: The prices of goods that are scarce in a town are shown in red. You will always get good prices for these goods.<n>
tr: 尽量把货物以高于平均价的价格卖出去， 再买入新的货物。<n>注意： 某座城镇里稀缺的货物， 其价格会以红色显示。 这类货物你总能卖出好价钱。<n>

en: Congratulations! You have formed your first convoy! Your next task is to increase your wealth to @g$GoldGoal$. You can check your wealth at any time under "Successes" in the log.<n><n>Good luck!
tr: 恭喜！ 你已经组建了第一支船队！ 下一个任务是把你的财富提升到 @g$GoldGoal$ 。 你随时可以在日志的 「收益」 里查看自己的财富。<n><n>祝你好运！

en: This must be a position in the north.
tr: 这必定是北方的一处位置。

en: The place lies in the southeast Caribbean.
tr: 那个地方在加勒比海的东南部。

en: You cannot visit the teacher. Your convoy must have @a$Amount$ of food on board.
tr: 你无法去拜访老师。 你的船队船上必须装有 @a$Amount$ 的食物。

en: Famine has broken out in %1. While the famine rages, the price of wheat, fruit, corn and meat will rise.
tr: %1 爆发了饥荒。 饥荒持续期间， 小麦、 水果、 玉米和肉类的价格都会上涨。
把货物排除出船长自主交易

en: Add untraded goods to manual trading
tr: 把未交易的货物加入手动交易

en: Many thought he was long since dead, but only recently I met a trader who happened to come across his hideout. It seems he's just been lying low. For @g$Price$, I'll tell you where you can find the trader.
tr: 很多人都以为他早就死了， 可我前些日子碰上个商人， 他无意间撞见了那个藏身处。 看来他一直躲得好好的。 给我 @g$Price$ ， 我就告诉你那商人在哪儿。

en: Attack trading convoys belonging to @n$TargetNation$ and sink or capture @I$NumShips$ ships by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前， 袭击 @n$TargetNation$ 的商船队， 击沉或俘获其中 @I$NumShips$ 艘船。

en: I might have known. My feckless son Boris has borrowed my finest ship. I have now discovered that he and his friends have decided to set off on a jaunt. No doubt, they have filled the hold with rum and I'm sure that I will never see my ship again. Could you retrieve my ship for me?
tr: 我就知道会这样。 我那个没用的儿子鲍里斯把我最好的船借走了。 我刚发现， 他和朋友几个商量着要出去玩一趟。 不用说， 他们肯定把货舱装满了朗姆酒， 我敢说再也见不到我的船了。 你能帮我把船要回来吗？

en: You have no convoy and no stores in the town
tr: 你在镇上既没有船队， 也没有存货

en: You should travel here if you want to bake colored sweet corn bread with fruit in the clay oven.
tr: 若你想用黏土炉烤着色泽鲜艳、 嵌着水果的甜玉米面包， 就得来这里。

en: You should travel here if you want to bake colored sweet corn bread with fruit in the clay oven.
tr: 若你想用黏土炉烤着色泽鲜艳、 嵌着水果的甜玉米面包， 就得来这里。

en: You should travel here if you want to bake colored sweet corn bread with fruit in the clay oven.
tr: 若你想用黏土炉烤着色泽鲜艳、 嵌着水果的甜玉米面包， 就得来这里。

en: You should travel here if you want to bake colored sweet corn bread with fruit in the clay oven.
tr: 若你想用黏土炉烤着色泽鲜艳、 嵌着水果的甜玉米面包， 就得来这里。

en: Good. @T$TargetTown$ is the town in question. Supply the town with everything it needs by @D$EndDate$. Its status cannot fall below "Boom". I must be honest and tell you that the town could quite possibly be hit by a plague. Be prepared for it.
tr: 很好， 出问题的城镇是 @T$TargetTown$ 。 你要在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把它需要的东西全部供应到位， 等级不能跌到 「繁荣」 以下。 老实告诉你， 这座城镇很可能会闹瘟疫。 你要有心理准备。

en: You have until @D$EndDate$ to complete this mission.
tr: 你必须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前完成这项任务。

en: Find and destroy one of Blackbeard's pirate convoys. You have until @D$EndDate$.
tr: 找到并摧毁黑胡子的一支海盗船队。 你有 @D$EndDate$ 的时间。

en: I will tell you a little about Hispaniola, the first American colony that became very important under Spanish rule.
tr: 我来跟你略谈伊斯帕尼奥拉， 它在西班牙统治下成为第一处真正重要的美洲殖民地。

en: A military convoy has tried, unsuccessfully, to attack the town by land.
tr: 一支军事船队试图从陆路进攻该城镇， 但没能成功。

en: Continue to defeat English military convoys until England's strength is rated as “weak”.
tr: 继续击败英格兰的军事船队， 直到英格兰的国力被评定为 「弱」。

en: The chest was full of fluffy cushions.
tr: 箱子里装满了蓬松的靠垫。

en: Excellent! You now have @g$Gold$.<n><n>Each nation has military convoys to defend its towns and protect the waters around them. The more towns a nation occupies, the more military convoys it needs to ensure they are adequately protected.<n><n>If a nation loses a military convoy, its military strength is weakened. Since military convoys are quite aggressive towards the enemy nation's towns and convoys during a war, a nation may lose a military convoy from time to time. For this reason, convoys are regularly sent from Europe to reinforce a nation’s military strength in the New World.<n><n>You can check a nation's strength under "Nations" in the Chronicle. If a nation is described as weak, its towns can be captured.<n><n>You should now defeat enough English military convoys to ensure that England's strength is rated as “weak”.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Defeat enough English military convoys to ensure that England is rated as “weak”.
tr: 太棒了！ 你现在有 @g$Gold$ 了。<n><n>每个国家都有军事船队， 用来保卫自己的城镇、 保护城镇周围的水域。 一个国家占领的城镇越多， 需要的军事船队就越多， 才能确保这些城镇都得到足够的保护。<n><n>一个国家若损失了一支军事船队， 其军事实力就会削弱。 由于战争期间军事船队对敌国的城镇和船队相当激进， 一个国家时不时就会损失一支军事船队。 因此， 欧洲方面会定期派出船队， 为该国家在新大陆的军事实力提供增援。<n><n>你可以在编年史的 「国家」 一栏查看某个国家的实力。 如果一个国家被描述为 「虚弱」， 它的城镇就可以被攻占。<n><n>你现在要击败足够多的英格兰军事船队， 让英格兰的实力被评为 「虚弱」。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>击败足够多的英格兰军事船队， 让英格兰被评为 「虚弱」。

en: %1 %2 %3 tries his luck in the Dutch town of %4.
tr: %1 %2・%3 到荷兰城镇 %4 碰碰运气。

en: I have no other news for you. See me again when you've accomplished the mission I set you.
tr: 我这里没有别的事告诉你了。 等你完成我交给你的委托， 再来找我。

en: <f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Choose a building<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res>Your first building in this town must be a warehouse
tr: <f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>选择一座建筑<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res>你在这座城镇的第一座建筑必须是仓库
找到黑胡子的海盗据点。 @l$IslandPos$

en: <n><n>A local trader offers you %1 for your permit and buildings. Do you want to accept the offer? Remember that you will then lose all of your buildings in this town.
tr: <n><n>本地商人愿意出 %1 收购你的许可和建筑。 你要接受这个报价吗？ 记住， 接受之后你将失去在这座城镇里的全部建筑。

en: %1,<n>now it is my turn to meet you. You are a popular fellow in my nation, I had always hoped to meet you in person.
tr: %1 ，<n>现在轮到我来见你了。 你在我们国家很受欢迎， 我一直都盼着能当面见你一面。

en: Supply @T$TargetTown$ with goods and buy up surplus goods. On @D$EndDate$, the town's status must be "Boom" and all of the local traders' businesses must be working to full capacity.
tr: 为 @T$TargetTown$ 供给货物并收购过剩货物。 到 @D$EndDate$ 时， 这座城镇的状态必须是 「繁荣」， 且当地商人的所有产业都必须满负荷运转。

en: The governor's daughter thanks you and gives you a map showing the location of a hideout containing @a$Amount$ of goods.
tr: 总督的女儿向你道谢， 并给了你一张藏宝图， 上面标着一个藏有 @a$Amount$ 货物的巢穴位置。

en: I must thank you once again, you have done so much for my nation. I shall reward you with additional land for your town %1. You will then own %2% of the district.
tr: 我必须再次感谢你， 你为我国做了这么多。 作为奖赏， 我会为你的城镇 %1 追加土地。 届时你将拥有该地区 %2% 的土地。

en: Active for %1 days. Average daily profit %2.
tr: 生效还有 %1 天。 日均利润 %2 。

en: Convoy @C$Convoy$ has picked up castaway. Take him to a town belonging to @n$DestNation$.
tr: 船队 @C$Convoy$ 救起了一名遇难者。 把他送到 @n$DestNation$ 的一座城镇。

en: A campfire exposes the teacher's hideout, not far from the shore. Your captain rows ashore and is met by an old man. When the old man sees all the wine, he rubs his hands with glee.
tr: 一堆营火暴露了老师的藏身处， 就在离岸不远的地方。 你的船长划船上岸， 遇见一位老人。 老人看到所有的葡萄酒， 欣喜地搓起了手。

en: Capture three English trading convoys: Board their ships and add them to your convoy.
tr: 俘获三支英格兰商船队： 登上它们的船， 把它们并入你的船队。

en: Build two weaving mills in Cartagena and produce @a$AmountGoal$ of cloth.
tr: 在卡塔赫纳建两座织造厂， 并生产 @a$AmountGoal$ 的布料。

en: You have made me so happy! Hurry to my father, he'll be overjoyed!
tr: 你让我太开心了！ 快去找我父亲， 他会高兴坏的！
城镇的粮食储备已被摧毁
那个位置就在 %1 附近。

en: The traveler has boarded the convoy. Bring him to @T$TargetTown$ by @D$EndDate$ .
tr: 旅人已经登上船队。 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把他送到 @T$TargetTown$ 。

en: I knew I could trust you. It concerns the town of @T$TargetTown$, which belongs to @n$HostileNation$. Attack the town and loot it for all I care, then seek out my wife. Don’t delay, as I have only been given until @D$EndDate$ to think it over.<n><n>If you do not yet possess a Letter of Marque against @n$HostileNation$, I will give you one.
tr: 我就知道可以信你。 这件事关系到属于 @n$HostileNation$ 的 @T$TargetTown$ 。 攻打那座城、 随便你怎么洗劫都行， 然后去找我的妻子。 别耽搁， 我只被宽限到 @D$EndDate$ 之前答复他们。<n><n>如果你还没有针对 @n$HostileNation$ 的私掠许可证， 我就给你一张。

en: My wife will be overjoyed. The poodle Michelle is hidden in @T$TargetTown$. Loot the town so that it looks like a military mission and then search for the dog. You have until @D$EndDate$.<n>Believe me, it will give me no pleasure to see the dog again, but my wife's sniveling shows no sign of abating.<n><n>If you do not yet possess a Letter of Marque against @n$HostileNation$, I will give you one.
tr: 我妻子一定会高兴坏了。 贵宾犬米歇尔藏在 @T$TargetTown$ 。 把那座城洗劫得像一场军事行动， 再去找那条狗。 你有 @D$EndDate$ 的时间。<n>信我， 再见到那条狗我一点也高兴不起来， 可我妻子那哭哭啼啼的劲儿丝毫没有收敛。<n><n>如果你还没有针对 @n$HostileNation$ 的私掠许可证， 我就给你一张。

en: Well done! You now have a score of 85% in Cartagena. Keep up the good work!<n>Increase your score to 100%.<n>By the way, you have just received a message about "promotion and ranks".
tr: 干得好！ 你在卡塔赫纳已经有 85% 的分数了。 继续保持！<n>把分数提升到 100%。<n>顺便一提， 你刚收到一条关于 「晋升与等级」 的消息。

en: and the harbor is sufficiently secure.
tr: 而且港口的防守也很稳妥。

en: Many thanks for your support and for returning my diaries. As a reward, I am presenting you with a barque. You will find her in the harbor.
tr: 多谢你的支持， 也谢谢你把我的日记还了回来。 作为报答， 我送你一艘三桅帆船。 她就在港口等你。

en: %1,<n>nice of you to drop by. Shall I tell you of the latest events I've heard?
tr: %1 ，<n>你来了正好。 要不要听听我最近打听到的消息？

en: You receive a discount of <o:0xFFF2FAAD>5%<o> for all goods bought if you do the trading yourself.
tr: 亲自进行交易时， 你购买的所有货物均可享受<o:0xFFF2FAAD>5%<o> 的折扣。

en: That sounds good. So travel to our enemies' towns and buy up import goods there. Deliver @a$Amount$ of each by @D$Date$ to my emissary at the marketplace of @T$TOWN$, he will pay more than twice the usual price.
tr: 听着不错。 那就去我们敌人的城镇， 把进口货物买下来。 在 @D$Date$ 之前， 把每样 @a$Amount$ 份交给 @T$TOWN$ 市场的我的特使， 他给的价钱比平时高出一倍还多。

en: Your convoy is in the harbor with an unarmed pinnace and your cash assets amount to %1.
tr: 你的船队已停泊港口， 有一艘未武装的轻型帆船， 现金资产为 %1 。

en: Build a church and increase the population of your town to 2,200. You have until @D$EndDate$.
tr: 建造一座教堂， 并把你城镇的人口增加到 2,200。 期限是 @D$EndDate$ 。

en: Capture a colonial town belonging to %3 for %1 by %2 . The town must not be the seat of a Governor or of the viceroy.
tr: 在 %2 之前攻占一座属于 %3 的殖民城镇， 以换取 %1 。 该城镇不得是总督或副王的驻地。

en: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>You have discovered a huge goods cache, but you have no room to take the goods on board.
tr: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>你发现了一处巨大的货物藏点， 但船上已经没有空间装下这些货物。

en: Are you not the famous @A$USER$? Could you please help me? I am being pursued by a bounty hunter, one of my adversaries put him on my tail.
tr: 你不就是那位大名鼎鼎的 @A$USER$ 吗？ 能帮我个忙吗？ 有个赏金猎人正在追我， 是我一个仇家把他雇来的。

en: I have some very good news: With the last artifact you found, I was able to make out an exact position. Here, I'll plot it for you on the sea chart. %1<n>Please be careful, as no one knows what lies in wait there.
tr: 我有个大好消息： 凭借你找到的最后一件文物， 我终于定出了准确的位置。 来， 我把它标在海图上给你看。 %1<n>小心些， 没人知道那里等着你的是什么。

en: On its sands, the sea is home to towns for which no one cares. But one of these in particular has always produced fine wares.
tr: 它的沙滩之上， 海洋环抱着一些无人关心的城镇。 但其中有一座， 却一直出产精良的货品。

en: An island lies here, as though in a cradle. A peninsula from the north curls around at an angle.
tr: 这里卧着一座岛， 宛如襁褓。 一方半岛自北方伸来， 绕成一个弯角。

en: An island lies here, as though in a cradle. A peninsula from the north curls around at an angle.
tr: 这里卧着一座岛， 宛如襁褓。 一方半岛自北方伸来， 绕成一个弯角。

en: White strand beside the jungle, a little river known to none. Here you lie well hidden, in a bay seen only by the sun.
tr: 丛林旁一段白沙， 一条无名的细河。 你在这里藏得很好， 藏进只有阳光才见的海湾。

en: So, you have not returned my wife to me! Then I cannot reward you. However, between us both, I am actually very grateful to you.
tr: 这么说， 你没有把我的妻子带回来！ 那你我就无从奖赏了。 不过说句私下话， 我其实很感激你。

en: Our enemy, @n$HostileNation$, will stop at nothing. My wife has been abducted and certain conditions have been attached to her release. However, I happen to know where she is being held. Officially, I can do nothing, you understand, but you could attack the town and bring her back to me.
tr: 我们的敌人 @n$HostileNation$ 什么事都做得出来。 我妻子被人绑架了， 对方还开出了释放她的条件。 不过我恰好知道她被关在哪里。 明面上我什么也做不了—— 你明白的—— 但你可以攻下那座城镇， 把她带回来给我。

en: I am glad to see you.<n>My wife recently received a groomed poodle from Paris. The wretched animal has driven me to distraction, but my wife is besotted with the dog.<n>Somebody learned of this, kidnapped the dog and handed it over to our enemies as a way of blackmailing us.<n><n>Can you rescue the poodle for me?
tr: 很高兴见到你。<n>我妻子最近从巴黎得到一只修剪过的贵宾犬。 这只讨厌的畜生把我折腾得快疯了， 可我妻子却迷上了它。<n>有人听说了这件事， 绑走这条狗， 转交给我们的敌人， 用来勒索我们。<n><n>你能替我把那条贵宾犬救回来吗？

en: Lasmiranda stirbt vor langer Weile! Sie sitzt seit vielen Tagen am Cap und winkt vorbeifahrenden Schiffe zu. Es sei aber noch kein wilder Pirat bei ihr vorgefahren, berichtet sie.
tr: 拉斯米兰达闲得发慌！ 她已经在海角上坐了好几天， 朝路过的船挥手， 可据她说， 到现在还没有哪个凶悍的海盗在她面前靠岸。
西班牙军事船队发起袭击

en: I’m sure you also trade in rum? I can tell you something about that.
tr: 你肯定也做朗姆酒生意吧？ 我可以跟你聊聊这个。

en: Christopher Columbus had indeed discovered a new land mass (or rather: rediscovered, for the Vikings had already set foot on American soil during the middle ages), but he mistakenly announced that he had discovered a sea route to India.<n><n>While preparing the second and third of his four voyages, the Genoan collaborated with Amerigo Vespucci from Florence. It was he who first suggested that these lands to the west actually belonged to a new and unknown continent. This spectacular realization reignited public interest and whenever anyone discussed these new territories, the name Vespucci was sure to be mentioned.<n><n>In contrast, Christopher Columbus’ star was in decline. In the meantime, he had even been sent home in chains after complaints by the Caribbean settlers, and his death as an embittered and sick man in 1506 did not attract the attention it deserved. It is therefore hardly surprising that the southern German cartographer Martin Waldseemüller turned to the popular name of Amerigo Vespucci as an inspiration when he tried to suggest a name for these unknown lands one year later. <n><n>Waldseemüller’s name was accepted by his colleagues. It would have been fairer if the continent had been christened “Columbia”.
tr: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布确实发现了一块新大陆—— 更准确地说， 是重新发现了它， 因为中世纪时维京人早已踏上过美洲的土地。 但他错误地宣称， 自己发现的是一条通往印度的航路。<n><n>在准备他那四次航行中的第二与第三次时， 这位热那亚人与来自佛罗伦萨的亚美利哥·韦斯普奇合作。 正是后者最先提出： 西边这些土地其实属于一块全新且未知的大陆。 这一惊人的判断重新点燃了公众的兴趣， 从此每逢谈起这些新领土， 人们必然会提到韦斯普奇这个名字。<n><n>相比之下， 哥伦布的星光正在黯淡。 与此同时， 他甚至因加勒比殖民者的控诉被押上锁链送回国内； 1506 年， 他这个满腹怨气又身染重病的人就此死去， 却并没有得到应有的关注。 因此， 一年后当南德意志制图师马丁·瓦尔德泽米勒要为这些未知土地想出一个名字时， 转而取材于那个当时广为流传的名字 「亚美利哥·韦斯普奇」， 也就不足为奇了。<n><n>瓦尔德泽米勒拟定的名字被同行采纳了。 不过， 若把那块大陆命名为 「哥伦比亚」， 本会更公平一些。

en: His home town is somewhere in the south, between Providence and Curacao.
tr: 他的家乡在南边， 普罗维登斯与库拉索之间的某个地方。

en: @A$USER$, I've been left in the lurch here. But I urgently need to get to @T$TargetTown$. Can you bring me there? I will pay you @g$Reward$!
tr: @A$USER$ ， 我在这里被人撇下了。 可我必须尽快赶到 @T$TargetTown$ 。 你能送我去吗？ 我给你 @g$Reward$ ！

en: I'm sorry, it turns out I can't give you this mission after all. I have just heard that the problem no longer exists.
tr: 抱歉， 这么看来这个委托我不能交给你了。 我刚听说， 那个问题已经不存在了。

en: Well done! Your town has already grown a little.<n><n>As soon as your town has more than 1,000 inhabitants, it will be of interest to traders from other towns, who may come to trade their goods.<n><n>Traders usually visit a town if there is a demand in the town for a certain good, in other words, if there are some goods that are not available in your town.<n><n>You have just received a message about trade and production in your own town. To read it, open the log.<n><n>Your first objective is to increase the population of your town to 1,000.<n><n>Note: If a town is to have more than 500 inhabitants, it must have an inn!<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Increase the population of your town to 1,000.
tr: 干得漂亮！ 你的城镇已经有点规模了。<n><n>一旦你的城镇人口超过 1000， 其他城镇的商人就会对你产生兴趣， 他们可能前来交易货物。<n><n>通常， 如果某座城镇对某种货物有需求—— 换句话说， 如果有些货物在你这里买不到—— 商人就会到这座城镇来做买卖。<n><n>你刚刚收到一条关于自己城镇贸易与生产的消息。 要查看它， 请打开日志。<n><n>你的第一个目标， 是把城镇人口增加到 1000 人。<n><n>注意： 一座城镇要拥有超过 500 名居民， 就必须有一家旅店！<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>把城镇人口增加到 1000 人。

en: %1 %2 %3 tries his luck in the French town of %4.
tr: %1 %2・%3 到法国城镇 %4 碰碰运气。

en: Unable to delete trade route. <n>The file may be write-protected.
tr: 无法删除贸易路线。<n>该文件可能是写保护的。
军事船队发现了一批走私货物。

en: %1,<n>it is lovely to see you again. I haven't stopped thinking of you since our last meeting. Come in quickly, I have a lot to tell you.
tr: %1 ，<n>真高兴又见到你。 上次见面之后， 我满脑子都是你。 快进来吧， 我有好多话想告诉你。

en: %1,<n>I need to talk to you about something. My father would dearly love nothing better than to choose a fine nobleman to wed his daughter. But my heart belongs to you. Will you not ask my father for my hand in marriage?
tr: %1 ，<n>我有件事要和你说。 我父亲最想做的， 就是挑一位品貌出众的贵族迎娶他的女儿。 可我的心早就属于你。 你愿不愿意去向我父亲求婚， 求他把我许配给你？

en: %1,<n>my heart leaps for joy every time we meet. But my father is threatening to marry me off to some would-be nobleman. You are the only one who can save me from this fate. Will you not ask my father for my hand in marriage?
tr: %1 ，<n>每次见到你， 我的心都会雀跃。 可我父亲正打算把我嫁给某个自命不凡的贵族。 只有你能救我脱离这场命运。 你愿不愿意去向我父亲求婚， 求他把我许配给你？

en: You have wreaked much destruction upon my nation, but you are also the only man who can save our fate. I will offer you our friendship for %1. What do you say?
tr: 你给我国造成了巨大的破坏， 但同时你也是唯一能挽救我国命运的人。 我愿意用 %1 换取与我国的友谊。 你意下如何？

en: Good! Now be on your way and destroy one of Blackbeard's pirate convoys. First, though, you must reinforce your convoy.
tr: 很好！ 现在出发， 去摧毁黑胡子的一支海盗船队吧。 不过首先， 你得先加强自己的船队。

en: Now try to strike some profitable bargains.<n>Open the Trade window and buy as much cotton, sugar and cocoa as you can transport in your convoy because these goods are produced in this town.<n>Then return to Cartagena and sell these goods at a profit.
tr: 现在试着做几笔有利可图的买卖。<n>打开贸易窗口， 尽可能多地买入你的船队装得下的棉花、 糖和可可， 因为这些货物正是这座城镇出产的。<n>然后返回卡塔赫纳， 把这些货物高价卖出。

en: Good day, %1. I have your new share here. This time you are getting %2!
tr: 你好， %1 。 你的新分红在这儿。 这次你能拿到 %2 ！

en: A local trader is prepared to sell you the business and all crop fields for a price of %1.
tr: 一位本地商人愿意以 %1 的价格把产业以及所有农田都卖给你。

en: Not far from the shore, your convoy discovers a small hermit's campsite. Your captain rows ashore and meets an old man wearing a captain's uniform that is even older than he is. He spots the barrels of rum and is delighted.
tr: 离岸不远， 你的船队发现了一处小小的隐士营地。 你的船长划船上岸， 遇见一位老人， 他身上的船长制服比他自己还要旧。 他一眼看见那些朗姆酒桶， 欣喜不已。

en: %1 has appointed a new governor named %2.
tr: %1 任命了一位新总督， 名叫 %2 。

en: You are a great help to me! If all goes according to plan, the helmsman will secretly throw the books overboard, one after the other. The ship has set sail from @T$HostileTown$, bound for Europe. Follow the ship and collect the books. Bring them to me by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 你帮了大忙！ 只要一切照计划进行， 舵手就会趁人不备把那些簿册一本接一本抛进海里。 船已从 @T$HostileTown$ 起航， 目的地是欧洲。 尾随这艘船， 把簿册收集起来， 并在 @D$EndDate$ 之前带给我。

en: The place is located somewhere near %1.
tr: 那个地方在离 %1 不远的某处。
摧毁黑胡子的海盗藏身处。

en: Unfortunately, I cannot search for survivors as none of my ships are currently available. Couldn't you take on this task?
tr: 可惜我没法派人去找幸存者， 因为我现在一艘能用的船都没有。 这件事你愿意接手吗？
袭击一名西班牙私掠者

en: You are doing me a great favor. All is in order, you have paid me the @g$PriceBuy$. Meet me in the market and I will hand over @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$. After that, take the goods to @T$Town$ by @D$EndDate$ and hand them over to @N$DestName$.
tr: 你可真帮了我大忙。 一切都办妥了， 你已经付清 @g$PriceBuy$ 。 到市场来找我， 我会交给你 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 。 然后在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把这些货物运到 @T$Town$ ， 交给 @N$DestName$ 。

en: Only recently he wrote to tell me he had thrown this chest overboard. @l$ChestPos$ You must bring me back my things! You can find me here until @D$EndDate$.
tr: 他最近才写信告诉我， 说把这个箱子扔下了海。 @l$ChestPos$ 你必须把我的东西带回来！ 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前我都在这儿。

en: Unfortunately, I cannot tell you anything definite. My harbor master gave me a vague description of the ship that they may have taken. A trader spotted this ship at sea and showed me the spot. @l$Pos$ Search this area, you may find a clue.
tr: 很遗憾， 我没法告诉你确切情况。 我的港务长只含糊描述了他们可能抢走的那条船。 有个商人在海上看见过那条船， 指给我看了位置。 @l$Pos$ 搜搜这一带， 也许能找到线索。

en: <n>The convoy had no other ship and was disbanded.
tr: <n>船队里再没有别的船， 于是解散了。
<ts:0><ts:160>选择<t>船队<n>进入<t>城镇图标/建筑<n>船只/港口<t>显示空闲船只

en: Thank you! My beautiful ship has been returned to me at last. Unfortunately, I can give you no gold, but I have had a couple of very nice goods delivered to you at the market in @T$Town$.
tr: 谢谢你！ 我那艘漂亮的船终于回到我手上了。 可惜我拿不出金币报答你， 不过我已让人把几样很不错的货物送到 @T$Town$ 的市场交给你。

en: This is the westernmost town of the region.
tr: 这里是这一地区最西边的城镇。

en: I knew you'd be interested. @N$ContactName$ is away for much of the time.
tr: 我就知道你会感兴趣。 @N$ContactName$ 大半时间都不在。

en: Oh @s$USER$, what am I to do? A trader from @T$Town$ keeps interfering in my business and snatching my profits. This has been going on for months. Can you help me get rid of his convoy?
tr: 啊， @s$USER$ ， 我该怎么办？ @T$Town$ 的一个商人总来插手我的生意， 把我的利润抢走， 这事已经闹了几个月。 你能帮我除掉他的船队吗？

en: I have just heard that a Spanish ship full of settlers has sunk.
tr: 我刚听说， 一艘满载移民的西班牙船沉了。

en: Right-click on convoy to add ships
tr: 右键点击船队可添加船只

en: Your mission is to capture any town belonging to %2 by %1.<n>To avoid any problems with the other nations, I will issue you with a Letter of Marque against %2.
tr: 你的任务是在 %1 之前攻占任意一座属于 %2 的城镇。<n>为免和其他国家起纠纷， 我会给你一张针对 %2 的私掠许可证。

en: Thank you! The settlers were on their way to @T$TOWN$ and intended to travel on to @T$Town$. Search the area around these towns until @D$EndDate$, as the ship may have sunk and there may be survivors.
tr: 谢谢！ 这些移民正赶往 @T$TOWN$ ， 并打算接着前往 @T$Town$ 。 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前搜寻这两座城镇之间的区域， 因为船可能沉在那里， 也许还有幸存者。

en: I regret that I cannot tell you exactly where to find it. @l$Pos$ Please bring me the package by @D$EndDate$, you will then receive a handsome reward.
tr: 很抱歉， 我没法告诉你它确切在哪里。 @l$Pos$ 请在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把包裹带给我， 届时你会得到丰厚的酬金。

en: A citizen died of a plague in one of our towns a few days ago. We tried to cover it up, but I'm afraid word still got out. Now many traders have decided not to call at the town. You have a fine trading fleet. Couldn't you supply the town for the next while?
tr: 几天前， 我们的一座城镇有位市民死于瘟疫。 我们试图隐瞒， 但消息还是传出去了。 如今许多商人决定不再前往那座城镇。 你有一支出色的商船队， 能否替那座城镇供货一段时间？

en: Should I sign on to this ship and assemble a new convoy?
tr: 要不要登上这艘船， 组建一支新的船队？

en: Have you heard of the notorious pirate Edward Teach, otherwise known as Blackbeard?
tr: 你听说过那位臭名昭著的海盗爱德华·蒂奇吗？ 他就是黑胡子。

en: You are to loot English ships and seize a certain number of goods.
tr: 你要劫掠英格兰船只， 并夺取一定数量的货物。

en: You are to loot Spanish ships and seize a certain number of goods.
tr: 你要劫掠西班牙船只， 并夺取一定数量的货物。

en: Deliver @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ from the market in @T$TOWN$ to the market in @T$Town$. You have until @D$EndDate$.
tr: 把 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 从 @T$TOWN$ 的市场送到 @T$Town$ 的市场。 你有 @D$EndDate$ 的时间。

en: I can't reach the number of points I called. I've lost.
tr: 我没能达到自己报的分数。 我输了。

en: I am glad to see you, @A$USER$, for I need your help. I once served under the pirate @P$PirateName$. However, I came to my senses and made a bargain with the Governor of @T$TargetTown$. Unfortunately, my former comrades have learned of this and have put a price on my head. Can you help me and take me to @T$TargetTown$?
tr: 见到你真高兴， @A$USER$ ， 因为我需要你的帮助。 我曾在海盗 @P$PirateName$ 手下效力。 不过后来我醒悟过来， 与 @T$TargetTown$ 的总督做了一笔交易。 可惜我昔日的同伙得知此事后， 悬赏要我的命。 你能帮我一把， 把我送到 @T$TargetTown$ 吗？

en: %1's attitude towards you is now neutral.
tr: %1 对你的态度现已转为中立。

en: The owner, @N$OwnerName$, is aboard the convoy @C$Convoy$. Bring him to @T$TargetTown$ before @D$EndDate$.
tr: 主人 @N$OwnerName$ 就在船队 @C$Convoy$ 上。 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把他送到 @T$TargetTown$ 。

en: Good! I am tasking you with procuring @a$Amount$ of tools. Deliver them by @D$Date$ to @T$DestTown$. You will be paid @g$GoldPerBarrel$ per <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen> at the marketplace.
tr: 好！ 我交给你去采购 @a$Amount$ 桶工具。 在 @D$Date$ 前把它们送到 @T$DestTown$ 。 在市场上， 每一<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>会付你 @g$GoldPerBarrel$ 。

en: %1,<n>I would be pleased to sell you a permit to construct buildings in this town. However, at your rank, you may only have %2 building permits, and you already have that many.<n><n>Come back when you have a higher rank.
tr: %1 ，<n>我很乐意卖给你一张在这座城镇建造的许可证。 不过以你现在的等级， 最多只能持有 %2 张建筑许可， 而你已经持有这么多了。<n><n>等你等级提升后再来吧。

en: Everyone has been given 5 cards. I'll call 1 point.<n><n>If you want to play, you must call one point higher.
tr: 每个人都已拿到 5 张牌。 我报 1 分。<n><n>想玩的话， 你必须报得更高一分。

en: You may have noticed how the price of cotton fell when you sold some.<n>This is because the price is determined by the supply and demand in the town.<n>Selling the goods satisfies the demand and the price falls. If you buy a good, its price will go up.<n>Now buy @a$SubGoal$ of wheat.
tr: 你可能已经注意到， 你一卖出棉花， 棉花的价格就下跌了。<n>这是因为价格由城镇的供求关系决定。<n>卖出货物满足了需求， 价格便会下跌； 买入某种货物， 它的价格就会上升。<n>现在买入 @a$SubGoal$ 小麦。

en: Thank you for completing the last mission I gave you.
tr: 谢谢你完成我交给你的最后一个任务。

en: I would like to thank you for completing my last mission.
tr: 我想为你完成我的最后一个任务而道谢。

en: Curses! Once again, my town has run short of @G$Goods$. It is sometimes quite beyond me how the resident traders carry on their business. Until I have sorted this matter out, I would be grateful if you could help me.
tr: 真是见鬼！ 我的城镇又一次缺了 @G$Goods$ 。 本地商人做起生意来那股劲头， 有时我实在无法理解。 在这件事解决之前， 若你能帮我一把， 我将不胜感激。

en: The %1 buccaneer %2 sneaked into the town harbor and threatened arriving traders. For at least four weeks, traders from outside will only call very reluctantly at the  town.
tr: %1 私掠者 %2 偷偷溜进了城镇港口， 威胁那些来港的商人。 至少四个星期之内， 外来的商人都会极不情愿地才肯进这座城镇。

en: %1 workers are needed in the town.
tr: 这座城镇需要 %1 名工人。

en: I thank you. Search the waters outside the town. You may find clues as to the drunkards' whereabouts. I can only wait here until @D$EndDate$, please don't delay!
tr: 多谢你了。 去城镇外的海面上搜寻吧， 也许能找到那些醉汉下落的线索。 我只能在这里等到 @D$EndDate$ ， 请别耽搁！

en: Your Letter of Marque against %1 is no longer valid.
tr: 你那张针对 %1 的私掠许可证已失效。

en: Today, @N$OwnerName$ came aboard the convoy. Bring him to @T$TargetTown$ before @D$EndDate$.
tr: 今天 @N$OwnerName$ 登上了船队。 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把他送到 @T$TargetTown$ 。
袭击一名英格兰私掠者

en: You must first build a warehouse in Cartagena before you can construct any other buildings.
tr: 你必须先在卡塔赫纳建起一座仓库， 之后才能建造其他任何建筑。

en: %1,<n>Our church needs constant maintenance and must be decorated as befits a place of worship, but Rome is far away. Make a donation to our church and we will include you in our prayers. Your reputation in my nation and my town will also benefit.<n><n>Choose the sum you would like to donate.
tr: %1 ，<n>我们的教堂需要持续修缮， 也需按礼拜场所的规格重新装饰， 但罗马远在天边。 向我们的教堂捐一笔钱， 我们就会在祷告中提及你的名字。 你的国家与城镇也会因此对你另眼相看。<n><n>请选择你要捐款的数额。

en: You are @s$USER$, aren't you? Then you're the person looking for more clues to a hidden treasure. I could help you, if you wish.
tr: 你就是 @s$USER$ ， 对吧？ 那么你一定在寻找更多隐藏宝藏的线索。 若你愿意， 我可以帮你。

en: Visit your new town and build a shipyard.
tr: 去你的新城镇， 建一座船坞。

en: %1 %2 has broken through the town's harbor defenses and looted the town.
tr: %1・%2 攻破了城镇的港口防线， 把整个镇子洗劫一空。
