en: I would gladly task you with capturing a town belonging to %1.  I have enough military convoys to protect any newly captured area.<n><n>However, %1 is still too strong for such an undertaking.<n><n>You could help to weaken %1 by destroying its military convoys.<n><n>Then return to me and I may have a mission for you.<n><n><n>You can check a nation’s strength under “Nations” in the Chronicle.
tr: 我很愿意派你去攻占 %1 的一座城镇。 我手头的军事船队足够守住任何新占下的地盘。<n><n>不过 %1 目前对这项任务来说还是太强了。<n><n>你可以摧毁 %1 的军事船队， 助我削弱他们。<n><n>然后再来找我， 也许就有新任务给你。<n><n><n>你可以在 「编年史」 的 「国家」 一栏里查看某国的实力。

en: Loot @a$Amount$ of spices, wine and tools from transport convoys belonging to @n$HostileNation$. You must not capture or sink any ships. Then deliver these goods to the market in @T$TOWN$ by @D$EndDate$. After that, you can collect your reward from the governor.
tr: 从 @n$HostileNation$ 的运输船队上劫掠 @a$Amount$ 香料、 葡萄酒和工具。 你不得俘获或击沉任何船只。 之后在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把这些货物送到 @T$TOWN$ 的市场。 完成后， 你可以去总督那里领取奖励。

en: I have been waiting for you, %1. What do you have for me?
tr: 我一直在等你， %1 。 你给我带来了什么？

en: A heavy storm is raging over the town
tr: 一场猛烈的风暴正席卷城镇

en: I have found out something more about the artifacts and the special location. One thing I can now say for sure: %1 What that place holds, I do not know. To locate the position more accurately, I need more artifacts.
tr: 关于这些文物和那个特殊地点， 我又查到了一些东西。 有一点我现在可以肯定： %1 那里藏着什么， 我还不知道。 要把位置定得更准确， 我需要更多文物。

en: Four towns sit on the bay together. Sail to the east, in the third you must tether.
tr: 四座城镇同处一湾。 向东航， 第三座便是你要停靠之处。

en: Thank you for returning my wife to me. Although I very much enjoyed the peace and quiet of the last few days, I could not simply abandon my wife to my enemies. As a reward, take this map showing a hideout containing @a$Amount$ of goods.
tr: 谢谢你把我的妻子带回来。 这几天的清静日子我固然十分享受， 但我终究不能把妻子丢给敌人。 作为报答， 收下这张图—— 这张图标着一处藏身处， 里面有 @a$Amount$ 的货物。

en: I have just heard that an English ship full of settlers has sunk.
tr: 我刚听说， 一艘满载移民的英格兰船沉了。

en: I have just heard that a Dutch ship full of settlers has sunk.
tr: 我刚听说， 一艘满载移民的荷兰船沉了。

en: I am therefore assigning you the mission of capturing a colonial town belonging to %2 by %1.    The town must not be the seat of a governor or the viceroy!
tr: 所以我派你执行这项任务： 在 %1 之前攻占一座属于 %2 的殖民地城镇。 这座城镇不能是总督或副王的所在地！

en: %1,<n>greetings. Come on in, we may have something to discuss.
tr: %1 ，<n>欢迎光临， 我们有些事或许可以谈谈。

en: However, the war with @n$FoeNation$ has made this difficult. Can you help me?
tr: 可是与 @n$FoeNation$ 的战争让这件事很难办。 你能帮我吗？
摧毁海盗 @P$PirateName$ 的藏身处。

en: What a calamity! Have you visited @F$WifeName$ yet today? You can spare yourself the trouble, for she has gone. Look, I found a farewell letter of sorts. She writes that she is fed up with her dull life and that she has eloped with an adventurer. You must rescue my beloved daughter for me!
tr: 真是倒霉！ 今天你去见过 @F$WifeName$ 了吗？ 省省力气吧， 她已经不在了。 你看， 我找到了一封像是告别信的东西。 信上说， 她受够了这种乏味的生活， 跟一个冒险私奔了。 你必须替我救回我的宝贝女儿！

en: Ha! My daughter, and your wife, has eloped with one of my officers of the town guard! I might have guessed! Now they are both missing, having stolen one of my ships! You must return my daughter to me and make her see reason! Strangely enough, I came across a map on which a place is marked in my daughter's apartments.
tr: 哈！ 我女儿， 也就是你老婆， 跟我卫队的一名军官私奔了！ 我早该想到的！ 现在两个人都不见了， 还顺走了我一艘船！ 你必须把我女儿带回来， 让她回心转意！ 说来也巧， 我在一张地图上发现了一个地方， 就标在我女儿的住处里。

en: New building land is now available there.
tr: 那里现在有新的建造用地了。

en: You know that many things that are now quite commonplace in Europe were first discovered in America. But do you know what “gifts” Europe brought to the New World?
tr: 你知道， 如今在欧洲司空见惯的许多东西， 最早都是在美洲发现的。 但你知道欧洲带给新世界的那些 「礼物」 是什么吗？

en: The viceroy will only see you if you bear no ill will towards his nation and hold at least the rank of Boatswain.
tr: 只有当你对他的国家没有敌意、 且爵位至少达到事务长时， 副王才会接见你。

en: Henry Avery is a prime example of the successful pirate. He captured the richest ships of his time, managed to elude the authorities and live long enough to enjoy his wealth.<n><n>Avery's early years are shrouded in mystery. However, we do know that in June 1694 he was a mate on a privateer named Charles, which had been given permission by the Spanish to capture ships belonging to the French colony of Martinique in the West Indies. One day, he led a mutiny and seized control of the ship, whereupon most of the crew sided with him. The ship, a fast privateer with 46 cannons and ideally suited to the role of pirate ship, was renamed Fancy. In 1695, he succeeded in carrying out his greatest feat: The looting of the Indian treasure fleet. As part of an alliance with other pirates, he attacked a heavily armed Indian treasure fleet and managed to capture two ships. The ships belonged to the Grand Mogul himself and were loaded with unimaginable treasures. <n><n>After bribing the governor of the Bahamas to offer the pirates protection, Avery paid off the crew, who then scattered to the four corners of the earth. Some of them were captured in England but Avery sailed to Ireland, where he disappeared without trace. We can only assume that he continued to enjoy his wealth in hiding.
tr: 亨利·艾弗里是成功海盗的典型范例。 他劫获了当时最富有的船只， 成功躲避当局追捕， 并且活得足够久， 得以享受自己的财富。<n><n>艾弗里早年的经历笼罩在迷雾之中。 不过我们知道， 1694 年 6 月， 他还是一艘名叫 「查尔斯」 号的私掠船上的大副； 该船获得西班牙方面许可， 可以缉拿西印度群岛法属马提尼克殖民地的船只。 一天， 他煽动哗变夺下这艘船， 大部分船员随即站在了他一边。 这是一艘快速私掠船， 装有 46 门火炮， 极适合改作海盗船， 随后被改名为 「范西」。 1695 年， 他完成了自己最壮举的战绩： 劫掠印度宝藏船队。 作为与其他海盗结盟的一部分， 他袭击了一支重装戒备的印度宝藏船队， 并成功夺走两艘船。 这两艘船属于莫卧儿皇帝本人， 船上满载着难以想象的财富。<n><n>在买通巴哈马总督为海盗提供庇护之后， 艾弗里付清了船员工钱， 船员们随后四散天涯。 其中一些人在英格兰被捕， 但艾弗里航往爱尔兰， 从此杳无音讯。 我们只能推测， 他此后一直在隐居中享受自己的财富。

en: There are interesting anecdotes behind the many names that the seafarers and cartographers had to come up with for the new swathes of land, rivers and settlements. Even the first name given by the European explorers of the Age of Discovery in America tells its own story. Christopher Columbus named the island on which he landed on October 12th 1492 Salvador (“Savior“). This was to give thanks to the Lord for protecting the convoy from disease and storms during the outward journey and above all, for preventing a mutiny that threatened to break out literally at the last minute before land was sighted.<n><n>In the times that followed, the Spanish Conquistadors mostly chose names with religious connotations, for example “Nombre de Dios” (“The Name of God“) or “Trinidad” (“Trinity”). In other cases, people took inspiration from the date or from their observations of the landscape. For example, Portuguese sailors named a bay on the Brazilian coast that they discovered on New Year’s Day 1502 “January River” (Rio de Janeiro), and the name of the city of Montevideo refers to Magellan’s alleged exclamation on seeing the coastline for the first time: “Monte vido eu!” (“I see a mountain!”).<n><n>It was also a popular custom for explorers to name swathes of land and towns after their rulers, their mother country or the town from which they came. Not only did this communicate to the outside world a clear statement of tenure, it also created a connection to one’s home country even in these far-flung lands.<n><n>If all else failed, one could always fall back on the names from the native Indian languages (although, in most cases, this did not deter the colonizers from subsequently chasing away or exterminating the natives themselves).<n><n>To this day, the myth persists that, on being asked by James Cook what that strange marsupial was called, an Australian Aborigine replied “kangooroo” or “ganguru”, which allegedly only meant “What are you talking about?”. Even if this is a myth, these kinds of amusing misunderstandings must certainly have taken place. <n><n>One would probably be astonished at how many names of towns, mountains and rivers simply mean “good morning!”, “I beg your pardon?” or “leave me in peace!” ...
tr: 航海家和制图师为新发现的大片陆地、 河流和聚落想出的众多地名背后， 藏着许多有趣的轶事。 甚至连大航海时代的欧洲探险家们为美洲各地取的第一批名字， 也各自讲述着一段故事。 1492 年 10 月 12 日， 克里斯托弗·哥伦布把他登陆的那座岛命名为萨尔瓦多 （意即 「救世主」）。 这是为了感谢上帝在远航途中护佑船队免受疾病与风暴侵袭， 尤其是感谢祂在最紧要关头—— 就在陆地望见的前一刻—— 阻止了一场即将爆发的哗变。<n><n>在此之后的日子里， 西班牙征服者们大多选择带有宗教含义的名字， 例如 「上帝之镇」 （Nombre de Dios） 或 「三位一体」 （Trinidad）。 有时人们也会从日期出发， 或根据自己对地貌的观察来命名。 例如葡萄牙水手在1502 年元旦发现巴西海岸的一处海湾， 便把它命名为 「一月之河」 （Rio de Janeiro）； 而蒙得维的亚这个名字， 则源自麦哲伦据说第一次望见海岸时那句惊呼： 「Monte vido eu！」 （ 「我看见一座山！」）<n><n>探险家们还常常习惯性地用他们的统治者、 母国或故乡城镇来为远方的土地和城镇命名。 这不仅向外界清楚地宣示了领土归属， 也让他们即使身处这些偏远的土地上， 仍与自己的祖国保持着一份联系。<n><n>实在无计可施时， 人们总还能退回到当地原住民的语言上去取名 （尽管在多数情况下， 这并没有阻止殖民者事后把原住民赶走或灭绝）。<n><n>直到今天仍流传着这样一个神话： 詹姆斯·库克问一名澳大利亚原住民那种奇特的袋兽叫什么， 对方回答说 「kangooroo」 或 「ganguru」 —— 据说这个词其实只是 「你在说什么？」 的意思。 即便这只是个神话， 这类令人忍俊不禁的误解肯定确实发生过。<n><n>人们大概会惊讶于， 城镇、 山脉与河流的众多名字， 其实就意味着 「早上好！」 「对不起， 请再说一遍？」 或者 「别来烦我！」 ……

en: Can you imagine life without chocolate? You certainly should, because cocoa was unknown in the rest of the world before the discovery of America. The word cocoa probably originates from the Maya language, to which it can first be traced: It seems certain that Maya traders were drinking cocoa 400 years before the birth of Christ.<n><n>The Aztecs, who were the dominant power on the Central American continent since the 14th century, even bestowed a religious significance on cocoa. The first European to come into contact with this delicacy was, once again, Christopher Columbus, although this was on a later voyage in 1502 that took him to Nicaragua.<n><n>However, the rightful “discoverer” of cocoa is Hernan Cortés, conqueror of the Aztec kingdom, who brought back to Spain the recipe for a drink called xocoatl (hence the word “chocolate”). The taste was initially too bitter for the European palate and it was only after people started to add sugar or vanilla that hot chocolate become a popular drink among the Iberian upper classes.<n><n>The Spanish kept the recipe to themselves for nearly a hundred years, after which time hot chocolate spread through France and the rest of Europe. Around the year 1700, the British added milk. The final breakthrough of cocoa in Europe took place when it was discovered how delicious coffee and cocoa tasted together.
tr: 你能想象没有巧克力的生活吗？ 你大概真该想象一下， 因为在美洲被发现之前， 可可对世界其他地方来说都是闻所未闻的。 「cocoa」 这个词很可能源自玛雅语， 它的踪迹最早也只能追溯到那里： 几乎可以肯定， 玛雅商人在基督诞生前 400 年就在喝可可了。<n><n>阿兹特克人自 14 世纪起就是中美洲大陆上的主导力量， 他们甚至赋予可可以宗教意义。 第一位接触这种美味的欧洲人又一次是克里斯托弗·哥伦布， 不过那是1502 年的一次后期航程， 目的地是尼加拉瓜。<n><n>不过， 可可当之无愧的 「发现者」 是阿兹特克王国的征服者埃尔南·科尔特斯， 他把一种叫作 xocoatl 的饮品的配方带回了西班牙 （ 「chocolate」 一词即由此而来）。 那味道对欧洲人的舌头来说起初太苦， 直到人们开始加入糖或香草， 热巧克力才在伊比利亚的上流社会流行开来。<n><n>西班牙人把这份配方秘而不宣了将近一百年， 此后热巧克力才传遍法国和欧洲其他地区。 大约在 1700 年， 英国人往里面加了牛奶。 可可在欧洲的最终突破， 发生在人们发现咖啡与可可搭配起来竟如此美味的时候。

en: Although it is sometimes difficult to distinguish between reality and legend when one talks about piracy, there is no disputing the fact that there were women pirates. Two of the most dazzling figures set out on this course on the island of Jamaica during the early 18th century.<n><n>Anne Bonny, who was said to have been stabbed in the stomach while still a child, had eloped with a seaman to the pirate haven of New Providence (Nassau). There, she managed to get rid of her husband and start her own career on board a captured Dutch ship. <n><n>There, she met Mary Read, who had already fought in the Spanish Wars of Succession disguised as a man and who allegedly bared her breasts to her opponents before killing them, to prove to them that they had been beaten by a woman.<n><n>After their capture in the year 1720, they only escaped being sent to the gallows because they were pregnant. They fared better than most of their male sidekicks, on whose heads Anne Bonny could only pour scorn.<n><n>Below are the words she spoke to the infamous “Calico Jack” on his way to the gallows: “I’m sorry to see you here, Jack, but if you had only fought like a man, you wouldn’t be here to be hung like a dog”.
tr: 谈论海盗时， 事实与传说往往难以分辨， 但海上有过女海盗这一点却是不容争辩的。 18 世纪初， 牙买加岛上启程走在这条道路上的， 有两位最为耀眼的人物。<n><n>据说安妮·博尼小时候就曾被人一刀捅进肚子， 后来跟一名水手私奔到了新普罗维登斯 （拿骚） 这座海盗窝。 在那里， 她设法除掉了丈夫， 并在一艘被缴获的荷兰船上开启了自己的职业生涯。<n><n>在那里， 她遇见了玛丽·雷德—— 后者早在西班牙王位继承战争中就曾女扮男装作战， 据说还在杀死对手之前袒胸露乳， 好让对方明白自己是被一个女人打败的。<n><n>1720 年被俘之后， 两人之所以没有被送上绞架， 只因为她们正怀着身孕。 她们的运气比大多数男同伙都好得多， 而安妮·博尼对那些人， 则只能报以鄙夷。<n><n>下面便是那位臭名昭著的 「花布杰克」 被押赴刑场时， 她对他说的话： 「真遗憾在这里看到你， 杰克； 但如果你当初像个男人那样拼命， 你现在就不会像条狗一样被吊在这里了。」

en: He has a girl, somewhere in a town in the middle of the Caribbean, between Cancun, Havana, Trinidad and Roatán.
tr: 他在加勒比海中部、 坎昆、 哈瓦那、 特立尼达与罗阿坦之间的一座城镇有个情人。

en: Everyone has been given 5 cards. I'll call %1 points.<n><n>If you want to play, you must call one point higher.
tr: 每个人都已拿到 5 张牌。 我报 %1 分。<n><n>想玩的话， 你必须报得更高一分。

en: Damn, I should have won that point. I've lost the game.
tr: 该死， 这分本该是我的。 我输了这局。

en: You've taken all my gold. Order me a bottle of rum, and then please leave me alone to drown my sorrows.
tr: 你把我的金子全拿走了。 给我上一瓶朗姆酒， 然后让我一个人借酒消愁吧。

en: Now you've done it! I won’t be able to show my face at home tonight.
tr: 这下你可把我害惨了！ 今晚我都没脸回家见人了。

en: Well done! Your convoy is now armed and ready for a small-scale battle.<n>As it happens, the Governor of Cartagena now has the perfect mission for you.<n>Click on the governor's building and accept his mission.
tr: 做得好！ 你的船队已经武装完毕， 可以打一场小规模的海战了。<n>巧的是， 卡塔赫纳的总督正好有一件委托要交给你。<n>点击总督府， 接受他的委托。

en: Very good, you have located the convoy.<n>Your next step is to clear your ship for action and prepare to engage in combat. To do so, open the list of ships in your convoy and select your sloop. To declare it as a warship, press the button next to the cannon. You can then "attack" the convoy by right-clicking on it.
tr: 很好， 你已经找到那支船队了。<n>下一步是把你的船整备到可以作战的状态。 为此打开船队的船只列表， 选中你的单桅帆船。 要把它定为军舰， 请按火炮旁边的那个按钮。 随后右键点击那支船队， 即可对它发起"攻击"。

en: Select the ship that you want to control in the sea battle from among your escort ships.<n><n>You can select another escort ship at any stage by clicking on it in the list.<n><n>But beware: As soon as the battle starts, each ship can only be selected once!
tr: 从你的护航船中选出你希望指挥的那一艘参加海战。<n><n>在任意阶段， 你都可以点击列表中的另一艘护航船来更换选择。<n><n>但要注意： 战斗一旦开始， 每艘船只能被选中一次！

en: Welcome, %1.<n><n>You already have a building permit and you may build in this town.
tr: 欢迎， %1 。<n><n>你已经持有建筑许可， 可以在这座城镇建造。

en: Save game error. Loading not possible.
tr: 保存游戏出错， 无法载入。

en: This strange device looks like an arrow. The vanes on it cause it to rotate as soon as you hold it in the water. A little dial counts each revolution, thus enabling you to calculate the ship's speed very accurately.
tr: 这件奇特的装置看起来像一支箭。 一放进水里， 它上面的叶片就会带着它旋转。 一个小转盘会数清每一圈的圈数， 让你得以非常准确地算出船速。

en: You still need %1 to reach the next rank
tr: 你还需要 %1 才能升到下一级

en: To change details, click on the town. Move and delete by dragging with your mouse.
tr: 要更改详情， 请点击该城镇。 用鼠标拖动即可移动和删除。

en: Your warships fought valiantly but could not repel the attack.
tr: 你的军舰英勇作战， 但没能击退这次进攻。

en: %1,<n>your mission was to capture a town, but you have failed. I hope you will stick to our agreements next time.
tr: %1 ，<n>你的委托是攻占一座城镇， 但你失败了。 希望下次你还记得我们的约定。

en: %1 has looted the legendary Spanish treasure fleet.
tr: %1 抢走了传说中的西班牙珍宝船队。

en: Meet the governor's emissary at the marketplace of @T$TOWN$ by @D$Date$ and deliver @a$Amount$ of wine, tools and spices. You must deliver all the goods together.
tr: 在 @D$Date$ 之前到 @T$TOWN$ 的市集上拜见总督的特使， 并交付 @a$Amount$ 葡萄酒、 工具和香料。 三种货物必须一并交付。

en: You have defeated the English buccaneer %1 in a duel and taken him hostage.
tr: 你在决斗中击败了英格兰私掠者 %1 ， 并把他扣为人质。

en: You have defeated the Spanish buccaneer %1 in a duel and taken him hostage.
tr: 你在决斗中击败了西班牙私掠者 %1 ， 并把他扣为人质。

en: The captain of the convoy is on the enemy ship. He suggests to your captain that the battle should be decided by a duel.<n><n>To spare the sailors, your captain accepts the challenge.
tr: 船队船长登上了敌船。 他向你的船长提议， 这场战斗应由一场决斗来定胜负。<n><n>为了避免水手伤亡， 你的船长接受了他的挑战。

en: The pirate %1 has defeated your captain in a fair duel. The captain nobly accepts the outcome and duly orders a retreat.
tr: 海盗 %1 在一场公正的决斗中击败了你的船长。 船长高尚地接受了结果， 并下令撤退。

en: While you are looting the town, a young woman comes running up to you.<n>"I know this attack is only being carried out on my father's orders! Did he tell you that I am here of my own free will and that I am truly in love with my abductor? I beg you not to take me back, I will reward you!".<n><n>Do you want to abandon the daughter to her fate here in @T$TargetTown$?
tr: 你正在洗劫城镇时， 一名年轻女子跑向你。<n>「我知道这次袭击只是奉我父亲的命令！ 难道他没告诉你， 我是自愿留在这里， 而且我真心爱着绑架我的这个人？ 我求你不要带我走， 我会报答你的！」<n><n>你要把总督的女儿丢在 @T$TargetTown$ ， 任她自生自灭吗？

en: You are a man of action. A transport convoy will shortly arrive here and will be leaving port for Europe on @D$DepartDate$. Sail ahead of it and secure its route to protect the convoy from attack.
tr: 你是个行动派。 一支运输船队很快就会抵达这里， 并将在 @D$DepartDate$ 离港前往欧洲。 抢在它前面航行， 为它保驾护航， 使它免遭袭击。

en: Select your ship and press the Fast Forward button.
tr: 选中你的船， 然后按快速前进按钮。

en: The position lies off the coast of %1.
tr: 那个位置在 %1 的海岸外。

en: The place lies somewhere not far from %1.
tr: 那个地方在离 %1 不远的某处。

en: Excellent! You restored the population of Tortuga within @I$Days$ days.
tr: 太好了！ 你在 @I$Days$ 天内恢复了托尔图加的人口。

en: I have just learned that the buccaneer %1 has recently left %2 to attack one of our towns. I hope we can stop him before he strikes.
tr: 我刚听说私掠者 %1 最近离开了 %2 ， 要来攻打我们的城镇。 希望我们能在他动手之前拦住他。

en: %1,<n>it’s been quite a while, but I’m happy to see you again. I have some news for you.
tr: %1 ，<n>过了挺久了， 不过见到你真高兴。 我有些消息要告诉你。

en: I recently overheard a conversation in which a trader mentioned that one of his ships had sunk. He wasn't too concerned about the ship, as it was only a rickety old tub. But it had a special chest on board.
tr: 我最近无意中听到一段对话， 一个商人提到他有条船沉了。 他倒不太在意那条船， 那不过是一条摇摇晃晃的老破船。 但船上有一只特别的箱子。

en: Today, the pirate %1 started wreaking havoc in the Caribbean.
tr: 今天， 海盗 %1 开始在加勒比地区大肆作乱。

en: Natives have attacked the town and looted all the luxury goods. The attack claimed the lives of %1 citizens.
tr: 原住民袭击了城镇， 抢走了所有奢侈品。 这次袭击夺去了 %1 名市民的性命。

en: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>You have discovered a huge goods cache and take the goods on board.
tr: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>你发现了一处巨大的货物藏点， 把货物装上了船。

en: I see you are a wealthy man, %1.<n><n>I would normally ask you for a loan, but unfortunately I can only do such business with local traders. Therefore, you must be able to produce a building permit for my town.
tr: 我看得出你是个有钱人， %1 。<n><n>换作平时， 我会向你讨一笔贷款， 可这笔生意我只和本地商人做。 所以， 你得能在我的城镇里拿到一张建造许可。

en: Loot the town of @T$TargetTown$, which belongs to @n$HostileNation$, and free the governor's wife by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 洗劫属于 @n$HostileNation$ 的城镇 @T$TargetTown$ ， 并在 @D$EndDate$ 之前救出总督的妻子。

en: X is a town that has streets paved with gold. Its majestic harbor is a sight to behold.
tr: X 是一座街道以黄金铺就的城镇。 它雄伟的港口值得一看。

en: What? You mean you threw the dog overboard? I am nevertheless very grateful to you. Naturally, I cannot officially reward you, but I once hid treasure in a secret location. Here is a map.
tr: 什么？ 你把狗扔下海了？ 不过我还是很感激你。 我自然没法公开奖赏你， 但我年轻时曾在某个隐秘之处藏过一批财宝。 地图给你。

en: You begin your career in the English town of %1 in the year %2.<n><n>
tr: 你在 %2 年于英格兰城镇 %1 开始自己的生涯。<n><n>

en: Look for him in the inns there. Believe me, you can take your time, but if you do happen to see him, send him my best regards and tell him he might like to remind my sister what he looks like!
tr: 去那儿的旅店里找找吧。 信我， 慢慢找没关系， 但要是真碰上了， 替我向他问好， 再提醒他一句： 他该让我妹妹记清楚他长什么样了！

en: Hunt down and kill the bounty hunter staying near the town of @T$Town$ by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前追查到并杀死盘踞在 @T$Town$ 附近的赏金猎人。
摧毁一支英国军事船队。

en: Build a cotton production facility in Santa Marta and increase your cash to @g$GoldGoal$ from trade.
tr: 在圣玛尔塔建造棉花生产设施， 并通过贸易把现金增加到 @g$GoldGoal$ 。

en: The Bermuda Islands are named after the Spanish explorer Juan Bermúdez who discovered them in 1503. The infamous area known to all seafarers as the “Bermuda Triangle”, in which the risk of mysterious shipping accidents is said to be very high, covers an area of the sea between the Bermuda Islands, Puerto Rico and Fort Lauderdale (Florida).<n><n>Some people maintain that the strange series of inexplicable events started with the voyage of Christopher Columbus: The seafarer from Genoa in the service of Spain found himself with his three ships on September 14th 1492 in this very area, when his compass needle began to spin wildly. This was caused by the difference between the geographic north pole and the magnetic north pole. The next day, an enormous flame appeared in the sky (possibly a meteor).<n><n>However, the nickname “Bermuda Triangle” only emerged after the Second World War, following a series of aircraft accidents that drew the public’s attention to this area in the southwest of the North Atlantic.<n><n>Followers of mysterious events point to more than 200 alleged unexplained accidents, although they interpret the borders somewhat generously. Most of these events, a large number of which did not even occur in the area, have a perfectly logical explanation.
tr: 百慕大群岛得名于西班牙探险家胡安·贝尔穆德斯， 他于 1503 年发现了它们。 而那个所有航海人都耳熟能详的、 据说神秘海难事故发生率极高的恶名区域—— 「百慕大三角」 —— 涵盖的是百慕大群岛、 波多黎各与劳德代尔堡 （佛罗里达） 之间的一片海域。<n><n>有些人坚持认为， 这一连串离奇事件要从克里斯托弗·哥伦布的航程算起： 1492 年 9 月 14 日， 这位为西班牙效力的热那亚航海家发现自己的三艘船正好位于这片海域， 而他的罗盘指针此时开始疯狂旋转。 这是地理北极与磁北极之间的差异造成的。 第二天， 天空中出现了一道巨大的火焰 （可能是流星）。<n><n>然而 「百慕大三角」 这个称呼其实是在第二次世界大战之后才出现的： 接连发生的一系列飞机失事事故， 才把公众的注意力引向北大西洋西南部的这片海域。<n><n>这些离奇事件的信徒列举了两百多起所谓无法解释的事故， 不过他们对边界划得颇为宽松。 这些事件中的大多数—— 其中相当多甚至压根没发生在这一带—— 都有完全合理的解释。

en: You are to loot French ships and seize a certain number of goods.
tr: 你要劫掠法国船只， 并夺取一定数量的货物。

en: You are to loot Dutch ships and seize a certain number of goods.
tr: 你要劫掠荷兰船只， 并夺取一定数量的货物。

en: You have won 1 point.<n>Choose your next card.
tr: 你赢了 1 分。<n>选你的下一张牌。

en: Well, the game went in my favor after all. I'm afraid you've lost.
tr: 嗯， 这局终究还是对我有利。 恐怕你输了。

en: This time, you begin the scenario in Cartagena, a governor town in the middle of the Caribbean.<n>Your convoy, which consists of a sloop, is in the harbor.<n>First you must arm your convoy because this scenario will involve sea battles.<n>Go to the docks and open the Cargo menu.
tr: 这一次， 你在加勒比海腹地的总督城卡塔赫纳开始这个剧本。<n>你那只由一艘单桅帆船组成的船队正在港口里。<n>你必须先为船队武装起来， 因为这个剧本会涉及海战。<n>去码头， 打开货物菜单。

en: I have further important information for you concerning the war with %1.<n><n>
tr: 关于与 %1 的战争， 我还有更重要的情报要告诉你。<n><n>

en: It contained a new collection of ladies' fashion from Paris.
tr: 里面是一批从巴黎寄来的最新女士时装。

en: You have now learned some of the basic controls and know how to send a convoy from one town to another. This is very important, because at first you will make your living by transporting and trading goods between the towns.<n><n>In the second part of this scenario, you will buy a ship and add it to your existing convoy.<n><n>Here's another tip:<n><n>You can press F1 at any time during the game to display a help page explaining the keyboard and mouse configuration.<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Your convoy with two ships must reach the harbor of the town of Cartagena.
tr: 你已经学会了一些基本操作， 也知道如何把一支船队从一座城镇派往另一座城镇了。 这非常重要， 因为在最初阶段， 你要靠在这些城镇之间运输和贸易货物来谋生。<n><n>在这个剧本的第二部分， 你将买下一艘船， 把它编入你现有的船队。<n><n>再给你一个提示：<n><n>游戏过程中任何时候按 F1， 都会弹出一页帮助， 说明键盘和鼠标的设置方式。<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>让你那支由两艘船组成的船队抵达卡塔赫纳港。

en: I am %1. Are you interested in doing business? If you give me a convoy, I will share %2 of my booty with you. You can even tell me which waters you want me to operate in. You can hand me over any convoy with up to 5 ships.
tr: 我是 %1 。 有兴趣和我做笔生意吗？ 你给我一支船队， 我就分你 %2 的战利品。 你甚至可以指定要我活动的水域。 随便交给我一支不超过 5 艘船的船队都行。

en: The pirate %1 has become more powerful. He now has %2 ships.
tr: 海盗 %1 变得更强大了， 如今他拥有 %2 艘船。

en: My thanks to you for destroying the pirate convoy. Here is a reward of @g$GoldReward$. If luck is on our side, we will soon discover the location of the pirate hideout. Then we can destroy it.
tr: 谢谢你摧毁了这支海盗船队。 这是给你的报酬 @g$GoldReward$ 。 如果运气好， 我们很快就能查到海盗据点的位置。 到时就能把它摧毁。

en: Oh, look. I've just received a message from my courier. The mission I was about to give you is no longer valid. I must have left it sitting on my desk for too long!
tr: 哦， 瞧。 我刚收到信使带来的消息。 我本来要交给你的那个任务已经作废了。 想必是我把它压在桌上太久了！

en: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>You have picked up a sailor from @n$Nation$. To thank you for rescuing him, he tells you where you can find many barrels of valuable debris. @l$DebrisPos$
tr: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>你救起一名来自 @n$Nation$ 的水手。 为感谢你救了他， 他告诉你哪里能找到许多桶贵重的残骸货物。 @l$DebrisPos$

en: You have just received two messages with some tips for successful trading.<n>Open the log to read the messages.<n>
tr: 你刚收到两条消息， 里面有些成功贸易的诀窍。<n>打开日志来读一读这些消息。<n>

en: Increase your convoy's firepower to at least 90 cannons.
tr: 把你船队的火力提升到至少 90 门火炮。

en: I am very grateful to you. A transport convoy will leave my harbor on @D$DepartDate$. I want you to protect it from military convoys from @n$HostileNation$ and make sure that reaches Europe safely.
tr: 我非常感谢你。 一支运输船队将在 @D$DepartDate$ 从我的港口出发。 我要你保护它免受 @n$HostileNation$ 军事船队的攻击， 确保它平安抵达欧洲。

en: Today, the %1 buccaneer %2 docked in the harbor of the town under a false flag,  posing as a trader. By so doing, he was able to buy stocks in the town. Many goods are now unavailable or very scarce.
tr: 今天， %1 私掠者 %2 挂着假旗停靠在城镇港口， 假扮成商人。 就这样， 他在镇上买下了大量存货。 如今许多货物要么缺货， 要么极其稀少。

en: As a result of your continuing poor relationship with %1, %3 of your businesses in %2 were seized today.
tr: 由于你与 %1 的关系一直很差， 你设在 %2 的产业中有 %3 处于今日被查封。

en: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>You have found a huge goods cache in the place the castaway described, and you take the goods on board.
tr: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>你在那个遇难者描述的地点发现了一处巨大的货物藏点， 把货物装上了船。

en: <n><n>The scenario is over when you close this window.
tr: <n><n>关闭这个窗口时， 剧本即告结束。

en: You may now control %1 captains and own %2 concession.<n>You have just received a message containing hints on the subject of “reputation”.
tr: 你现在可以指挥 %1 名船长， 并持有 %2 处让与权。<n>你刚收到一条消息， 内容是关于 「声望」 的提示。

en: You are in the colonial town of Santa Marta. Click on the town name to display the town information.
tr: 你现在身处殖民地城镇圣玛尔塔。 点击城镇名称， 即可显示城镇信息。

en: @s$USER$, I have some information that I'm sure is worth @g$Price$ to you. My brother-in-law knows @N$TeacherName$, a retired captain.
tr: @s$USER$ ， 我有些消息， 我相信对你来说值 @g$Price$ 。 我姐夫认识 @N$TeacherName$ ， 一位退役船长。

en: %1,<n>There you are, I was just wondering where you’ve been all this time. I have some news for you.
tr: %1 ，<n>你来得正好， 我正琢磨你这些天跑哪儿去了。 我有消息告诉你。

en: I am happy to see you.
You have defeated the %1 buccaneer %2 in a duel and taken him hostage. You can go to a Governor of his nation to demand a ransom for him.
tr: 你在决斗中击败了私掠者 %1 %2 ， 并扣下他做了人质。 你可以去找他本国的一位总督， 要求赎回他。

en: Come in, my son. Will you not sit yourself down to pray?
tr: 进来吧， 我的孩子。 坐下来祷告好吗？

en: That will be all for today. I wish you the best of luck until we meet again.
tr: 今天就到这里吧。 愿你一切顺利， 我们下次再会。

en: Two abandoned ships are located two days north of Cartagena. I want you to dispose of them.
tr: 卡塔赫纳以北两天航程处有两艘废弃的船。 我要你去处理掉它们。

en: Thank you kindly. The town in question is called @T$TargetTown$. I hope I can come to an arrangement with the traders before @D$EndDate$. Until then, the town cannot fall below the status "Boom", so I can negotiate from a stronger position.
tr: 多谢了。 那座城镇名叫 @T$TargetTown$ 。 我希望能赶在 @D$EndDate$ 之前和那里的商人谈妥条件。 在此之前， 这座城镇的等级不能跌到 「繁荣」 以下， 那我谈判时才更有底气。

en: The town in difficulty is @T$TargetTown$. Its status cannot fall below "Boom" before @D$EndDate$, otherwise too many citizens will leave the town. There is even the risk of a plague breaking out there. You must ensure that you supply the town with enough goods in time to prevent this!
tr: 陷入困境的那座城镇是 @T$TargetTown$ 。 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前， 它的等级不能跌到 「繁荣」 以下， 否则太多市民会离城而去， 那里甚至有爆发瘟疫的风险。 你必须及时给城镇供应足够的货物， 阻止这一幕！

en: Form a second convoy and increase your total assets to @g$GoldGoal$.
tr: 组建第二支船队， 并把总资产增加到 @g$GoldGoal$ 。

en: I have just heard that a French ship full of settlers has sunk.
tr: 我刚听说， 一艘满载移民的法国船沉了。

en: Thank you for doing me this favor.<n><n>Now to our agreement. The old captain is called @N$TeacherName$ and he has retired not far from here.<n><n>@l$TeacherPos$<n><n>Look along the coast there and you will find him.<n><n>Bring @a$Amount$ of rum with you or he won’t be willing to help.
tr: 谢谢你帮我这个忙。<n><n>现在来谈谈我们的约定。 老船长名叫 @N$TeacherName$ ， 退休后住得不远。<n><n>@l$TeacherPos$<n><n>沿那附近的海岸找找就能找到他。<n><n>带上 @a$Amount$ 的朗姆酒， 不然他不会愿意帮忙。

en: I am therefore assigning you the mission of capturing a colonial town belonging to %2 by %1.    The town must not be the seat of a governor or the viceroy!<n><n>To avoid problems with the other nations, I will issue you with a Letter of Marque against %2.
tr: 所以我派你执行这项任务： 在 %1 之前攻占一座属于 %2 的殖民地城镇。 这座城镇不能是总督或副王的所在地！<n><n>为免和其他国家起纠纷， 我会给你一张针对 %2 的私掠许可证。

en: Disaster has struck and it appears to me that you are in the thick of it. My daughter has been abducted by pirates, but someone has left you a message with a map showing the location of a particular spot. It looks to me like a trap, but what are we to do? You have to rescue my daughter!
tr: 大祸临头， 而我看你正身处风暴中心。 我女儿被海盗劫走了， 不过有人给你留了一条消息， 还附了一张地图， 标出某个地点。 在我看来这多半是个陷阱， 可我们又能怎么办？ 你必须救回我女儿！

en: A number of traders have joined forces and are demanding greater protection in our waters. To back up their demands, they have decided to stop supplying one of our towns soon. Can you intervene to help me and the citizens?
tr: 一些商人联合起来， 要求在我们的海域获得更充分的保护。 为表明态度， 他们决定近期停止为我们的某座城镇供货。 你能出手相助， 帮我和市民们解围吗？

en: The first encounters between the native inhabitants of the New World and the white seafarers generally passed off peacefully. In many places, the Europeans were greeted as gods. Here and there, this impression was based on old myths, but in most cases, the Native Americans were simply impressed by the tall blonde strangers that arrived in shimmering armor on their “water houses” (ships).<n><n>Columbus, Cortez and all the other explorers were only too delighted to perpetuate this illusion, but the Native Americans were confronted with the brutal reality soon enough: Driven by their insatiable lust for gold, the “Spanish disease” as the Native Americans called it, the Spaniards abused, enslaved and massacred entire populations. The sight of horses, hitherto unknown in America, and the sound of the canons caused utter panic and those that survived the massacre soon succumbed to smallpox, influenza or another imported disease.<n><n>Famous intellectuals such as Gonzolo Oviedo or Juan de Sepulveda tried to justify the crimes committed by the Europeans by using blood-curdling racist arguments that portrayed the native American race as being base, ignorant and inferior.<n><n>The same men who had scientists and witches burnt at the stake because of their beliefs, were well versed in the art of creating shocking accounts of the “bestial customs” of the Native Americans: Although the practices of idolatry, sacrificing humans and cannibalism were by no means imaginary, they were used henceforth by the white man as a blanket justification for imposing the most brutal sanctions of every kind on the Native Americans.
tr: 新大陆的原住民与白人航海者之间的最初接触， 一般来说都是和平的。 在许多地方， 欧洲人被当作神祇般迎接。 这种印象的来源， 一部分来自古老传说， 但更多时候， 只是因为那些金发高个的陌生人乘坐熠熠生辉的 「水上房屋」 （船只） 而来， 让原住民惊骇不已。<n><n>哥伦布、 科尔特斯以及所有其他探险家， 都乐见其成地维持着这个误会， 但原住民很快就面对了残酷的事实： 西班牙人被永无止境的黄金欲所驱动， 一场原住民称之为 「西班牙病」 的噩梦就此展开—— 他们凌虐、 奴役并屠杀整族整族的人口。 美洲此前从未见过马匹—— 那高头大马的模样； 火炮的轰鸣更令人失声惊惶。 幸存下来的那些人也很快死于天花、 流感， 或其他某种被带进来的疾病。<n><n>贡萨洛·奥维耶多、 胡安·德·塞普尔维达之类的名士， 曾试图用骇人听闻的种族主义论调为欧洲人所犯的罪行开脱， 把美洲原住民的种族描绘成卑劣、 无知且低人一等。<n><n>同样这些人—— 他们曾因为他人的信仰而把科学家和女巫绑上火刑柱， 也深谙炮制骇人听闻的 「野蛮习俗」 故事之道： 偶像崇拜、 活人献祭和食人这些做法固然并非虚构， 但从今以后， 白人却干脆把这一整套清单当作一张万能的免责声明， 用来为对原住民施加各种最残暴的惩罚开脱。

en: The first part of America that rose to great importance under the Spanish was Hispaniola. Christopher Columbus had already founded the first European settlement here in 1493, although it had been wiped out by Native Americans even before he returned from Europe.<n><n>Over the following years, the Spanish Crown took increasing control of this island. The first monastery and the first cathedral were built, and it was here that the social system that was to be extended to the other areas was first established: A slave-holding society, strictly divided into classes and closely associated with the Catholic Church.<n><n>Hisponiola seemed to offer huge opportunities and attracted many enterprising settlers across the ocean. <n><n>However, it was not long before Spain directed its attention to other regions: By now, the great realms of the continent had been discovered and conquered. Here, it was easier to rule, the deposits of gold and silver were richer and easier to extract.<n><n>Just like a toy that has been tossed aside, people lost interest in Hispaniola. Dutch, English and French pirates took turns to mount attacks. In 1697, the French took control of Saint Domingue, the western part of the island (today Haiti) and established a profitable plantation economy. The production of cocoa, sugar, indigo, cotton and coffee made Saint Domingue the most profitable colony in the New World in the 18th century.<n><n>The only successful slave revolt in history, which erupted as a result of the French Revolution, eventually led to the independence of Haiti in 1804. The rebels treated their former oppressors very much as they had been treated themselves: "For the declaration of independence, we need the skin of a white man for the parchment, his skull as an inkwell, his blood as ink and a bayonet for a pen" announced the black General, Boisrond-Tonnerre at the time.
tr: 在西班牙统治下最先取得重要地位的美洲地区， 是伊斯帕尼奥拉岛。 克里斯托弗·哥伦布早在 1493 年就在这里建立了第一座欧洲殖民点， 尽管在他从欧洲返回之前， 这地方就已经被原住民夷为平地。<n><n>在此之后的日子里， 西班牙王室逐步加强了对这座岛屿的控制。 第一座修道院和第一座主教座堂建了起来， 日后将被推广到其他地区的社会制度， 也正是在这里初步成形： 一个蓄奴的社会， 等级划分极为严格， 与天主教会紧密结合。<n><n>伊斯帕尼奥拉似乎提供了巨大的机会， 吸引了许多雄心勃勃的移民渡海而来。<n><n>然而没过多久， 西班牙就把目光转向了别处： 此时大陆上的那些宏大国度已经被发现并征服了。 在这里统治更容易， 金银矿藏也更富、 更易开采。<n><n>伊斯帕尼奥拉就像一件被丢到一旁的玩具， 人们对它失去了兴趣。 荷兰、 英国和法国的海盗轮番发起攻击。 1697 年， 法国人控制了岛上的西部圣多明各 （今日海地）， 并建立起了赚钱的种植园经济。 可可、 糖、 靛蓝、 棉花和咖啡的产量， 让圣多明各在 18 世纪成为新世界最赚钱的殖民地。<n><n>历史上唯一一次成功的奴隶起义， 起因是法国大革命， 最终导致海地在 1804 年独立。 起义者对待昔日压迫者的方式， 与压迫者当初对待他们的方式如出一辙： 「为了宣布独立， 我们需要一张白人的皮当羊皮纸， 用他的颅骨作墨水瓶， 用他的血作墨水， 再用一把刺刀作笔——」 黑人将军布瓦隆-东内尔当时这样宣布。

en: A typical Caribbean product, though of questionable benefit to mankind, is rum. This spirit made from sugar-cane molasses, which originally bore the colorful name of “devil killer”, was first alluded to in Barbados in 1650. As the pirates’ legendary drink of choice, most people tend to associate rum with the island of Jamaica, one of the most feared pirate’s dens of all time. <n><n>Slave traders sold the human merchandise that they had purchased on the African coast in the Caribbean for large quantities of molasses. This molasses was refined into rum in New England and then transported to Africa on the very same ships. The spirit was sold in Africa and the empty ships were then loaded with a fresh cargo of slaves. With this fatal “triangle trade”, the ship owners ensured that their ships were always fully laden on every voyage.
tr: 朗姆酒是加勒比的典型产物， 尽管它对人类是否真有好处很值得怀疑。 这种用甘蔗糖蜜酿成的烈酒， 最初有个耸人听闻的名字—— 「撒旦杀手」， 早在 1650 年就已在巴巴多斯被人提及。 作为海盗传奇性的首选饮品， 大多数人都会把朗姆酒与牙买加岛联系起来， 它曾是最令人胆寒的海盗巢穴之一。<n><n>奴隶贩子把他们在非洲海岸买来的人口货物， 在加勒比大量换成糖蜜。 这些糖蜜在新英格兰被蒸馏成朗姆酒， 然后又由同一批船运回非洲。 烈酒在非洲就地卖掉， 空船再装上新鲜的一船奴隶。 通过这套致命的 「三角贸易」， 船主们确保自己的船在每一次航程中都是满载。

en: %1,<n>in normal circumstances I wouldn't see you now, but times are hard and I have something to discuss with you.
tr: %1 ，<n>换作平时我不会在这个时候见你， 但眼下时局艰难， 我有些事要跟你谈。

en: So be it. I want you to destroy @I$NumConvoys$ military convoys belonging to @n$TargetNation$. You must hurry, for the success of the entire operation depends on the element of surprise. You therefore only have until @D$EndDate$.
tr: 就这么办。 我要你摧毁 @I$NumConvoys$ 支属于 @n$TargetNation$ 的军事船队。 你必须抓紧时间， 因为整个行动的成功取决于出其不意。 所以你只有到 @D$EndDate$ 的期限。

en: I'm afraid you have taken too long to reply. Speak with my daughter first to see if she still wants you.
tr: 恐怕你回话太慢了。 先去和我女儿谈谈， 看看她是否还愿意跟你走。

en: Oh no, not you again! I can still remember our last game. Do you still not have enough? Well, I won't be playing with you for the time being.
tr: 哦不， 怎么又是你！ 上一局的事我还记得清清楚楚。 你还没玩够？ 好吧， 暂时我不跟你玩了。

en: I have won 1 point.<n>And here is my card.
tr: 我赢了 1 分。<n>这是我的牌。

en: I have the following mission for you.<n><n>
tr: 我有一件委托想交给你。<n><n>

en: It was used to store perfumed rose petals.
tr: 这里曾用来存放香玫瑰花瓣。

en: The chest contained a general's uniform, an Indian costume, workers' garments and a leather suit.
tr: 箱子里装着一身将军制服、 一套印度服饰、 工人的衣服和一套皮装。

en: It also contained berets with earmuffs.
tr: 里面还有带耳罩的贝雷帽。

en: You can now boost your reputation in %1 by attacking Dutch ships and towns. This will not diminish your reputation in the other nations.
tr: 你现在可以通过袭击荷兰船只和城镇来提升在 %1 的声望， 这不会让你在其他国家的好感下降。

en: In %1, a business owned by a local trader has been demolished.
tr: 在 %1 ， 本地商人名下的一家产业被拆毁了。

en: You have received a Letter of Marque against Spain.
tr: 你已获得针对西班牙的私掠特许状。

en: In the full version of the game, you can attack towns from land or from the sea.
tr: 在游戏的完整版本中， 你可以从陆路或海路攻打城镇。

en: Ensure that your town has a supply of @a$Amount$ of all goods.
tr: 确保你的城镇有 @a$Amount$ 的各类货物储备。

en: You can now boost your reputation in %1 by attacking Spanish ships and towns. This will not diminish your reputation in the other nations.
tr: 你现在可以通过袭击西班牙船只和城镇来提升在 %1 的声望， 这不会让你在其他国家的好感下降。

en: Today, the %1 buccaneer %2  tried to storm the town. However, the attack was successfully repulsed.
tr: 今天， %1 私掠者 %2 试图强攻这座城镇。 不过这次进攻被成功击退了。

en: You have defeated the French buccaneer %1 in a duel and taken him hostage.
tr: 你在决斗中击败了法国私掠者 %1 ， 并把他扣为人质。

en: You have defeated the Dutch buccaneer %1 in a duel and taken him hostage.
tr: 你在决斗中击败了荷兰私掠者 %1 ， 并把他扣为人质。

en: The town is flourishing due to a gold discovery
tr: 因发现金矿， 这座城镇日益繁荣

en: I must thank you once again, you have done so much for my nation. As a reward, I shall give you the remaining land for your town %1. You now own the entire district.
tr: 我必须再次感谢你， 你为我国做了这么多。 作为奖赏， 我把城镇 %1 剩下的土地也给你。 现在你拥有整个区域了。

en: Greetings, @A$USER$. I am offering you @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ at a unit price of @g$Price$. Are you interested?
tr: 你好， @A$USER$ 。 我这里有 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ ， 单价 @g$Price$ 。 你有兴趣吗？

en: Hello @A$USER$. I have @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$. I would be happy to get rid of it at a unit price of @g$Price$. Are you interested?
tr: 你好， @A$USER$ 。 我有 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ ， 愿意按单价 @g$Price$ 全部脱手。 你有兴趣吗？

en: While looting the town, your crew also discovered where the Governor's wife was hiding and "freed" the woman. She wasin the kitchen at the time.<n> "Don't take me back to the Governor in @T$TOWN$. I never loved him, I swear it!".<n><n>Do you want to take this woman with you and bring her back to the Governor despite her pleas ?
tr: 洗劫城镇时， 你的船员还发现了总督的妻子藏身之处， 把她给 「放」 了出来。 当时她正在厨房里。<n>「别把我送回 @T$TOWN$ 的总督那里。 我从来没爱过他， 我发誓！」<n><n>尽管她苦苦哀求， 你还要把这个女人带走、 送回总督吗？

en: That's agreed then, thank you. If my information is correct, the treasure fleet recently left @T$StartTown$ and is en route to @T$DestTown$. There it will anchor for longer than usual. Now make haste and intercept it!
tr: 那就说定了， 谢谢。 如果我的情报没错， 宝藏船队最近已离开 @T$StartTown$ ， 正驶向 @T$DestTown$ ， 会在那里停留得比平时更久。 现在赶紧去截住它！

en: The place lies not far off the coast of %1.
tr: 那个地方离 %1 的海岸不远。

en: The place lies somewhere 2 to 3 days' journey to the east of %1.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 以东两到三天航程处的某处。

en: The position lies in an area 1 day’s journey from %1.
tr: 那个位置在离 %1 一天航程的区域内。

en: Destroy the convoy belonging to the trader @N$Name$. His hometown is @T$Town$. You have until @D$EndDate$.
tr: 摧毁属于商人 @N$Name$ 的船队。 他的家乡是 @T$Town$ 。 你有 @D$EndDate$ 的时间。

en: As you know, your first building in a town must always be a warehouse. You cannot construct any other buildings until you have built this.<n>You already have a warehouse in the town where you started the game. Find it and click on it. It is shown in light blue on the screen.
tr: 你已经知道， 在城镇里建造的第一座建筑必须是仓库。 在建成之前你无法建造其他任何建筑。<n>你在游戏起始的那座城镇里已经有一座仓库。 找出它并点击它， 它在屏幕上显示为浅蓝色。

en: Click on one of your cocoa plantations.
tr: 点击你的可可种植园之一。

en: You already attacked the town of %1 in the last 30 days. The captain refuses to attack it again on moral grounds.
tr: 你在过去 30 天里已经袭击过 %1 这座城镇。 船长出于道义理由拒绝再次进攻。

en: Today, %1 %2 captured the town of %4 for %3. %5 now has %6 towns in the New World, while %7 is only represented by a single town in the New World.
tr: 今天， %1・%2 为 %3 攻下了 %4 这座城镇。 %5 在新世界如今有 %6 座城镇， 而 %7 在新世界只剩下一座城镇。

en: <g:INTEXT_FLASCHENPOST_800x600.screen><n>You have found a fragment of a treasure map in a bottle. You place the piece of map in your log.
tr: <g:INTEXT_FLASCHENPOST_800x600.screen><n>你发现了一个装着藏宝图碎片的瓶子， 于是把这块碎片记入日志。

en: Greetings, %1. Do you have all the goods for the feast?
tr: 你好啊， %1 。 宴会的货都备齐了吗？

en: %1,<n>I was not expecting to see you again so soon. I don’t believe I have any news for you as yet.
tr: %1 ，<n>没想到这么快就又见到你了。 眼下我还没什么消息可告诉你。

en: I would gladly task you with capturing a town belonging to %1.  I have enough military convoys to protect any newly captured area.<n><n>However, %1 is still too strong for such an undertaking.<n><n>You could help to weaken %1 by destroying its military convoys.<n><n>Then return to me and I may have a mission for you.
tr: 我很愿意派你去攻占 %1 的一座城镇。 我手头的军事船队足够守住任何新占下的地盘。<n><n>不过 %1 目前对这项任务来说还是太强了。<n><n>你可以摧毁 %1 的军事船队， 助我削弱他们。<n><n>然后再来找我， 也许就有新任务给你。

en: I will soon be sending important documents to Europe. As we are currently at war with @n$HostileNation$, I am taking no risks and want to arrange an additional escort. Could you provide this escort?
tr: 我不久后要把重要文件送往欧洲。 眼下我们正与 @n$HostileNation$ 交战， 我不敢冒任何风险， 想再加派一支护航队伍。 你能提供这支护航吗？

en: Thank you for returning the package to me. Here is your reward of @g$Reward$.
tr: 谢谢你把包裹给我带回来。 这是给你的报酬 @g$Reward$ 。

en: I am delighted. Please deliver @a$Amount$ to the market. There, you shall receive your payment of  @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen> until @D$Date$.
tr: 太好了。 请把 @a$Amount$ 送到市场。 在那里， 每交付一<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>桶就能拿到 @g$GoldPerBarrel$ ， 一直到 @D$Date$ 。

en: Attack convoys belonging to @n$HostileNation$ and capture two @S$ShipType$ type ships. Anchor these ships in the harbor of @T$TOWN$ and visit the governor again by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 袭击 @n$HostileNation$ 的船队， 俘获两艘 @S$ShipType$ 型船只。 把这些船停泊在 @T$TOWN$ 的港口， 并在 @D$EndDate$ 之前再去拜访总督。

en: Destroy all of Blackbeard’s pirate convoys that are at sea. Do not attack his hideout!
tr: 摧毁黑胡子所有在海上的海盗船队。 不要攻打他的藏身处！

en: A local trader is prepared to sell you the business for a price of %1.
tr: 当地一名商人愿意以 %1 的价格把产业卖给你。

en: A lonely town lies in the west of the headland.
tr: 海角西边有一座孤零零的城镇。

en: The distance from X to Nombre is not far, you have plenty of rum and can enjoy a cigar.
tr: X 离 Nombre 不远， 那里有的是朗姆酒， 雪茄也尽管享用。

en: X lies on the island, it’s really quite small. But look to the southeast, there’s none larger at all.
tr: X 在一座岛上， 那岛实在很小。 但望向东南， 就再没有更大的了。

en: X lies on the island, it’s really quite small. But look to the southeast, there’s none larger at all.
tr: X 在一座岛上， 那岛实在很小。 但望向东南， 就再没有更大的了。

en: What have you done! How could you leave my daughter behind in enemy hands? I will tell all of @n$Nation$ that you cannot be trusted! (Reputation in @n$Nation$ has diminished)
tr: 你都干了些什么！ 怎么能把我女儿落在敌人手里？ 我要告诉 @n$Nation$ 的所有人， 说你不可信任！ （在 @n$Nation$ 的声望下降）

en: You begin your career in the Dutch town of %1 in the year %2.<n><n>
tr: 你在 %2 年于荷兰城镇 %1 开始自己的生涯。<n><n>

en: I am glad to see you, @A$USER$. You have a large trading fleet don't you? It's just that I have to ship @A$Amount$ of @G$Goods$.<n>How about you pay me a surety of @g$PriceBuy$ and take the goods to @T$Town$. There, you will be able to sell the goods for @g$PriceSell$.
tr: 很高兴见到你， @A$USER$ 。 你有一支大型商船队吧？ 是这样， 我要把 @A$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 运出去。<n>你付给我 @g$PriceBuy$ 作为押金， 把货物运到 @T$Town$ ， 到那里就能按 @g$PriceSell$ 卖掉。

en: I have managed to plant a spy on board a Dutch ship.
tr: 我设法在一条荷兰船上安插了密探。

en: One of the most dazzling figures in a list of explorers and conquerors that included many other colorful characters was the English writer and adventurer Sir Walter Raleigh (approx. 1554 – 1618). He first came to prominence in 1580 when he defeated an uprising by Irish rebels opposed to the English occupation.<n><n>He became a favorite of Queen Elizabeth I and used his influence to finance an expedition to find the legendary city of Eldorado in South America. Despite the total failure of several expeditions to find anything of value, he managed to retain the support of his financial backers in London by using his unique powers of persuasion. He gave them to believe that the final prize always lay just beyond the next estuary and that he could not possibly give up now.<n><n>Nevertheless, his credit eventually came to an end. To often, people had listened to his lofty promises only to find out later on that they were nothing but hot air. Raleigh finally fell from grace with Elizabeth. Her successor, James I, saw this hot-blooded adventurer as a threat to his more moderate foreign policy and had him arrested on very weak grounds and sentenced to death as soon as he came to power. His sentence was commuted (mind you, it was not lifted!) and Raleigh was imprisoned in the Tower of London.<n><n>Years later, when the state of the country’s finances persuaded the King that it was necessary, he gave Sir Walter Raleigh permission to lead another expedition to Guyana. This was an absurd situation: giving a man, who was himself sentenced to death, the authority over the life and death of others and sending him off in search of gold! However, this contradiction resolved itself relatively soon afterwards, for Raleigh, by now wracked with fever, lived to see his final expedition end in failure.<n><n>On his return to England, the furious King decided that Raleigh’s stay of execution decreed in 1603 should now come to an end. Sir Walter Raleigh was executed shortly afterwards.
tr: 在一份群英荟萃的探险家与征服者名单中， 最耀眼的人物之一， 是英国作家兼冒险家沃尔特·雷利爵士 （约1554 — 1618年）。 他于1580 年首次崭露头角， 当时他平定了爱尔兰反叛者针对英格兰占领的起义。<n><n>他成了伊丽莎白一世女王的宠臣， 并借助自己的影响力出资资助了一场远征， 去寻找南美洲那座传说中的黄金之城埃尔多拉多。 尽管数次远征搜寻有价之物都以彻底失败告终， 他却凭着独特的说服力， 保住了伦敦那些出资人的支持。 他让他们相信， 最丰厚的奖赏永远就在下一个河口的那一边， 而他现在无论如何都不可能放弃。<n><n>然而他的信誉最终还是走到了尽头。 人们听了太多他那些不切实际的承诺， 后来才发现不过是一派空言。 雷利终于失宠于伊丽莎白。 她的继任者詹姆斯一世视这位热血冒险家为对自己较为温和的对外政策的威胁， 几乎没抓到什么把柄便将其逮捕， 并在即位后不久判处他死刑。 判决后来被改为了缓刑 （注意， 并没有被撤销！）， 雷利被囚禁在伦敦塔中。<n><n>多年之后， 当国家财政的状况促使国王认为有必要时， 他准许沃尔特·雷利爵士率领另一次远征前往圭亚那。 这是个荒谬的处境： 把一个自己已被判死刑的人， 赋予决定他人生死的权力， 再派出去寻找黄金！ 不过这个矛盾不久便自行化解了—— 此时已被热病折磨的雷利， 活着看到了他的最后一次远征以失败告终。<n><n>回到英格兰后， 怒不可遏的国王认定： 雷利在1603 年获得的缓刑如今该结束了。 不久之后， 沃尔特·雷利爵士被处决。

en: The legendary Spanish treasure fleet, which regularly set sail from America to Spain, also gave rise to all manner of greed beyond the Iberian peninsula. It was primarily an ambitious England who saw this as an opportunity to contest Spain’s role as mistress of the seas and queen of the world.<n><n>As the island kingdom was still too weak to engage in large-scale military campaigns, it made far more sense to engage its rival outside of Europe, far afield, where she would neither expect to be attacked nor receive any warning of attack. There, one could loot one’s victim with ease and then simply disappear and no one in Europe would hear of the events for months.<n><n>Daring captains, the most famous of whom was Francis Drake (1540-1596), were issued with Letters of Marque by Her Majesty Elizabeth I. These Letters of Marque resembled a kind of blank check and were a license to loot that elevated Drake and his associates above the level of regular buccaneers and conferred on them the status of private robber barons in the service of a higher authority. They made an excellent job of it. Nowhere were Iberian ships and garrisons safe.<n><n>In 1578, Francis Drake traversed the Straits of Magellan and set off like a whirlwind on the hunt for Spanish booty along the Pacific coast of America. No one had ever dared to do this before! On his return to Plymouth harbor in 1580, Drake had become the second captain after Magellan to sail around the world. <n><n>Meanwhile, King Philip of Spain was boiling with rage and waved the Treaty of Tordesillas, under which His Holiness the Pope had adamantly declared the western hemisphere to be within Spain’s sphere of influence in 1494. – But how could this sort of protest have any affect on this peculiar island nation of Protestant heretics, who completely rejected the authority of the Pope in Rome and who even refused to adopt the modern Gregorian calendar until 1753, purely because it had been developed on the orders of Pope Gregory in 1582?<n><n>Once more, it seemed that the matter could only be resolved by means of war. Philip’s Armada set sail for England in 1588, but under the command of Sir Francis Drake, who had by now been made a knight, and with the help of several timely storms, the English succeeded in destroying the Spanish fleet. For hundreds of years afterwards, no one would challenge Great Britain’s position as the leading sea power.
tr: 那支定期从美洲驶往西班牙的传奇西班牙珍宝船队， 在伊比利亚半岛之外也激起了各式各样的贪念。 主要是雄心勃勃的英格兰看到了一个机会， 要与西班牙争夺海上霸主和世界女王的地位。<n><n>这个岛国当时还没有强到足以投入大规模军事行动， 因此把战场摆到欧洲之外的遥远地方要明智得多—— 在那里， 她既不会料到遭人袭击， 也不会收到任何袭击的预警。 在那里， 你可以轻而易举地抢光受害者， 然后从容消失， 欧洲几个月之内都不会听说这件事。<n><n>那些胆大的船长—— 其中最著名的是弗朗西斯·德雷克 （1540 — 1596年） —— 由伊丽莎白一世女王亲自颁发私掠许可证。 这种私掠许可证形如一张空白支票， 是一份抢劫许可： 它把德雷克及其同伙凌驾于普通海盗之上， 使他们成为效忠更高权威的私掠男爵。 他们也把这份差事干得相当漂亮。 伊比利亚的船队与守军， 没有一处是安全的。<n><n>1578 年， 弗朗西斯·德雷克穿越麦哲伦海峡， 像旋风一样沿着美洲太平洋海岸搜寻西班牙的财富。 此前从未有人胆敢这样做！ 1580 年他返回普利茅斯港时， 已成为继麦哲伦之后第二位环航世界的船长。<n><n>与此同时， 西班牙国王菲利普暴跳如雷， 援引了托尔德西利亚斯条约—— 教宗陛下曾在1494 年断然宣布西半球属于西班牙的势力范围。 可是， 对这个奇特的异教新教岛国而言， 这种抗议又能有什么作用呢？ 它完全拒绝承认罗马教宗的权威， 甚至直到 1753 年才肯采用现代的格里高利历， 仅仅因为这套历法是教宗格里高利在 1582 年下令制定的。<n><n>又一次， 看来这件事只能靠战争来解决。 菲利普的无敌舰队于 1588 年驶向英格兰， 但在此时已受封为爵士的弗朗西斯·德雷克爵士指挥下， 再加上几场来得正是时候的风暴相助， 英格兰人成功摧毁了西班牙舰队。 在此后数百年的时间里， 再也没有人敢挑战大不列颠作为海上霸主地位。

en: He has a girl, somewhere in a town far to the southwest.
tr: 他在西南方很偏的一座城镇有个情人。

en: He has a girl, somewhere in a town to the southeast.
tr: 他在东南方向的一座城镇有个情人。

en: I don't even need to ask you if you'll join me in a game, you're as cleaned out as a freshly scrubbed deck! Come back when your pockets are full.
tr: 都不用问你会不会上钩了， 你已经输得像刚被刷过的甲板一样干净。 等你口袋里又有钱时再来吧。

en: Your convoy picks up a message in a bottle. The bottle contains a map showing the location of a particular spot.
tr: 你的船队捞到一只漂流瓶。 瓶中有一张地图， 标出了某个特定地点的位置。

en: Your convoy picks up a message in a bottle. The bottle contains a map showing the location of a particular spot.
tr: 你的船队捞到一只漂流瓶。 瓶中有一张地图， 标出了某个特定地点的位置。

en: Apparently the chest contained, among other things, a box of mint cookies from England.
tr: 箱子里似乎除别的东西外， 还放着一盒英格兰产的薄荷饼干。

en: The game time is limited to one year in this demo.
tr: 本试玩版的游戏时间限制为一年。

en: A ruler that can slide back and forth is set into another ruler. A sliding bracket made of transparent material is attached to this. You could use this device to carry out simple calculations very quickly.
tr: 一把可以来回滑动的尺子嵌在另一把尺子里， 上面还装着一个透明材料制成的滑动卡尺。 借助这件装置， 你可以很快完成简单的计算。

en: This anchor is more decorative than practical. At best, it could be used to anchor a rowing boat.<n>It is very heavy for its size and is covered with intricate decorations and unknown lettering.
tr: 这只锚与其说实用， 不如说装饰。 它顶多能用来泊一条划艇。<n>以它的尺寸而言算是很重了， 上面布满精细的装饰和不明文字。

en: I believe I have already heard tell of you, %1. I am %3, the governor’s daughter. I always wanted to meet a %2. Please, do tell me of your adventures!
tr: %1 ， 我想我早就听说过你了。 我是总督的女儿 %3 。 我一直想见一见 %2 。 求你说说你的历险故事吧！

en: So, you are the famous %1! I had imagined you as being much taller, from all the stories I've heard about you. But that doesn't make you any less interesting! Come over here and tell me of your adventures! I have already heard my father, the governor, talk so much about you.
tr: 原来你就是那位大名鼎鼎的 %1 ！ 我听说了那么多关于你的故事， 想当然以为你高大得多。 不过这丝毫不减你的魅力！ 过来给我讲讲你的历险故事吧！ 我父亲总督早就把你的事讲了一大堆。

en: <g:INTEXT_SCHATZKISTE_800x600.screen><n>Using your treasure map, you have found treasure.<n>@g$Gold$
tr: <g:INTEXT_SCHATZKISTE_800x600.screen><n>借助你的藏宝图， 你找到了宝藏。<n>@g$Gold$

en: At last, the convoy finds your wife, adrift at sea. She is unconscious, but she comes to after a while:<n>"This buffoon abducted me! He actually believed that I wanted to elope with him just because I smiled politely at him once or twice.“
tr: 船队终于在海上找到了漂流的妻子。 她人不省人事， 但过了一会儿醒了过来：<n>"这个蠢货绑架了我！ 他居然以为我只对他礼貌地笑过一两次， 就该跟他私奔。 "

en: You have no damaged ships or convoys in the harbor.
tr: 你的港口里没有受损的船只或船队。

en: There is a plague of rats in %1. The consumption of wheat, fruit, corn and meat is twice as high for one month.
tr: %1 爆发了鼠患。 接下来一个月， 小麦、 水果、 玉米和肉的消耗量将翻倍。

en: You can only enter a trade route if the captain of the convoy has %1 experience points. He currently has %2 points.
tr: 只有当船队船长的经验点达到 %1 点， 你才能开辟这条航线。 他目前有 %2 点。

en: You can now boost your reputation in %1 by attacking English ships and towns. This will not diminish your reputation in the other nations.
tr: 你现在可以靠袭击英格兰的船只和城镇来提升在 %1 的声望， 而不会削减你在其他国家的声望。

en: Strange things are happening in Tortuga. Due to a number of events that have happened in the past, hardly a single trader dares set foot in the town. Your task is to support Tortuga as best you can by supplying goods.<n><n>But your starting capital is not exactly spectacular. You have @g$StartGold$ cash available. Nonetheless, you have a well-equipped trading convoy in the harbor and some stores of goods.<n><n>Your first objective is to increase your cash to @g$GoldGoal$. Complete this task as fast as possible, but you cannot take longer than 40 days.<n><n>A word of advice: Under no circumstances should you sell your ships. However, you can take out loans.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Increase your cash to @g$GoldGoal$ by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 托尔图加正在发生一些怪事。 由于过去发生的一连串事件， 如今几乎没有任何商人敢踏入这座城镇。 你的任务是尽你所能供应货物， 以扶持托尔图加。<n><n>但你手上的启动资金并不算可观。 你手头有 @g$StartGold$ 现金。 不过， 港口里停着一支装备齐全的贸易船队， 还有一些货物存货。<n><n>你的第一个目标， 是把现金增加到 @g$GoldGoal$ 。 尽快完成这项任务， 但耗时不得超过 40 天。<n><n>一句忠告： 无论如何都不要卖掉你的船。 不过， 你可以去贷款。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把现金增加到 @g$GoldGoal$ 。

en: In the last scenario, you learned how to add ships to a convoy by right-clicking on the harbor.<n>Now, however, you should assemble a new convoy by hiring a captain at the inn.<n>Find the inn (located in the center of the town) and click on it.
tr: 上一个剧本里， 你学会了通过右击港口把船只加入船队。<n>不过这一次， 你该在旅店雇一名船长的方式来组建一支新船队。<n>找到旅店 （位于城镇中心） 并点击它。

en: Deliver any amount of @G$Goods$ to the market in @T$TOWN$. There you will receive @g$Price$ per barrel immediately. On @D$EndDate$, an expeditionary convoy will collect the goods. Escort the convoy to Europe and you will receive another @g$Price$ per barrel.
tr: 把任意数量的 @G$Goods$ 送到 @T$TOWN$ 的市集。 在那里你每桶能立刻拿到 @g$Price$ 。 到 @D$EndDate$ 时， 会有一支远征船队来收取货物。 把船队护送到欧洲， 你每桶还能再拿到 @g$Price$ 。

en: Supply @T$TargetTown$ with goods and buy up surplus goods. On @D$EndDate$, the town's status must be "Flourishing economy" and all of the local traders' businesses must be working to full capacity.
tr: 为 @T$TargetTown$ 供给货物并收购过剩货物。 到 @D$EndDate$ 时， 这座城镇的状态必须是 「兴旺」， 且当地商人的所有产业都必须满负荷运转。

en: Excellent! You destroyed all of the pirate convoys so that none of the pirates can escape. If you destroy all of a pirate gang's convoys before attacking their hideout, it will take longer for new pirate convoys to appear in the Caribbean.<n><n>Now attack the hideout the same way you would attack a town by selecting you convoy and then right-clicking on the pirate hideout.  If some pirate ships are anchored in the harbor, you must first attack these before you can win the harbor battle.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Destroy Blackbeard’s pirate hideout.
tr: 太棒了！ 你把所有海盗船队都消灭了， 现在一个海盗也逃不掉。 如果在攻打某个海盗团的巢穴之前， 先把它所有的船队全部摧毁， 新的海盗船队在加勒比海出现就会更慢一些。<n><n>现在像攻打城镇那样去攻击巢穴： 先选中你的船队， 然后右键点击海盗巢穴。 如果港口里停泊着一些海盗船， 你必须先攻下它们， 才能赢下这场港口之战。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>摧毁黑胡子的海盗巢穴。

en: We are at war with Spain and must ensure that the Spanish treasure fleet never reaches Europe. Luckily, we have learned which town the fleet will be calling at next. We will sabotage the fleet at this town so that it has to prolong its stay in the harbor. This should give you enough time to intercept the fleet and prevent it from reaching Europe. Do you accept this mission?
tr: 我们正与西班牙交战， 必须确保西班牙珍宝船队永远到不了欧洲。 幸运的是， 我们已经查明船队下一站会停靠哪座城镇。 我们要在那座城镇搞破坏， 迫使它延长停泊时间。 这应该能给你足够的时间去截住船队， 阻止它抵达欧洲。 你接受这项任务吗？

en: Well done! Now you have a town of your own! No one but you may build in this town. <n><n>The town already has some buildings, such as the docks, where you can trade, and your palace. The rest you must build yourself.<n><n>Sail with your convoy to your town. Carry as much wood and as many bricks as you can because you'll need these to construct buildings.<n><n>First, build a shipyard, where you'll be able to repair your own ships.<n><n>Note:<n> It costs a lot to maintain the crew on your escort ships. You should dismiss the crew, as you no longer need them.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Visit your new town and build a shipyard.
tr: 干得好！ 你现在有了自己的城镇！ 除了你， 谁也不能在这座城里动工。<n><n>城里已经有一些建筑， 比如可以交易的码头， 以及你的宫殿。 其余的都得你自己盖。<n><n>驾船队驶向你的城镇。 木材和砖块能带多少带多少， 因为建造房屋要用到它们。<n><n>先建一座船坞， 这样你就能维修自己的船了。<n><n>注意：<n>维持护航船上的船员开销很大。 你已经用不上他们了， 把他们解散掉吧。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>去你的新城走一趟， 建起一座船坞。

en: Captain %1 assembles a new convoy.<n>The  convoy is seaworthy and waiting in the harbor.<n>The daily cost of the captain and basic crew is %2.
tr: 船长 %1 组建了一支新船队。<n>船队已可出海， 正在港口等候。<n>船长和基础船员的每日花费是 %2 。

en: @A$USER$, come here and sit down, I have some business to discuss with you.<n>I'm trying to buy @G$Goods$ for @n$HostileNation$. As you know, @n$Nation$ and @n$HostileNation$ are at war. In fact, it is now a punishable offence in @n$HostileNation$ to import @G$Goods$ from @n$Nation$, and good prices are being paid accordingly. So I'd like to ask you if you'd be interested in a little smuggling?
tr: @A$USER$ ， 过来坐下， 我有些事要和你谈。<n>我想替 @n$HostileNation$ 采购 @G$Goods$ 。 你知道 @n$Nation$ 和 @n$HostileNation$ 正在交战。 事实上， 如今从 @n$Nation$ 进口 @G$Goods$ 在 @n$HostileNation$ 是要治罪的， 因此价格也相应地被抬高了。 所以我想问问你， 对这么点走私生意有没有兴趣？

en: @A$USER$, would you be interested in a little smuggling? I am here on behalf of a trader from @T$TargetTown$. Due to the war, no goods may currently be transported from towns of @n$Nation$ to @T$TargetTown$. The man who sent me is interested in @G$Goods$. He will pay you @g$Price$ for each barrel you deliver him. What do you say?
tr: @A$USER$ ， 对这么点走私生意有没有兴趣？ 我是代表 @T$TargetTown$ 的一位商人来的。 由于战事， 目前 @n$Nation$ 的城镇不能向 @T$TargetTown$ 运输任何货物。 派我来的人对 @G$Goods$ 很感兴趣。 你每送到他一桶， 他就付你 @g$Price$ 。 怎么样？

en: Go to the market in @T$Town$ within the next 30 days to collect your reward.
tr: 在接下来的 30 天内去 @T$Town$ 的市场领取你的奖励。

en: Visit the Governor of @T$TOWN$ and accept his mission.
tr: 拜访 @T$TOWN$ 的总督并接受他的任务。

en: The place is located 1 to 2 days' journey to the east of %1.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 以东一天到两天航程处。

en: The position lies many days' journey to the east of %1.
tr: 那个位置在 %1 以东好几天的航程处。

en: The place lies somewhere out of reach to the south of %1.
tr: 那个地方在遥不可及的 %1 以南的某处。

en: <ts:0><ts:160>with convoy selected on:<n>sea chart/Mini Map<t>send convoy<n>- with CTRL<t>set route point<n>created convoy<t>transfer<n>harbor<t>ship transfer
tr: <ts:0><ts:160>选中船队时：<n>海图／小地图<t>派出船队<n>按住 CTRL<t>设置航线点<n>新建船队<t>转移<n>港口<t>船只转移

en: %1,<n>you know quite well I'd tell you to go to hell under normal circumstances, but in dire times like these, I'd sell my soul to the devil himself.<n><n>So come on in, I have something to tell you.
tr: %1 ，<n>换作平时， 我早叫你见鬼去了， 但眼下这种危难时候， 我连灵魂都肯卖给魔鬼本人。<n><n>那就进来吧， 我有件事要告诉你。

en: Your task is to ensure that the town of @T$TargetTown$ declines in status to “Recession” by @D$EndDate$. You have two options here:<n><n>Either attack the town and loot all the goods to bring about the status “Recovery”. The town’s status will then continue to decline due to the scarcity of goods.<n><n>Alternatively, you can cut off the supply of goods to the town by intercepting trading convoys. Note:  If you only loot a convoy and do not capture it, your reputation with the nation in question will suffer to a much lesser extent.
tr: 你的任务， 是设法让 @T$TargetTown$ 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把城镇地位降到 「衰退」。 你有两个选择：<n><n>其一， 攻打该城镇并抢光全部货物， 把城镇地位打成 「复苏」。 此后由于货物匮乏， 城镇地位还会继续下滑。<n><n>其二， 你也可以通过拦截贸易船队来切断对该城镇的货物供应。 注意： 如果你只抢掠一支船队而不占领它， 你与相关国家的声望所受损害会小得多。

en: Far to the east of Charleston lie the Bermuda Islands. Steer well clear of them! Two months ago, my brother-in-law sailed there to explore them, but he never returned. No one knows what goes on there, but one thing is certain: A terrible fate awaits all those that dare to sail too close to the islands!
tr: 在查尔斯顿以东很远的地方就是百慕大群岛。 务必绕开它们！ 两个月前， 我姐夫驶往那里探查， 却再也没有回来。 没人知道那边有什么， 但有一点可以肯定： 胆敢驶得太近的人， 都会遭遇可怕的命运！

en: This ship has recently set sail with a convoy bound for Europe. I want you to see whether my spy on board has thrown important documents overboard for us.
tr: 这艘船刚随一支前往欧洲的船队启航。 我要你看看， 我安插在船上的密探是否为我们把重要文件扔下了海。

en: Greetings, @s$USER$. Do you wish to set off in search of treasure? Then listen to the first clue.
tr: 你好， @s$USER$ 。 你想出发去寻宝吗？ 那就先听第一条线索吧。

en: This veteran captain knew every trick in the book for getting the better of even the most experienced traders.
tr: 这位老船长把讨价还价的门道全摸透了， 连最老练的商人也不是他的对手。

en: and the harbor is very poorly defended.
tr: 而且港口的防守极为薄弱。

en: <n><n>You can go to a governor of his nation to demand a ransom for him.
tr: <n><n>你可以去找他本国的一位总督， 要求赎回他。

en: %1,<n>I am glad that you have come. Come in and I'll see if I have something for you.
tr: %1 ，<n>很高兴你来了。 进来吧， 我看看有没有事给你做。

en: We have an agreement then. On the last trip I signed on to, the captain lost his temper over a chest for some reason, which he then just dumped overboard.
tr: 那就这么说定了。 上一次我签下的航程里， 船长不知为何为一个箱子大发脾气， 顺手就把它扔进了海里。

en: Look out for English trading convoys and sink or capture at least @I$NumShips$ ships.
tr: 留意英格兰商船队， 击沉或俘获其中至少 @I$NumShips$ 艘船。

en: Look out for Spanish trading convoys and sink or capture at least @I$NumShips$ ships.
tr: 留意西班牙商船队， 击沉或俘获其中至少 @I$NumShips$ 艘船。

en: %1 %2 has broken through the town's land defenses and looted the town.
tr: %1・%2 突破了城镇的陆上防线， 洗劫了这座城镇。

en: This displays the ship’s data, which you already saw in the shipyard.<n>Before you can do anything with an individual ship, you must add it to a convoy.<n>To do this, select your convoy again.
tr: 这里显示船只的数据， 你在船坞里已经见过了。<n>要对单艘船做任何事， 你得先把它编入一支船队。<n>为此， 重新选中你的船队。

en: You have defeated your opponent and sunk a ship.
tr: 你击败了对手， 并击沉了一艘船。

en: The town that you seek is a desolate place, far flung from all the world, as though forsaken, or in disgrace.
tr: 你要找的城镇是个荒凉之所， 远离世间一切， 仿佛被遗弃， 或已失宠。

en: The town that you seek is a desolate place, far flung from all the world, as though forsaken, or in disgrace.
tr: 你要找的城镇是个荒凉之所， 远离世间一切， 仿佛被遗弃， 或已失宠。

en: The town that you seek is a desolate place, far flung from all the world, as though forsaken, or in disgrace.
tr: 你要找的城镇是个荒凉之所， 远离世间一切， 仿佛被遗弃， 或已失宠。

en: A lonely town lies in the west of the headland.
tr: 海角西边有一座孤零零的城镇。

en: Powerful river flowing so deep, on towards the east and into the swamp. From there to the southeast, sometimes over land. To the town with the X, at the edge, at the end.
tr: 一条水势深沉的急流奔涌， 向东流入沼泽。 自那里转向东南， 有时还需走陆路。 通往那座带 X 的城镇， 尽头便是。

en: Oh, thank you for bringing back my beloved daughter. Here is a map. On it, I have marked the spot where I once hid lots of treasure.
tr: 啊， 谢谢你把我心爱的女儿带回来。 这是一张图， 上面标着我当年藏了大量财宝的地方。

en: You begin your career in the French town of %1 in the year %2.<n><n>
tr: 你在 %2 年于法国城镇 %1 开始自己的生涯。<n><n>

en: On behalf of my nation, I would like to thank you for destroying a convoy of the notorious pirate %1.<n><n>You will receive a total reward of %2 for all of the pirate ships you defeated, and I can assure you that my nation is very grateful to you.
tr: 我谨代表我国， 向你摧毁恶名昭著的海盗 %1 的一支船队表示感谢。<n><n>你击败的每一艘海盗船都会折算成酬金， 总计 %2 。 我可以向你保证， 我国对你感激不尽。

en: Thank you! You must hurry, for it will be very difficult to locate the convoy if it has chosen a new region as its destination. Its last position has been marked on your sea chart. @l$Pos$ You have until @D$EndDate$.
tr: 谢谢！ 你必须赶快行动 —— 如果它已经改换了目的地， 就很难再找到它了。 它最后的位置已标在你的海图上。 @l$Pos$ 你有 @D$EndDate$ 的时间。

en: Well done! The plague in Tortuga is over and the population has been restored to @I$Pop$.<n>You accomplished this mission within @I$Days$ days.
tr: 干得漂亮！ 托尔图加的瘟疫已经结束， 人口恢复到了 @I$Pop$ 。<n>你在 @I$Days$ 天内完成了这项任务。

en: A local trader is prepared to pay you %1 for the business and all crop fields.
tr: 一位当地商人愿意出 %1 买下你的产业和全部农田。

en: Greetings, @A$USER$. I must deliver a large consignment of @G$Goods$ to @T$Town$ but, unfortunately, my captain has let me down. I propose the following plan: You pay me a surety of @g$PriceBuy$, transport @a$Amount$ to @T$Town$ and there you will receive @g$PriceSell$ in return. What say you?
tr: 你好， @A$USER$ 。 我要把一大批 @G$Goods$ 运到 @T$Town$ ， 可不幸的是， 我的船长指望不上。 我有个提议： 你付给我 @g$PriceBuy$ 作为押金， 把 @a$Amount$ 运到 @T$Town$ ， 到那里你就能收到 @g$PriceSell$ 。 怎么样？

en: We are at war with @n$TargetNation$ and, in light of recent events, the time has now come for us to retaliate. I want you to capture or sink military ships on my behalf. Do you accept this mission?
tr: 我们正与 @n$TargetNation$ 交战， 鉴于最近发生的事， 反击的时刻终于到了。 我要你替我俘获或击沉他们的军舰。 你接受这项任务吗？

en: Just recently, @n$TargetNation$ attacked one of our towns. Now I'm planning my own military action against @n$TargetNation$ and was wondering if you'd like to be part of it? I want you to sink or capture military convoys. Everything you loot from them is yours to keep, all I care about is weakening @n$TargetNation$. Are you interested?
tr: 就在不久前， @n$TargetNation$ 袭击了我们的一座城镇。 我正打算对 @n$TargetNation$ 采取军事行动， 不知你想不想参与？ 我要你击沉或俘获他们的军事船队。 你从船上缴获的一切都归你自己， 我只在乎削弱 @n$TargetNation$ 。 你有兴趣吗？

en: One of our towns has been attacked by @n$TargetNation$. We are now retaliating and sinking their ships. I would very much like to send you to a particular area and authorize you to capture or sink military ships.
tr: 我们的一座城镇遭到了 @n$TargetNation$ 袭击。 我们正在反击， 击沉他们的船只。 我很想把你派往某个特定区域， 授权你俘获或击沉那里的军舰。

en: I have managed to plant a spy on board a French ship.
tr: 我设法在一条法国船上安插了密探。

en: Everyone has been given 5 cards. I’ll call 5 points.<n><n><n>Since you cannot beat that, the game is mine!
tr: 每个人都拿到了 5 张牌。 我要叫 5 分。<n><n><n>你们赢不了， 这局归我！
<f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>警告<f:fonts\Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>可能有闲置货物被运走！<n>

en: Greetings to you! I am just drafting a new historical essay.
tr: 你好！ 我正在起草一篇新的历史随笔。

en: A military convoy has tried, unsuccessfully, to breach the town's harbor defenses.
tr: 一支军事船队试图突破该镇的港口防御， 但没能成功。

en: A trader from a different nation has lured away a considerable number of workers. These workers have left the town as settlers together with their families.<n><n>Now your task is to find enough settlers so that every business in the town has a full complement of workers by no later than @D$EndDate$.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective <f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>The number of citizens (inhabitants minus soldiers) must be restored to @I$Pop$ by no later than @D$EndDate$.
tr: 另一个国家的商人拐走了相当多的工人。 这些工人已经作为移民， 带着家眷离城而去。<n><n>你现在的任务， 是找到足够多的移民， 以便在不迟于 @D$EndDate$ 时， 让城里每一家企业都有完整的工人配置。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标 <f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>必须在不迟于 @D$EndDate$ 时， 把居民人数 （常住人口减去士兵） 恢复到 @I$Pop$ 。

en: Very good! That was no simple feat! England has now lost so many military convoys that its towns can be captured. In grateful recognition of your service, the Governor of the Turk Islands provides you with four more carracks.<n><n>You can only capture a nation's towns by order of a viceroy. A viceroy will only instruct you to capture a town if his own nation is militarily strong and the enemy nation is militarily weak.<n><n>Unfortunately, Holland is not strong enough to be able to capture a town. However, you can do something about this: Pay a visit to the Dutch viceroy in Grand Bahama and hand over one of your convoys to him. He will then assemble a new military convoy, which will increase Holland's military strength.<n><n>If you want to hand over a convoy to a viceroy, the convoy in question must have exactly five ships and at least 150 cannons.<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Help the viceroy to increase Holland's military strength. Then accept a mission to capture towns on his behalf.
tr: 非常好！ 这可不是件容易的事！ 英格兰已经损失了如此之多的军事船队， 以至于它的城镇可以被攻占了。 为感谢你所提供的服务， 特克群岛的总督再给你四艘大帆船。<n><n>只有奉副王之命， 你才能攻占他国城镇。 而副王只有在自身国家军事强大、 敌国军事虚弱的情况下， 才会命你攻城。<n><n>不幸的是， 荷兰目前的实力还不足以攻占城镇。 不过你可以为此做点事： 去拜访大巴哈马的荷兰副王， 把你的一支船队移交给他。 这样他就会组建一支新的军事船队， 从而增强荷兰的军事实力。<n><n>如果你想把船队移交给一位副王， 这支船队必须恰好有五艘船， 并且至少配备 150 门火炮。<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>帮助副王增强荷兰的军事实力， 然后接受一项代表他攻城掠地的任务。

en: Well done! You have destroyed the pirate convoy.<n>Now return to the Governor of Cartagena because this is part of your mission.<n><n>Note that your missions are automatically recorded in your log. You can view the details of your mission there at any time if necessary.
tr: 做得好！ 你已经消灭了这支海盗船队。<n>现在返回卡塔赫纳总督处， 因为这属于委托的一部分。<n><n>注意， 你的委托会自动记录进日志。 必要的时候， 你随时可以在那里查看详情。

en: Oh, I am plagued with misfortune. Several weeks ago, I came across a ship belonging to the notorious pirate @P$PirateName$. However, the captain of this ship must have been very inexperienced, as we managed to sink it almost without trying.<n>Unfortunately, this hapless captain turned out to be the beloved nephew of the pirate @P$PirateName$. Ever since he heard my name, he has been hunting me down. My crew have taken my ship and have fled in terror and now I am stranded here.<n>Can you help me to get to @T$TargetTown$, my home town?
tr: 唉， 我真是祸不单行。 几周前， 我撞见了一艘属于恶名昭著的海盗 @P$PirateName$ 的船。 可这条船的船长想必是个雏儿， 因为我们几乎没费什么劲就把它沉了。<n>不幸的是， 这个倒霉船长偏偏是海盗 @P$PirateName$ 宠爱的侄子。 自从他听说过我的名字， 就一路追杀我。 我的船员们抢走了我的船， 惊慌逃散， 于是我现在被困在了这里。<n>你能帮我回到我的故乡 @T$TargetTown$ 吗？

en: Apparently it was used to store brightly colored feather dusters.
tr: 这里似乎曾用来存放颜色鲜艳的羽毛掸子。

en: Increase the population of your town to 1,000.
tr: 把你城镇的人口增加到 1,000。

en: Although this rope must have been exposed to seawater for some time, it looks as if it had just been made. It feels wonderfully smooth and ties very strong knots.
tr: 这根绳子想必在海水里泡过一段时间， 却看起来像刚做出来的一样。 手感异常光滑， 打出的结也极其牢靠。

en: <f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res>Your captain is on the left. You control him as follows:<n> <n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Attack<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>To attack, left-click on part of your opponent’s body. Click on different parts of his body to increase your chances of scoring a hit.<n> <n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Defend<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>As soon at the opponent prepares to attack, you must click the right mouse button at the right time to ward off the attack.<n> <n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Special attacks<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>Press the left mouse button just before your captain has returned to the starting position after an attack.<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Endurance<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>Each attack reduces your captain’s endurance, which recovers between attacks.<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Reaction time<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>The more duels you have won, the faster you must react.
tr: <f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res>你的船长在左侧。 你可以这样操控他：<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>攻击<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>要攻击， 就在对手身体的某一部分上点击左键。 点击他身体的不同部位， 可以提高你命中的机会。<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>防御<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>对手一准备攻击， 你就必须在恰当时机点击右键， 把这一击挡开。<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>特殊攻击<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>在船长于一次攻击后回到起始位置的瞬间之前， 按下左键。<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>耐力<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>每次攻击都会消耗你船长的耐力， 而在两次攻击之间耐力会恢复。<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>反应速度<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>你赢下的决斗越多， 需要的反应就越快。

en: A town belonging to @n$TargetNation$ is in serious dispute with its viceroy. I know the reason why and I am now planning to support the town, so as to tempt it to side with us. You could help me do this.
tr: @n$TargetNation$ 的一座城镇与本国副王正陷入严重争端。 我知道原因， 正打算支援该镇， 诱使它站到我方一边。 你可以帮我促成这件事。

en: Read and follow the hints in the Event window.
tr: 阅读并遵循事件窗口里的提示。

en: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>You have rescued the trader @N$Name$ from @T$DestTown$. He promises you a large reward if you return him to his hometown.
tr: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>你救起商人 @N$Name$ （来自 @T$DestTown$ ）。 只要你把他送回故乡， 他就给你丰厚酬谢。

en: Visit towns in 4 different nations with different sets of buildings<n><n:10>Enjoy a rich variety of graphics as you move through different landscapes.<n><n:10>Loot and capture towns for your favorite nation<n><n:10>Build your own towns<n><n:10>Buy businesses from other traders and establish monopolies on goods<n><n:10><o:0xFFFFEB7D>...take the whole of the Caribbean by storm!
tr: 造访 4 个不同国家的城镇， 各地建筑风格各异<n><n:10>穿行于多样的地貌之间， 尽享丰富的画面表现。<n><n:10>为你钟爱的国家洗劫与攻占城镇<n><n:10>建造你自己的城镇<n><n:10>从其他商人手中买下产业， 建立货物垄断<n><n:10><o:0xFFFFEB7D>…… 以风暴席卷整个加勒比海！

en: Read and follow the hints in the Event window.
tr: 阅读并遵循事件窗口里的提示。

en: Holland and England have made peace, so you can no longer capture any towns.<n><n>You got quite far in this scenario but you didn't have time to capture enough towns on behalf of Holland.<n><n>You can capture towns in the same way in free-play mode. However, you must first be sure that the nation whose towns you want to capture is militarily weak. In addition, the nation that wants to capture these towns must be militarily strong and the two nations must be at war with one another.<n><n>Note: You are usually awarded a plot of land on which you can establish your own towns whenever you capture towns for a viceroy. However, this feature is deactivated in this scenario.
tr: 荷兰与英格兰已经议和， 因此你再也无法攻占任何城镇。<n><n>你在这个剧本里走得相当远， 但没能及时为荷兰攻占足够多的城镇。<n><n>在自由模式中， 你也可以用同样的办法攻占城镇。 不过你必须先确认： 你想攻打城镇的那个国家在军事上处于弱势。 此外， 想要攻占这些城镇的那个国家必须军事强大， 而且这两个国家必须彼此交战。<n><n>注意： 当你为一位副王攻打城镇时， 通常会获得一块土地， 供你自己建造城镇。 不过本剧本中这项功能已被关闭。

en: The town information shows the goods that are produced in the town.<n><n>Your relationship with Spain is also displayed: This relationship is friendly! This means that you will be paid the best possible prices in the town.<n><n>Now close this window and take a look around the town.
tr: 城镇信息会显示这座城镇出产哪些货物。<n><n>你与西班牙的关系也会一并显示： 这层关系是友好的！ 这意味着你在这座城镇能拿到最有利的价格。<n><n>现在关闭这个窗口， 在城里四处看看。

en: Captains are always to be found at the inn. If there is a captain staying in the town, this will be indicated by the third button in the Inn menu.<n>If you have other ships or convoys in the harbor, you must tell the captain where exactly he is to be employed.<n>Specify that he is to captain your new ship.
tr: 船长总能在旅店里找到。 如果城里有船长住着， 旅店菜单里的第三个按钮就会有所提示。<n>如果你在港口里还有别的船只或船队， 你必须告诉船长他具体要在哪条船上任职。<n>指定由他指挥你的新船。

en: I am grateful for your support.
As of today, %1 and %2 are at war. Both sides increase their number of military convoys.
tr: 从今天起， %1 与 %2 宣战。 双方都增加了军事船队的数量。

en: A pirate convoy under the command of @P$PirateName$ is currently at large near the town of Belize, northwest of Cartagena. Your mission is to destroy the convoy. Then return to the Governor of Cartagena.
tr: 一支由 @P$PirateName$ 指挥的海盗船队目前正在卡塔赫纳西北方的伯利兹镇附近出没。 你的任务是摧毁这支船队。 之后返回卡塔赫纳总督处。

en: I'm afraid I'm unable to tell you where to find one of Blackbeard's convoys, as they are currently at a secret location. However, I'm allowing you plenty of time for this mission. You have until @D$EndDate$ to destroy a convoy.
tr: 恐怕我没法告诉你黑胡子的船队在哪里， 他们目前藏在一个秘密地点。 不过这项任务我给你留了充足的时间。 你有到 @D$EndDate$ 为止来摧毁一支船队。

en: I don't have any other news for you. Come back to see me another time.
tr: 我没有别的新消息要告诉你。 改天再来看看吧。

en: Good day to you, but I'm afraid you're too early! I have no new shares for you yet. Please be patient for another few days!
tr: 你好， 不过恐怕你来得太早了！ 我这里还没有新的分红给你。 请再耐心等几天！

en: You can now boost your reputation in %1 by attacking French ships and towns. This will not diminish your reputation in the other nations.
tr: 你现在可以靠袭击法国的船只和城镇来提升在 %1 的声望， 而不会削减你在其他国家的声望。

en: He is happy to teach the captain all about the art of navigation.
tr: 他很乐意把航海的门道全都教给这位船长。

en: Construct five different businesses and residential buildings in Tortuga and increase the population to 1,500 by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 在托尔图加建起五座不同的产业和住宅建筑， 并在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把人口增至 1500。

en: A storm front is moving from the northeast into the Caribbean. Production on crop farms is halved in all affected towns.
tr: 一股风暴锋面正从东北方向移入加勒比。 所有受影响城镇的作物农场产量减半。

en: Sell the goods in your warehouse in @T$TOWN$ to increase your cash to @g$GoldGoal$.
tr: 把 @T$TOWN$ 仓库里的货物卖掉， 把现金增加到 @g$GoldGoal$ 。

en: Then I shall charge you with bringing @T$TargetTown$ to the status "Flourishing economy" by @D$EndDate$. Bring the town the goods it needs and take away surplus goods, so that the resident traders start producing properly again.
tr: 那么我要你负责在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把 @T$TargetTown$ 提升到 「经济繁荣」 的等级。 把城镇需要的货物运进去、 把多余货物运出来， 让镇上的商人重新正常生产。

en: Your captain has won his sword fight against %1. Your men begin searching for the pirate treasure and find %2.<n><n>You have destroyed the hideout and ended the reign of pirate %3.
tr: 你的船长在与 %1 的刀剑比拼中获胜。 你的人开始搜寻海盗宝藏， 找到了 %2 。<n><n>你摧毁了藏身处， 终结了海盗 %3 的统治。

en: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>You discover a huge goods cache in the place the castaway described.<n>Unfortunately your convoy has no more space left on board, so you will have to leave the goods behind for now.
tr: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>你在那个遇难者描述的地点发现了一处巨大的货物藏点。<n>可惜你的船队船上已经没有空位， 暂时只能把这些货物留在原处。

en: Good! The convoy set sail from @T$HostileTown$ in the direction of Europe and will leave the Caribbean in the east. Search the entire route for the documents and bring them to me by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 好！ 船队已从 @T$HostileTown$ 起航驶向欧洲， 将从加勒比海的东面离开。 沿整条航线搜寻那些文件， 并在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把它们带给我。

en: So you must act quickly. It was last in @T$StartTown$, from there it set off for @T$DestTown$, where it will anchor for longer than usual. The longer you hold off your attack, the more gold it will have on board. You can keep the lot, but the treasure fleet must never reach Europe.
tr: 所以你得抓紧动手。 它上一站是 @T$StartTown$ ， 正驶向 @T$DestTown$ ， 会在那里停留得比平时更久。 你拖得越久， 它船上的黄金就越多。 这些钱你可以全拿走， 但宝藏船队绝不能抵达欧洲。

en: The place lies not far from %1, at most 1 day’s journey.
tr: 那个地方离 %1 不远， 最多一天航程。

en: The place is located in the region around %1 and Trinidad.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 与特立尼达之间的区域。

en: The position lies out of reach to the south of %1.
tr: 那个位置在遥不可及的 %1 以南。

en: You are truly generous. Search the waters outside the town, you may find clues as to where the drunkards congregate. I can only wait here until @D$EndDate$, please don't delay!
tr: 你真是慷慨。 去城镇外的海面上搜寻吧， 也许能找到那些醉汉聚居的线索。 我只能在这里等到 @D$EndDate$ ， 请别耽搁！

en: That's agreed then. Please loot @T$TargetTown$ and return my daughter to me. Her birthday is on @D$EndDate$ and she must be back here again for this special occasion.<n><n>If you do not yet possess a Letter of Marque against @n$HostileNation$, I will give you one.
tr: 那就说定了。 请洗劫 @T$TargetTown$ ， 把我女儿带回来。 她的生日是 @D$EndDate$ ， 这个特别的日子她必须赶回来。<n><n>如果你还没有针对 @n$HostileNation$ 的私掠许可证， 我就给你一张。

en: In the warehouse, you can see which buildings you own in the town and what it costs to maintain them.<n>You can also see how much rent your tenants pay you and what goods your businesses are producing.<n>Later, you'll be able to give the storekeeper instructions.<n>Have a look around the warehouse and then close it.
