tr: 在仓库里， 你可以看到自己在城中拥有哪些建筑， 以及维护它们要花多少钱。<n>你还能看到住户向你支付的租金， 以及各家企业正在生产哪些货物。<n>之后你就能向店主下达指令了。<n>在仓库里四处看看， 然后关闭它。

en: You have served my nation long and faithfully, now I must reward you for your loyalty. I shall give you a parcel of land on which you can establish your own town.
tr: 你长久以来忠心事奉我的国家， 如今我必须奖赏你的忠诚。 我赐你一块土地， 你可以据此建立自己的城镇。

en: I don't care if it was @N$OwnerName$ who sent you or the hunchbacked Grand Vizier of Taipei! I have a problem. And, until it is solved, I am not interested in hearing about anything else. I have a suggestion: How about you find me a chest, and I’ll tell you where this crazy old @N$TeacherName$ is hiding.
tr: 我不在乎是 @N$OwnerName$ 派你来的， 还是台北那个驼背大宰相派来的！ 我有个麻烦事。 在解决之前， 别的什么都别跟我提。 我有个提议： 你帮我找个箱子， 我就告诉你那个疯老头 @N$TeacherName$ 躲在哪儿。

en: All your sailors already have the highest possible morale.
tr: 你所有的水手士气都已经达到最高了。

en: Your captain has defeated the commander in the duel. <n><n>What do you want to do now?
tr: 你的船长在决斗中击败了对方指挥官。<n><n>你现在想怎么办？

en: We must make good this shortage quickly. Will you help me do this?
tr: 我们必须尽快补上这个缺口。 你愿意帮我吗？

en: You should now have sufficient town defenses for the moment. Now increase the size of your town and improve its appearance. Build a church, as well as more production facilities and residential areas to attract more than 2,200 inhabitants to your town.<n><n>You have until @D$EndDate$ to do so. The scenario will then be over.<n><n>Don't forget to sell the goods you produce at a profit! <n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Build a church and increase the population of your town to 2,200. You have until @D$EndDate$.
tr: 你现在的城镇防务应该已经够用了。 接下来扩张城镇规模、 改善城镇面貌。 建起一座教堂， 再多建些生产设施和住宅区， 吸引两千二百多名居民迁入你的城镇。<n><n>你要在 @D$EndDate$ 之前完成， 剧本随后即告结束。<n><n>别忘了把你生产出来的货物高价卖出！<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>建起一座教堂， 并把城镇人口增加到 2,200 人。 你有 @D$EndDate$ 的时间。

en: Thank you for the @g$TotalPrice$. Meet me at the market and I will give you the goods.
tr: 谢谢你付的 @g$TotalPrice$ 。 到市场来找我， 我把货物给你。

en: This action disbands the convoy and moves goods, cargo and boarding crew to the other convoy. The captain is dismissed and the Transfer window is closed. Do you want to choose this option?
tr: 这项操作会解散船队， 把货物、 货箱和登船船员转到另一支船队上。 船长会被解职， 转移窗口随之关闭。 确定要选这个操作吗？

en: I'm in an awkward position. I have until @D$EndDate$ to deliver @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ to @T$Town$, but my convoy is already underway with another delivery of goods. I'll make you the following offer: Pay me a surety of @g$PriceBuy$ and deliver the goods. You will then receive @g$PriceSell$ in return. What do you say to that?
tr: 我的处境有些棘手。 我必须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 运到 @T$Town$ ， 可我的船队已经在跑另一趟货了。 我给你这个提议： 付我 @g$PriceBuy$ 作为押金， 替我把货送到， 到时候你就能拿到 @g$PriceSell$ 。 怎么样？

en: You start the game with the rank of Sailor in the Spanish governor town of @T$TOWN$, where you already have a warehouse. You also have a convoy in the harbor with two armed ships but no sailors.<n><n>The first objective in this scenario is to visit the Governor of @T$TOWN$ and accept his mission. He is having problems with the notorious pirate, Edward Teach, better known as Blackbeard, and wants you to help him.<n><n>Important: The nations are at peace in this scenario. This means that you must never attack a convoy belonging to a nation.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Visit the Governor of @T$TOWN$ and accept the mission he assigns to you.
tr: 你以水手身份在西班牙总督城 @T$TOWN$ 起步， 那里已经有一座属于你的仓库。 你的港口里还有一支船队， 配有两艘武装船， 却没有水手。<n><n>本剧本的第一个目标， 是拜访 @T$TOWN$ 的总督并接下他的任务。 他正被臭名昭著的海盗爱德华·蒂奇(即黑胡子)搅得不得安宁， 想请你出手相助。<n><n>注意： 本剧本中各国处于和平状态。 这意味着你绝不可攻击任何国家的船队。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>拜访 @T$TOWN$ 的总督， 接下他交给你的任务。

en: I have managed to plant a spy on board a Spanish ship
tr: 我设法在一条西班牙船上安插了密探

en: Greetings, %1. Shall I arrange a feast for you in our town? It will improve prosperity in this town for a time and will help you to obtain a building permit.<n><n>The feast shall be held no later than %2.<n><n>How lavish should the feast be?
tr: 你好， %1 。 要我在城里为你办一场宴会吗？ 这会让城镇繁荣一阵子， 也有助于你取得建筑许可证。<n><n>宴会最迟要在 %2 之前举行。<n><n>宴会要办得多隆重？

en: One of the most popular pirates of all time was Edward Teach (died 1718), alias Blackbeard, whose hallmark, as his name implies, was his fearsome black plaited beard. With a crew of 300 men, he sailed the high seas in his ship, Queen Anne’s Revenge, a converted Dutch trading ship, and had no fear of taking on the warships of the Royal Navy.<n><n>Over a period of 18 months, Teach, who was born in Bristol, wrought havoc, mainly in the northern part of the West Indies and along the coast of North America. He was always able to find refuge in the Bahamas and in poverty-stricken North Carolina.<n><n>Another reason why Blackbeard was so famous was that he fitted the stereotype of a terrifying, hot-blooded and temperamental buccaneer: He is alleged to have maimed his gunner Israel Hands by shooting him twice, for no reason other than to remind the rest of the crew who was in charge.<n><n>His final hour only arrived in 1718 when the pirate hunter Robert Maynard tracked down his sloop. Despite being roaring drunk, Teach fought like a demon and was only defeated after a bitter struggle. He was killed in the battle and most of the surviving members of his crew were hanged.
tr: 有史以来最受欢迎的海盗之一， 是爱德华·蒂奇(卒于 1718 年)， 也就是黑胡子。 正如其名所示， 他的标志特征是那条骇人的黑色辫须。 他率领 300 名船员， 驾着 「安妮女王复仇号」 在公海上驰骋—— 那是一艘改装的荷兰商船—— 面对皇家海军战舰也毫无惧色。<n><n>在 18 个月里， 蒂奇大肆劫掠， 主要在西印度群岛北部和北美沿岸。 他总能在巴哈马和贫困的北卡罗来纳找到藏身之处。<n><n>黑胡子之所以如此出名， 还有一个原因： 他完美契合了那个可怕、 热血又暴躁的私掠者刻板印象。 据说他的炮手以色列·汉斯被他连开两枪打伤， 理由无非是要提醒其余船员， 这里谁说了算。<n><n>他的末日直到 1718 年才到来， 当时的捕海盗人罗伯特·梅纳德追踪到了他的单桅帆船。 尽管已经烂醉如泥， 蒂奇仍像恶魔一样战斗， 经过苦战才被击败。 他战死沙场， 幸存船员中的大部分被处以绞刑。

en: It was probably the Roman writer Polybius who first mentioned the word “pirate” (peirato) at around 140 BC. Since then, many different words have been used to refer to these fearful seafaring villains: Corsairs, freebooters, buccaneers, filibusters ... The men who surrounded Klaus Störtebeker were known as “The Vitalian Brotherhood” and Bartholomew Roberts gave himself and his band of murderous thugs the rather innocuous title “Gentlemen of Fortune”. Ultimately, however, it made little difference to the trader who it was who emerged out of the void to attack his ship. <n><n>Buccaneers have been a scourge to mankind down through the ages in every corner of the world. In ancient times, the Cicilian pirates spread such terror across the entire Mediterranean that the Roman Empire was forced to mount regular campaigns against them. Hidden islands and jagged coastlines located near to frequently-traveled trade routes provided the ideal locations for pirate activity: Those areas where reefs, currents and bad weather conditions made easy targets of the cumbersome trading ships provided a refuge to which one could quickly retreat after the outrage had been committed. The coast of Asia Minor was as feared in ancient times as the Caribbean was during the Age of Discovery, while the pirates of Southeast Asia assumed an almost mythical status.<n><n>According to the origins of the word, a “buccaneer” was actually a seaman who put to sea as a private individual, not as a sailor of the navy, in search of booty and who was therefore considered to be engaged in piracy. <n><n>However, the issuing of Letters of Marque gave some of the Caribbean buccaneers a semblance of legality. These documents were issued by English, French or Dutch governors and their purpose was to direct the scourge of piracy at the opposing powers.<n><n> The ease with which Letters of Marque could be obtained depended on the particular governor. One governor would consider it dishonorable to enter into a pact with pirates. Others were rather less scrupulous or may simply have been corrupt or cowardly.
tr: 「pirate」 （peirato） 这个词， 大概最早是罗马作家波利比乌斯在公元前 140 年前后提出的。 此后， 人们用过许多不同的词来指称这些可怕的海上恶徒： corsair、 freebooter、 buccaneer、 filibuster…… 克劳斯·施托特贝克尔周围那帮人被称为 「维塔利安兄弟会」， 而巴塞洛缪·罗伯茨则给自己和那伙杀人刽子手取了个听起来无害无害的称号—— 「幸运绅士」。 可对那个商人来说， 出手的究竟是谁其实根本无所谓： 反正总有人会从虚空里冒出来， 袭击他的船。<n><n>世世代代以来， 私掠者都是人类在世界各地的祸害。 在古代， 西西里海盗在整个地中海制造了如此彻底的恐怖， 以至于罗马帝国不得不周期性地对他们发动讨伐。 那些隐蔽的岛屿与嶙峋的海岸线紧邻繁忙的贸易航线， 是海盗活动的绝佳据点： 在暗礁、 暗流与恶劣天气让笨重的商船轻易成为猎物的地方， 就有可供作案的巢穴， 犯下暴行之后可以迅速撤回去。 古代的小亚细亚海岸之可怕， 不亚于大航海时代的加勒比； 而东南亚的海盗则近乎神话般的存在。<n><n>从词源上说， 「buccaneer」 原意是一个以私人身份出海、 而非作为海军水手航行的海员， 为的是寻找战利品， 因此被视为从事海盗活动。<n><n>然而， 私掠许可证的颁发， 让加勒比的某些私掠者看上去多少有了几分合法性。 这些文件由英国、 法国或荷兰的总督签发， 目的是把海盗之祸引向敌对势力。<n><n>私掠许可证容易到什么程度就能拿到， 取决于具体是哪位总督。 有的总督认为与海盗订立约定是不名誉的； 另一些则没那么讲究， 或者干脆就是腐败或胆怯。

en: The “seven seas” are actually only three (namely, the three oceans): The North and South Pacific, the North and South Atlantic, the Arctic and Antarctic Oceans and the Indian Ocean.<n><n> The Pacific Ocean owes its name to the first circumnavigation of the globe by Fernando Magellan, who had the good fortune to encounter favorable weather during the many hungry weeks it took him to cross this vast ocean.<n><n>And another thing: The Caribbean derives its name from the “Karibe” (or “Karaibe”), the peoples of an Indian language group, whose area of settlement stretched from the Antilles along the northern coast of South America.
tr: 所谓 「七大洋」， 其实只有三个 （即三大洋）： 北太平洋与南太平洋、 北大西洋与南西洋、 北冰洋与南极洋， 以及印度洋。<n><n>太平洋的名字， 要归功于费尔南多·麦哲伦环球航行的壮举： 在横渡这片辽阔大洋的漫长而饥饿的日子里， 他运气极好， 一路遇上了好天气。<n><n>还有一点： 加勒比之名源自 「Karibe」 （或作 「Karaibe」）， 那是某个印第安语系民族的称呼， 他们的地盘从安的列斯群岛一路沿着南美洲北岸铺开。

en: Without doubt, the voyages of Christopher Columbus (1451-1506) to America ranked among the greatest adventures ever undertaken by mankind. Even a writer could hardly dare to imagine such a tale of dramatic events and strange coincidences.<n><n>Although the navigator from Genoa had managed to convince the royal couple Isabella and Ferdinand of Spain of his idea that there was a western sea route to India, he was certainly not able to rely on the assent of the crew on board. Indeed, most of the crew were pressed into service: As punishment for misdemeanors against the Crown, the town of Palos was forced to provide two ships with crews.<n><n>The news of Columbus’ plan provoked expressions of horror. The crew was firmly convinced that they were sailing under the command of a madman who could only bring destruction on himself and all who sailed with him.<n><n>However, Columbus’ greatest enemy was superstition: Every imaginable tale of horror appeared to have made its way on board and any strange or sinister events only reinforced the sailor’s fears: A volcano erupted as they sailed past Tenerife, then they saw columns of fire in the sky and even the compass needle appeared to be playing tricks on the crew. If the ships were becalmed, this was seen as a bad omen. On the other hand, if they made good progress, this meant that the wind always blew from east to west and that they would never be able to turn around.<n><n>On many occasions, a mutiny appeared to be inevitable. One night, the captain heard footsteps and muttering outside his cabin, and only when he started to pray in a loud voice did the assassins lose courage and sneak away.<n><n>The most serious crises always broke out when what was thought to be an island on the horizon turned out once again to be nothing more than an optical illusion. It was just such an occurrence on October 10th that brought matters to a head. With great difficulty, Columbus negotiated an ultimatum of three days, after which the crew wanted to turn around (preferably without their captain). However, fate had other intentions: They did in fact sight land within these thee days. None of those present could have dreamt that, instead of Asia, they had stumbled upon a completely new and unknown continent.<n><n>Japan and China still lay thousands of nautical miles away and only for the unbelievable good fortune that a foreign continent lay in its path, Columbus’ expedition would have been lost. The morale of the crew was immediately lifted. None of them could recall ever having harbored thoughts of mutiny ...
tr: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布 （1451 — 1506年） 前往美洲的航程， 无疑位列人类所进行过的最伟大冒险之中。 即便是作家， 也几乎不敢想象出这样一部由戏剧性事件与离奇巧合构成的故事。<n><n>这位热那亚航海家虽然说服了西班牙王室夫妇伊莎贝拉与斐迪南， 相信存在一条通往印度的西行航路， 却显然无法指望船上的船员们会同意。 事实上， 大多数船员都是被强征来的： 作为对王室不敬行为的惩罚， 帕洛斯城被迫提供两艘船和船员。<n><n>哥伦布计划的消息引发了种种惊恐的议论。 船员们坚信， 他们是在一个疯子的指挥下航行， 这个人只会给他自己以及所有跟他一起出海的人带来毁灭。<n><n>然而， 哥伦布最大的敌人是迷信： 各种能想象到的恐怖故事似乎都混上了船， 任何怪异的或不祥的事件只会加深水手们的恐惧—— 驶过特内里费岛时火山喷发， 随后他们看到天空中出现火柱， 甚至连罗盘的指针都像是在跟船员们耍花招。 船只若遇风平浪静， 就被视为不祥之兆。 反过来， 如果他们进展顺利， 就意味着风总是从东往西吹， 他们永远都无法掉头返航。<n><n>很多次， 哗变似乎都不可避免。 一天夜里， 船长听见舱外有脚步声和低声咒骂， 直到他开始大声祈祷， 那些刺客才失去勇气， 悄悄溜走。<n><n>最严重的危机总是发生在这样的时刻： 地平线上那个被当成岛屿的东西， 结果又一次不过是一场海市蜃楼。 10 月 10 日发生的正是这样一件事， 把事情推到了紧要关头。 哥伦布费尽周折谈成了一个最后通牒： 三天之后， 船员们就要调头返航 （最好是不带船长一起）。 然而命运另有安排： 他们确实在这三天里看见了陆地。 在场的人谁也想不到， 他们找到的不是亚洲， 而是一块全新且未知的大陆。<n><n>日本与中国仍在数千海里之外， 若非命运之神给了他们难以置信的好运， 让一块外来大陆恰好横在航路上， 哥伦布的远征早已全军覆没。 船员的士气立刻大振。 他们谁也再也想不起自己曾有过哗变的念头……

en: A mere two weeks after his arrival in the New World, Christopher Columbus reached Cuba, the largest island in the West Indies. Several tribes lived here, the Ciboney, die Guanahatabey and the Tainos, who, despite their peaceful nature, all suffered the same unhappy fate as other Native American tribes: In 1511, after fighting a four-year war against the Spanish, they were conquered and exterminated. This then resulted in large numbers of black slaves being imported here. The island, with its capital city Havana, was divided into seven administrative areas (cabildos), each of which sent a deputy to a special council. The deputy’s duty was to represent local interests of the area.<n><n>What is remarkable about the history of Cuba is that, apart from a short interlude of British control from 1762 to 1763, the island remained in Spanish hands for a relatively long time. This may have been because Cuba was not one of the most important areas of the Spanish empire during colonial times (for example, there were hardly any mineral deposits) and was generally used as a stopover on the way to the continent. In any case, while the vast majority of South American and Central American countries fought for their independence in the first quarter of the 19th century, the Spanish were able to hold on to Cuba until 1898, when they ceded control of the island to the United States.
tr: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布抵达新大陆仅仅两周， 便到达了西印度群岛最大的岛屿—— 古巴。 这里生活着若干族群： 西博尼人、 瓜纳哈塔贝人和泰诺人。 尽管他们性情温和， 却都和其他美洲原住民族一样遭遇了同样的不幸结局： 1511 年， 在与西班牙人打完四年战争之后， 他们被征服并灭绝。 此后， 大批黑人奴隶被输入此地。 这座岛屿连同其首府哈瓦那， 被划分为七个行政管区 （cabildos）， 各管区派出一名代表参加一个专门的议会。 代表的职责是维护本地区的利益。<n><n>古巴的历史引人注目之处在于： 除了 1762 年至 1763 年一段短暂的英国占领期外， 这座岛屿在西班牙人手中握有相当长的时间。 这或许是因为在殖民时代， 古巴并非西班牙帝国最重要的地区之一 （比如那里几乎没有任何矿藏）， 而它通常只是驶往大陆途中的中转站。 无论如何， 当南美和中美洲绝大多数国家都在 19 世纪第一个四分之一世纪里为独立而战时， 西班牙人却一直守住了古巴， 直到 1898 年， 才把该岛的控制权让给美国。

en: That's a strange and very interesting artifact you've found there. Please leave it here with me and bring me any other artifacts you can find. Maybe I can find out something about them.
tr: 你找到的这件文物真是奇特又有意思。 请把它留在我这儿， 再把你能找到的其他文物都带来。 或许我能从中看出些名堂。

en: He often has business to attend to in the middle of the Caribbean, between Andross, Charles Towne, Santo Domingo and Port Royale
tr: 他常常在加勒比海中部办事， 在安德罗斯、 查尔斯敦、 圣多明各与皇家港之间的区域。

en: Increase the population of your town to 480.
tr: 把你城镇的人口增加到 480。

en: Quality of Life in Your Town

The ship's technical details, such as its maximum load capacity, are displayed here as in the shipyard.<n>You can also see the daily cost of  maintaining the ship.<n>Now convert the ship into a warship by ticking the cannon symbol.
tr: 船只的技术参数 （比如最大载货量） 会像在船厂里一样显示在这里。<n>你还能看到维持这艘船的每日开销。<n>现在勾选火炮图标， 把这艘船转为军舰。

en: We are at war with @n$HostileNation$ and I am itching to sabotage a town belonging to our enemies. Do you wish to help me cut the supply of goods to a town, in order to bring down its status?
tr: 我们正与 @n$HostileNation$ 交战， 我正迫不及待想去破坏一座敌方城镇。 你愿意帮我切断某座城镇的货物供应， 好压低它的等级吗？

en: A small box contains an ornate device that can be used to light a fire very easily. This box is covered in mysterious engravings.
tr: 一只小盒子里装着一件精巧的装置， 可以很方便地生火。 盒面上满是神秘的刻纹。

en: It is 1676 in the Dutch governor town of the Turk Islands. Holland is in possession of seven towns, five of which are colonial towns, one a governor town and one a viceroy town.<n><n>England is in possession of 14 towns and has been at war with Holland for a long time and will continue to be for many months to come. As long as this war lasts, you must capture towns from the English Crown on behalf of Holland.<n><n>But before you can attack any English towns, you need more capital and more arms for your convoy. Your first objective is to defeat three English trading convoys and capture their ships.<n><n>First, though, you must obtain a Letter of Marque from the Dutch governor in the Turk Islands.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Pay a visit to the Governor of the Turk Islands and obtain a Letter of Marque against England.
tr: 1676 年， 荷兰人统治的特克群岛上。 荷兰拥有七座城镇， 其中五座是殖民城镇， 一座是总督城， 一座是副王城。<n><n>英国拥有 14 座城镇， 并且与荷兰打了很久的仗， 而且这场战争还会再持续许多个月。 只要战争还在继续， 你就必须代表荷兰去夺取英国王室手中的城镇。<n><n>但在你攻打任何英国城镇之前， 你的船队还需要更多资金和更多武装。 你的第一个目标， 是击败三支英国贸易船队并缴获它们的船。<n><n>不过首先， 你必须从特克群岛的荷兰总督那里取得一份私掠许可证。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>拜访特克群岛总督， 取得针对英国的私掠许可证。

en: %1,<n>I am so happy to see you again. Tell me how you've been since we last met. Did you bring something for me?
tr: %1 ，<n>真高兴又见到你。 说说我们分别后你过得怎么样。 有给我带东西吗？

en: A Spanish military convoy is attacking
tr: 西班牙军事船队正在进攻

en: You need tools to produce colonial goods. In the same way, you need raw materials to produce finished goods. Finished goods include rope and cloth, for example. The raw materials for these are hemp and cotton.<n><n>Now that you know how to build production facilities, you should purchase a building permit in a governor town and build facilities there for producing finished goods. However, before you can purchase a building permit, you must have established a proven trading record with the town, which means that you must sell goods to the town when they are in scarce supply.<n><n>But be careful! If you buy up scarce goods in a town, this has a negative effect on your trading record with the town! Goods that are scarce in a town are displayed in red in the Trade window.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Improve your trading record in Cartagena so that you can purchase a building permit there.
tr: 你要有工具才能生产殖民地商品。 同理， 你要有原料才能生产成品。 成品例如绳索和布料， 而它们的原料则是大麻和棉花。<n><n>既然你已经知道怎么建生产设施了， 就应当到总督城去买一份建造许可， 并在那里建起生产成品的设施。 不过在你能够买到建造许可之前， 你必须先与该城镇建立一份有口皆碑的贸易记录—— 也就是说， 当城镇里某种货物紧缺时， 你要卖货给它。<n><n>但要当心！ 如果你在某座城镇里大量收购紧缺货物， 这会损害你与该城镇的贸易记录！ 城镇中紧缺的货物， 在贸易窗口里是以红色显示的。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>改善你在卡塔赫纳的贸易记录， 以便能在那里购买建造许可。

en: Greetings! Do you own a ship? I lost mine in a recent storm. Fortunately, I was able to save myself, but I lost my chest containing many of my most precious personal effects. Could you set sail and see whether my chest is still floating around somewhere at sea? I will reward you handsomely, for the chest is very valuable to me.
tr: 你好！ 你有自己的船吗？ 我的船在最近一场风暴里丢了。 所幸我保住了性命， 可装着我许多最珍贵私人物品的箱子却没了。 你能出海去看看我的箱子是否还漂在海上某处吗？ 我会重重酬谢， 那箱子对我意义重大。

en: Congratulations! You have successfully completed the scenario and have captured several English towns on behalf of Holland.<n><n>You can capture towns in the same way in free-play mode. But remember to ensure that the nation whose towns you want to capture must be militarily weak. In addition, the nation for which you want to capture towns must be militarily weak and the two nations in question must be at war.<n><n>Note: You are usually rewarded with a plot of land on which you can build your own towns when you capture towns for a viceroy. However, this feature is deactivated in this scenario.
tr: 恭喜！ 你已顺利完成这个剧本， 并代表荷兰攻占了几座英国城镇。<n><n>在自由模式中， 你也可以用同样的办法攻占城镇。 但请务必记住： 你想攻打城镇的那个国家， 必须在军事上处于弱势。 此外， 你打算为其攻打城镇的那个国家同样必须军力薄弱， 而且这两个国家必须处于交战状态。<n><n>注意： 当你为一位副王攻打城镇时， 通常会获得一块土地， 供你自己建造城镇。 不过本剧本中这项功能已被关闭。

en: Today, the English buccaneer %1 encountered a Spanish military convoy and was killed.
tr: 今天， 英格兰私掠者 %1 遭遇西班牙军事船队， 被击杀了。

en: It is the year 1570 and we find ourselves in the Caribbean. Your objective is to rise from being a humble trader to become an influential businessman. To help you achieve the status you seek, you can transport goods as well as trade, build, and engage in politics and piracy.<n><n>The following scenario will teach you the basics of how to play the game. As with the other scenarios, this involves several different objectives. You must achieve all of your objectives to successfully complete the scenario.<n><n>You can now close this window using the Close button and refer to the Event window in the bottom-left of your screen.<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Follow the instructions in the Event window.
tr: 1570 年， 我们来到加勒比海。 你的目标是从一个默默无闻的小商人， 成长为一位举足轻重的实业家。 为了帮你取得所追求的地位， 你可以既跑运输、 又做贸易， 还能搞建筑、 参与政治与海盗活动。<n><n>接下来的剧本会教你游戏的基本玩法。 与其他剧本一样， 这里包含若干个不同的目标。 你必须完成全部目标， 才能顺利通关。<n><n>你现在可以点 「关闭」 按钮关掉这个窗口， 然后查看屏幕左下角的事件窗口。<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>按照事件窗口里的指示去做。

en: Notice how the price of wheat has just gone up? <n>Note, however, that the price depends not only on the supply but also on your reputation in the town.<n>Click on the button with the building to the bottom-right of the Trade window.
tr: 注意到小麦的价格刚刚上涨了吗？<n>不过要注意， 价格不只取决于供应量， 还取决于你在这座城镇的声望。<n>点击贸易窗口右下角那个带房屋图标的按钮。

en: You have chased the viceroy out of town. From this day on, this town belongs to %1.
tr: 你已把副王逐出城镇。 从今天起， 这座城镇归 %1 所有。

en: The status of a town can advance through seven levels, from poverty to wealth. At the lowest two levels, the quality of life is so bad that citizens regularly leave the town. On the other hand, when a town reaches the levels of “flourishing economy”, “wealth” and “riches”, your businesses receive an efficiency bonus and your workforce is more cost-efficient. At the highest level, a town even produces its own settlers.<n><n>You will find more information on the effects of each status level in the town information. To display this, click on the town name.<n><n> A sufficient supply of two to three goods in each goods group will ensure a good quality of life in your town. The supply of a good is sufficient if it can cater for the town’s population for ten days.<n><n>Note: A town's status doesn't improve overnight. It takes a while for the town’s citizens to adapt to a new situation.
tr: 城镇地位共分八级， 从萧条一直升到富有。 在最低的两级， 生活质量糟糕到居民经常离城而去。 反过来， 当一座城镇达到 「兴旺」 「富裕」 和 「富有」 这些等级时， 你的产业会获得效率加成， 你的劳动力也会变得更划算。 而在最高等级， 城镇甚至能自行生产移民。<n><n>关于每个地位等级的具体影响， 你可以在城镇信息里查到。 点击城镇名称即可打开。<n><n>每一组货物中， 有两到三种货物供应充足， 就能确保城镇的生活质量良好。 所谓某种货物供应充足， 是指它能维持城镇人口十天的用量。<n><n>注意： 城镇地位不会一夜之间提升。 城镇居民适应新情况需要一段时间。

en: The %1 buccaneer %2 has caused a plague of rats in the town. The consumption of wheat, fruit, corn and meat is twice as high for one month.
tr: %1 私掠者 %2 在城镇里引发了鼠患。 接下来一个月， 小麦、 水果、 玉米和肉的消耗量将翻倍。

en: You have found the chest of @N$ContactName$.<n><n>
A local trader is prepared to sell you the residential area for a price of %1.
tr: 一位本地商人愿意以 %1 的价格把住宅区卖给你。

en: He will therefore teach the young captain everything he knows about winning battles.
tr: 因此他会把自己所知的取胜之道全部教给这位年轻船长。

en: Donated by %1<n>on %2.<n><n>The school improves the quality of life in the town.
tr: %1<n>于 %2 捐赠。<n><n>这所学校改善了城镇的生活质量。

en: This must be a position in the middle of the Caribbean.
tr: 这必定是加勒比海中央的一处位置。

en: The place lies somewhere in the east.
tr: 那个地方在东方的某处。

en: The place lies in the Southern Caribbean.
tr: 那个地方在加勒比海南部。

en: While looting the town, your men come across a young lad with a poodle. The boy tells you that the Governor of @T$TOWN$ staged the kidnapping himself, in order to get rid of the dog. The captain decides to take Michelle on board his ship. He then wonders if it is worth returning the dog to the Governor of @T$TOWN$.<n><n>Do you want to throw the dog overboard?
tr: 洗劫城镇时， 你的人遇见一个牵着贵宾犬的少年。 那孩子告诉你， 是 @T$TOWN$ 的总督自己策划了这起绑架， 为的就是除掉这条狗。 船长于是把米歇尔带上船， 接着琢磨到底值不值得把狗送回 @T$TOWN$ 的总督那里。<n><n>你要把这条狗扔下海吗？

en: You have sabotaged the town of @T$TargetTown$ and I thank you on behalf of my nation. I have a very special reward for you. I have persuaded a very experienced captain to join you. His name is @N$CaptainName$ and he awaits you at the inn.
tr: 你破坏了 @T$TargetTown$ ， 我代表我国向你道谢。 我为你准备了一份特别的奖赏： 我已说服一位经验极其丰富的船长加入你。 他叫 @N$CaptainName$ ， 正在旅店等你。

en: Excellent. The ship has already left the harbor of @T$HostileTown$ bound for Europe. However, she is carrying a passenger who still owes me a favor. He will search the ship for documents and will secretly throw them overboard, one after the other. Your mission is to collect the documents and bring them to me by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 很好。 那艘船已经驶离 @T$HostileTown$ 的港口， 目的地是欧洲。 不过船上有一名乘客， 还欠我一个人情。 他会搜查船舱， 找出文件并一本接一本偷偷抛进海里。 你的任务是把文件收集起来， 并在 @D$EndDate$ 之前带给我。

en: The town is recovering from a plague.
tr: 城镇正在从瘟疫中恢复。

en: %1 has set loose %2 the buccaneer to sabotage our towns. Only recently he attacked %3, and now he is en route to his home town. You would do me and my nation a huge favor if you were to stop this buccaneer in his tracks.
tr: %1 放走了 %2 这个私掠分子， 让他去破坏我们的城镇。 他刚袭击了 %3 ， 现在正回他的老巢。 你要是能把他拦下来， 就是帮了我和我们国家的大忙。

en: I am quite sure he could teach one of your captains a thing or two! So, will you give me the gold?
tr: 我敢说他一定能教会你手下一位船长几招！ 怎么样， 钱给不给？

en: @s$USER$, I've heard you are interested in treasure maps. I have a piece here that belongs to your map. I'll give it to you for @g$Price$.
tr: @s$USER$ ， 听说你对藏宝图有兴趣。 我这儿有一块， 正好能接上你的那张。 卖你 @g$Price$ 。

en: %1 %2 receives the town of %3 from the English viceroy.
tr: %1・%2 从英格兰副王手中接管了 %3 。

en: You'll have a lot more to do in this scenario than in the first. You'll learn how to trade successfully and make your first trading profits.<n><n>You'll also form a second convoy to allow you to transport more goods.<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Read and follow the hints in the Event window.
tr: 这个剧本里你要做的事， 比第一个剧本多得多。 你会学会怎么做生意赚到第一桶金。<n><n>你还将组建第二支船队， 以便运载更多货物。<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>阅读并照做 「事件」 窗口里的提示。

en: Nice work! You now have an impressive convoy.<n><n>Your next task won't be an easy one, as it involves attacking and defeating an English military convoy. The Governor of the Turk Islands has provided you with another ship as backup. Locate it in the harbor of the Turk Islands and add it to your convoy.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Destroy an English military convoy.
tr: 干得漂亮！ 你现在有一支像样的船队了。<n><n>下一项任务可不轻松： 要攻打并击败一支英格兰军事船队。 特克群岛的总督已为你增派了一艘战舰作为后援， 去特克群岛的港口找到它， 把它并入船队。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFHk.res><n><n><c>摧毁一支英格兰军事船队。

en: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>The treasure chest is empty, however, it served as a buoy for a rope. Not far below the surface, you discover a hideout containing cannons. Your crew haul as many of these cannons as possible on board.
tr: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>宝箱是空的， 不过它曾被用作缆绳上的浮标。 离水面不远的地方， 你发现一处堆着火炮的藏点。 船员们尽可能多地把火炮搬上了船。

en: <n><n>To attack the hideout, you must send a convoy there in the same way you would send one to a town. Watch out! Any pirate convoy that is not in the hideout when you attack will be warned and will set up a new hideout.
tr: <n><n>要攻打藏身处， 你得像派船队去城镇那样， 派一支船队过去。 小心！ 进攻时凡是不在藏身处里的海盗船队都会收到消息， 然后另立新的藏身处。

en: Do you know what the best thing would be? To buy up the imported goods in @n$Nation2$ and cause a shortage there. Deliver @a$Amount$ of each to the marketplace. My emissary will wait there until @D$Date$ and will pay you a high price.
tr: 你知道最划算的做法是什么吗？ 去 @n$Nation2$ 把进口货物全部买走， 让那边缺货。 再把每样 @a$Amount$ 份送到市场。 我的特使会一直等到 @D$Date$ ， 并给你高价。

en: So, @N$OwnerName$ sent you to see me? Yes, I do know this old captain, he could certainly teach your crew a thing or two. Why should I help you though? But I don't want to be difficult, I appreciate you must have spent some time tracking me down. If you do a small favor for me, I'll tell you where the captain has retired.
tr: 哦， @N$OwnerName$ 派你来找我？ 这位老船长我确实认识， 他肯定能教会你船员一些东西。 可我为什么要帮你呢？ 算了， 我不刁难你—— 我知道你找我也花了些工夫。 你帮我个小忙， 我就告诉你那船长退隐何处。

en: Look out for French trading convoys and sink or capture at least @I$NumShips$ ships.
tr: 留意法国商船队， 击沉或俘获其中至少 @I$NumShips$ 艘船。

en: Look out for Dutch trading convoys and sink or capture at least @I$NumShips$ ships.
tr: 留意荷兰商船队， 击沉或俘获其中至少 @I$NumShips$ 艘船。

en: I hear that you want to put yourself to the test as commander of a sea battle. Well, I have a task for you that could benefit both of us.<n>Two abandoned ships are floating aimlessly at sea as we speak. I want you to get rid of these ships before they start to pose a threat to my traders.<n>Do you accept this mission?
tr: 听说你想检验一下自己作为海战指挥官的本事。 好， 我有个任务， 对你我都有好处。<n>此刻有两艘被遗弃的船在海上漫无目的地漂流。 我要你在它们威胁到我的商人之前把它们清除掉。<n>你接受这个任务吗？

en: You now see the familiar town view again, but this time it's of Port Royale. You can move through any town in which you have convoys or buildings.<n>Look for the shipyard in the harbor and click on it, because we want to buy a new ship.
tr: 现在又看到熟悉的城镇视图了， 不过这次是皇家港。 凡是拥有你船队或建筑的城市， 你都可以前往。<n>在港口里找到船坞并点它一下， 我们要买一艘新船。

en: Click on the goods to activate or cancel sale.
tr: 点击货物可开启或取消出售。

en: Here in the island chain, you’ll see a break. To the west there are islands and in the south. In the north there is nothing, only water and smoke.
tr: 在这串岛屿中间， 你会看到一处断口。 西边和南边都有岛屿。 北边什么也没有， 只有水和烟。

en: Attack on a Spanish transport convoy
tr: 袭击一支西班牙运输船队

en: My father tells me that the pirate %1 currently poses the greatest threat. He has %2 convoys and a total of %3 ships.
tr: 我父亲告诉我， 海盗 %1 是眼下最大的威胁。 他有 %2 支船队， 合计 %3 艘船。

en: The pirate %1 poses the greatest threat. He has %3 ships and a total of %2 convoys. I managed to establish the last known position of one of his convoys. %4 I'll mark the spot on the sea chart for you.
tr: 海盗 %1 是最大的威胁。 他有 %3 艘船， 合计 %2 支船队。 我设法查到了他其中一支船队最后已知的位置。 %4 我在海图上给你标出来。

en: You have also learned something very interesting: the treasure fleet is currently in %1!
tr: 你还打听到一件很有意思的事： 宝藏船队目前就在 %1 ！

en: There is a ship available in the harbor.
tr: 港口里有一艘可用的船。

en: The convoy cannot set sail because the crew's morale is too low. Give them more shore leave or have the convoy blessed in the church.
tr: 船队无法启航， 因为船员士气太低。 多给他们一些上岸休假， 或者到教堂为船队祈福。

en: %1,<n>greetings. Let me have a quick look through my documents, so I can see if I have something for you.
tr: %1 ，<n>欢迎光临。 容我翻翻手头的文书， 看看有没有能给你的东西。

en: and may now control any number of captains and permits.
tr: 现在船长数与许可证数都不限上限了。

en: One of our towns now hardly sees a trader from one end of the week to the next, because a rumor has spread that a plague has hit the town. Can you help me to quash the rumor by supplying the town with goods?
tr: 我们的某座城镇现在从这周初到下周初都见不到几个商人， 因为有传言说那座城镇爆发了瘟疫。 你能帮我平息谣言， 给那座城镇供货吗？

en: The threat of a plague has loomed over one of our towns in recent weeks. To make matters worse, the traders are giving the town a wide berth now as well. Can you help support the town until the situation improves?
tr: 近几周来， 瘟疫的威胁一直悬在我们的某座城镇上空。 更糟的是， 商人如今也对该城敬而远之。 你能帮助扶持这座城镇， 直到情况好转吗？

en: I have managed to plant a spy on board an English ship.
tr: 我设法在一条英国船上安插了密探。

en: You should be able to find him there in the next couple of months.
tr: 接下来这几个月， 你应该能在那儿找到他。

en: Greetings, %1. Shall I arrange a feast for you in our town? It will improve prosperity in this town for a time and will enhance your reputation in my nation.<n><n>The feast shall be held no later than %2.<n><n>How lavish should the feast be?
tr: 你好， %1 。 要我在城里为你办一场宴会吗？ 这会让城镇繁荣一阵子， 也会提升你在我国的声望。<n><n>宴会最迟要在 %2 之前举行。<n><n>宴会要办得多隆重？

en: <ts:80>Due to wear and tear, a %1 D774has sunk today on the trade route.<n><n>Losses:<n><n>Goods:<t>%2<n>Cannons:<t>%3<n>Sailors:<t>%4<n><n>Pay more attention to the condition of your ships. You can also activate automatic repairs for trade routes.
tr: <ts:80>因磨损老化， 今天有一艘 %1 在贸易航线上沉没。<n><n>损失：<n><n>货物： <t>%2<n>火炮： <t>%3<n>水手： <t>%4<n><n>多留意船的状况。 你也可以为贸易航线启用自动维修。

en: Have you ever come across the term “indentured labor”? I could tell you something about this.
tr: 你听说过 「契约劳工」 这个词吗？ 关于这个我可以跟你谈谈。

en: Let me tell you a little about Cuba, the largest island in the West Indies.
tr: 让我跟你略谈古巴， 西印度群岛中最大的岛。

en: Your captain has won the duel and boarded the enemy ship.
tr: 你的船长赢下了决斗， 并登上了敌船。

en: Congratulations! You now have some experience of producing goods. You may also have noticed that it is not always easy to sell the goods you have produced at a profit while keeping your business afloat by trading in other goods.<n><n>If you establish businesses in later scenarios or in free-play mode, you must always ensure that you can sell the goods produced at a profit. Producing goods is expensive and finding the raw materials is not always easy.<n><n>For this reason, you should first build up your financial reserves by trading and then very gradually begin to produce goods.
tr: 恭喜！ 你现在有了一些生产货物的经验。 你可能也注意到了， 想在维持其他货物贸易的同时把自己生产出来的货物高价卖出， 并不总是件容易的事。<n><n>如果你在后续剧本或自由模式中开设产业， 就必须始终确保产出的货物能盈利卖出。 生产货物的成本很高， 而找到原料也并非总是容易。<n><n>正因如此， 你应当先通过贸易积累起财务储备， 然后才非常缓慢地开始生产货物。

en: The Welshman, Bartholomew Roberts (1682? – 1722), was not only one of the most important pirates but he was also a very unusual one. Also known as “Black Bart” (not to be confused with “Blackbeard” alias Edward Teach), he was a late convert to piracy at 37 years of age, although the transition into criminal activities was without doubt a smooth one: The ship on which he was working and which was attacked in 1719 by his fellow Welshman Howell Davis was in fact a slave ship.<n><n>Roberts decided to throw in his lot with Davis, after whose murder a couple of weeks later, he assumed the role of captain. It is said that Bartholomew Roberts avoided alcohol and preferred tea.<n><n>In contrast to Teach, who cast himself as the devil incarnate, Roberts had a penchant for fine clothes, disliked gambling and insisted that his men said their prayers. However, this certainly did not mean that Roberts was a pious man at heart. There are numerous tales of the atrocities he committed, especially against prisoners, during his countless looting exploits. With a haul of over 400 ships and an area of operation extending from Brazil as far as Newfoundland and West Africa, he was, along with Henry Morgan, one of the most successful pirates of Central America. <n><n>The roar of guns from a British warship off the coast of Guinea in 1722 signaled the end of his career and the removal of one of the greatest menaces on the seven seas.
tr: 威尔士人巴塞洛缪·罗伯茨 （1682？ — 1722年）， 不仅是最重要的海盗之一， 也是一位极不寻常的海盗。 他又名 「黑巴特」 （别与 「黑胡子」 爱德华·蒂奇混为一谈）， 37 岁时才转而去做海盗， 不过这一步的过渡无疑顺滑得很： 1719 年， 他供职的那条船被他的威尔士同乡豪厄尔·戴维斯袭击—— 那实际上是一条奴隶船。<n><n>戴维斯被杀后， 罗伯茨决定与这位同伙共进退， 并在几周后接手了他的船长之位。 据说巴塞洛缪·罗伯茨不碰酒， 只喝茶。<n><n>与把自己打扮成魔鬼化身的蒂奇不同， 罗伯茨偏爱精致衣裳， 厌恶赌博， 还坚持要求手下船员做祷告。 当然， 这绝不代表罗伯茨是个内心虔诚的人。 关于他在无数次劫掠中犯下的暴行—— 尤其是对俘虏的暴行—— 流传着大量传说。 总计劫走四百余艘船， 活动范围从巴西一路延伸到纽芬兰与西非海岸； 他与亨利·摩根并列为中美洲最成功的海盗。<n><n>1722 年， 一艘英国战舰在几内亚海岸外开炮的轰鸣， 宣告了他职业生涯的终点， 也宣告了七大洋上最大祸患之一的消亡。

en: <n>Do you want to give me some gold for the upkeep of additional soldiers? I can get %2 new soldiers for %1.
tr: <n>你愿意出点钱， 用来维持额外的士兵吗？ 我能用 %1 换到 %2 名新兵。

en: Greetings. Do you have a ship that can bring me to @T$TargetTown$? I urgently need to get there by @D$EndDate$. I will pay you @g$Reward$ if you get me there on time.
tr: 你好。 你有船能送我去 @T$TargetTown$ 吗？ 我必须赶在 @D$EndDate$ 前赶到那里。 准时把我送到， 你就拿 @g$Reward$ 。

en: All convoys consist of trading ships and escort ships.<n>If one ship in your convoy is to be involved in a battle, you must define it as a warship. <n>Open the list of ships in your convoy to display all your ships.
tr: 所有船队都由商船和护航船组成。<n>若船队中的某艘船要参战， 就必须把它定为军舰。<n>打开船队的船只列表， 即可看到你所有的船。

en: The Ships list displays all of the ships in your convoy. The warship status is displayed in the top right corner of a ship. If a cannon symbol is displayed, the ship is defined as a warship and it takes part in battles. Clicking on this corner changes the status directly.<n>But you should now click on your new ship and select it.
tr: 船只列表会显示船队中的全部船只。 军舰状态显示在船只的右上角。 若出现火炮图标， 就说明该船已被定为军舰， 会参与战斗。 点击这个角落即可直接切换状态。<n>不过现在你应该点击你的新船并选中它。

en: You have just received some money to help you make sure your convoy is better equipped.<n>Your convoy should have three fully-armed ships and a full crew.<n>Don't forget the ammunition, and remember to define your new ships as warships. Do this now.
tr: 你刚收到一笔钱， 用来帮你的船队把装备配得更齐。<n>你的船队应当有三艘武装齐全的船， 船员也要满编。<n>别忘了弹药， 也记得把你的新船定为军舰。 现在就去做。

en: Port battles are similar to sea battles, except for the fact that the battle is between you and very solid cannon towers instead of other ships.<n>To win a port battle, you have to destroy all of the towers.<n>Sometimes there are armed ships in the harbor. In this case, you must fight the ships before you can attack the port itself.
tr: 港口战斗与海战类似， 区别只在于对手不是别的船， 而是极其坚固的炮塔。<n>要赢下一场港口战斗， 你必须摧毁所有炮塔。<n>港口里有时会有武装船只。 这种情况下， 你必须先解决这些船， 才能攻击港口本身。

en: You don't have enough cash to settle your debts. As soon as you have %1, the sum will be collected.
tr: 你的现金不够清偿债务。 等你攒到 %1 之后， 这笔钱就会被收走。

en: This device is like an oil lamp with its own flint. If you turn the small wheel, sparks fly onto a wick and can ignite a flame even in a strong wind.
tr: 这件装置类似自带火石的油灯。 转动小轮， 火星便飞向灯芯， 即便在大风里也能点起火苗。

en: Your convoy has recovered from the sea a casket containing one of the governor's documents.
tr: 你的船队从海上打捞起一只箱子， 里面装着一份总督的文件。

en: You didn't manage to increase the population of Tortuga to @I$Pop$ by no later than 20 days after the end of the plague. <n><n>As soon as a town's status reaches "boom" or higher, new workers can be hired. You can supply the town with new workers in the form of settler families. These travel from Europe to the governor towns, where they wait for a passage to other towns. You'll also find settlers waiting to be picked up in towns with a lower status.
tr: 你没能把托尔图加的人口在瘟疫结束后 20 天内增加到 @I$Pop$ 。<n><n>城镇的等级一旦达到 「繁荣」 或更高， 就能雇到新工人。 你可以把移民家庭送到城镇， 为他们补充人手。 他们从欧洲出发， 先到总督城， 再在那里等待船只前往其他城镇。 在等级较低的城镇里， 你也会发现有待接走的移民。

en: An English military convoy is attacking
tr: 英格兰军事船队正在进攻

en: Your mission is to attack and loot transport convoys belonging to @n$HostileNation$, without capturing or sinking their ships. You must then deliver the goods to the market. You have until @D$EndDate$.
tr: 你的任务是袭击并洗劫 @n$HostileNation$ 的运输船队， 但不得俘获或击沉其中的船只。 之后你还得把货物送到市集。 期限是 @D$EndDate$ 。

en: A local trader is prepared to pay you %1 for the residential area.
tr: 一位本地商人愿意出 %1 买下你的住宅区。

en: Supply the town of @T$TargetTown$, which belongs to @n$TargetNation$, with goods so that the town attains the status "Flourishing economy" and has more than 2,000 inhabitants by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 为属于 @n$TargetNation$ 的 @T$TargetTown$ 城镇供给货物， 使其在 @D$EndDate$ 之前达到 「兴旺」 的经济状态， 并拥有 2000 名以上的居民。

en: Today, the English buccaneer %1 encountered a Dutch military convoy and was killed.
tr: 今天， 英格兰私掠者 %1 遭遇荷兰军事船队， 被击杀了。

en: We are at war with @n$TargetNation$. I therefore want you to sink or capture a specific number of trading ships. Everything you loot from them is yours to keep, all I care about is weakening @n$TargetNation$'s economy. Can I count you on board?
tr: 我们正与 @n$TargetNation$ 交战， 因此我要你击沉或俘获一定数量的商船。 你从它们身上抢到的一切都归你自己， 我只想削弱 @n$TargetNation$ 的经济。 可以指望你吗？

en: Today, the Spanish buccaneer %1 encountered an English military convoy and was killed.
tr: 今天， 西班牙私掠者 %1 遭遇英格兰军事船队， 被击杀了。

en: At the docks, you can trade both between the town and your warehouse and between the town and your convoy.<n>You can now see what goods the town has and what goods your convoy has. Use the arrows to buy and sell (the prices are shown on the arrows).<n>Now sell your cotton.
tr: 在码头， 你可以进行城镇与仓库之间、 以及城镇与船队之间的交易。<n>现在你能看到城镇有哪些货物、 船队有哪些货物。 用箭头买入卖出 （价格显示在箭头上）。<n>现在卖掉你的棉花。

en: Now click on the Inhabitants symbol under the town name on the left of the screen to display Santa Marta's stock.
tr: 现在点击屏幕左侧城镇名称下方的 「居民」 图标， 查看圣玛尔塔的库存。

en: You have chased the Governor out of town. From this day on, this town belongs to %1.
tr: 你已把总督逐出城镇。 从今天起， 这座城镇归 %1 所有。

en: I can mark the approximate location of his convoy on the sea chart. @l$ConvoyPos$ Whether or not you destroy this convoy is up to you. However, you must accomplish this mission by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 我可以在海图上标出他船队的大致位置。 @l$ConvoyPos$ 要不要摧毁这支船队由你决定。 不过你必须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前完成这项任务。

en: You didn't manage to restore the population of Tortuga.<n><n>As soon as a town's status reaches "boom" or higher, new workers can be hired. You can supply the town with new workers in the form of settler families. These travel from Europe to the governor towns, where they wait for a passage to other towns. You'll also find settlers waiting to be picked up in towns with a lower status.
tr: 你没能恢复托尔图加的人口。<n><n>城镇的状态一旦达到 「繁荣」 或更高， 就可以雇用新工人。 你可以用移民家庭的形式为城镇补充人手。 他们从欧洲前往总督城， 在那里等候前往其他城镇的船位。 在状态较低的城镇里， 你也会找到等待被接走的移民。

en: Your troops break down the town gate and take the commander hostage. When the town's soldiers see this, they capitulate.<n><n>What do you want to do now?
tr: 你的部队攻破城门， 抓走了城镇指挥官作为人质。 城镇的士兵一见如此便投降了。<n><n>你现在想做什么？

en: You have received a loan to the value of %1. The repayment is %2 and will be due on %3.
tr: 你获得了一笔价值 %1 的贷款。 还款额为 %2 ， 于 %3 到期。

en: I cannot tell you how many more towns the treasure fleet will visit. All we can say for sure is that the fleet takes more gold on board with every town it visits. I don't care when you attack, because you can keep the gold. All I want you to do is ensure that the treasure fleet disappears. It was last in @T$StartTown$, and its next port of call is @T$DestTown$, where it will lie at anchor for about five days.
tr: 我没法告诉你宝藏船队还会造访多少座城镇。 能肯定的是， 船队每造访一座城镇， 船上装的黄金就更多一些。 你什么时候动手都行， 拿到手的黄金全归你。 我只要你确保宝藏船队消失。 它上一站是 @T$StartTown$ ， 下一站是 @T$DestTown$ ， 会在那里抛锚约五天。

en: The place is located not far off the coast to the east of %1.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 以东、 离海岸不远处。

en: This challenging scenario is all about trade, production and goods supplies in a town.<n:25>Strange things are happening in Tortuga: Hardly any traders want to visit the town and several events are making life difficult for its citizens. Your task is to save the town from ruin. At the end of the scenario, your score will be displayed. It depends on your speed and on your wealth at the end of the scenario.<n:25>In this scenario, you can use all the options offered in free-play mode but you will also have specific objectives to achieve.
tr: 这个高难度剧本讲的是城镇里的贸易、 生产与货物供应。<n:25>托尔图加正发生怪事： 几乎没有商人愿意来这座城镇， 好几件事让市民的日子很难过。 你的任务是把这座城镇从破产边缘救回来。 剧本结束时会计分， 分数取决于你的速度， 以及剧本结束时你的财富。<n:25>本剧本中你可以使用自由模式提供的全部选项， 但同时也有特定目标要完成。

en: This is the clue that can lead you to a hoard of treasure:<n><n>
tr: 这就是能把你引向一处宝藏的线索：<n><n>

en: Colonial towns like Santa Marta can produce two essential goods, two raw materials and one colonial good.<n>In the last scenario, you learned that there is a particularly high demand for raw materials and colonial goods in governor towns.<n>You want to produce the colonial good cocoa first.<n>Now close the town information.
tr: 像圣玛尔塔这样的殖民地城镇， 能生产两种必需品、 两种原料和一种殖民地商品。<n>上一剧本中你已经了解到， 总督城对原料和殖民地商品的需求格外旺盛。<n>你打算先生产殖民地商品可可。<n>现在关闭城镇信息。

en: Not bad! You have raised your profile in Cartagena considerably.<n>But be careful not to buy up any scarce goods in Cartagena! You can easily recognize scarce goods because the stocks of these goods are displayed in red.<n>Increase your trading record score to 85%.
tr: 不错！ 你在卡塔赫纳的声望提升了不少。<n>但当心别在卡塔赫纳大量买进稀缺货物！ 稀缺货物很容易辨认， 它们的库存是以红色显示的。<n>把你的贸易记录分数提升到 85%。

en: Very good! As a Sailor, you can be granted two building permits.<n>Go to the master builder in Cartagena and apply for a permit.<n>If you don't have enough gold, you must trade some more. Don't forget to trade the goods that you are producing in Santa Marta.
tr: 很好！ 作为水手， 你可以获发两张建筑许可证。<n>去卡塔赫纳的总建筑师那里申请许可证。<n>如果你的钱不够， 那就再交易一些。 别忘了卖掉你在圣玛尔塔生产的货物。

en: Now you know how sea battles work. It is also possible to attack an entire town to loot it or to capture it on behalf of another nation. However, to do so, you need large convoys with powerful ships. As you can imagine, attacking a city will seriously damage your reputation with the nation in question and its military convoys will pursue you from then on.<n><n>Alternatively, you can attack a pirate hideout. Pirate hideouts are usually in secret locations but each of these locations will become known at some point in the game. You can then attack a pirate hideout in the same way you attack a town, to destroy the entire pirate gang.<n><n>The strength of the defenses surrounding one of these hideouts depends on how long a pirate gang has been at large and how successfully their convoys have looted trading ships.<n><n>Your final task in this scenario will be to raid a small pirate's den. Find out where the hideout is located from the Governor of @T$TOWN$.<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Destroy the pirate hideout of @P$PirateName$.
tr: 现在你已经知道海战是怎么打了。 你也可以攻打整座城镇， 将其洗劫一空， 或代表他国予以占领。 但要这么做， 你得拥有由强力舰船组成的大型船队。 可以想象， 攻打一座城市会严重损害你与该国的关系， 而它的军事船队此后也会一路追猎你。<n><n>你也可以选择攻打海盗巢穴。 海盗巢穴通常设在隐秘地点， 但这些地点在游戏进程中的某个时刻都会为人所知。 届时你就可以像攻打城镇那样攻打海盗巢穴， 把整个海盗团一网打尽。<n><n>这些巢穴的防御强度， 取决于该海盗团逍遥法外的时长， 以及他们的船队劫掠商船的成功程度。<n><n>这个剧本的最后一项任务， 是突袭一个小海盗窝。 去向 @T$TOWN$ 的总督打听巢穴的位置。<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>摧毁 @P$PirateName$ 的海盗巢穴。

en: A convoy belonging to the pirate %1 has attacked your convoy.
tr: 属于海盗 %1 的一支船队袭击了你的船队。

en: Under orders from %2, the buccaneer %1 is on his way to attack our towns. I have learned that he is currently in %3 to prepare his next action.
tr: 奉 %2 的命令， 私掠者 %1 正赶来攻打我们的城镇。 我得知他目前在 %3 ， 正为下一仗做准备。

en: Whenever you capture enemy towns for a viceroy, he will grant you a plot of land in return. On this land, you can build a town that will belong to you and in which you can construct different buildings. In other words, any viceroy can help you become the owner of your own town. <n><n>Your next objective is to improve your reputation with Spain, because a viceroy will only receive you if you have a good reputation with his nation.<n><n>You can check your reputation with a nation under the town name in the town view, for example. In Margarita, where you start the game, three flags are displayed, indicating that your reputation with Spain is "neutral".<n><n>You can improve your reputation with a nation by accomplishing missions for its governors, hunting pirates or trading with its towns and delivering the goods they need.<n><n>Since Spain and France are at war, you can obtain a Letter of Marque against France from the Governor of Margarita. You can improve your reputation quickly with letters of Marque.<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Improve your reputation with Spain to "friendly".
tr: 每当你替一位副王攻下敌方城镇， 他都会回报你一块土地。 在这块地上， 你可以建一座属于自己的城镇， 并在镇内建造各种建筑。 换句话说， 任何一位副王都能帮你成为自有城镇的主人。<n><n>你的下一个目标是提升与西班牙的声望， 因为只有你在他的国家有声望， 副王才会接见你。<n><n>在城镇视图里， 城镇名称下方就能查看你与某国的声望。 游戏开始所在的玛格丽塔就显示着三面旗子， 这说明你对西班牙的声望是 「中立」。<n><n>提升声望的办法有： 替该国总督完成任务、 清剿海盗， 或与该国的城镇贸易并送上门他们需要的货物。<n><n>由于西班牙正与法国交战， 你可以在玛格丽塔总督处取得针对法国的私掠许可证。 靠私掠许可证能快速提升声望。<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>把与西班牙的声望提升到 「友好」。

en: %1 %2 receives the town of %3 from the Spanish viceroy.
tr: %1・%2 从西班牙副王手中接管了 %3 。

en: A local trader is prepared to pay you %1 for the business.
tr: 本地商人愿意付 %1 跟你做这笔生意。

en: A military convoy has destroyed the town's harbor defenses and has looted goods. The status of the town has also fallen.
tr: 一支军事船队摧毁了城镇的港口防线， 洗劫了货物。 城镇的等级也随之下降。

en: I am certain that you have already heard of the pirate @P$PirateName$. He already has @I$NumConvoys$ convoys and we have not yet discovered his hideout. Fortunately, we know the whereabouts of one of his convoys. Perhaps he is still nearby. I want you to destroy this convoy.
tr: 你肯定已经听说过海盗 @P$PirateName$ 了。 他已经有 @I$NumConvoys$ 支船队， 而我们还没查出他的藏身处。 好在我们掌握了他其中一支船队的下落， 也许它还在附近。 我要你摧毁这支船队。

en: The position is @l$Pos$. Search this area, you may find a clue. Please bring me back my daughter safe and sound.
tr: 位置是 @l$Pos$ 。 搜搜这一带， 也许能找到线索。 请把我女儿平安带回来。

en: %1 %2 You also have a permit to erect buildings and establish businesses in %3 and you already own a warehouse in the town.<n><n>As you are young and inexperienced, you have only reached the rank of Ship's Boy. Therefore you cannot yet command further convoys or buy additional building permits in another town.<n><n>Your rank is determined by your total assets, which comprise cash and property and currently amount to around %4. You will reach the next rank as soon as your assets reach %5.<n><n><n>Good luck!
tr: %1 %2 你还持有许可证， 可在 %3 建造房屋、 开办产业， 并且你已在该城镇拥有一座仓库。<n><n>你年轻且缺乏经验， 目前只达到船上的小伙计等级， 因此还不能指挥更多商船队， 也不能在其他城镇再购买建造许可证。<n><n>你的等级由总资产决定， 包括现金与船只等财产， 目前约为 %4 ； 总资产达到 %5 时， 你就会晋升下一级。<n><n><n>祝你好运！

en: So be it. I hereby task you with attacking trading convoys belonging to @n$TargetNation$ and capturing or sinking @I$NumShips$ ships. You therefore only have until @D$EndDate$.
tr: 就这么定了。 我现在正式派你袭击 @n$TargetNation$ 的商船队， 俘获或击沉其中 @I$NumShips$ 艘船。 期限只有到 @D$EndDate$ 。

en: The commander of the town guard has defeated your captain in a fair duel. The captain nobly accepts the outcome and duly orders a retreat.
tr: 城镇卫队的指挥官在一场公平决斗中击败了你的船长。 船长坦然接受结果， 随即下令撤退。

en: Construct five harbor cannons in your town and increase the number of soldiers to 300.
tr: 在你的城镇建造五门港口炮， 并把士兵人数增加到 300。

en: This displays the number of ships in the convoy. A convoy can have up to 10 ships led by a captain.<n>Now let's send the convoy to another town.<n>Click on the button with the arrow in the top-right of your screen to leave the town and display the sea chart.
tr: 这里显示船队里的船只数量。 一支船队最多有 10 艘船， 由一位船长统领。<n>现在把这支船队派往另一座城镇。<n>点屏幕右上角那个带箭头的按钮离开城镇， 打开海图。

en: Since your convoy has arrived in Port Royale, you may now enter in the town. Just click on the town symbol (with the small houses).
tr: 你的船队已经抵达皇家港， 现在可以进城了。 点一下城镇符号 （那排小房子） 就行。

en: You have sunk %1 ships in your opponent’s convoy.
tr: 你在对手的船队中击沉了 %1 艘船。

en: I want you to attack military convoys belonging to @n$HostileNation$ and capture two @S$ShipType$ type ships. Anchor the ships in the harbor and then come back to me.
tr: 我要你去袭击属于 @n$HostileNation$ 的军事船队， 并俘获两艘 @S$ShipType$ 级的船。 把船停泊在港口， 然后回来见我。

en: I want you to attack military convoys belonging to @n$HostileNation$ and capture two @S$ShipType$ type ships. Anchor the ships in the harbor and then come back to me.
tr: 我要你去袭击属于 @n$HostileNation$ 的军事船队， 并俘获两艘 @S$ShipType$ 级的船。 把船停泊在港口， 然后回来见我。

en: Tortuga didn't achieve the status "wealth" in time. Each and every good influences the status of a town. If there is sufficient supply of a good to last 10 days, the good will have the best possible affect on the citizens' quality of life and therefore on the status of the town.
tr: 托尔图加未能及时达到 「富足」 的等级。 每一种货物都会影响城镇的等级。 某种货物若供应充足、 能维持十天， 它对市民生活品质、 进而对城镇等级的影响就会达到最佳。

en: Some aspects of the trade route had to be changed.<n><n>In this game, some of the towns in the route have not been discovered yet and have been removed, or you want to trade goods in a town, but there is no warehouse in this town. In this case, captain trading for the relevant town is activated for the corresponding goods.
tr: 贸易路线的某些环节不得不作出调整。<n><n>在本局游戏中， 路线上有些城镇尚未被发现， 因而被移除了； 又或者你想在某座城镇交易货物， 但那里没有仓库。 这时就会由自行经营的船长为对应的货物代为交易。

en: I have inspected the new artifacts and I think the engravings denote a particular location. %1 But I'm not sure yet. Hopefully you'll find even more artifacts, because I'm sure I can pinpoint the location more precisely.
tr: 我看过这些新文物了， 我觉得上面的刻纹指向某个特定地点。 %1 不过我还没把握。 希望你能找到更多文物， 那样我肯定能把位置定得更准。

en: Attack on an English transport convoy
tr: 袭击一支英格兰运输船队

en: The traveler @N$Name$ thanks you for rescuing him and disembarks.
tr: 旅人 @N$Name$ 感谢你救了他， 随即下船离去。

en: <n>Note that you also need a Letter of Marque to hunt for buccaneers.
tr: <n>注意， 追捕私掠者还需要一张私掠许可证。

en: Thank you. Here is the map piece. Good luck searching for the treasure!
tr: 谢谢。 这是你应得的地图碎片。 祝寻宝顺利！

en: Unfortunately you do not have enough credit to provide me with a loan.
tr: 可惜你的信用额度不够， 我没法批贷款给你。

en: There you are again, and I see you’ve succeeded.<n><n>So I must keep to my side of our agreement. You will find Master @N$TeacherName$ in his hideout.<n><n> @l$TeacherPos$<n><n>Look along the coast there and you’ll find him.<n><n>Bring @a$Amount$ of wine with you as payment.
tr: 你又来了， 看来事情办成了。<n><n>那么我也该履行约定。 @N$TeacherName$ 师傅在他的藏身处。<n><n>@l$TeacherPos$<n><n>沿那附近的海岸找找， 就能找到他。<n><n>带上 @a$Amount$ 的葡萄酒作为报酬。

en: <n><n>I advise you to send a captain who has no battle experience.
tr: <n><n>我建议你派一名没有战斗经验的船长。

en: You have conquered the legendary treasure fleet.
tr: 你已征服了传说中的宝藏船队。

en: The game "One-Armed Pirate" is a game of chance with 32 cards. Each player puts their stake in the pot and is given 5 cards, which the other player cannot see.<n><n>First, each player must call the number of points they think they can win, where each trick won equals one point. The player who calls the higher number of points leads the game and decides the trump suit. He must now try to win at least that number of points.<n><n>The player who leads plays his first cards and the other player must follow by playing a card of the same suit, if he can. The player with the highest card wins the point.<n><n>If a player cannot follow suit, he can discard any card or play a trump card.<n><n>The sequence of the cards is I, II, III, IV, Pirate, Bride, Governor, Parrot. A trump card beats all other cards.<n><n>The player who has won the point plays the next card. You continue like this until someone wins the game.<n><n>If the leader succeeds in winning the number of points he called, he wins the game and takes the pot. If he doesn't, his opponent wins.
tr: 「独臂海盗」 是一款用 32 张牌玩的机会游戏。 每位玩家把赌注放进底池， 并拿到 5 张对方看不见的牌。<n><n>首先， 每位玩家都要报出自己认为能赢的点数， 每赢一墩得一分。 报点数更高的玩家先出牌， 并决定主花色。 他必须设法赢到至少自己报的那么多分。<n><n>先出牌的玩家打出手牌， 另一位玩家若做得到， 必须跟出同花色的牌。 牌最大者赢得这一分。<n><n>若某玩家无法跟花色， 可以弃掉任意一张牌， 或打出一张主牌。<n><n>牌的顺序是 I、 II、 III、 IV、 海盗、 新娘、 总督、 鹦鹉。 主牌压过其他所有牌。<n><n>赢得这一分的玩家再出下一张牌。 如此继续， 直到有人赢下整局。<n><n>若先手者成功赢到了自己报的点数， 他即获胜并拿走底池； 若没有， 则对手获胜。

en: Excellent! The convoy of pirate @P$PirateName$ is located near the town of Belize, which is approximately 5 days’ journey northwest of here This town is in the northwest. Then return here to bring me news of your success.
tr: 太棒了！ 海盗 @P$PirateName$ 的船队就在伯利兹镇附近， 离这里往西北约五天航程。 这座城镇位于西北方。 摧毁它， 然后回来向我报告你的成果。

en: A little more than 1 day’s journey west of Cartagena is the small island of Providence. The pirate convoy commanded by @P$PirateName$ was last seen there. You should find the pirate convoy commanded by @P$PirateName$ approximately 1 day’s journey northeast of there.<n>Destroy it and then return here to give me a full account of the events.
tr: 卡塔赫纳往西略多于一天的航程处， 是小岛普罗维登斯。 海盗 @P$PirateName$ 指挥的船队最后一次被人看见就在那里。 你应该能在那里东北方约一天航程处找到这支船队。<n>摧毁它， 然后回来向我详细讲述此事的经过。

en: Have you ever heard tell of the Welsh pirate Bartholomew Roberts?
tr: 你听说过威尔士海盗巴塞洛缪·罗伯茨吗？

en: I’ve found some information for you about the pirate Henry Morgan. Let me tell you.
tr: 我找到了一些关于海盗亨利·摩根的消息， 说来听听。

en: It is already a well known fact that the European conquerors always heeded the call of silver and gold. However, of almost greater value were spices. It is difficult to imagine how dull the European diet of the Middle Ages must have been, if one thinks of the dangers people were prepared to face in order to obtain a little pepper or nutmeg.<n><n>In this regard, the discovery of America proved to be extremely disappointing at first. People noted with interest the exotic animals that Christopher Columbus brought home with him, rejoiced at the expansion of their country’s possessions and at the many souls that they imagined would be saved by the spread of Christianity there. However, the mountains of gold proved rather more elusive than had been promised. These voyages only became profitable ten to twenty years later, when a veritable flood of American silver started to arrive in Europe. <n><n>On one of these voyages, Columbus brought back a treasure more precious than all the gold and silver in the entire world: On the 4th of November 1492, the natives presented him with what he described as an apple that tasted of chestnuts. At that moment, he became the first European to eat a potato! The Indian word for this plant was “batate” and it survives to this day in the English language as “potato”.<n><n>Many other things that we take for granted today were first brought to Europe by Columbus and his successors: Tobacco, tomatoes, corn and the hammock. Or as the Native Americans would say: “hamaka” (from which the English word is derived).
tr: 欧洲征服者总是追逐白银与黄金的召唤， 这早已是众所周知的常识。 然而几乎比金银更有价值的， 却是香料。 若想到人们甘冒何等危险只为获取一小撮胡椒或肉豆蔻， 就很难想象中世纪欧洲的饮食该是何等寡淡。<n><n>在这方面， 发现美洲一开始令人极度失望。 人们怀着兴趣打量克里斯托弗·哥伦布带回家的奇异动物， 为本国疆域的扩张和想象中基督教传播将拯救的众多灵魂而欣喜。 然而黄金之山远比许诺的更难寻觅。 这些航程要到十至二十年后才真正获利—— 那时美洲的白银才如洪流般涌入欧洲。<n><n>在这些航程中的一次， 哥伦布带回了一件比全世界所有金银都更珍贵的宝物： 1492 年 11 月 4 日， 原住民送给他一样东西， 他形容那像苹果、 味道却像栗子。 就在那一刻， 他成了第一个吃土豆的欧洲人！ 这种植物的印第安语名称是 「batate」， 而它以 「potato」 之名一直存活至今的英语里。<n><n>我们今天视为理所当然的许多东西， 也都是哥伦布及其后继者最早带到欧洲的： 烟草、 番茄、 玉米， 以及吊床。 用美洲原住民的话说， 就是 「hamaka」 （英语的吊床一词即由此而来）。

en: Why is it that the language spoken in Brazil is Portuguese, when almost everywhere else in South America, it is Spanish?<n><n>Well, both the Spaniards and the Portuguese, who had discovered the sea route to India along the African coast, recognized early on that their future lay across the oceans. Each jealously watched the other to make sure that, in their hunt for goods, subjects and land, they did not encroach on each other’s territory.<n><n>As there was no such thing as international law at that time, in cases of conflict, they turned to the Pope, who was the only person to whose authority both nations were prepared to submit. For its part, the Catholic Church had an interest in ensuring that the Spaniards and Portuguese zealously pursued the Christianization of “heathens” in the unknown lands instead of wasting their energies making life difficult for one another.<n><n>Agreement was therefore reached during joint negotiations in Tordesillas (1494) and Saragossa (1529) that the newly discovered territories to the west of a particular line of longitude should belong to Spain and all others to Portugal. This line of longitude cut across what was at that time undiscovered South America so that its eastern side, part of what is now Brazil, fell to Portugal.
tr: 为什么巴西说的语言是葡萄牙语， 而南美洲几乎其他所有地方说的却是西班牙语？<n><n>这话说来话长。 西班牙人与葡萄牙人早已发现了沿非洲海岸通往印度的航路， 两国的目光都很快投向了海外。 双方各自警惕地监视着对方， 确保自己在追逐货物、 臣民与土地时， 不会侵占对方的势力范围。<n><n>由于当时根本不存在什么国际法， 一旦发生冲突， 两国就去找教皇裁决—— 因为他是唯一一个两国都愿意接受其权威的人。 就天主教教会而言， 它也乐见西班牙人和葡萄牙人热心推动对 「异教徒」 的基督教化， 而不是把精力浪费在彼此为难上。<n><n>于是双方在托尔德西利亚斯 （1494 年） 与萨拉戈萨 （1529 年） 的联合谈判中达成协议： 某条经线以西新发现的领土归西班牙所有， 以东的所有领土归葡萄牙所有。 这条经线切过当时尚未被发现的南大陆， 于是它东侧、 也就是今日巴西的一部分归了葡萄牙。

en: Next to Cuba, Jamaica is probably the most famous of the Caribbean islands. Its name is derived from the Arawak Indian name of Xymaca, which means roughly “the land of wood and water”. Christopher Columbus himself, who had discovered the island nine years previously, had ample opportunity to experience the beauty of the landscape and the friendliness of its inhabitants when his ship was wrecked off the northern coast in 1503.<n><n>Indeed he liked it so much that he transferred ownership of the entire island from the King of Spain and declared it as his own. In spite of this, this island paradise was quite neglected over the next few decades until it was seized by the British in 1655. Very few Arawak still remained at this stage, as their tribe proved particularly susceptible to the diseases that the Europeans had brought with them.<n><n>In 1661, Edward D'Oyley was appointed captain general and governor of Jamaica. Under his authority, the capital of Port Royal was transformed into a vibrant, heavily defended haven for pirates. It was said to be the “richest and most corrupt place on earth” and many of the inhabitants, who were otherwise ordinary traders, frequently banded together to carry out private raids in Spanish waters. At first, the British Government showed little inclination to reign in these goings on, as after all, the buccaneers kept its Spanish rivals at bay.<n><n>It was only after Sir Henry Morgan took office as governor (significant in that he was a former pirate himself) that culture and order returned to Jamaica. Morgan ruthlessly suppressed piracy and showed no hesitation in sending his former associates to the gallows.<n><n>However, no sooner had British authority been re-established than a new and lucrative source of income in addition to growing sugar cane was discovered: After 1672, Port Royal developed into the largest slave market in the world, once the English Royal African Company had established a monopoly.
tr: 除古巴之外， 牙买加大概是加勒比最著名的岛屿了。 它的名字源自阿拉瓦克语中的 Xymaca， 大致意思是 「森林与水之乡」。 九年前亲手发现该岛的克里斯托弗·哥伦布， 在 1503 年船只于北岸失事时， 有充分机会体验这里的风光之美与居民的友善。<n><n>他喜爱此地至此， 竟把整座岛屿的所有权从西班牙国王手里转到了自己名下， 宣布归己所有。 尽管如此， 在接下来的几十年里， 这座天堂般的岛屿一直无人问津， 直到 1655 年被英国人夺走。 那时阿拉瓦克人已经所剩无几， 因为他们这个族群对欧洲人带来的疾病格外缺乏抵抗力。<n><n>1661 年， 爱德华·多伊利被任命为牙买加的总督兼军事长官。 在他治下， 首都皇家港被改造成了一座活力十足、 防御森严的海盗避风港。 据说这里是 「地球上最富有也最腐败的地方」， 许多原本只是普通商人的居民， 常结伙到西班牙海域去干私掠勾当。 起初英国政府对这类勾当并不怎么管， 毕竟这些私掠者毕竟替它挡着西班牙的对手。<n><n>直到亨利·摩根爵士出任总督—— 这件事本身就耐人寻味， 因为他自己从前也是海盗—— 牙买加才重新找回文化和秩序。 摩根毫不留情地镇压海盗， 把自己昔日的那帮同伙送上绞刑架时也毫不迟疑。<n><n>然而， 英国的权威刚刚恢复， 人们就发现了一门比不断增长的甘蔗生意更赚钱的新生意： 1672 年之后， 皇家非洲公司取得垄断， 皇家港发展成为世界上最大的奴隶市场。

en: The most famous buccaneer of the 17th century was the Welshman, Henry Morgan (1635-1688), who plagued the Spanish colonies in the West Indies, thereby shaking the authority of the great Iberian power in the region to its foundations.<n><n>His life exemplifies the rather dubious morality behind the policies of Britain, Holland and France, who were only too happy to turn a blind eye to piracy as long as it inflicted damage on the other great powers.<n><n>Henry Morgan, who was put in command of a buccaneer ship in 1668, first started to wreak havoc along the northern coast of South America. In command of almost 2,000 men, he captured the heavily defended town of Panama in August 1670, and then absconded with most of the booty on the return voyage. However, because the attack took place after Spain and England had signed a peace treaty, has was taken prisoner and put on trial in London.<n><n>Morgan was not convicted, on the contrary: It was not long before the winds of diplomacy had once more changed direction. Not only was Morgan pardoned, he was made a knight. As Sir Henry, he was appointed as the new governor of Jamaica, where he imposed strict law and order and lived out the remaining years of his life as a wealthy and respected planter.
tr: 17 世纪最著名的海盗是威尔士人亨利·摩根 （1635 — 1688年）， 他在西印度群岛的西班牙殖民地肆虐， 从根本上动摇了这个伊比利亚大国的地区权威。<n><n>他的一生， 例证了英国、 荷兰与法国政策背后那颇为暧昧的道德观： 只要海盗行为能伤害到其他列强， 他们便乐得睁一只眼闭一只眼。<n><n>1668 年， 摩根受命指挥一艘海盗船， 最初在北美洲南岸一带大肆破坏。 1670 年 8 月， 他率领近两千人攻下了防守严密的重镇巴拿马城， 随后在返航途中带着大部分战利款溜之大吉。 然而由于这次袭击发生在西班牙与英国签订和平条约之后， 他被俘， 并被押往伦敦受审。<n><n>摩根最终并未被判有罪， 恰恰相反： 没过多久， 外交的风向便再度转变。 摩根不仅被赦免， 还被授以骑士爵位。 作为 「亨利爵士」， 他被任命为牙买加的新任总督， 在那里厉行法纪， 以一位富有而受人敬重的种植园主的身份度过余生。

en: Your trading record in this town is not yet impressive enough for you to be allowed to meet the treasurer. Deliver goods that the town needs to improve your trading record.
tr: 你在该镇的贸易记录还不够漂亮， 尚不足以让你觐见财务官。 给城镇送来它需要的货物， 提升你的贸易记录。

en: @A$USER$, I'm looking for a ride to @T$TargetTown$. I would be most grateful if you would offer me a berth on one of your ships. I will pay you @g$Reward$.
tr: @A$USER$ ， 我想搭船去 @T$TargetTown$ 。 若你肯让我上你的一条船， 我将不胜感激。 我会付你 @g$Reward$ 。

en: Governors often propose missions that will improve your reputation with their nation if they are successfully accomplished.<n>You are also entitled to ask governors for Letters of Marque or claim ransom for buccaneers whom you have captured.<n>Now use your convoy to find the ships the governor told you about.
tr: 总督们常常会给出一些委托， 你要是办成了， 声望就会提升， 在该国的地位也就更高。<n>你也可以向总督索取私掠特许状， 或者为你俘获的海盗索要赎金。<n>现在用你的船队去找总督提到的那几艘船。

en: This is Port Royale's Sea Battle View.<n>It shows your ship and you can view the abandoned ships by moving the display window.<n>Now deactivate pause mode and practice navigating with the right mouse button. The Event window displays the direction of the wind and the ship during sea battles.
tr: 这就是 Port Royale 的海战视图。<n>它会显示你的船， 移动显示窗口还可以查看那些被弃置的船只。<n>现在关闭暂停模式， 用鼠标右键练习航行。 海战期间， 事件窗口会显示风向和风向标船。

en: You could do me a favor.<n><n>
Are you sure you want to delete the route?
tr: 你确定要删除这条航线吗？

en: It was crammed full of dolls and feather boas.
tr: 里面塞满了玩偶和羽毛围巾。

en: A military convoy has attacked the town by land and looted goods. Many of the town's troops were killed and the status of the town has fallen.
tr: 一支军事船队从陆路袭击了该城镇并洗劫货物。 镇上的许多士兵丧命， 该镇等级已经下降。

en: We are at war with %1, but the enemy does not have enough military convoys to protect its waters. I want you to take advantage of this and capture a town.
tr: 我们正与 %1 交战， 但敌人的军事船队不足以守卫它的海域。 我要你抓住这个机会， 攻占一座城镇。

en: %1 does not have enough military convoys to protect its waters! We should get going this instant and capture a town!!<n>Can I rely on you?
tr: %1 的军事船队不足以守卫它的海域！ 那就立刻出发， 攻占一座城镇！！<n>我能指望你吗？

en: Your time is up but you have not achieved the final scenario objective.<n><n>In free-play mode, the viceroy of any nation may grant you the gift of your own town. But this is not so easy to achieve, because you must always capture towns in order to be awarded a plot of land, and this will naturally damage your reputation with other nations. <n><n>Anything you have learned in this scenario about developing your town will help you to develop businesses in other towns also. The main difference is that you don't have to worry about defending those towns.
tr: 你的时间用完了， 但并没有达成剧本的最终目标。<n><n>在自由模式中， 任何一位副王都可能把一座属于你的城镇赏赐给你。 但这并不容易做到， 因为你必须不断攻占城镇才能获得土地， 而这自然会损害你与其他国家的关系。<n><n>这个剧本里你学到的所有城镇发展心得， 同样会帮助你在其他城镇开设店铺。 唯一的区别是， 你不必再为那些城镇的防守操心。

en: %1,<n><n>You have not done enough trade with this town. Deliver goods that are in demand to improve your trading record. Only then can you buy a permit.
tr: %1 ，<n><n>你与这座城镇的交易太少了。 送来它需要的货物以改善贸易记录， 之后你才能购买许可证。

en: In the last scenario, you learned that your rank depends on your total assets. Your total assets comprise your cash as well as your buildings, ships and goods. You can check your total assets at any time under "Successes" in the log.<n><n>You can also check the blue bar indicating your experience, which is always at the bottom of the screen in the convoy display. When the bar reaches the right edge of the screen, you are promoted to the next rank. You cannot drop below a rank once you have reached it.<n><n>The higher your rank, the more convoys you can command and, therefore, the greater the number of towns in which you can establish businesses later. After you reach a certain rank, you are entitled to an unlimited number of convoys and building permits.
tr: 在上一个剧本里， 你已经得知自己的等级取决于总资产。 总资产包括你的现金， 以及你的建筑、 船只和货物。 你可以随时在日志的 「成就」 一栏查看总资产。<n><n>你还可以查看那条表示你经验值的蓝条， 它始终位于屏幕底部的船队面板中。 当这条蓝条抵达屏幕右边缘时， 你就被提升到下一个等级。 一旦达到某个等级， 你就不会再掉下去。<n><n>等级越高， 你能指挥的船队就越多， 因而你日后能够开设店铺的城镇数量也越多。 达到一定等级后， 你还可以享有数量无限的船队和建造许可。

en: Find and destroy a convoy belonging to the pirate @P$PirateName$ by @D$EndDate$. The last known position of one of his convoys is marked for you on the sea chart. @l$Pos$
tr: 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前找到并摧毁属于海盗 @P$PirateName$ 的一支船队。 他的船队最后已知的位置已在海图上标出。 @l$Pos$

en: You have come across @I$Settlers$ shipwrecked settlers on a raft. Unfortunately, you do not have enough room for all of them on board your convoy. Return with another convoy.
tr: 你遇到了一群 @I$Settlers$ 遇险的殖民者， 他们挤在一只木筏上。 可惜你的船队装不下所有人。 再带一支船队回来吧。

en: Pay a visit to the Governor of the Turk Islands and obtain a Letter of Marque against England.
tr: 拜访特克群岛的总督， 取得一份针对英格兰的私掠许可证。

en: Today, the English buccaneer %1 encountered a French military convoy and was killed.
tr: 今天， 英格兰私掠者 %1 遭遇法国军事船队， 被击杀了。

en: Today, the French buccaneer %1 encountered a Spanish military convoy and was killed.
tr: 今天， 法国私掠者 %1 遭遇西班牙军事船队， 被击杀了。

en: Today, the Dutch buccaneer %1 encountered an English military convoy and was killed.
tr: 今天， 荷兰私掠者 %1 遭遇英格兰军事船队， 被击杀了。

en: Today, the Dutch buccaneer %1 encountered a Spanish military convoy and was killed.
tr: 今天， 荷兰私掠者 %1 遭遇西班牙军事船队， 被击杀了。

en: I was wondering if you might be able to help us in our war against @n$TargetNation$. I would like to send you into a particular area and task you with capturing or sinking ships there.
tr: 不知道你能否在我们对 @n$TargetNation$ 的战争中帮上一把。 我想派你前往某片特定海域， 让你俘获或击沉那里的船只。

en: Today, the Spanish buccaneer %1 encountered a French military convoy and was killed.
tr: 今天， 西班牙私掠者 %1 遭遇法国军事船队， 被击杀了。

en: Today, the Spanish buccaneer %1 encountered a Dutch military convoy and was killed.
tr: 今天， 西班牙私掠者 %1 遭遇荷兰军事船队， 被击杀了。

en: Now you can trade between your warehouse and the town.<n>In every town in which you want to set up production of a good, you must first build a warehouse. You will always already own a warehouse in your starting town.<n>Now sell all the goods you have in the warehouse.
tr: 现在你可以在仓库与城镇之间进行交易。<n>想在某座城镇生产某种货物， 就必须先在那里建一座仓库。 你的起始城镇里必定已经有一座仓库。<n>现在把仓库里的所有货物都卖掉。

en: This will open the Trade window for Santa Marta.<n>Therefore, you do not have to enter a town to trade there.<n>Now sell all the goods that you have on board your convoy.<n>Then close the Trade window.
tr: 这会打开圣玛尔塔的贸易窗口。<n>因此你不必进入城镇就能在那里交易。<n>现在把船队上所有的货物都卖掉。<n>然后关闭贸易窗口。

en: Go to the town view for Cartagena.<n>Usually, you must have a convoy anchored in the harbor if you want to enter a town. However, you have a warehouse in Cartagena and can therefore enter this town whenever you like.<n>Click on the shipyard in Cartagena.
tr: 切换到卡塔赫纳的城镇视图。<n>通常你想进入一座城镇， 得先有船队停泊在港口。 不过你在卡塔赫纳有仓库， 因此随时都可以进入这座城镇。<n>点击卡塔赫纳的船坞。

en: You have occupied the town council. From this day on, this town belongs to %1.
tr: 你已占领镇议会。 从今天起， 这座城镇归 %1 所有。

en: Use a convoy to find the teacher's hideout. @l$TeacherPos$ There must be @a$Amount$ of wine on board the convoy.
tr: 派一支船队去找老师的藏身处。 @l$TeacherPos$ 船上必须装载 @a$Amount$ 葡萄酒。

en: Use a convoy to find the teacher's hideout. @l$TeacherPos$ There must be @a$Amount$ of rum on board the convoy.
tr: 派一支船队去找老师的藏身处。 @l$TeacherPos$ 船上必须装载 @a$Amount$ 朗姆酒。

en: Select a function from the list to change the keyboard configuration.
tr: 从列表中选一项功能， 即可更改按键设置。

en: You destroyed Blackbeard's hideout but you didn't manage to destroy all of his convoys first.
tr: 你摧毁了黑胡子的巢穴， 但没能先把他所有船队都摧毁掉。

en: You don't get opportunities like this every day! Today one of my informants told me the route the Spanish treasure fleet is currently following. But that's not all. We have learned that the fleet will be lying at anchor for longer than usual at the next town it visits. Since we are at war with Spain, we should give the viceroy something to smile about and make sure the treasure fleet never reaches its destination in Europe. Will you intercept the fleet for my nation?
tr: 这种机会可不是天天都有！ 今天我的一个线人告诉我西班牙珍宝船队眼下正在走的航线。 但这还不是全部。 我们得知船队会在下一座访问的城镇停泊得比平时更久。 既然我们正与西班牙交战， 就该给副王一点乐子看看， 绝不能让珍宝船队抵达它在欧洲的目的地。 你愿意为我国截住这支船队吗？

en: %1 is full and no longer has any space on which to build a warehouse. If you want to gain a foothold in this town in spite of this, you can try to persuade one of the local traders to demolish one of his businesses.<n><n>Businesses are demolished if the price in the town for the goods produced remains at a low level over a long period, that is, if there is a surplus of the good. To achieve this, you must first start to hoard the product. Then sell sufficient quantities of the product at the town market to drive the price down to a low level.<n><n>The goods produced are delivered to the town market once a day. If the price is currently minimal, the business reduces its complement of workers. You can check this by clicking on the business. A business is demolished once 30 workers have been made redundant.
tr: %1 已经满了， 再也没有空间可以建造仓库。 如果你仍想在这座城镇站稳脚跟， 可以试着说服当地一位商人拆掉他自己的一处产业。<n><n>如果某种商品在城里的价格长期维持在低位， 也就是说该商品出现了过剩， 对应的产业就会被拆除。 要造成这种局面， 你必须先开始囤积该产品， 然后在城镇市场卖出足够多的量， 把价格压到低位。<n><n>本地生产的商品每天一次送到城镇市场。 如果价格目前处于最低水平， 该产业就会削减工人编制。 点击该产业即可查看这一点。 一旦有 30 名工人被裁减， 该产业就会被拆除。

en: After a while, your convoy discovers a hideout on land. The captain rows ashore and looks around. He finally finds the old master and explains what brings him there. The hermit accepts the food.
tr: 过了一阵子， 你的船队在陆地上一处藏身点。 船长划船上岸四处查看， 终于找到了那位老人并说明来意。 隐士收下了食物。

en: A new storm from the southwest is closing in on the Caribbean. Production on crop farms is halved in all towns affected by the storm.
tr: 又一场风暴正从西南方向逼近加勒比。 所有受风暴影响的城镇， 作物农场产量减半。

en: You are @s$USER$, are you not? Would you not be interested in a treasure map? I only have a small scrap of it, but with luck you will find the remaining pieces!<n>I'll give you the piece for @g$Price$.
tr: 你就是 @s$USER$ ， 对吧？ 对藏宝图有兴趣吗？ 我这儿只有一小块， 但你运气好的话， 自会找到其余碎片！<n>这块卖你 @g$Price$ 。

en: How could this happen! Supplies of tools have run low in @T$DestTown$ and now the production of colonial goods is threatened. Will you help me to solve this dilemma?
tr: 怎么会这样！ @T$DestTown$ 的工具供应已经吃紧， 殖民地货物的生产受到了威胁。 你愿意帮我解决这个难题吗？

en: The place is located somewhere 1 to 2 days’ journey to the east of %1.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 以东一天到两天航程处的某处。

en: The place is located 2 to 3 days' journey to the east of %1.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 以东两到三天航程处。

en: The place lies to the south of %1.
The place is located somewhere up to 1 day’s journey from %1.
tr: 那个地方在离 %1 最多一天航程处的某处。

en: The place lies somewhere in the area, 1 day’s journey from %1.
tr: 那个地方在离 %1 一天航程范围内的某处。

en: Some of the settlers were unhappy with the working conditions in @T$SampleTown$ and left in a rickety rowing boat. They have not been seen since. Could you help me search for them?
tr: 有些移民对 @T$SampleTown$ 的劳动条件不满， 驾着一条破破烂烂的小划船走了， 此后再没出现过。 你能帮我找找他们吗？

en: the military presence in this town could be better
tr: 这座城镇的驻军状况还有待加强

en: Click on your cocoa plantation. The display always shows all of your cocoa plantations in the town.<n>Once your production facilities are constructed, you’ll need 30 workers, that is, 30 settlers. Now leave the plantation, go to the docks in the harbor and press the “Cargo” button (the bottom button on the right).
tr: 点击你的可可种植园。 这个界面总会显示你在该城的所有可可种植园。<n>生产设施建成后， 你需要 30 名工人， 也就是 30 名移民。 现在离开种植园， 前往港口的码头， 按下 「货物」 按钮(右下角那个)。

en: Good! I am assigning you the mission of causing the town of @T$TargetTown$ to fall into a state of “Recession”. You have until @D$EndDate$.<n><n>To achieve your objective, you must intercept all traders visiting the town so that it receives no more goods and its status slowly starts to decline.<n><n>However, there is a way of making this happen faster. This involves attacking and looting the town. Your attack will cause the status to drop rapidly to “Recovery” and the resulting scarcity of goods in the town will then cause it to drop even further until the town is in “Recession”.
tr: 很好！ 我要交给你的任务是让 @T$TargetTown$ 陷入 「衰退」 状态。 你的期限是 @D$EndDate$ 。<n><n>要达成目标， 你必须拦截所有前往该城镇的商人， 让它再也收不到任何货物， 城镇地位随之缓慢下滑。<n><n>不过， 也有办法让这一切来得更快： 那就是攻打并洗劫这座城镇。 你的进攻会让城镇地位迅速跌到 「复苏」， 而随之而来的货物匮乏会让它继续下探， 直到跌入 「衰退」。

en: There is nothing you can do for me.

Now you should create jobs in the town and construct residential areas.<n><n>Since settlers will only want to stay in your town if they can find work there, you should first construct four production facilities. Decide what kind of production facilities you want to build. But ensure that you only produce goods that you'll be able to sell at a profit in other towns, because production costs are high and you rely on the profits you make from selling the goods.<n><n>Four production facilities provide jobs for 120 workers. Since each of these workers is one of a family of four, you must provide living quarters for 480 citizens, in other words, four residential areas.<n><n>As soon as your production facilities and residential areas are ready, you can try to bring settlers from other towns to your own town. Settlers usually wait for work in governor towns. <n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Increase your town's population to 480.
tr: 现在你应当在城镇里创造就业岗位， 并建造居住区。<n><n>移民只有在这座城镇里能找到工作时， 才会愿意留下来， 所以你首先得建造四座生产设施。 先想清楚要建哪一种生产设施。 但务必确保你只生产那些能在其他城镇卖出利润的货物， 因为生产成本很高， 而你全靠卖货赚来的利润过活。<n><n>四座生产设施可以提供 120 个岗位。 由于这些工人各自都是四口之家的一员， 你必须为 480 名居民提供住处—— 换句话说， 就是四个居住区。<n><n>生产设施和居住区一旦就绪， 你就可以试着从其他城镇引来移民。 移民通常是在总督城里等着找工作。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>把城镇人口增加到 480 人。

en: %1,<n><n>I have sent you the sum of %2 gold coins today. My debt with you is therefore settled.<n><n>The Treasurer of %3
tr: %1 ，<n><n>我已于今日付给你 %2 金币， 我们的债务就此两清。<n><n>%3 的财务主管

en: Do you wish to set off on a treasure hunt, @A$USER$? Then I can give you your first clue.
tr: 你想去寻宝吗， @A$USER$ ？ 那我这就告诉你第一条线索。

en: I have nothing further to discuss with you.<n>Improve your reputation with my nation if you want to do more business with me.
tr: 我没什么可再跟你谈的了。<n>想和我做更多生意， 就去提升你在我的国家的声望。

en: Pause game during editing of trade routes.
tr: 编辑贸易路线时暂停游戏。

en: This experienced seaman was a master at battle.
tr: 这位老水手打起仗来是个高手。

en: You have purchased a building permit and you may now build in this town. Your first building must be a warehouse.<n><n>Note: The more building permits you have, the more expensive the next one will be and the longer it will take for your trading record in other towns to improve.
tr: 你买下了建筑许可， 现在可以在这座城镇里动工了。 你的第一座建筑必须是仓库。<n><n>注意： 你手上的建筑许可越多， 下一张就越贵， 你在其他城镇的贸易记录改善起来也越慢。

en: %1,<n>it's good to see you again. In the last couple of days, I’ve asked around and I may now have some news for you.
tr: %1 ，<n>又见到你真高兴。 这两天我四处打听， 现在也许有些消息要告诉你。

en: In this scenario, the Spanish viceroy grants you a plot of land on which you can build your own town. The objective of this scenario is ensure that your town's economy begins to flourish.<n:25>However, before you receive a plot of land, you must improve your reputation with Spain and make yourself popular with the Spanish viceroy by capturing towns on his behalf.
tr: 在本剧本中， 西班牙副王会赐你一块土地，<n:25>你可以在上面建起自己的城镇。 本剧本的目标， 是让你的城镇经济开始繁荣起来。 不过在拿到土地之前， 你得先提升与西班牙的声望， 并替那位西班牙副王攻下城镇， 以博取他的好感。

en: Having defeated your adversary's escort ships, you seize %1 trading ships.<n><n>You now have to decide which goods you want to take and whether you want to capture the ships or just loot them.
tr: 你击溃了对手的护航船， 抢下了 %1 艘商船。<n><n>现在你得决定取走哪些货物， 以及是俘获这些船， 还是只抢了货就放它们走。

en: Your wife has disappeared. Speak to the governor!
tr: 你妻子失踪了。 去和总督谈谈！

en: Today, the %1 buccaneer %2 entered the town under a false name and caused a great deal of unrest among the workers. They now refuse to work for two weeks.
tr: 今天， %1 的私掠者 %2 用假名潜入城镇， 在工人中掀起了极大的骚乱。 他们现在拒绝干活， 整整两周。

en: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>An old and almost completely rotten wooden chest is floating in the water. Whatever it once contained, nothing remains now apart from a revolting smell. In spite of this, your crew's morale is lifted because the search for the treasure has finally come to an end.
tr: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>水面上漂着一只又老又朽、 几乎散架的木箱。 里面曾经装过什么， 如今已无从得知， 只留下一股恶臭。 即便如此， 船员们还是松了口气—— 寻宝的折腾总算结束了。

en: A transport convoy will be arriving here shortly. A spy has told me that our enemy is planning to attack this convoy on its return voyage to Europe. Can you protect the convoy on its way home?
tr: 一支运输船队很快就要抵达这里。 我的密探告诉我， 敌人打算在这支船队返回欧洲的途中伏击它。 你能护送它平安回家吗？
