en: I'm sorry, it turns out I can't give you this mission after all. I have just received a message telling me that the problem no longer exists.
tr: 抱歉， 看来这任务终究还是不能交给你。 我刚收到消息， 说这个问题已经不存在了。

en: %1, you have captured the beloved town of my father for %2! I want nothing more to do with you. I hope I never see you again. You should know that you never meant anything to me and that I won't spare you a thought in the future.<n>I sincerely hope that, sooner or later, you receive the punishment that you so richly deserve.<n><n>%3
tr: %1 ， 你为了 %2 夺走了我父亲的挚爱之城！ 我不想再与你有一丝瓜葛， 只盼从此再不相见。 你要明白， 你从来就不曾对我意味着什么， 今后我也不会再为你费心思。<n>我衷心希望， 你早晚会受到你应得的惩罚。<n><n>%3

en: Thank you. I will pay you high prices for wine, tools and spices until @D$Date$. Meet my emissary at the marketplace and deliver @a$Amount$ of each. He will only accept a complete delivery and will pay you there and then.
tr: 谢谢。 在 @D$Date$ 之前， 我会用高价收购葡萄酒、 工具和香料。 到市场找我的特使， 每样交 @a$Amount$ 份。 他只接受一次交齐， 届时当场付款。

en: Thank you. I am a trader from @T$Town$. As my pursuers do not know where I am staying, they will surely try to catch me in my home town. Start your search there and kill the bounty hunters. I must depart from here no later than @D$EndDate$. If you accomplish the mission before then, I will pay you @g$Reward$.
tr: 谢谢。 我是 @T$Town$ 的商人。 追我的人不知道我藏在哪里， 肯定会在我的故乡逮我。 先去那儿查， 把赏金猎人干掉。 我最迟必须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前离开。 你若能在此之前完成任务， 我就付你 @g$Reward$ 。

en: Excellent! Your town is now quite large. Soon, the first traders from other towns will land to trade goods with your town.<n><n>But your town is also in danger of being visited by other, less desirable characters. These include pirates and buccaneers from nations with which you have a poor relationship. Your next task is therefore to hire soldiers and erect harbor cannons.<n><n>Fortunately, the citizens in your town can organize themselves to a large degree. You only have to give them some instructions and purchase any necessary materials. After that, there are no extra costs.<n><n>You can construct harbor cannons using the Construction menu, and you can hire soldiers from your palace.<n><n>Remember:<n>Soldiers need living quarters too! However, in contrast to workers, soldiers only require one  space each.<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario  objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Construct five harbor cannons and increase your soldiers to 300.
tr: 太棒了！ 你的城镇现在规模不小了。 很快， 第一批来自其他城镇的商人就会登陆， 来与你的城镇交易货物。<n><n>不过你的城镇也可能招来一些不受欢迎的客人， 其中包括与你关系不睦的国家的海盗和私掠者。 所以你的下一个任务是招募士兵、 修筑港口炮。<n><n>幸而镇上的市民基本上能自己组织起来。 你只要给他们一些指示、 买齐所需材料就行， 之后就不再有额外开销。<n><n>你可以在 「建造」 菜单里修筑港口炮， 也可以在宫殿里招募士兵。<n><n>记住：<n>士兵也需要住处！ 不过与工人不同， 士兵每人只占一个空间。<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>建造五门港口炮， 并把士兵人数增加到 300 人。

en: Nobody here can bear the sight of you.
tr: 这里没人受得了看见你。

en: The game could not be deleted!
Three little islands this area surround, but only on one are there ropes to be found.
tr: 这一带三座小岛环绕， 却只有其中一座能找到缆绳。

en: Attack on a Dutch transport convoy
tr: 袭击一支荷兰运输船队

en: Now take heed! I'm afraid my brother-in-law is a bit of a vagabond, no one knows exactly where he is.
tr: 现在听我说！ 我那小舅子有点浪荡， 谁也说不准他到底在哪儿。

en: Good. The ship went down somewhere along the route between @T$TOWN$ and @T$Town$. Please hurry! The chances of finding any survivors after @D$EndDate$ are slim.<n>By the way, there is a shortage of workers in @T$SampleTown$ at the moment. You could simply put the survivors ashore there.
tr: 好。 那艘船沉在 @T$TOWN$ 到 @T$Town$ 之间的某处航线上。 请快！ 过了 @D$EndDate$ 还能找到幸存者的机会就渺茫了。<n>顺便一提， @T$SampleTown$ 眼下正缺工人。 你完全可以把幸存者送到那里上岸。

en: So the ships are in the harbor. I thank you. I will have a new military convoy assembled immediately.<n>As I said before, my resources are currently very limited and I regret that I cannot reward you with gold. However, your reward is no less valuable.<n>Here, take this map instead. I have marked on it the location of a sunken transport convoy. There you shall find a vast quantity of goods.
tr: 船都进港了。 谢谢你。 我这就集结一支新的军事船队。<n>我之前说过， 眼下我的资财十分有限， 很抱歉没法赏你金币。 不过这份奖赏的价值并不逊于金币。<n>给你这张图吧。 上面标着一支沉没的运输船队的所在地， 你会在那里找到大量货物。

en: I am faced with a problem. I must have a constant stock of @G$Goods$ for the transport convoys.
tr: 我遇到了一个麻烦。 运输船队需要 @G$Goods$ 的存货不断供应。

en: The location of the base that the notorious pirate %1 operates from is no longer a mystery. %2 We should crush this gang to pieces without further delay. I think you are just the man for this job.
tr: 那个恶名昭著的海盗 %1 所在的据点如今已不是什么秘密了。 %2 我们得立刻把这伙人碾碎。 我觉得你就是干这件事的人选。

en: You have attacked a convoy belonging to a friendly nation. In this scenario, the nations are at peace, which means that you must on no account attack traders or military convoys.
tr: 你袭击了一支属于友好国家的船队。 本剧本中各国处于和平状态， 也就是说， 你绝不可袭击商船队或军事船队。

en: The welfare of @T$TargetTown$ is very close to my heart, but I'm afraid the town's economy has been in difficulty for some time. The problem is always the same: Traders stop calling at the town because demand is too low and the goods the town produces are not collected. This makes the town unattractive for new settlers. Will you help me get the town back on its feet?
tr: @T$TargetTown$ 的安危一直很牵挂我的心， 但恐怕那座城镇的经济已经困难了很久。 问题始终是同一个： 需求太低， 商人不再进镇， 城镇出产的货物也无人收购。 这让城镇对新的移民失去了吸引力。 你愿意帮我让这座城镇重新站起来吗？

en: If you want to purchase a business or residential building from a local trader, you must have both a building permit and a warehouse in the town.
tr: 若要向本地商人买下企业建筑或住宅建筑， 你必须同时拥有建筑许可证和该镇的一座仓库。

en: I’d be happy to tell you something of the life of the pirate Henry Avery.
tr: 我很乐意跟你聊聊海盗亨利·艾弗里的一生。

en: It is well known that many things we now take for granted first arrived in Europe as a result of the trade with America. However, the cultural exchange worked the other way around.<n><n> For example, when one pictures the typical Native American of the North American plains, it is hard to imagine that there were no horses in America before the arrival of the Spanish and the Portuguese. Many of the Native Americans fled in blind panic the first time that they saw a horse and rider, because they thought that this was a strange beast comprising two beings that had grown into one.<n><n>Coffee, which one normally associates with countries such as Brazil and Guatemala, is not native to America and had already traveled across three continents before its arrival there: From Africa (probably from Ethiopia), it traveled via the Arab countries before arriving in southwest Europe. The plant was first introduced in America during the 18th century, when the drink’s increasing popularity made it necessary to increase cultivation of the crop.<n><n>In the potato, the Europeans had discovered in the Caribbean a basic foodstuff of unimaginable value. Conversely, wheat was unknown in America until the arrival of the Spanish and the English, who brought this crop to Mexico in 1520 and to Virginia in 1777 respectively. Although people originally felt that the American climate was not suited to growing wheat, it was North America in particular that witnessed the most phenomenal success of this crop. Today, wheat is the agricultural crop with the largest acreage under cultivation in the world.
tr: 众所周知， 如今我们视为理所当然的许多东西， 最初都是通过与美洲的贸易才抵达欧洲的。 然而文化上的交流却是双向的。<n><n>比如， 当你想象北美平原上典型的美洲原住民时， 很难想象在西班牙人和葡萄牙人到来之前， 美洲是没有马的。 许多原住民第一次看到骑手与马匹时都惊慌逃散， 因为在他们看来， 这是一种由两个生命长成一体的怪物。<n><n>咖啡， 人们通常把它和巴西、 危地马拉这样的国家联系在一起， 其实并非美洲原生； 在到达美洲之前， 它已经跨越了三个大洲： 它从非洲 （很可能是埃塞俄比亚） 出发， 经由阿拉伯诸国传入南欧。 这种植物是在18 世纪才被引入美洲的—— 当时这种饮料日益流行， 人们不得不扩大对它的种植。<n><n>在欧洲人于加勒比发现的土豆， 是一种价值难以想象的基本主食。 反过来， 小麦在美洲一直无人知晓， 直到西班牙人和英国人的到来： 他们分别在1520 年和 1777 年把这种作物带到墨西哥和弗吉尼亚。 尽管人们最初认为美洲的气候并不适合种小麦， 但恰恰是北美大陆见证了这种作物最为惊人的成功。 如今， 小麦是全世界播种面积最大的农作物。

en: Almost everywhere in their newly acquired colonies, the Spanish set up a rigid social system offering precious little opportunity for advancement. At the very top of the hierarchy were those fellow countrymen born in Europe.<n><n> Spaniards born in the colonies were known as Creoles. Although they were only considered as being of secondary importance in the hierarchy, they occupied most of the lesser positions in the state, church and the army.<n><n>Spaniards of European descent and Creoles therefore represented the elite class in the colonies. The children of mixed marriages between whites (mostly men) and Native Americans were known as mestizos. The Native Americans, who originally owned the land, occupied the very lowest position in society and in those areas where they had been completely exterminated by the Europeans, this honor was reserved for the black slaves.<n><n>The relative proportions of these classes among the population differed greatly among the various regions of the Spanish empire. In Mexico, for example, the mestizos formed the largest section of the population. On many islands, black slaves were present in superior numbers (and at the mercy of their masters). Native American tribes also managed to survive in those areas where jungles, swamps and mountainous regions offered a safe retreat, for example, in Bolivia or Florida.
tr: 在新获得的殖民地， 几乎处处都是西班牙人建立起来的僵硬社会等级， 几乎不给人任何上升机会。 等级的最顶端， 是那些出生于欧洲的同胞。<n><n>出生在殖民地的西班牙人被称为克里奥尔人。 尽管在等级表中他们只被视为次要， 却占据了国家、 教会与军队中绝大多数较低的位置。<n><n>因此， 欧洲血统的西班牙人与克里奥尔人构成了殖民地的精英阶层。 白人 （多数是男性） 与原住民通婚所生的子女被称为混血儿 （mestizos）。 原本拥有这片土地的原住民， 处于社会的最底层； 而在那些已被欧洲人彻底灭绝的原住民所在地区， 这份 「荣耀」 则留给了黑人奴隶。<n><n>这些阶层在人口中的相对比例， 在西班牙帝国的各个地区差异极大。 例如在墨西哥， 混血儿构成了人口中最大的部分。 在许多岛上， 黑人奴隶的人数更多 （并任由主人摆布）。 而在丛林、 沼泽与山区提供了安全退避之所的地方—— 比如玻利维亚或佛罗里达—— 一些原住民族群也得以幸存。

en: In this scenario, you have to track down and kill the infamous pirate Edward Teach, otherwise known as Blackbeard. The Governor of Havana gives you various instructions and supports you in your quest.<n:25>In this scenario, you can use all the options offered in free-play mode. However, you'll also have specific tasks to fulfill in order to complete the scenario successfully.
tr: 本剧本中， 你必须追查并杀死那位臭名昭著的海盗爱德华·蒂奇， 即黑胡子。 哈瓦那总督会给你各种指示， 并在这场搜捕中支持你。<n:25>本剧本中你可以使用自由模式提供的全部选项。 不过要想成功完成剧本， 你还有特定任务要完成。

en: Would you like to chance a little card game with me?<n><n>Then choose your stake! I’ll match it, and the winner takes all.
tr: 要不要跟我来一局小小的牌戏？<n><n>那就选定你的赌注！ 我跟注， 赢家通吃。

en: All ships engaged in the battle are displayed at the bottom of the screen. Here you can use which ammunition you want to use. Select the heavy cannonballs and sink one of the enemy ships.<n>You can fire with the left mouse button, but only when your ship is in a good firing position. Targets are then shown in red.
tr: 参战的所有船只都显示在屏幕底部。 你可以在此选择要使用的弹药。 选中重型炮弹， 击沉一艘敌船。<n>你可以用鼠标左键开火， 但只有在你的船处于良好射击位置时才可行。 此时目标会显示为红色。

en: Usually, the enemy has a crew and a battle ensues on board the ship between your crew and theirs.<n>When the battle is over, all of the ships that have been boarded fall to the victor.<n>Now add the enemy ship to your convoy and close the Transfer window .
tr: 通常敌船上都有船员， 于是双方船员会在船上展开战斗。<n>战斗结束后， 所有被登上的船只都归胜者所有。<n>现在把这艘敌船加入你的船队， 然后关闭移交窗口。

en: Select your convoy and then right-click on the harbor to add the new ship to the convoy.
tr: 选中你的船队， 然后右键点击港口， 把新船加入船队。

en: Excellent!<n>Now visit the Governor and accomplish the mission he assigns to you.
tr: 非常好！<n>现在去拜访总督， 完成他交给你的委托。

en: You are now going to raid a pirate hideout.<n>First, ensure that your convoy is "shipshape"!<n>You could visit some more governor towns to see if a larger ship is available in one of the shipyards.<n>Along the way, pay a visit to the governor and obtain some information on the pirate hideout.
tr: 你即将去袭击一处海盗据点。<n>先确保你的船队状态良好！<n>你可以多跑几座总督城， 看看有没有船厂里备着更大的船。<n>路上顺便拜访总督， 从他那里打听一些关于海盗据点的消息。

en: Unfortunately, a plague has broken out in Tortuga. It will rage in the town for about one month. The town's status falls considerably and its citizens are dying every day. Many citizens are terrified of the disease and are fleeing.<n><n>For you as a trader, it is also of interest that the demand for garments and wood is doubled in the town while the plague rages.<n><n>Your task now is to ensure that the town is supplied during the plague and to ensure that the number of citizens does not fall.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>The number of citizens (inhabitants minus soldiers) must be restored to @I$Pop$ by no later than 20 days after the end of the plague. This will ensure that all businesses have a full complement of workers.
tr: 不幸的是， 托尔图加爆发了瘟疫。 它将在城里肆虐大约一个月。 城镇地位大幅下滑， 居民每天都在死去。 许多居民被这场疾病吓得仓皇出逃。<n><n>对你这个商人来说还有一点值得留意： 瘟疫肆虐期间， 城里的服装和木材需求翻了一倍。<n><n>你现在的任务， 是保证瘟疫期间城镇供应不断， 并保证居民人数不下降。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>必须在瘟疫结束后不迟于 20 天内， 把居民人数 （常住人口减去士兵） 恢复到 @I$Pop$ 。 这将确保所有企业都有充足的工人。

en: It evidently contained a beautiful miniature dolls' teaset.
tr: 里面显然装着一套精美的迷你茶具。

en: The most valuable thing in the chest was a long Scottish tartan skirt made of bearskin.
tr: 箱子里最值钱的， 是一条用熊皮做的苏格兰长格呢裙。

en: <n>I will pay you %1 per barrel of %2. You have %3 with you.<n><n>Would you like to give me the goods?
tr: <n>我按每桶 %1 收购 %2 。 你手上带着 %3 。<n><n>你愿意把货给我吗？

en: This is an ordinary gold watch, but it is smaller than any you have ever seen. On a disc behind the face, you also notice a moon that seems to be slowly rotating. There are also some engravings on the back of the watch.
tr: 这是一只普通的金表， 但比你见过的任何一只都要小。 表盘后面的圆盘上， 还看得见一轮似乎缓缓旋转的月亮。 表背也刻着一些花纹。

en: In this scenario, you must help the Dutch colonies to acquire new towns.<n:25>You begin the scenario with a well-armed convoy and some starting capital. By capturing English trading ships, you'll immediately increase your wealth and will be able equip your convoy with more arms.<n:25>Later, your convoy will attack English military convoys to weaken England's defenses and will then be able to capture their towns.
tr: 在这个剧本中， 你必须帮助荷兰殖民地获取新的城镇。<n:25>剧本开始时你有一支装备精良的船队和一笔启动资金。 抢下英格兰的商船就能立刻增厚你的财富， 好为船队配更多军械。<n:25>之后， 你的船队将袭击英格兰的军事船队以削弱其防御， 进而攻占他们的城镇。

en: The viceroy has instructed me to support the town of @T$Town$. I would therefore be happy to pay for a school in the town. However, the town council has rejected my offer, they don't want me interfering and would rather take the gold directly. Hence, I wanted to ask whether you could build the school.
tr: 副王已指示我支援 @T$Town$ 这座城镇， 所以我很乐意出钱帮它建一所学校。 可镇议会拒绝了我的提议—— 他们不想让我插手， 宁愿直接把钱收走。 所以我想问问， 你能不能把这所学校建起来。

en: My thanks to you for destroying that pirate convoy. Here is a reward of @g$GoldReward$.<n>By the way: Whenever you accomplish a mission on my behalf, you automatically improve your reputation with my nation.<n>If, on the other hand, you have a low reputation with my nation, I'm afraid I cannot entrust any missions to you.
tr: 谢谢你摧毁了那支海盗船队。 这是给你的报酬 @g$GoldReward$ 。<n>顺便说一句： 每当你替我完成一件委托， 你在我国的声望就会自动提升。<n>反过来说， 如果你在我国声望不高， 恐怕我就没法把委托交给你了。

en: Greetings to you, @s$USER$. I am organizing a convoy to Europe, for I have heard that @G$Goods$ is fetching a very high price. I am offering a unit price of @g$FullPrice$ to anyone who can deliver me @G$Goods$ . Do we have a deal?
tr: 你好， @s$USER$ 。 我正在组织一支前往欧洲的船队， 因为我听说 @G$Goods$ 在那边价格极高。 凡是把 @G$Goods$ 运给我的， 我出单价 @g$FullPrice$ 。 成交？

en: You have not yet returned my ship? Please tie it up in the harbor as soon as you find it and then come back to me.
tr: 我的船还没还回来吗？ 一找到它， 就赶紧在港口停好， 然后回来见我。

en: A Dutch military convoy is attacking
tr: 荷兰军事船队正在进攻

en: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>You have rescued the very experienced captain @N$Name$. He asks to be put ashore at a town belonging to @n$DestNation$.
tr: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>你救起经验丰富的船长 @N$Name$ 。 他请求把他送到 @n$DestNation$ 的一座城镇上岸。

en: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>You have picked up @I$Sailors$ shipwrecked sailors, who appear to be acquainted with some of the crew. The welcome party raises the morale of the crew.
tr: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>你救起 @I$Sailors$ 名遇险的水手， 他们似乎和船上的某些人认识。 这场欢迎仪式提起了全船的士气。

en: Guide your captain through duels with  other captains and pirates.<n><n>Accomplish countless missions involving battles, trade and politics.
tr: 带着你的船长与各国船长和海盗一决高下。<n><n>完成无数涉及战斗、 贸易与政治的任务。

en: Today, the French buccaneer %1 encountered an English military convoy and was killed.
tr: 今天， 法国私掠者 %1 遭遇英格兰军事船队， 被击杀了。

en: Today, the French buccaneer %1 encountered a Dutch military convoy and was killed.
tr: 今天， 法国私掠者 %1 遭遇荷兰军事船队， 被击杀了。

en: Today, the Dutch buccaneer %1 encountered a French military convoy and was killed.
tr: 今天， 荷兰私掠者 %1 遭遇法国军事船队， 被击杀了。

en: Now switch to the sea chart and travel with your convoy to Santa Marta. Do not enter Santa Marta, but right-click on the town as soon as the convoy reaches the town.
tr: 现在切换到海图， 驾船队前往圣玛尔塔。 不要进入圣玛尔塔， 而要在船队抵达城镇时立刻右击城镇名称。

en: You have found the remains of the sunken transport convoy, but there is no room to take the goods on board.
tr: 你找到了沉没运输船队的残骸， 但船上已经没有空间装载这些货物。

en: Congratulations! You have successfully completed this scenario and now know how to build your own town.<n><n>In free-play mode, the viceroy of any nation may grant you the gift of your own town. But this is not easy to achieve, because you must always capture towns in order to receive a plot of land, and this will naturally damage your reputation with other nations. <n><n>Anything you have learned in this scenario about developing your town will help you to develop businesses in other towns also. The main difference is that you don't have to worry about defending those towns.
tr: 恭喜！ 你已顺利完成这个剧本， 现在明白了如何建造自己的城镇。<n><n>在自由模式中， 任何一位副王都可能把一座属于你的城镇赏赐给你。 但这并不容易做到， 因为你必须不断攻占城镇才能获得土地， 而这自然会损害你与其他国家的关系。<n><n>这个剧本里你学到的所有城镇发展心得， 同样会帮助你在其他城镇开设店铺。 唯一的区别是， 你不必再为那些城镇的防守操心。

en: Hello @A$USER$. Can you deliver @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ to me? I am prepared to pay the sum of @g$TotalPrice$, which would mean a unit price of @g$Price$. What say you?
tr: 你好， @A$USER$ 。 你能给我送来 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 吗？ 我愿意支付 @g$TotalPrice$ ， 也就是单价 @g$Price$ 。 怎么样？

en: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>You have found flotsam and take it on board your convoy.
tr: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>你发现了漂浮物， 已将其装上船队。

en: You already know that only escort ships can take part in sea battles. The vanquished trading ships always fall to the victor, who can choose to loot or capture them.<n><n>You are not always the initiator of sea battles involving your convoys. If one of your convoys is attacked by pirates or by a military convoy from a nation in which your reputation is very low, you can engage in combat or your convoy can try to avoid the battle. If you want to avoid a battle, your escort ships must try to keep the enemy from getting too close to your trading ships.<n><n>If this fails, your escort ships will be captured and your trading ships  looted. If a convoy has no warships, all it can do in the case of an attack is try to avoid a battle. Advantage: The trading ships are only looted by the enemy and are not captured.<n><n>Now pay the governor a visit. He has a new mission for you. <n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Accomplish the next mission assigned to you by the governor.
tr: 你已经知道， 只有护航船才能参加海战。 战败一方的商船总是归胜者所有， 胜者可以决定洗劫还是俘获它们。<n><n>涉及你船队的海战并不总是由你挑起。 如果你的某支船队遭到海盗袭击， 或遭到你在该国声望极低的那个国家的军事船队袭击， 你可以选择迎战， 也可以让船队设法避战。 要想避战， 你的护航船必须设法阻止敌人靠商船太近。<n><n>若这一手没奏效， 你的护航船会被俘， 商船会被洗劫。 如果一支船队里没有军舰， 遭袭时它唯一能做的就是设法避战。 好处是： 商船只会被洗劫， 不会被俘获。<n><n>现在去拜访总督吧。 他有个新任务交给你。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>完成总督交给你的下一个任务。

en: The place lies somewhere in the northwest.
tr: 那个地方在西北方的某处。

en: One of my rivals in @n$HostileNation$ has stolen my diaries and now wants to send them to Europe. It is vital that he does not succeed. Luckily, I was able to bribe the helmsman on the ship carrying the diaries to Europe. Now I need your help.
tr: @n$HostileNation$ 的一个对手偷走了我的日记， 还想把它们送往欧洲。 绝不能让他得逞。 所幸我买通了那艘运送日记赴欧船上的舵手。 现在我需要你的帮助。

en: You have found a very special ship!<n><n><g:INTEXT_BONUSSCHIFF_800x600.screen><n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Steam-powered sailing ship<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><n>Never in your life have you seen such a ship! It seems to be powered not only by the sails on its twin masts, but also by a curious mechanism that uses steam to power two paddle wheels. Apparently, this allows the ship to keep moving even if there isn't a breath of wind.
tr: 你找到了一艘非同寻常的船！<n><n><g:INTEXT_BONUSSCHIFF_800x600.screen><n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>蒸汽动力帆船<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><n>你这辈子从没见过这样的船！ 它似乎不光靠两根桅杆上的帆驱动， 还有一套奇怪的装置， 用蒸汽带动两只明轮。 据说这样一来， 即便一丝风都没有， 这船照样能走。

en: The place lies somewhere to the west of %1.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 以西的某处。

en: The position lies up to 1 day’s journey to the north of %1.
tr: 那个位置在 %1 以北最多一天航程处。

en: The position lies up to 1 day’s journey to the south of %1.
tr: 那个位置在 %1 以南最多一天航程处。

en: Produce cocoa in Santa Marta and build up a supply of @a$AmountGoal$ in your warehouse.
tr: 在圣玛尔塔生产可可， 并在你的仓库里囤到 @a$AmountGoal$ 。

en: <ts:80><ts:160>I have learned the following from talking to traders:<n><n>The four most expensive goods in %1 are:<n><n>%2<t>%3%<t>%4<n>%5<t>%6%<t>%7<n>%8<t>%9%<t>%10<n>%11<t>%12%<t>%13<n><n>(100% = normal production price)
Maximum reached for this town size
tr: 这种城镇规模已达上限

en: Are you sure you want to quit the game and return to Windows?
tr: 你确定要退出游戏并返回 Windows 吗？
把货物排除出手动交易

en: You did not manage to deliver the goods in time for the feast.<n><n>%1 wants nothing more to do with you.
tr: 你没能及时交付宴席所需的货物。<n><n>%1 再也不想跟你有任何瓜葛。

en: You have failed to breach the town's defenses.
tr: 你未能攻破这座城镇的防御。

en: Select a residential area in the Construction menu and look at the construction costs display. <n>You may not have enough building materials in storage. However, you can buy any materials that you need in the town if they are in sufficient supply. <n>Otherwise, you'll have to source them in another town.<n>Then build a residential area.
tr: 在建造菜单中选中住宅区， 查看建造费用显示。<n>你的库存里可能没有足够的建筑材料。 不过， 只要城镇供应充足， 你可以在城里买到任何需要的材料。<n>否则， 你就得去别的城镇弄货。<n>然后建起一处住宅区。

en: Tools are imported goods. This means that you'll find the most plentiful supply and the lowest prices in governor towns.<n>You could try to source some in Cartagena to the southwest or far to the east in Margarita .
tr: 工具属于进口货物。 这意味着在总督城里货源最充足、 价格最低。<n>你可以去西南方的卡塔赫纳， 或者东边很远的玛格丽塔找找货源。

en: Under "Trading Record", you can now check what percentage of the required score you have already achieved. If 100% is displayed here, you can apply for a permit from the master builder.<n>Close the town information.
tr: 在 「贸易记录」 下， 你现在可以查看所要求分数的完成百分比。 这里显示 100% 时， 你就可以向总建筑师申请许可证。<n>关闭城镇信息。

en: Note which goods are lacking in the town. For example, the town will always need sugar and cotton because it produces rum and garments.<n>But there are other scarce goods in the town also.<n>Go to other towns to buy the goods that Cartagena needs and improve your trading record.
tr: 记下该镇缺哪些货物。 例如， 这座城镇总会需要糖和棉花， 因为它出产朗姆酒和衣物。<n>不过镇上还有其他稀缺货物。<n>去其他城镇买进卡塔赫纳需要的货物， 提升你的贸易记录。

en: In this scenario, you'll learn how to establish businesses and find out what you need to take into account when you do so. You'll also construct residential areas for your new workers.<n><n>In Port Royale 2, you can build in any town where you have a purchased a building permit. The more permits you have, the more expensive your next one will be. You already have one permit in the town where you started the game, so you can start to construct new buildings there immediately.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Construct one cocoa production facility and one residential area in Santa Marta.
tr: 在这个剧本里， 你将学会如何开设产业， 以及为此需要考虑哪些因素。 你还会为新来的工人建造居住区。<n><n>在 Port Royale 2 中， 你可以在任何一座你已购得建造许可的城镇里动工。 你的许可越多， 下一张就越贵。 你在游戏开局所在的那座城镇里已经有一张许可， 所以可以立刻开始在那里建造新建筑。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>在圣玛尔塔建造一座可可生产设施和一座居住区。

en: Congratulations! You can now produce cloth from cotton in Cartagena.<n><n>As you can imagine, the costs of producing cloth depend to a large degree on the price you pay for the cotton. For this reason, you can only produce finished goods if you can be sure of being able to purchase the raw materials at a reasonable price. Alternatively, you can produce the raw materials yourself.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Build a cotton production facility in Santa Marta and trade to increase your cash to @g$GoldGoal$.
tr: 恭喜！ 你现在可以用棉花在卡塔赫纳生产布料了。<n><n>不难想象， 生产布料的成本在很大程度上取决于你为棉花支付的价钱。 因此， 只有当你有把握能以合理价格购进原料时， 才可以生产成品。 当然， 你也可以自己生产这些原料。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>在圣玛尔塔建一座棉花生产设施， 并通过贸易把现金增加到 @g$GoldGoal$ 。

en: Just the other day, a seaman from Port Royale told me that they recently sailed very close to the Bermuda Islands. They almost sailed too close, for with his own eyes, he saw a huge monster moving in the water. It was spitting fire and smoke belched from its long ears. Woe betide those that dare to approach this sea monster!
tr: 就在前几天， 皇家港的一名水手告诉我， 他们最近驶得离百慕大群岛很近， 差点靠得太近—— 他亲眼看见水中有一个巨大的怪物在移动。 它喷吐火焰， 长耳里冒出浓烟。 胆敢靠近这头海怪的， 必遭横祸！

en: <g:INTEXT_FLASCHENPOST_800x600.screen><n>You have found a fragment of a treasure map. It seems to belong to the map you already have in your log.
tr: <g:INTEXT_FLASCHENPOST_800x600.screen><n>你发现了一块藏宝图碎片， 它似乎属于你日志里已有的那张地图。

en: Once again, we are faced with a shortage of those imported goods delivered by transport convoys from @n$Nation$. Could you help my friends and I with regard to this matter?
tr: 我们又一次面临短缺： 由来自 @n$Nation$ 的运输船队送来的进口货物已经断供。 这件事， 您能帮帮我和朋友吗？

en: Thank you for bringing me the documents. As a reward, I am presenting you with a barque. You will find her in the harbor.
tr: 谢谢你把文件带给我。 作为报答， 我送你一艘三桅帆船。 她就在港口等你。

en: Thank you for bringing me the documents. As a reward, I am presenting you with a barque. You will find her in the harbor.
tr: 谢谢你把文件带给我。 作为报答， 我送你一艘三桅帆船。 她就在港口等你。

en: @s$USER$, sit down beside me, I know where you can get training for one of your captains. Do you remember @N$TeacherName$?
tr: @s$USER$ ， 坐过来吧， 我知道哪儿能让你手下的船长受训。 还记得 @N$TeacherName$ 吗？

en: They say he was an outstanding navigator.
tr: 据说他是个出色的领航员。

en: %1,<n>there you are again, I’m glad to see. I believe I may have some information for you.
tr: %1 ，<n>又见到你， 我很高兴。 我想我有些消息要告诉你。

en: Having defeated your adversary's escort ships, you seize a trading ship.<n><n>You now have to decide which goods you want to take and whether you want to capture the ships or just loot them.
tr: 你击溃了对手的护航船， 抢下一艘商船。<n><n>现在你得决定取走哪些货物， 以及是俘获这条船， 还是只抢了货就放它走。

en: %1 %2 receives the town of %3 from the Dutch viceroy.
tr: %1・%2 从荷兰副王手中接管了 %3 。

en: Do you want to demolish all of this large business?

en: The trade in “black gold” had already begun in the early 16th century. The slave traders’ preferred source of “goods” was the coast of West Africa that stretched between the Senegal river and what is today known as Cameroon. Not only was this area ideally situated from a transport point of view, it also possessed a stable economic and sociopolitical infrastructure. This meant that the sailors did not have to go hunting for slaves themselves, but could purchase their victims from the local chieftains or from other slave traders.<n><n>Young men between the ages of 15 and 35 were particularly sought after because they were destined primarily for hard labor on the plantations. Approximately one in every five slaves didn’t even survive the crossing, which could last for up to six weeks. Some died as a result of the barbaric treatment meted out by their masters, while others perished due to accidents at sea. Taking this high mortality rate into account, the slave traders sought to make each voyage as profitable as possible by cramming as many slaves as they could onto their ships. For weeks on end, these wretched creatures lay side by side like sardines in a tin, chained to one another, in the dark and with barely enough air to breathe.<n><n>Under these conditions, it is almost incredible that any of them survived these journeys!
tr: 「黑色黄金」 的买卖早在 16 世纪初就已开始。 奴隶贩子偏爱的 「货物」 来源， 是西非从塞内加尔河延伸到今日喀麦隆之间的海岸。 这一地区不仅在运输上位置得天独厚， 还具备稳定的经济与社会政治基础设施。 这意味着水手们不必自己去猎捕奴隶， 而是可以向当地酋长或其他奴隶贩子买下他们的受害者。<n><n>15 至 35 岁的年轻男子尤其抢手， 因为他们注定主要要被送进种植园从事苦役。 大约每五个奴隶里就有一个连横渡都撑不过去， 而航程最长可达六周。 有些人死于主人施加的野蛮折磨， 另一些人则葬身海上事故。 考虑到如此高的死亡率， 奴隶贩子便想方设法让每次航行尽可能赚钱， 往船上尽可能多地塞进奴隶。 一连几个星期， 这些可怜的生物像罐头里的沙丁鱼一样肩挨肩躺着， 彼此锁在一起， 置身黑暗之中， 空气稀薄得几乎无法呼吸。<n><n>在这种条件下， 他们之中居然有人能活着走完这段航程， 几乎难以置信！

en: From the moment it was announced, the discovery of the New World fired the imagination of the people of Europe. What sort of creatures might these unexplored territories contain? The most incredible rumors circulated: One island was said to be teeming with cannibals, the next with headless creatures whose faces were set into their stomachs.<n><n>The South American landscape of Patagonia translates roughly as “land of the big-footed ones” while the Amazon owes its name to a horde of female warriors who are alleged to have reminded the explorers of similar female warriors from Greek mythology.<n><n>While there was a factual background to some of these rumors, others were based on misunderstandings and misinterpretations or on stories that the Native Americans themselves had simply picked up somewhere.<n><n>However, many of these rumors were simply the product of people’s vivid imaginations and, more often than not, people only believed them because they wanted to. This would explain why entire generations of conquistadors searched for the legendary Fountain of Youth, the Garden of Eden and Eldorado, the city of gold. They were encouraged in their erroneous beliefs by the Native Americans, who constantly assured them that they had heard of one place or another, but who simply wished to buy time so they could entice these greedy white men deep inland and cut them off from their ships.
tr: 新世界的发现一经宣布， 便点燃了欧洲人的想象力。 这些未经探索的土地上究竟藏着什么样的生灵？ 各种最难以置信的传闻四处流传： 据说有一座岛上遍是食人族， 另一座岛则住着无头怪， 它们的脸长在肚子上。<n><n>南美洲巴塔哥尼亚的地名大致可译为 「大脚者的土地」， 而亚马逊河的名字则源于一支女战士族群—— 据说她们让探险者想起了希腊神话中类似的女性战士。<n><n>这些传闻中有些确有事实依据， 另一些则源于误解与误读， 或是原住民自己不知从哪儿听来的故事。<n><n>不过， 这些传闻中有许多不过是人们丰富想象力的产物； 而更多时候， 人们之所以相信它们， 只因为他们愿意相信。 这就解释了为什么一代又一代的征服者会去寻找传说中的青春泉、 伊甸园， 以及黄金之城埃尔多拉多。 原住民非但没有纠正他们的迷思， 反而不断鼓励—— 总是向他们保证说自己听说过某个地方； 他们不过是想拖延时间， 好把这些贪婪的白人诱到内陆深处， 与他们的船只断绝联系。

en: As is generally known, the early phase of the colonization of America was undertaken by Spain and Portugal. They were later joined by Holland and, most importantly, by England and France. What is rather less well known is that numerous Spanish expeditions would never have been undertaken had it not been for their powerful German financial backers.<n><n>By the year 1500, Upper Swabia and Augsburg in particular had developed into one of the most important centers of trade and finance in Europe. From here, the merchant families of Fugger and Welser exerted a powerful influence over world politics. For example, it was their extensive financial support that helped King Charles of Spain become Emperor of Germany in 1519. King Henry VIII of England and many of the Popes were happy to count Jakob Fugger the “Wealthy” among their friends.<n><n>Naturally, these astute traders had their own ulterior motives in bestowing this kind of support. In return, they expected to be assigned privileges or permission to participate in the royal mining of silver. The Welsers even managed to temporarily acquire part of the northern coast of Venezuela, where they founded towns such as “New Augsburg” and from where they sent several expeditions on (mostly fruitless) searches into the heartland for treasure.
tr: 众所周知， 美洲殖民的早期阶段是由西班牙和葡萄牙开启的。 后来加入的是荷兰， 而最重要的是英格兰与法国。 但鲜为人知的是： 若不是那些财力雄厚的德国金融赞助者， 西班牙的许多次远征根本不会成行。<n><n>到 1500 年， 上施瓦本和奥格斯堡已发展成为欧洲最重要的贸易与金融中心之一。 福格与韦尔泽两家的商人家族， 从这里对世界政治施加着强大的影响。 例如， 正是他们大量的资金支持， 帮助西班牙的卡洛斯国王于 1519 年成为德国皇帝。 英格兰的亨利八世国王和多位教宗， 都很乐于把 「富有的」 雅各布·福格算作自己的朋友。<n><n>这些精明的商人当然也有自己的私下盘算。 作为回报， 他们期待获得特权， 或获准参与王室的白银开采。 韦尔泽家族甚至一度取得了委内瑞拉北部海岸的一部分， 在那里建起了 「新奥格斯堡」 这样的城镇， 并从那里派出多支探险队， 深入内陆寻宝 （大多一无所获）。

en: By conquering half of the globe, the Spanish Crown found itself able to avail of unique opportunities. Over a period of several centuries, up until the demise of the great American cultures of the Incas, Mayas and Aztecs and the discovery of huge silver deposits in Peru and Mexico by the latest, Spain’s position appeared to be unassailable. It seems almost absurd that it was precisely this immense wealth that precipitated this world power’s decline.<n><n>A large part of the treasures sent by ship back to Spain went directly into the pockets of those traders north of the Pyrenees who had financed the voyages in the first place. However, the remainder was still sufficient to drive up price levels on the Iberian peninsula. People there began living beyond their means: In an age where the ability to hold court on a grand scale was considered more important than balancing the state budget, people payed little attention to trivial financial concerns.<n><n>Goods were imported in ever increasing quantities aboard foreign ships because people had become far too refined to produce them at home. Even the equipment and provisions for the expeditions to America were seldom provided by the domestic traders. People remarked with pride: All of Europe is at Spain’s command.<n><n>However, the flow of silver had to run dry eventually, and the rude awakening that followed would resemble a hangover after a long night’s drunken carousing: The Dutch and the British were attempting to drive Spain from the high seas. Numerous religious wars against the protestant “heretics” and against the Turks had devoured enormous sums of money and the vast empire, on which the sun never set, had developed into an ungovernable colossus.<n><n> The crisis was apparent to all in the year 1557, when the new Spanish ruler, Philip II, was forced to declare state bankruptcy for the first time. The great empire, which had held greater treasures than any empire that had gone before, was broke.
tr: 西班牙王室在征服了半个地球之后， 发现自己享有一种独特的机会。 在长达几个世纪的时间里—— 直到印加、 玛雅与阿兹特克这些伟大美洲文明的消亡， 以及后来在秘鲁和墨西哥发现巨型银矿藏为止—— 西班牙的地位看上去坚不可摧。 然而恰恰是这份庞大的财富， 促成了这个世界强国的衰落， 这几乎显得荒谬。<n><n>用船运回西班牙的财宝中， 很大一部分直接流进了比利牛斯山以北那些商人的口袋—— 正是他们出资资助了这些航程。 但剩下的部分， 仍足以把伊比利亚半岛的物价推高。 那里的人开始过着入不敷出的生活： 在一个把大规模排场看得比平衡国家预算更重要的年代， 人们根本不怎么理会那些琐碎的财务问题。<n><n>商品以越来越多的数量乘外国船运来， 因为人们已经矫情到不肯自己生产这些东西了。 连前往美洲的探险队所需装备与给养， 也很少由本国商人提供。 人们自豪地感叹： 整个欧洲都在听命于西班牙。<n><n>然而白银的洪流终究会枯竭， 随之而来的当头棒喝， 活像通宵痛饮之后的那阵宿醉： 荷兰人和英国人正在把西班牙逐出公海。 针对新教 「异端」 和土耳其人的一场场宗教战争吞掉了巨额钱财， 而这个日不落的庞大帝国已经长成一个无法治理的巨怪。<n><n>1557 年， 危机已为所有人所察觉： 西班牙的新君主菲利普二世被迫首次宣布国家破产。 这个曾经拥有比此前任何帝国都更多财富的大帝国， 穷了。

en: The Bahamas, which for a brief period in the middle of the 17th century served as a refuge for religious dissenters from England, was from 1670 officially under the control of the Earl of Albemarle and other gentlemen who had taken ownership of the group of islands from King Charles II in the hope of making profits.<n><n>Despite their promises, however, these individual showed little interest in setting up a well-ordered civil administration. Quite the opposite was the case: Similar to other places in the Caribbean, hordes of pirates settled in the Bahamas, especially on the island of New Providence, which was home to the town of Nassau. <n><n>The shallow bays, into which heavy warships could not intrude, offered an ideal berth for several hundred sloops and pirate barques. The frequent raids in Spanish waters resulted in reprisals and John Wentworth, the first governor, had the unenviable task of reimposing law and order on the islands.<n><n>As the situation showed no signs of improvement, King George I of England confiscated the Bahamas again and turned it into a Crown Colony. Woodes Rogers, the former buccaneer and circumnavigator, was appointed the first royal governor in the middle of 1718.<n><n>Using a carrot and stick approach, he brought an end to the chaos that had hitherto prevailed. He held out a general amnesty for all pirates who were prepared to renounce their activities under oath. For all those who were unwilling to do so, punishment awaited in the form of a fleet of ships armed to the teeth.<n><n>After normal conditions had been restored in this way, the island group was granted its own parliament in 1729 and over the following hundred years, with the exception of occasional disturbances as a result of invasions, the history of the Bahamas remained relatively uneventful.
tr: 巴哈马群岛在 17 世纪中叶曾短暂充当英格兰宗教异议者的避难所， 而从 1670 年起， 它正式归奥伯马尔伯爵等一批绅士管辖—— 他们从查理二世国王手中买下了这组岛屿， 指望从中获利。<n><n>然而尽管他们信誓旦旦， 这些人对建立一套井然有序的民政管理却兴趣寥寥。 恰恰相反： 与加勒比其他地方的遭遇一样， 大批海盗在巴哈马安家落户， 尤其集中在新普罗维登斯岛—— 拿骚镇就在这座岛上。<n><n>那些重型战舰无法驶入的浅水海湾， 为数百艘单桅帆船和海盗双桅船提供了理想的停泊处。 他们在西班牙海域的频繁劫掠招来了报复， 首任总督约翰·温特沃思面临着一项棘手任务： 在这些岛屿上重新建立法律与秩序。<n><n>眼看情况毫无好转， 英格兰的乔治一世国王再度没收了巴哈马， 把它改为王室直辖殖民地。 1718 年中， 前私掠者兼环球航行家伍兹·罗杰斯被任命为首位皇家总督。<n><n>他软硬兼施， 结束了此前一直弥漫的混乱。 他宣布大赦： 凡愿意宣誓放弃海盗活动的海盗， 一律既往不咎。 至于不肯就范者， 等待他们的是一支全副武装的舰队的惩罚。<n><n>就这样恢复正常秩序之后， 这组岛屿于 1729 年获得了自己的议会； 在此后的一百年里， 除了偶尔因入侵而起的动荡之外， 巴哈马的历史相对平静。

tr: 法国军事船队正在进攻

en: Our current enemy, @n$HostileNation$, has attacked our transport convoys and looted the imported goods that were intended for the English towns in the New World.
tr: 我们当前的敌人 @n$HostileNation$ 袭击了我们的运输船队， 抢走了原本要运往新世界英格兰城镇的进口货物。

en: Our current enemy, @n$HostileNation$, has attacked our transport convoys and looted the imported goods that were intended for the Spanish towns in the New World.
tr: 我们当前的敌人 @n$HostileNation$ 袭击了我们的运输船队， 抢走了原本要运往新世界西班牙城镇的进口货物。

en: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>You have rescued a priest from @n$DestNation$. He cannot pay you to take him to a town belonging to his nation, but he promises to intervene on your behalf in order to improve your reputation in @n$DestNation$.
tr: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>你救起一名来自 @n$DestNation$ 的神父。 他付不起船费送你回本国城镇， 但他答应替你出面说情， 好让你在 @n$DestNation$ 的声望有所改善。

en: My dear %1,<n>perhaps I can help you with a loan so you can assist us in developing this town. What amount did you have in mind?
tr: 亲爱的 %1 ，<n>也许我能借笔钱给你， 帮你协助我们开发这座城镇。 你想借多少？

en: Blackbeard has discovered that you are collaborating with the Governor of @T$TOWN$.  He has therefore begun to terrorize the traders who visit @T$TOWN$.  Within a few days, hardly any traders will dare to come to @T$TOWN$. <n><n>This is only a temporary tactic. Your task is to supply the town with goods until @D$EndDate$. The status of the town must not drop below "flourishing economy".<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Supply @T$TOWN$ with goods until @D$EndDate$. The status of the town must not drop below "flourishing economy".
tr: 黑胡子发现你在与 @T$TOWN$ 的总督暗中合作。 于是他开始恐吓前来 @T$TOWN$ 的商人。 不出几天， 就几乎没人敢再来了。<n><n>这只是权宜之计。 你的任务是持续为该城镇供应货物， 直到 @D$EndDate$ 。 城镇地位不得降到 「兴旺经济」 之下。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>持续向 @T$TOWN$ 供应货物直到 @D$EndDate$ 。 城镇地位不得降到 「兴旺经济」 之下。

en: Battle against pirates, buccaneers and military convoys from enemy nations.<n><n>Try your hand at hunting down trading convoys as a buccaneer.<n><n>Set off in search of the legendary Spanish treasure fleet.<n><n>Command 16 different types of ship.
tr: 与海盗、 私掠者以及敌国军事船队交战。<n><n>以私掠者身份去追猎商船队试试身手。<n><n>出海寻找传说中的西班牙珍宝船队。<n><n>指挥 16 种不同类型的船只。

en: There is a shortage of @G$Goods$ for processing in my town. The stocks of the various businesses are already very low. Could you help me?
tr: 我的城镇缺少可供加工的 @G$Goods$ 。 各家产业的存货都已经很少了。 你能帮我一把吗？

en: Greetings, %1. Seaman %2 has offered his services as an inexperienced captain.
tr: 你好， %1 。 海员 %2 自荐为一名经验不足的船长。

en: Use a convoy to find the teacher's hideout. @l$TeacherPos$ There must be @a$Amount$ of food on board the convoy.
tr: 派一支船队去找老师的藏身处。 @l$TeacherPos$ 船上必须装载 @a$Amount$ 食物。

en: You are not exactly on good terms with my nation. Do you want to improve your reputation by paying %1 to my nation as a token of goodwill?
tr: 你与我国的关系算不上友好。 你愿意向我国支付 %1 作为善意表示， 以改善你的声望吗？

en: I'm afraid I have no use for you at the moment.<n> I can only task you with capturing a town if a hostile nation is weakened and I have enough military convoys available to protect my towns.
tr: 恐怕我现在用不上你。<n>只有当敌国实力削弱、 而且我有足够的军事船队保卫我的城镇时， 我才能委托你攻占城镇。

en: @N$Name$ has jumped overboard in a rage because you were too slow.
tr: @N$Name$ 因为你动作太慢， 一怒之下跳海了。

en: In the demo, you can only enter the towns that were already shown at the start of the game.<n><n>However, you can trade with any town by dispatching a convoy to the town and right-clicking on the town while the convoy is selected.
tr: 在试玩版里， 你只能进入游戏开始时展示过的城镇。<n><n>不过你可以和任何城镇交易： 派一支船队前往该城镇， 选中船队后右击城镇名称即可。
使用彩色硬件鼠标指针

en: Greetings, @A$USER$. Would you be interested in supplying me with @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$? I will pay you @g$Price$ per unit, which means a total of @g$TotalPrice$. Are you interested?
tr: 你好， @A$USER$ 。 你愿意给我供应 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 吗？ 我按每单位 @g$Price$ 付给你， 总计 @g$TotalPrice$ 。 你有兴趣吗？

en: You have no free ships in the harbor.

As you know, we are at war with @n$HostileNation$.<n><n>This would be a good time to fill our warehouses with goods that @n$HostileNation$ has in plentiful supply.<n><n>I want you to capture a substantial quantity of a particular good for me.
tr: 如你所知， 我国正与 @n$HostileNation$ 交战。<n><n>眼下正是把 @n$HostileNation$ 大量出产的货物装满我们仓库的好时机。<n><n>我要你替我截获大量某一种特定货物。

en: <ts:20>You already know how to buy and sell goods in the Trade window. Here are some more tips:<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>The price shown on the arrows depends on the unit size<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>It doesn’t matter whether you buy or sell one good 10 times or buy or sell 10 goods once only. The total price is the same.<n><n><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>A price is always shown, even if a good is not available. This is always the price for a unit of goods, regardless of the unit size that is set.<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>You can also trade by clicking on the symbol for a good. When you do this, a small window containing a scrollbar appears. You can use this scrollbar to specify how many goods you want to buy or sell. The individual price and the total price are then immediately displayed.
tr: <ts:20>你已经知道如何在 「贸易」 窗口里买卖货物了。 这里再补几条技巧：<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>箭头上标出的价格取决于单位数量<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>把一种货物分 10 次买卖， 和一次买卖 10 单位， 总价是一样的。<n><n><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>即使某种货物没有货， 价格也照样显示。 这个价格永远按一个单位算， 与你设定的单位数量无关。<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>你也可以直接点击货物的图标来交易。 这样会弹出一个带滚动条的小窗口， 拖动滚动条即可指定你要买卖的货物数量， 单价与总价会立即显示出来。

en: An English military convoy has destroyed a convoy belonging to the pirate %1.
tr: 一支英格兰军事船队摧毁了海盗 %1 的一支船队。

en: A Spanish military convoy has destroyed a convoy belonging to the pirate %1.
tr: 一支西班牙军事船队摧毁了海盗 %1 的一支船队。

en: The place is located 1 to 2 days' journey to the southeast of %1.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 东南一天到两天航程处。

en: Donated by %1<n>on %2.<n><n>The hospital reduces the risk of plagues and improves the quality of life in the town.
tr: 由 %1 捐赠<n>于 %2 。<n><n>医院能降低瘟疫风险， 并提升城镇的生活品质。

en: You are still too inexperienced for your first mission. Come back to me as soon as you have reached the rank of Sailor, perhaps I will have a job for you then.<n><n>Your rank will rise if you accumulate further assets.
tr: 你的经验还太嫩， 接不了第一个任务。 等你升到水手再来找我， 那时或许我就有活儿给你了。<n><n>你的等级会随着资产累积而提升。

en: A business can employ 30 workers. Since there are four family members in an average worker's family, living quarters for 120 people are required for each business you establish. <n>A residential area has space for 120 tenants and so one residential area is required for each business.<n>Now close the Construction menu and click on your new residential area.
tr: 一家企业可雇用 30 名工人。 普通工人家庭平均有四口人， 所以每开一家企业， 就需要能容纳 120 人的住处。<n>一处住宅区可容纳 120 名住户， 因此每家企业需要配一处住宅区。<n>现在关闭建造菜单， 点击你新建的住宅区。

en: Your men set off to find the treasure chamber without meeting any resistance. They loot %1.<n><n>You must now choose what goods you want to loot from the town's warehouse.
tr: 你的人马一路摸到藏宝室， 没遇到任何抵抗。 他们搜出了 %1 。<n><n>现在你得决定从城镇仓库里搬走哪些货物。

en: Nice work! With your Letter of Marque, you are now officially in the service of Holland and involved in the war with England. This means that you can attack English trading ships without your reputation suffering in Holland, France or Spain.<n><n>Naturally, your reputation with England will be damaged and, from now on, whenever you are in English waters, you should be on the lookout for the military convoys that will be pursuing you!<n><n>The English towns are all located to the southeast of the Turk Islands. Sail in this direction with your convoy and search for suitable trading convoys to capture. Sell the loot and the smaller ships to increase your wealth.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Capture three English trading convoys: Board their ships and add them to your convoy.
tr: 干得漂亮！ 有了私掠许可证， 你如今正式为荷兰效力， 参战的对象是英格兰。 这意味着你可以攻击英格兰商船， 而不必担心自己在荷兰、 法国或西班牙的声望受损。<n><n>当然， 你在英格兰的声望会一落千丈； 今后身在英格兰水域时， 可要当心那些追杀你的军事船队！<n><n>英格兰的城镇全都位于特克群岛的东南方向。 带队往那个方向航行， 找些商船队下手。 把战利品和小船卖掉， 财富自然就来了。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>夺取三支英格兰商船队： 登上它们的船， 把它们并入你的船队。

en: %1,<n>you weren’t gone for long this time. Have you nothing else to do?
tr: %1 ，<n>这回走得没多久啊。 别的事都忙完了？

en: You now have enough gold to increase your convoy's firepower. Look in the shipyards in the Governor towns for the most powerful ship you can afford.<n><n>Then add this ship to your convoy and take more cannons and sailors on board. If you don't have enough gold, trade some more.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Increase your convoy's firepower to at least 90 cannons.
tr: 你现在有足够的钱给船队增加火力了。 去总督所在城镇的船坞看看， 挑一艘你买得起的最强战船。<n><n>然后把这条船并入船队， 多带些火炮和水手上船。 钱不够就再多做几笔生意。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>把船队的火力提升到至少 90 门炮。

en: %1 %2 receives the town of %3 from the French viceroy.
tr: %1・%2 从法国副王手中接管了 %3 。

en: I have a problem. My wife wants to travel to Europe on the next convoy, in order to visit her family. Unfortunately, @n$HostileNation$ has learned of this and is planning to intercept the convoy. Can you guarantee my wife safe passage?
tr: 我有个麻烦。 我妻子想搭下一支船队去欧洲， 探望她的家人。 可惜 @n$HostileNation$ 已经得知此事， 正打算拦截船队。 你能保证我妻子平安通行吗？

en: The commander of the town guard calls to your captain from the town wall,  asking him to call off the battle and fight a duel with him instead. To avoid further losses, your captain agrees.
tr: 城镇卫队的指挥官站在城墙上向你的船长喊话， 要他停战， 改与他单独决斗。 为避免更多伤亡， 你的船长答应了。

en: Keep a lookout for English convoys in the area and destroy @I$NumConvoys$ of them.
tr: 在这一带搜寻英格兰船队， 摧毁其中 @I$NumConvoys$ 支。

en: The status of the town is low.

We are at war with @n$HostileNation$. One of my captains recently thought of a clever way to demoralize @n$HostileNation$. He suggested assembling a military convoy comprising our enemy’s ships, in order to give them a taste of their own medicine, so to speak.<n>You appear to be just the man to secure these ships for us.
tr: 我们正与 @n$HostileNation$ 交战。 我手下一位船长刚想出一个妙计， 好让 @n$HostileNation$ 灰心丧气： 把从敌人手里夺来的船编成一支军事船队， 让他们也尝尝自己的滋味。<n>看来只有你能替我们把这些船夺过来。

en: I am delighted. I regret that I cannot allow you much time. You must accomplish this mission by @D$EndDate$.   Attack trading convoys belonging to @n$TargetNation$ and sink or capture @I$NumShips$ ships.
tr: 我很高兴。 抱歉不能给你太多时间。 你必须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前完成任务。 袭击 @n$TargetNation$ 的商船队， 击沉或俘获 @I$NumShips$ 艘船。

en: It gives me great satisfaction to hear that you have put Blackbeard in his place. As a reward, I am making you the gift of a Spanish galleon. It is awaiting you in the harbor. <n><n>And, while I’m at it, I might as well give you @g$Reward$.
tr: 听说你终于让黑胡子服了， 我十分满意。 作为奖励， 我送你一艘西班牙盖伦舰， 正在港口等你。<n><n>既然说到这儿， 还有一份 @g$Reward$ 也给你。

en: A saboteur has contaminated the food supplies in Tortuga. This has immediately triggered a famine in the town.<n><n>Your task is to end this famine as quickly as possible.<n><n>For about 2-3 weeks, you must ensure that more goods are available than are consumed per day for as many foodstuffs as possible.<n><n>Hint: The foodstuffs include wheat, fruit, corn and meat.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>The famine must end by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 一名破坏者在托尔图加的粮食供应中下了毒， 城中当即爆发饥荒。<n><n>你的任务是尽快结束这场饥荒。<n><n>大约两三周的时间里， 你要让尽可能多的食物做到每日供应多于消耗。<n><n>提示： 食物包括小麦、 水果、 玉米和肉类。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>饥荒必须在 @D$EndDate$ 前结束。

en: Holy August is now northward bound, very soon in the town is where he’ll be found.
tr: 圣奥古斯丁已北去， 不出多久， 他就会出现在城中。

en: Holy August is now northward bound, very soon in the town is where he’ll be found.
tr: 圣奥古斯丁已北去， 不出多久， 他就会出现在城中。

en: Holy August is now northward bound, very soon in the town is where he’ll be found.
tr: 圣奥古斯丁已北去， 不出多久， 他就会出现在城中。

en: Attack on a French transport convoy
tr: 袭击一支法国运输船队

en: Are you not @A$USER$? I may have a task for you.<n>A long time ago, I gave a sizeable loan to a trader from  @T$Town$ and it is nearly as long since he was supposed to have repaid it.  Well, he did not do so and it don’t think it will occur to him to do so in the future.<n>Therefore, I want to teach him a lesson! Would you attack one of his convoys for me? I will reward you richly!
tr: 你不是 @A$USER$ 吗？ 我这里或许有个活儿给你。<n>很久以前， 我借给 @T$Town$ 一个商人一大笔钱， 他也早该还了。 可他就是没还， 看样子往后也不会还。<n>所以， 我要给他一个教训！ 你愿意替我袭击他的一支船队吗？ 我会重重酬谢！

en: %1 and %2 signed a peace treaty today The relevant Letters of Marque are no longer valid.
tr: %1 与 %2 于今日签署了和约。 相应的私掠许可证已失效。

en: Business growth since the start of the game
tr: 自游戏开始以来的产业增长

en: You have done what I asked and I am very grateful to you.<n><n>You will find the teacher named @N$TeacherName$ by the coast.<n><n> @l$TeacherPos$ <n><n>Search the area there and bring @a$Amount$ of food with you, so that he will be willing to help you.
tr: 你照我说的做了， 我非常感激。<n><n>名叫 @N$TeacherName$ 的老师就住在海岸边。<n><n>@l$TeacherPos$<n><n>在那片区域搜寻一番， 带上 @a$Amount$ 的食物， 这样他才肯帮你。

en: Increase your trading profits in the town of Cartagena and obtain a building permit from the master builder.
tr: 提高你在卡塔赫纳的贸易利润， 并向营造师取得一张建造许可证。

en: Congratulations! You have achieved your objective and made more money. You have also reached a higher rank.<n><n>Your rank is always determined by your total assets. These comprise cash as well as property, such as goods and ships. You can check your wealth at any time under "Successes" in the log. This will also tell you when you'll reach the next rank.<n><n>The higher your rank, the more convoys you can command and, therefore, the greater the number of towns in which you can establish businesses later.<n><n>Now that you have a higher rank, you should assemble another convoy and continue trading to increase your wealth.<n><n>You can check your wealth at any time by positioning your cursor on the blue bar indicating your wealth, which is displayed under this window. <n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Assemble a second convoy and increase your total assets to @g$GoldGoal$.
tr: 恭喜！ 你达成了目标， 赚到了更多的钱， 同时也晋升了一级。<n><n>你的等级始终由总资产决定。 总资产既包括现金， 也包括货物、 船只这样的财产。 你随时可以在日志的 「成就」 里查看自己的财富， 那里也会告诉你什么时候能升到下一级。<n><n>等级越高， 你能指挥的船队就越多， 以后能在更多城镇开设的产业也就越多。<n><n>现在你等级更高了， 该再组建一支船队， 继续贸易来增加财富。<n><n>你随时可以把鼠标移到本窗口下方那条显示财富的蓝色长条上， 查看自己的财富。<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>再组建一支船队， 并把总资产增加到 @g$GoldGoal$ 。

en: I thank you on behalf of my nation. The convoy will now be licked into shape and the crew will be assembled. It will be ready to set sail in 15 days.<n><n>If you want to hand over another convoy, you must wait until then.
tr: 我谨代表我国向你致谢。 这支船队会整编完毕， 船员也会招募齐备， 15 天后即可启航。<n><n>若想再交给我一支船队， 得等到那时候。

en: Find the pirate convoy commanded by @P$PirateName$, which is located approximately 1 day’s journey northeast of Providence. Destroy this convoy.<n>Then return to the Governor of Cartagena.
tr: 找到海盗 @P$PirateName$ 指挥的船队， 它位于普罗维登斯东北约一天航程处。 摧毁这支船队。<n>然后回去见卡塔赫纳的总督。

en: You have been assigned the mission of tracking down and destroying one of Blackbeard's pirate convoys.<n><n>Blackbeard has a secret hideout where he keeps several convoys, each consisting of five fully-armed ships. This will be a difficult mission for the convoy you have at present.<n><n>Therefore, you should first increase your convoy's firepower. To get enough money to purchase a bigger ship, you can sell the goods from your warehouse in @T$TOWN$ at the best prices you can get. Follow the tips in the Event window, which tell you where you can sell the goods at a good price to the north and east of @T$TOWN$.<n><n>Don't spend too much time on this, as you still have to accomplish the governor's mission afterwards!<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Sell the goods in your warehouse in @T$TOWN$ and increase your cash to @g$GoldGoal$.
tr: 你已接受任务： 追踪并摧毁黑胡子的一支海盗船队。<n><n>黑胡子有一处秘密藏身处， 里面藏着好几支船队， 每支都由五艘全副武装的船只组成。 以你现有的船队， 这会是一份艰难的任务。<n><n>所以你得先提升船队的火力。 要凑够钱买更大的船， 可以把 @T$TOWN$ 仓库里的货物按你能拿到的最好价钱卖掉。 照着 「事件」 窗口的提示做， 它会告诉你 @T$TOWN$ 东北方向的哪里能卖出好价钱。<n><n>别在这上面花太多时间， 之后你还得完成总督的任务！<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFHk.res><n><n><c>卖掉你在 @T$TOWN$ 仓库里的货物， 把现金增加到 @g$GoldGoal$ 。

en: Good. The two abandoned ships I want you to dispose of are located approximately two days north of Cartagena.
tr: 很好。 我要你处理掉的两艘弃船， 位于卡塔赫纳以北约两天航程处。

en: Greetings, @N$PlayerName$. Won't you come over here?
His home town is somewhere in the north of the Caribbean, to the east of Grand Bahama.
tr: 他的家乡在加勒比海北部， 大巴哈马以东的某个地方。

en: The status of the town is too low.
<n>The viceroy of %1 has moved to %2. Governor %3 %4 has been dismissed.
tr: <n>%1 的副王已迁往 %2 。 总督 %3·%4 已被免职。

en: I have heard that you can be trusted, @A$USER$. I am in the service of the Governor of @T$TargetTown$ and must see him urgently to give him some highly sensitive information. Unfortunately, certain parties are intent on preventing me from reaching @T$TargetTown$. For this reason, I am asking you whether you can grant me safe passage.
tr: 我听说你值得信赖， @A$USER$ 。 我如今在 @T$TargetTown$ 总督手下效力， 必须尽快见到他， 向他递交一份极其敏感的情报。 不幸的是， 有些人铁了心要阻止我抵达 @T$TargetTown$ 。 因此我想问你， 能否让我平安通行。

en: Introductory Scenario<n><n>In Port Royale 2, you can build in any town in which you have a building permit. You always have permission to build in the town in which you start the game.<n:25>This scenario introduces you to construction and production. Your task is to construct several commercial and residential buildings. In the various steps in the scenario, you will have to find raw materials, settlers and workers.
tr: 序章<n><n>在 Port Royale 2 中， 凡是持有建筑许可的城镇你都能建造。 而游戏起始的那座城镇， 你本来就拥有建造许可。<n:25>这个剧本会教你建造与生产。 你的任务是建起若干商业建筑和住宅建筑。 在剧本的各个步骤中， 你得自行寻找原料移民和工人。

en: There you are, %1. Have you enough storage space with you?
tr: 你来了， %1 。 你带的仓储空间够吗？

en: The town of @T$TargetTown$ now belongs to our nation and we have you to thank for this. The master builder in the town has therefore provided you with a building permit and several buildings in the town.
tr: @T$TargetTown$ 如今已归我国所有， 这都要归功于你。 因此， 该镇的总建筑师已为你提供了一张建筑许可， 以及镇上的若干建筑。

en: No convoy available in the harbor
This horn is not sounded with your mouth, but by using a device that resembles a pump. If you press it down hard, the horn sounds louder than you would have believed possible.
tr: 这只号角不是用嘴吹的， 而是借助一个类似打气筒的装置。 你用力按下它， 发出的声响会比想象中更响亮。

en: Today, the convoy of the English buccaneer %1 was destroyed by %2.
tr: 今天， %2 摧毁了英格兰私掠者 %1 的船队。

en: there are far too few soldiers in this town
tr: 这座城镇的士兵远远不够

en: The %1 buccaneer %2 has contaminated large amounts of food in the town. A famine has broken out as a result. While the famine rages, the price of wheat, fruit, corn and meat will rise.
tr: %1 私掠者 %2 污染了镇上的大量食物， 结果爆发了饥荒。 饥荒期间， 小麦、 水果、 玉米和肉类的价格都会上涨。

en: The last feast was held quite recently. Come back and talk to me some other time.
tr: 上一场宴会才刚办过不久。 改天再来和我聊聊吧。

en: <ts:75><ts:150><ts:225><ts:300>A plague of rats has destroyed food in your warehouses. Plagues of rats frequently occur if traders hoard too much food in their warehouses.<n><n>Losses:
tr: <ts:75><ts:150><ts:225><ts:300>鼠疫毁掉了你仓库里的粮食。 商人若在仓库里囤积过多粮食， 鼠疫就会频繁发生。<n><n>损失：

en: Now it’s time to find Blackbeard’s pirate hideout and put an end to his dastardly deeds.  Once a pirate has been at large for a while, it will only be a matter of time until his hideout is discovered. But you can also do something to influence this: From time to time, a pirate convoy will return to its hideout to drop off loot and make any necessary repairs.<n>If you follow one of these pirate convoys on the sea chart and watch as it disappears into its hideout, it is very likely that you'll discover the location of the hideout. Once you have discovered the hideout, you can destroy it by attacking it from the sea in the same way you attack a town.<n><n>Hint:<n> @l$IslandPos$ Wait until a convoy approaches and observe it as it disappears into its hideout.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Locate Blackbeard's hideout.
tr: 现在是时候去找到黑胡子的海盗巢穴， 彻底终结他的恶行了。 一个海盗逍遥法外一段时间之后， 他的巢穴迟早会被发现。 不过你也可以主动做点什么来促成这件事： 海盗船队时不时会回到巢穴， 卸下赃物并做必要的修缮。<n>如果你在海图上跟踪其中一支海盗船队， 看着它消失进巢穴， 你很可能就会发现巢穴的位置。 一旦发现了巢穴， 你就可以像攻打城镇那样从海上攻击它， 把它摧毁。<n><n>提示：<n>@l$IslandPos$ 等待一支船队靠近， 观察它消失进巢穴。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>找到黑胡子的巢穴。

en: Excellent! You increased supplies of the goods that could be produced and put an end to the strike in Tortuga within @I$Days$ days.
tr: 太棒了！ 你提高了可生产货物的库存， 并在 @I$Days$ 天内平息了托尔图加的罢工。

en: Our current enemy, @n$HostileNation$, has attacked our transport convoys and looted the imported goods that were intended for the French towns in the New World.
tr: 我们当前的敌人 @n$HostileNation$ 袭击了我们的运输船队， 抢走了原本要运往新世界法国城镇的进口货物。

en: Our current enemy, @n$HostileNation$, has attacked our transport convoys and looted the imported goods that were intended for the Dutch towns in the New World.
tr: 我们当前的敌人 @n$HostileNation$ 袭击了我们的运输船队， 抢走了原本要运往新世界荷兰城镇的进口货物。

en: Do you want to buy a Letter of Marque for %1 and hunt down the ships of our enemies in the name of Holland?
tr: 你想花 %1 买一份私掠许可证， 以荷兰之名追猎我们敌人的船只吗？

en: You have three buttons with the numbers 1, 10 and 100 at the very top of the Trade window to allow you to trade larger quantities of goods more quickly. Click on the button 10 and watch how the prices change.<n>It makes no difference whether you buy 10 x 1 good or 1 x 10 goods: The total price is always the same. Now buy @a$SubGoal$ of rum.
tr: 贸易窗口最上方有三个分别标着 1、 10 和 100 的按钮， 方便你更快地大批量交易。 点击 10 号按钮， 看价格如何变化。<n>买 10 件 x 1 种货和买 1 件 x 10 种货没有区别： 总价始终相同。 现在买入 @a$SubGoal$ 朗姆酒。

en: When you carry settlers to a town where workers are needed, the settlers will thank you by paying you a fare when they disembark.<n><n>A small number of tools is always required to produce colonial goods like cocoa. If these tools are not available, production stops. Later, when you know a little more about prices and quantities, you can instruct the storekeeper to purchase tools regularly in the town. However, you should purchase the tools yourself for the moment, to be on the safe side.<n><n>This is your next task. Then there will be nothing to stop you from producing cocoa.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Produce cocoa and build up a supply of @a$AmountGoal$ in your warehouse.
tr: 当你把移民运到缺人的城镇时， 他们会在下船时付给你一笔运费， 以此向你致谢。<n><n>生产可可这类殖民地商品， 始终需要少量工具。 一旦没有工具， 生产就会停下来。 等你略微摸清价格与数量之后， 可以指派店老板定期在城里采购工具。 不过眼下为了稳妥， 工具还是你自己买。<n><n>这就是你的下一项任务。 做完之后， 就再没有什么能阻止你生产可可了。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>生产可可， 并在仓库中囤到 @a$AmountGoal$ 。

en: The goods have been loaded onto your convoy. Goodbye %1.
tr: 货物已经装上你的船队。 再见， %1 。

en: You have made yourself very unpopular in my nation. But %1 is prepared to forget the hostilities for %2. Are you prepared to pay this amount?
tr: 你在我国已经极不受欢迎。 不过只要付 %2 ， %1 就愿意既往不咎。 你准备付这笔钱吗？

en: You were unable to defeat %1, the English buccaneer, and have lost the ship to him.
tr: 你没能击败英格兰私掠者 %1 ， 船只落入对方手中。

en: You must accumulate @g$GoldGoal$ cash by trading.

A workers' strike has been instigated in Tortuga. All of the workers have downed tools and are now on strike (but they are still incurring costs for your business).<n><n>Your task is to maintain ample stocks of the goods that the workers would normally produce, to ensure that the workers' strike fails and that they resume work.<n><n>Note: The town produces wheat, bricks, cotton, sugar and tobacco. <n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>The stocks of goods produced in the town must be @a$Amount$ for each good by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 托尔图加爆发了工人罢工。 所有工人都放下工具罢工了 （不过他们仍让你的产业照付开销）。<n><n>你的任务是维持工人平常生产的那些货物的充足库存， 让罢工失败、 让他们复工。<n><n>注意： 该镇生产小麦、 砖块、 棉花、 糖和烟草。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>你必须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前， 让镇内每一种货物的库存都达到 @a$Amount$ 。

en: A Dutch military convoy has destroyed a convoy belonging to the pirate %1.
tr: 一支荷兰军事船队摧毁了海盗 %1 的一支船队。

en: I am most grateful to you for bringing me the imported goods, for we in the New World have not been supplied by my nation's transport convoys for many weeks now. As a reward, I am presenting you with two Dutch trading flute-ships. They are waiting for you in the harbor.
tr: 你替我把这些进口货物带回来， 我感激不尽 —— 新世界这边已经好几个星期没得到我国的运输船队补给了。 作为报答， 我送你两艘荷兰商货船。 它们正在港口等你。

en: The place lies somewhere close to %1.
tr: 那个地方就在 %1 附近。

en: The position is located 3 to 4 days' journey to the east of %1.
tr: 那个位置在 %1 以东三到四天航程处。

en: You have done absolutely nothing about the abduction. I am left with no choice but to agree to the terms of @n$HostileNation$.
tr: 针对那起绑架， 你什么都没做。 我别无选择， 只能接受 @n$HostileNation$ 的条件。
完成总督的下一个任务。

en: You have defeated your adversary and boarded a ship.<n><n>You now have to decide which goods you want to take and whether you want to capture the ship or just loot it.
tr: 你击败了对手并登上了对方的船。<n><n>现在你得决定要取走哪些货物， 以及是俘获这条船还是只洗劫它。

en: You have defeated your adversary and boarded several ships.<n><n>You now have to decide which goods you want to take and whether you want to capture the ships or just loot them.
tr: 你击败了对手并登上了对方的几条船。<n><n>现在你得决定要取走哪些货物， 以及是俘获这些船还是只洗劫它们。

en: Prevents trade routes from depleting minimum stock level
tr: 防止贸易路线把库存耗到最低线以下

en: Congratulations! You have successfully completed the second scenario. You have learned how to trade profitably, reached a higher rank and assembled a new convoy by hiring a new captain.<n><n>Note that the more experience captains have, the more expensive they are. They usually have very little experience at first but, over time, all captains gain experience in navigation, trade and combat, depending on how you employ them. You can check the current experience levels of your captains in the Overview for a convoy. To do so, click on a convoy and then on the "Overview and Costs" button.<n><n>In the next scenario, you'll establish your own businesses and produce goods.
tr: 恭喜！ 你已成功完成第二个剧本。 你学会了如何靠贸易赚钱， 等级也提升了， 还通过招募新船长组建了一支新船队。<n><n>注意： 船长经验越丰富， 身价越高。 他们起初通常经验很少， 但随着时间推移， 每位船长都会根据你的安排， 在航海、 贸易和战斗上积累经验。 在船队的 「总览」 里可以查看当前各船长的经验水平： 先点选一支船队， 再点 「总览与费用」 按钮。<n><n>下一个剧本中， 你将自立产业并生产货物。

en: Then so it shall be. But before I entrust her to you, you must procure the goods for the banquet. Meet my wedding banquet organizer at the market.<n><n>The banquet will be held as soon as you have delivered all of the goods.
tr: 那就这样定了。 不过在我把她托付给你之前， 你得先把宴席的货物备齐。 去市场找我那位婚宴承办人。<n><n>货物一交齐， 宴会立刻就开。

en: Since colonial goods are shipped to Europe from governor towns, the demand for cocoa in these towns is high. These conditions are good for your first business. Now locate and click on the master builder's building in the center of the town.
tr: 殖民地商品是从总督城运往欧洲的， 因此这些城镇对可可的需求很高。 条件正适合你开办第一家企业。 现在找出并点击城镇正中的总建筑师建筑。

en: There is no construction period for a residential area because the tenants live in tents at first.<n>Over time, the tenants themselves develop the residential area into a very sizeable building.<n>The appearance of a residential area depends on how old it is and on the status of the town.<n>Close the residential area dialog.
tr: 住宅区没有建造期， 因为住户一开始是住在帐篷里的。<n>随着时间推移， 住户们自己会把住宅区发展成一座相当可观的建筑。<n>住宅区的外观取决于它的年头和城镇的地位。<n>关闭住宅区对话框。

en: Sail with your convoy to the town of Cartagena and enter the town.<n>A small circle symbol is displayed below the town name on the right of the screen. This shows your trading record in Cartagena up to now.<n>Things are a little easier for you in this scenario because you have received a bonus.<n>Now open the town information.
tr: 驾着你的船队前往卡塔赫纳镇并进入城镇。<n>屏幕右侧的镇名下方会显示一个小圆形图标， 它显示你至今在卡塔赫纳的贸易记录。<n>本剧本里你较为顺利， 因为你得到了一份加成。<n>现在打开城镇信息。

en: Excellent! You have now done enough trade with Cartagena.<n>Unfortunately, your rank is still Ordinary Sailor and so you can only be granted one permit.<n>To be promoted to the next rank, you must increase your wealth by trading some more.
tr: 太棒了！ 你与卡塔赫纳的交易量已经足够。<n>可惜你的等级仍是普通水手， 所以只能获发一张许可证。<n>要升到下一等级， 你得再通过贸易增加财富。

en: Well, get going then. Head for the waters around the town of @T$TargetTown$.
tr: 那就快去吧。 动身前往 @T$TargetTown$ 一带的海域。

en: I see you have a piece of a treasure map in your log. Would you be interested in a new piece? You never know, perhaps it will already be enough for you to find the treasure.<n>I'll give it to you for @g$Price$.
tr: 我看你的航海日志里夹着一块藏宝图碎片。 想不想再来一块？ 谁知道呢， 说不定凑齐了就能找到宝藏。<n>这块卖你 @g$Price$ 。

en: %1,<n>it’s you, is it? I hardly recognize you. I understand that your adventures take up a lot of your time. However, you really could visit me more often.
tr: %1 ，<n>是你吗？ 我差点没认出你来。 听说你四处冒险， 忙得很。 不过你确实该常来看看我。

en: You do not have any map pieces at the moment.
tr: 你现在手上没有藏宝图碎片。

en: We are at war with %1 and you have ensured that %1 only has one town left. We cannot take this, and so I am unable to task you with capturing any town at present. <n><n>But do come back again when the situation changes.
tr: 我们正与 %1 交战， 而你已让 %1 只剩下一座城镇。 这我们无法接受， 所以眼下我不能派你攻占任何城镇。<n><n>不过情况一变， 还请再来。

en: Thank you!<n> Naturally, you will first need a permit in the town, but you are sure to receive one.<n>I will of course pay for all of your expenses as soon as the school is built. My wife's birthday is on @D$EndDate$, see to it that the foundation stone for the school is laid by then.
tr: 谢谢！<n>当然， 你得先在镇上取得建造许可， 不过你肯定能拿到。<n>学校一开工， 我就付清你所有的费用。 我妻子的生日是 @D$EndDate$ ， 务必在那之前打好学校的地基。

en: Keep a lookout for Spanish convoys in the area and destroy @I$NumConvoys$ of them.
tr: 在这一带搜寻西班牙船队， 摧毁其中 @I$NumConvoys$ 支。

en: A man who was once a good friend has run off with an expensive chest of mine.
tr: 一个曾经的好友， 带着我一只贵重的箱子跑了。

en: All pirates have their own hideout from which they dispatch convoys to capture booty. Meanwhile, the pirate @P$PirateName$ has amassed a fleet of @I$NumConvoys$ convoys. By chance, we have discovered the recent whereabouts of an important captain from this gang and his convoy. I want you to find and destroy this convoy.
tr: 每个海盗都有自己的藏身处， 从那里派出船队去抢东西。 而海盗 @P$PirateName$ 已经攒起一支 @I$NumConvoys$ 支船队的舰队。 我们碰巧查到了这伙人一位重要头目及其船队的下落。 我要你找到并摧毁这支船队。

en: The position is @l$Pos$. Search this area, perhaps @F$WifeName$ was trying to tell us something when she mentioned it. Please bring my daughter back safe and sound. And if you come across that Casanova, give him my best regards.
tr: 位置是 @l$Pos$ 。 搜搜这一带， @F$WifeName$ 提起它时， 也许是在暗示我们什么。 请把我女儿平安带回来。 要是碰上那个卡萨诺瓦， 替我向他问好。

en: Attack trading convoys belonging to @n$TargetNation$ in the waters around @T$TargetTown$ and sink or capture @I$NumShips$ ships.  You have until @D$EndDate$.
tr: 在 @T$TargetTown$ 附近海域， 袭击 @n$TargetNation$ 的商船队， 击沉或俘获 @I$NumShips$ 艘船。 期限是 @D$EndDate$ 。

en: The display at the bottom center of your screen changes when you click on a building. Depending on the type of building, you now receive information or you can do certain things.<n>There are buttons to the right of the building display. To leave the building, click on the button marked "X".
tr: 点击建筑后， 屏幕下方中央的显示栏会随之改变。 视建筑类型而定， 你会看到信息， 或者可以做些事情。<n>建筑显示栏右侧有几个按钮。 要离开建筑， 点标着 「X」 的那个。

en: My nation recently lost the last governor town to its enemies.<n><n>If these enemy nations are weakened by having their military convoys sunk, we will then be able to win back some towns.<n><n>To avoid any problems with the other nations, I will  issue you with a Letter of Marque against our enemies.
tr: 我国最近把最后一座总督城丢给了敌人。<n><n>只要击沉这些敌国的军事船队、 削弱他们， 我们就能夺回一些城镇。<n><n>为免和其他国家起冲突， 我给你签发一份针对敌人的私掠许可证。

en: Excellent! Now you should capture more English towns on Holland's behalf. But don't be slow because you can only capture towns while Holland and England are at war.<n><n>As usual, missions of this kind can only be assigned to you by the viceroy in Grand Bahama. Before you can be assigned any more missions to capture towns, you may have to do something to influence the military strengths and weaknesses of the two nations. You already know how to do this.<n><n>As backup, the Governor of the Turk Islands has provided you with three more carracks.<n><n>There are also many sailors and weapons available in the harbor.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Accomplish two more missions to capture towns for the Dutch viceroy before the end of the war between Holland and England. You have until @D$EndDate$. The scenario will then be over.
tr: 太好了！ 现在你该替荷兰去占领更多英格兰城镇了。 但别磨蹭， 只有荷兰与英格兰交战期间才能攻占城镇。<n><n>和往常一样， 这类任务只有大巴哈马的副王才能派给你。 在你能再接到攻占城镇的任务之前， 或许得先做点什么去影响两国的军事强弱。 你已经知道该怎么做了。<n><n>作为后援， 特克群岛总督又给了你三艘卡拉克帆船。<n><n>港口里还可以招募到大量水手、 购置武器。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>在荷兰与英格兰的战争结束之前， 再为荷兰总督完成两座城镇的攻占任务。 你有 @D$EndDate$ 的时间。 之后剧本即告结束。

en: Your reputation in %1 is too low for you to be granted a meeting with the treasurer.
tr: 你在 %1 的声望太低， 不足以获得财务主管的接见。

en: If off the cliffs to the north you should teeter, then in X you will certainly soon feel much better.
tr: 若你从北边的悬崖上跌落， 到了 X 必定很快会舒服得多。

en: The traveler @N$Name$ thanks you for rescuing him and pays you a reward of @g$Reward$.
tr: 旅人 @N$Name$ 感谢你救了他， 付给你 @g$Reward$ 作为酬谢。

en: You have found an empty bottle of rum.<n>Continue in the same direction and look for more bottles, and you may discover the drunkards’ whereabouts.
tr: 你发现了一个空的朗姆酒瓶。<n>沿这个方向继续找更多酒瓶， 也许就能查出那些醉汉的下落。

en: So the ships are in the harbor. I thank you. I will have a new military convoy assembled immediately.<n>This time, I shall not reward you with gold, for you have plenty of that already.<n>Instead, I shall give you a map on which I have marked the location of a sunken transport convoy. There you shall find a vast quantity of goods.
tr: 船都进港了。 谢谢你。 我这就集结一支新的军事船队。<n>这一次我不赏你金币 —— 你已经够多了。<n>作为替代， 我给你一张图， 上面标着一支沉没的运输船队的所在地。 你会在那里找到大量货物。

en: <g:INTEXT_SCHATZKISTE_800x600.screen><n>You have found a treasure chest in the water.<n><n>@g$Gold$
I’ll tell you what I’ve learned about the slave trade from my own experiences.
tr: 我来告诉你我从亲身经历中了解到的奴隶贸易。

en: But you yourself are accustomed to sea travel and must be familiar with the illnesses seamen suffer.
tr: 不过你惯于海上航行， 想必很清楚水手们会染上哪些疾病。

en: Let me tell you something about Spain’s riches.
tr: 让我跟你谈谈西班牙的富庶。

en: You might not believe it, but there are female pirates too!
tr: 你可能不信， 但女海盗也是有的！

en: We are not at war with any other nation, but we cannot safely increase our military strength with additional convoys. <n><n>Could you let me have one of your own convoys?
tr: 我们没有与任何国家交战， 但也无法安全地靠扩充船队来增强军力。<n><n>你能把你的一支船队借给我吗？

en: He is usually to be found in a town to the north, between Biloxi and Grand Bahama.
tr: 他通常在北边、 比洛克西与大巴哈马之间的城镇。

en: He often has business in a town to the south, between Providence and Curacao.
tr: 他常在南边办事， 在普罗维登斯与库拉索之间。

en: Help the viceroy in Grand Bahama to increase Holland’s military strength by handing over a convoy to him. Then accept a mission to capture towns on his behalf.
tr: 帮大巴哈马的副王把一支船队交给他， 以增强荷兰的军事实力。 随后接受委托， 代他攻占城镇。

en: Well done!<n>Cannons and sailors are always divided equally among the escort ships in a convoy.<n>Ensure that your escort ships are fully armed and have a full crew, and then pay a visit to the governor and accept the new mission he assigns to you.
tr: 做得好！<n>船队中的火炮和船员始终由各艘护航船平均分配。<n>确保你的护航船全部武装到位、 船员满编， 然后去拜访总督， 接受他交给你的新委托。

en: <n><n>You are delighted to add the ship to your convoy.
tr: <n><n>你欣然把这艘船加入了船队。

en: The chest contains lots of useful things including whips, candles and powder compacts.
tr: 箱子里装了不少实用东西， 包括鞭子、 蜡烛和粉盒。

en: Here's the gold. But please accept some advice: Don't spend it all at once!
tr: 金子给你。 不过听我一句劝： 别一次花光！

en: Thank you! The new troops will arrive in the next few days, as soon as there is enough room to accommodate them.
tr: 谢谢！ 新部队会在接下来几天内抵达， 只要有足够的空间容纳他们。

en: The needle of this compass moves very freely and settles into position very quickly. You have never seen such an accurate compass.<n>The compass is wrought like a piece of jewelry and the underside is adorned with various engravings.
tr: 这副罗盘的指针转动得非常灵活， 几乎立刻就稳定下来。 你从没见过这么准确的罗盘。<n>罗盘打造得如同珠宝， 底面还刻着各式各样的花纹。

en: This chart looks very different to the ordinary sea charts that are available. It is very detailed and has been drafted using several colors. However, you cannot identify which area is shown on the chart.
tr: 这张海图与市面上普通的海图很不一样。 它十分精细， 还用上了好几种颜色绘制。 不过你认不出它画的是哪一片海域。

en: Today, the convoy of the Spanish buccaneer %1 was destroyed by %2.
tr: 今天， %2 摧毁了西班牙私掠者 %1 的船队。

en: Very good! You have destroyed one of Blackbeard's pirate convoys. Now go to the Governor of @T$TOWN$ and collect your reward.<n><n>He also has another mission for you to accomplish.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Accomplish another mission for the Governor of @T$TOWN$.
tr: 很好！ 你已经摧毁了黑胡子的一支海盗船队。 现在去 @T$TOWN$ 的总督那里领取报酬。<n><n>他还另有一件委托要交给你。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>再为 @T$TOWN$ 的总督完成一件委托

en: I am faced with a small problem in @T$Town$. I promised my wife that I would see to it that a school was built there. Unfortunately, relations between myself and the master builder remain extremely hostile. He would never allow me to interfere in the affairs of his town. Could you not build the school for me?
tr: 我在 @T$Town$ 遇到了一点小麻烦。 我向妻子承诺过， 一定会在那儿建起一所学校。 可惜我与总建筑师的关系极度恶劣， 他绝不会允许我插手他城镇的事务。 你能不能替我把学校建起来？

en: A problem has arisen regarding a town belonging to @n$TargetNation$. A written agreement setting out the peaceful handover of the town to our nation was signed long ago. Regrettably, @n$TargetNation$ is no longer honoring the agreement. I want you to support the town until such time as the disputes have been resolved.
tr: @n$TargetNation$ 的一座城镇出了状况。 很久以前， 双方曾签署过一份将该城镇和平移交给我国的书面协议。 遗憾的是， @n$TargetNation$ 如今不再遵守协议。 我要你支援这座城镇， 直到争端得到解决为止。

en: @s$USER$, in Europe, @n$Nation$ is experiencing a shortage of @G$Goods$. I am therefore organizing an expedition to Europe. I will buy as much @G$Goods$ as you can supply and am prepared to offer you a unit price of @g$FullPrice$. Are you interested?
tr: @s$USER$ ， 在欧洲， @n$Nation$ 正缺少 @G$Goods$ 。 因此我正在组织一次欧洲远征。 只要你供得上， 我就尽量多买 @G$Goods$ ， 愿出单价 @g$FullPrice$ 。 你有兴趣吗？

en: Thank you. It looks as though we shall not be receiving any imported goods from Europe in the near future. As we are currently at war with @n$HostileNation$, we have the opportunity of looting goods from the transport convoys of our enemies, without capturing or sinking their ships.<n>Please procure @a$Amount$ of each of the goods spices, wine and tools and deliver them to my trader at the market by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 谢谢。 看来短期内我们都别想再从欧洲收到进口货物了。 由于我们正与 @n$HostileNation$ 交战， 倒是有机会从敌人的运输船队上抢些货物， 而且不必俘获或击沉他们的船。<n>请在 @D$EndDate$ 之前， 把香料、 葡萄酒和工具各弄到 @a$Amount$ ， 交给市集上我的商人。

en: The column in the far right of the trade menu displays the average prices for the goods you have bought. Since you want to sell the goods at a profit, you must find a town where a higher price will be paid.<n>Now open the transfer between the ship and your warehouse by clicking on the fourth button (with the crane) on the bottom right.
tr: 贸易菜单最右边那一列显示你买下这些货物的平均价格。 既然你想赚取差价， 就得找到一个能卖出更高价格的城镇。<n>现在点击右下角第四个按钮 （带吊臂的那个）， 打开船只与仓库之间的移交界面。

en: In this window, you can move goods between your convoy and your warehouse. Now load any remaining goods from your warehouse onto the convoy, because you want to sell the goods in another town.<n>Then close the Trade window by clicking on the button marked "X" on the bottom right.
tr: 在这个窗口里， 你可以在船队与仓库之间调动货物。 现在把仓库里剩下的货物都装上船队， 因为你打算到另一座城镇去卖。<n>然后点击右下角标着 「X」 的按钮关闭贸易窗口。

en: I recently had the Association of Catholic Producers on my doorstep. They are complaining that there is not enough @G$Goods$ in the town. I had to endure their complaining for three hours. I cannot go through that again. Could you not help to extricate me from this delicate situation?
tr: 最近天主教生产者协会找上门来。 他们抱怨镇上的 @G$Goods$ 不够用。 我不得不忍受他们整整三个小时的唠叨。 我可不想再来一次。 你能不能帮我从这个尴尬的处境里脱身？

<ts:0><ts:110><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>左键<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>齐射<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>右键<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>设定航向<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>1,2,3<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>选择弹药<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>4<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>准备登船t<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>%1<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>开炮

en: You were unable to defeat %1, the Spanish buccaneer, and have lost the ship to him.
tr: 你没能击败西班牙私掠者 %1 ， 船只落入对方手中。

en: You cannot demolish this part of the large business, because this would be a building development for which you have no permission.
tr: 你不能拆除这座大型产业的这一部分， 因为那属于你没有建筑许可的改建工程。

en: Greetings, @s$USER$. You look like just the sort of chap who might be interested in a treasure map. I have a part of a larger map here. I can't tell you where to find the remaining pieces, but there are sure to be other parts of the map in circulation. You'll just have to keep a sharp lookout.<n>In any case, you can have this piece for @g$Price$.
tr: 你好， @s$USER$ 。 瞧你这副样子， 就是会对藏宝图感兴趣的人。 我这儿有一块更大藏宝图的碎片。 其余的在哪儿我可说不上， 不过肯定还有别的碎片在外流传， 你只管留心。<n>总之， 这块卖你 @g$Price$ 。

en: You didn't manage to increase supplies of wheat, bricks, cotton, sugar and tobacco to 150 barrels. Buy the goods in nearby towns and deliver them immediately to your warehouse in Tortuga. Once you have them all, sell them to the town.
tr: 你没能把小麦、 砖块、 棉花、 糖和烟草的储备增加到 150 桶。 去附近城镇买货， 立刻送进你在托尔图加的仓库。 备齐之后， 全部卖给城镇。

en: The place lies in the middle of the Caribbean.
tr: 那个地方在加勒比海中央。

en: My nation lacks tools. We should obtain them from the other nations. What do you think?
tr: 我国缺少工具。 我们该从别的国家弄来。 你觉得呢？

en: My daughter already mentioned you were coming. She can be very impetuous sometimes, you know. But I cannot stand in the way of my daughter's wishes, and I do believe you are the right man for her. And so I must ask you: will you take %1 as your wife?
tr: 我女儿已经说过你要来。 她有时候性子很急， 你知道。 但我不能拦着女儿的心意， 也确实觉得你正是她要的人。 所以我必须问你： 你愿意娶 %1 为妻吗？

en: Very good! Now pay a visit to the Spanish viceroy in Port Royale and accept a mission to capture a French town.<n><n>Usually, you have to capture two towns before a viceroy grants you a plot of land. However, in this scenario, you have a small bonus and only have to capture one town for Spain.<n><n>You can decide which town to capture. It is a good idea to choose a town with a minimum number of harbor cannons.
