One French town that would be an ideal target at present is @T$SampleTown$.<n><n>In return for capturing a town, the viceroy will grant you a plot of land. Note: You cannot speak with a viceroy unless you hold at least the rank of Boatswain.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Pay a visit to the Spanish viceroy in Port Royale and accept a mission to capture a town. After you have accomplished this mission, you can accept his gift of a plot of land.
tr: 很好！ 现在去拜访皇家港的西班牙副王， 接受一项攻占法国城镇的任务。<n><n>通常你得攻占两座城镇， 副王才会赏你一块地。 不过在本剧本中你有点额外的优待， 只需为西班牙攻占一座城镇。<n><n>攻哪座城镇由你决定。 最好挑一座港口炮最少的城镇。 眼下最理想的目标之一是法国城镇 @T$SampleTown$ 。<n><n>作为攻占城镇的回报， 副王会赏你一块地。 注意： 你的等级至少要达到事务长等级才能与副王对话。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>拜访皇家港的西班牙副王并接受攻占城镇的任务。 完成这个任务后， 就能收下他送的土地。

en: The harbor defenses are destroyed and your crew dock in the harbor. The town guard is nowhere to be seen.<n><n>What do you want to do now?
tr: 港口防线已被摧毁， 你的船员在港内靠岸。 城镇卫队不见踪影。<n><n>你现在想做什么？

en: A French military convoy has destroyed a convoy belonging to the pirate %1.
tr: 一支法国军事船队摧毁了海盗 %1 的一支船队。

en: Congratulations! You have successfully completed this scenario and now have some experience of sea battles and port attacks.<n><n>Always make sure your escort ships are well armed before you attack another convoy. Of course, you should also think very carefully before deciding which convoys to attack. Transport convoys from Europe and military convoys are always very powerful and pirates can sometimes become powerful opponents too.<n><n>If you attack traders without first obtaining a Letter of Marque from the Governor of a nation, this has a major influence on your reputation with all nations.  At worst, powerful military convoys will pursue your convoy.<n><n>A word of advice: If you capture a trading convoy without sinking its ships and only loot it, the negative impact on your reputation is much smaller.
tr: 恭喜！ 你已成功完成这个剧本， 现在对海战和攻港都有所体会了。<n><n>袭击另一支船队前， 务必确认护航船已武装妥当。 当然， 决定打哪支船队之前也要仔细权衡。 来自欧洲的运输船队和军事船队一向非常强大， 海盗有时也会变成难缠的对手。<n><n>如果没先从某国总督手里拿到私掠许可证就袭击商人， 这会严重影响你在所有国家的关系。 最坏的情况是， 强大的军事船队会追猎你的船队。<n><n>一句忠告： 如果你俘获一支商船队而不击沉它的船、 只是洗劫， 对声望的负面影响会小得多。

en: Last night, the %1 buccaneer %2 sneaked into the town and destroyed all the crop farms along with their harvest. You cannot harvest again for approximately 2 weeks.
tr: 昨夜， 私掠者 %1 %2 偷偷溜进城镇， 把所有农场连同收成一并毁掉。 大约两周之内你都没法再收获。

en: Thank you for your kind donation.
You have accepted the mission to destroy the hideout of pirate %1. %2
tr: 你已接受任务： 摧毁海盗 %1 的藏身处。 %2

en: %1,<n>choose which convoy should be blessed. The blessing will give all your sailors the highest possible morale.
tr: %1 ，<n>选择你要赐福的船队。 这道祝福会让全体水手士气达到最高。

en: The war with @n$HostileNation$ has resulted in a shortage of imported goods for the colonies in @n$Nation$. Since there appear to be no shortages in @n$HostileNation$, we could attack their transport convoys and procure the scarce goods in this way. You could undertake this task.
tr: 与 @n$HostileNation$ 的战争使 @n$Nation$ 的殖民地进口货物短缺。 既然 @n$HostileNation$ 那边似乎并不缺货， 我们就去袭击他们的运输船队， 把紧缺的货物抢过来。 这件事你可以接手。

en: I refer to the town of @T$TargetTown$. All traders have been forbidden to sail to the town. Your mission is to supply the town in order to restore its wealth. In this way, we can make clear our interest in @T$TargetTown$. You have until @D$EndDate$ to accomplish your mission.
tr: 我说的是 @T$TargetTown$ 。 所有商船都被禁止驶往该城。 你的任务是向该城供货， 让它的财富恢复， 以此表明我们对 @T$TargetTown$ 的关注。 你须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前完成任务。

en: In this scenario, you'll learn how to wage a battle at sea. The scenario begins with a short practice battle. Later, you'll have to track down and destroy the convoy of a notorious pirate.<n><n>You'll also get to know the Governor of Cartagena, where you start the scenario. He will help you to become accomplished in waging sea battles and later he will assign you the mission of hunting down a certain pirate.<n><n>Your rank at the start of the scenario is Sailor. You must have reached this rank in order to be assigned a mission by the governor. <n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Pay a visit to the Governor of Cartagena and accomplish the mission he assigns to you.
tr: 在本剧本中， 你将学会怎么打一场海战。 剧本一开始是一场简短的海战演练。 之后你得追踪并摧毁一支恶名昭彰的海盗的船队。<n><n>你还会认识卡塔赫纳的总督—— 剧本就从这座城开始。 他会带你在海战中积累经验， 日后还会交给你一项追捕某位海盗的任务。<n><n>剧本开始时你的等级是水手。 必须达到这个等级， 总督才会给你派任务。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>拜访卡塔赫纳总督， 完成他交给你的任务。

en: Unfortunately, you didn't have enough time to make @g$GoldGoal$ in cash.<n><n>Sell the goods in your warehouse in Tortuga in the towns where they are in short supply and be on the lookout for goods that you can buy at a good price.<n><n>You can also get a loan from the treasurer in Tortuga.
tr: 可惜你的时间不够， 没能攒到 @g$GoldGoal$ 现金。<n><n>把托尔图加仓库里的货物卖到缺货的城镇去， 同时留意那些能低价买进的货物。<n><n>你也可以向托尔图加的财务主管借一笔款。

en: Keep a lookout for Dutch convoys in the area and destroy @I$NumConvoys$ of them.
tr: 在这一带搜寻荷兰船队， 摧毁其中 @I$NumConvoys$ 支。

en: I must return to @T$Town$ urgently, as I have some business to take care of there before I can make off for good. Unfortunately, the access routes to @T$Town$ are being watched by a bounty hunter, whom you must kill. I will reward you with @g$Reward$ if you accomplish the mission before @D$EndDate$.
tr: 我必须赶回 @T$Town$ ， 那里有件事要在我远走高飞前办完。 可惜通往 @T$Town$ 的几条路都被一个赏金猎人盯上了， 你得把他杀掉。 你若能在 @D$EndDate$ 之前完成任务， 我就赏你 @g$Reward$ 。

en: Excellent! Now your convoy is armed and ready to track down one of Blackbeard's pirate convoys.<n><n>The Event window provides daily hints to help you discover the location of the pirate convoy, provided that the location is at sea. Finding pirates can be difficult because they always return to their hideout after a successful raid on a trading ship.<n><n>Remember that a pirate convoy can have up to five warships. Reinforce your convoy if you don't think it is powerful enough. You already know how to get your hands on some gold.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Accomplish the mission assigned to you by the Governor of @T$TOWN$.
tr: 太好了！ 你的船队已经武装齐备， 可以去追查黑胡子的一支海盗船队了。<n><n>「事件」 窗口每天都会给些提示， 帮你在船队位于海上时找到它的位置。 找海盗可不容易， 因为每次抢商船得手， 他们都会退回藏身处。<n><n>记住， 一支海盗船队最多能有五艘战舰。 要是你觉得船队不够强， 就去加强它。 反正你已经知道怎么弄到钱了。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFHk.res><n><n><c>完成 @T$TOWN$ 总督交给你的任务。

en: Deliver @a$Amount$ by @D$Date$. You can hand over the goods at the market and you shall receive an immediate payment of @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen> of @G$Goods$.
tr: 在 @D$Date$ 之前交付 @a$Amount$ 。 你可以在市场交货， 每交付一<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>桶 @G$Goods$ ， 当场就能拿到 @g$GoldPerBarrel$ 。

en: Welcome to %1,<n><n>I'd like to give you some words of advice to enable you to find your way in the region around %2 more quickly, so you can assist my nation in expanding this and other towns.<n>I'm sure you are already familiar with the basic information about governor towns: They need a constant supply of colonial goods for export to Europe. At the same time, these towns usually offer an assortment of luxury goods, which can be sold for a handsome profit to other towns.<n>Just one more thing: You might be interested to know that governors assign missions from time to time. However, you cannot accept missions until you have reached the rank of Ship's Boy.<n><n>%3 %4, Governor of %5
tr: 欢迎来到 %1 。<n><n>我先给你几条忠告， 好让你更快熟悉 %2 一带的情况， 这样才能帮我的国家把这座城镇和其他城镇发展起来。<n>我想总督城的基本情况你已经很了解了： 它们需要源源不断的殖民地货物出口到欧洲。 同时， 这些城镇通常也备有各类奢侈品， 卖到别的城镇能赚上一笔。<n>还有一点： 你或许想先知道， 总督时不时会派任务给你， 不过在达到船上的小伙计等级之前， 你还不能接受任务。<n><n>%3 %4 ， %5 的总督

en: A Transfer window opens, in which you can add individual ships to the convoy.<n>To do this, click on the single ship on the left and drag it to the convoy, so that the convoy consists of two ships.<n>Then close the Transfer window again using the "X" button on the right.
tr: 「调拨」 窗口打开了， 可以把单艘船加入船队。<n>点左边那艘单独的船， 把它拖到船队上， 这样船队就有两艘船了。<n>然后用右边的 「X」 按钮关掉调拨窗口。

en: There you are, %1. Do you have all the goods with you?
tr: 你来了， %1 。 货物都带齐了吗？

en: Please pull up a stool, @A$USER$. My name is @N$OwnerName$ and I have an important matter to discuss with you. Where do I begin? Well, I had an argument with my wife; she accused me of being unfaithful to her, which of course is completely untrue. Anyway, she threw me out of the house, and that's not the worst of it: She has hired a bounty hunter, so I can no longer even enter the town. Can you help me?
tr: @A$USER$ ， 请坐。 我叫 @N$OwnerName$ ， 有件要紧事想跟你商量。 从哪说起呢？ 我跟妻子吵了一架， 她指控我对她不忠， 这当然是胡说八道。 总之， 她把我赶出了家门， 这还不算最糟： 她还雇了个赏金猎人， 害得我现在连城都进不去。 你能帮我吗？

en: Search outside the town of @T$TOWN$ for clues as to the drunkards' whereabouts. Return the ship to the trader @N$OwnerName$ by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 在 @T$TOWN$ 城外搜寻那些醉汉下落的线索。 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把船交还给商人 @N$OwnerName$ 。

en: %1 %2 has attacked the town but could not breach the defenses.
tr: %1・%2 进攻了城镇， 但未能突破防御。

en: That groomed poodle Michelle belonging to the Governor of @T$TOWN$ is being held captive in @T$TargetTown$. Loot the town and rescue the dog before @D$EndDate$.
tr: @T$TOWN$ 总督的那只梳妆贵宾犬米歇尔被关在 @T$TargetTown$ 。 洗劫该镇， 并在 @D$EndDate$ 之前救出这条狗。

en: Your troops soon gain the upper hand. Suddenly a white flag is raised above the town wall: the town guard has capitulated!<n><n>What do you want to do now?
tr: 你的军队很快占据上风。 忽然， 城墙上升起一面白旗： 城镇卫队投降了！<n><n>你现在想做什么？

en: You have discovered the location of Blackbeard's hideout. For information on the pirate gang, left-click on the hideout symbol on the sea chart.<n><n>Beware: When you destroy a hideout, the pirate gang is annihilated. However, any pirate convoys that were not in the hideout at the time are informed and they then set up a new hideout.<n><n>Your first objective is therefore to destroy all of the convoys belonging to the hideout. Ideally, you should lie in wait for any convoys that sail into or out of the hideout and attack them.<n><n>You have received some more cash to support you in your quest.<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Destroy all of Blackbeard’s pirate convoys that are currently at sea. Do not attack his hideout!
tr: 你已发现了黑胡子藏身处的位置。 要查看这伙海盗的资料， 请在海图上左键点击藏身处的标记。<n><n>当心： 摧毁藏身处会把这伙海盗一网打尽。 但当时不在藏身处里的海盗船队会得到消息， 随后另立新的藏身处。<n><n>所以你的首要目标是摧毁属于该藏身处的所有船队。 最好埋伏起来， 袭击进出藏身处的船队。<n><n>我们又拨给你一笔钱， 助你完成这趟差事。<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFHk.res><n><n><c>摧毁黑胡子所有在海上的海盗船队。 不要攻打他的藏身处！

en: My father tells me that pirates pose no threat at the moment.
tr: 我父亲说， 海盗目前还构不成威胁。

en: Some time ago, my youngest daughter ran off with some sort of passing adventurer, it was said at the time. I have now discovered that she is living in @T$TargetTown$ and that she is to marry the commander of the town. I know my daughter, she would never do such a thing of her own free will! I can hardly suggest to the viceroy that we have to attack a town to rescue my daughter? But how about you?
tr: 不久前， 我最小的女儿据说是跟一个路过的冒险私奔了。 如今我发现她住在 @T$TargetTown$ ， 而且要嫁给该镇的指挥官。 我了解自己的女儿， 她绝不会自愿做出这种事！ 我总不能去跟副王说， 为了救我女儿得攻打一座城镇吧？ 可换了你呢？

en: You've now learned how to buy and sell goods. You should always buy goods in the towns where they are produced, as they are generally less expensive there.<n><n>Note: If you want to trade with a convoy, you must have selected it and it must already be in the town before you enter the docks.<n><n>Later in this scenario, you should make profits by trading on your own. The Event window contains tips for doing this.<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>You must make @g$GoldGoal$ in cash from trade.
tr: 你已经学会如何买卖货物。 买卖时务必在货物产地购入， 那里的价格通常更低。<n><n>注意： 若要与船队交易， 你必须先选中它， 并在进入码头之前让它已经进入城镇。<n><n>本剧本稍后， 你要靠独自贸易赚取利润。 事件窗口里会给你相关提示。<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>你必须通过贸易赚到 @g$GoldGoal$ 现金。

en: I have some amusing information for you about the naming of new geographical discoveries.
tr: 我有些关于新地理发现命名规则的趣闻， 说给你听听。

en: Surely you have already come face to face with a buccaneer or have already accepted a Letter of Marque?
tr: 你肯定已经遇上过私掠者， 或者已经接受过私掠特许状了吧？

en: The beginning of the colonial age brought with it numerous health problems, hitherto largely unknown on the much shorter journeys in the Mediterranean or along the coast. A crossing to the colonies in the Caribbean and North America took from one to two months, or even longer if the ship encountered storms or periods where there was no wind. The difficulties to be overcome were therefore hardly surprising: The stench of filthy clothing and poor personal hygiene, contaminated and rotten food, a lack of clean water, rats on board as well as the psychological strain caused by monotony and cabin fever. The terrible specter of scurvy hung over every seaman: This disease, caused by a lack of vitamins, manifested itself in the loss of hair and teeth and cost many sailors their lives. It was the circumnavigator of the globe, James Cook (1728-1779), who first succeeded in treating this disease. Not only did he insist that the ship be kept clean, he also provided his crew with sauerkraut and fresh fruit. Anyone going ashore also had to contend with tropical diseases such as blackwater fever, one of the most dangerous manifestations of malaria: This infection, whose symptoms include a quickening of the pulse, fever, shivering and dark-colored urine, was almost always fatal.
tr: 殖民时代伊始， 也带来了众多健康问题—— 这些在地中海或沿岸那些短得多的航程中基本不会遇到。 前往加勒比和北美殖民地的横渡要花上一到两个月， 遇上风暴或无风的时段还更久。 因此要克服的困难并不出人意料： 肮脏衣物与个人卫生不良的恶臭、 受污染而腐败的食物、 清洁水源的缺乏、 船上的老鼠， 以及单调生活和幽闭恐惧带来的心理压力。 坏血病的可怕阴影笼罩着每一个海员： 这种由维生素缺乏引起的疾病， 表现为脱发和掉牙， 夺去了许多水手的性命。 最先成功治疗此病的是环球航行者詹姆斯·库克(1728-1779)。 他不仅坚持把船保持干净， 还给船员提供酸菜和新鲜水果。 上岸的人还得应付黑尿热这类热带疾病， 它是疟疾最危险的表现形式之一： 这种感染的症状包括脉搏加快、 发热、 发抖和尿液颜色加深， 几乎总是致命。

en: With the emergence of a Spanish empire stretching across the globe, it became necessary to establish colonial authorities with sufficient powers to deal with day-to-day administrative matters as well as any crises that might suddenly arise. For this purpose, the title of viceroy was conferred on the most important governors in the colonies.<n><n>At the height of the world empire, there were two such dignitaries, in New Spain (Mexico) and in Peru. The viceroyalties of New Granada and Rio de la Plata were added during the 18th century.<n><n> The duties of a viceroy (also known as a virrey), which he performed together (and often in conflict) with an administrative council known as the Audiencia, included the normal tasks of a government official: Raising and collecting taxes, ensuring that the population abided by the law, organizing the colony’s defenses and so on. He was also responsible for protecting the Native American population and for the appointment of lesser ecclesiastical and secular dignitaries.<n><n>Due to the enormous economic and political importance of its overseas possessions, the Crown always kept a watchful eye on the activities of its viceroys. They were forbidden from engaging in any extra commercial activities that would earn them an additional income. Quite apart from this, rivalry between the virreys only resulted in the mutual restriction of their power.
tr: 随着一个横跨全球的西班牙帝国崛起， 有必要设立拥有足够权力的殖民当局， 既处理日常行政事务， 也应对任何可能突然出现的危机。 为此， 殖民地里最重要的总督被授予了 「副王」 （viceroy） 的头衔。<n><n>在世界帝国的鼎盛时期， 这样的大员有两位， 分别驻于新西班牙 （墨西哥） 和秘鲁。 新格拉纳达与拉普拉塔两个副王区则在18 世纪增设。<n><n>副王 （西班牙语亦称 virrey） 的职责是与一个叫作 Audiencia 的行政委员会共同履行 （且常常发生冲突）， 内容包括政府官员的日常事务： 征收与催缴税款、 确保民众遵守法律、 组织殖民地防务等等。 他还负责保护美洲原住民人口， 并任命较低一级的教会与世俗官员。<n><n>由于海外属地具有极大的经济与政治重要性， 王室始终对其副王的动向严加监视。 他们被禁止从事任何能带来额外收入的商业活动。 除此之外， 副王之间的竞争只会导致彼此权力的相互掣肘。

en: He often has business to attend to in a town in the northwest.
tr: 他常常在西北方向的一座城镇办事。

en: I have reached the number of points I called. You have lost.
tr: 我达到了自己报的分数。 你输了。

en: Good! Board the second ship.<n>To do so, click on the “Board” button on the bottom right of the ship display.<n>Then move towards the enemy ship and ram it. Take note: The F1 button is also active during sea battles.
tr: 很好！ 登上第二艘船。<n>为此请点击船只显示区右下角的"登船"按钮。<n>然后驶向敌船撞它。 注意： 海战期间 F1 按钮同样可用。

en: First, buy a new ship. Go to the shipyard and buy a ship with as many cannons as possible.
tr: 先买一艘新船。 去船厂挑一艘尽可能多装火炮的船。

en: Before the Governor assigns a new mission to you, make sure that your convoy is "shipshape"!<n>If your convoy is damaged, go to the shipyard and have it repaired.
tr: 在总督交给你新委托之前， 先确保你的船队状态良好！<n>如果船队有损伤， 就去船厂把它修好。

en: The Governor of Cartagena believes you have great potential and makes you a gift of @g$Gold$.<n><n>Hint:<n>Purchase goods that are in plentiful supply in a town (the quantity must not be shown in red). Then sell these goods in a town where they are in short supply to ensure that you get a better price for them.<n><n>You will soon increase your wealth in this way.
tr: 卡塔赫纳总督认为你潜力非凡， 赏给你 @g$Gold$ 。<n><n>提示：<n>在供应充足的城镇里购入货物 （数量不能显示为红色）， 再到缺货的城镇卖出， 这样才能卖上更好的价钱。<n><n>用这个办法， 你很快就能增厚自己的财富。

en: The chest contained several maids' uniforms.
tr: 箱子里有好几件女仆制服。

en: I am most eager to bring about economic ruin in one of the enemy’s towns. Why don't we blockade the access routes to a town belonging to @n$HostileNation$ until it has reached the status "Recession"?
tr: 我一心想让敌方某座城镇陷入经济崩溃。 不如我们封锁 @n$HostileNation$ 一座城镇的进出通道， 直到它的等级跌到 「衰退」？

en: The person who charged you with your task has had goods delivered to the market in @T$Town$.
tr: 派你去做这件事的人， 已经把货物送到 @T$Town$ 的市场了。

en: Your ships inflict <o:0xFFF2FAAD>5%<o> more damage in sea battles if you command the battle yourself.
tr: 亲自指挥海战时， 你的船只造成的伤害提高 <o:0xFFF2FAAD>5%<o>。

en: This instrument consists of rotating vanes and a dial that displays the rotational speed of the vanes. By holding the vanes in the wind, you can read the direction and speed of the wind. The instrument is meticulously crafted and marked with an unknown symbol.
tr: 这件仪器由旋转叶片和一个刻度盘组成， 刻度盘显示叶片的转速。 把叶片举到风中， 你就能读出风向和风速。 仪器做工极精， 上面还刻着一个不明符号。

en: A round disk, finely engraved, into which various smaller round disks are set. You could use it to see which part of the starry sky is currently visible, depending on the date and time.<n>Markings on the disk show that this instrument was once used to determine a ship's position in a particular region.
tr: 一枚雕刻精细的圆盘， 上面嵌着若干较小的圆盘。 你可以用它查看目前星空的哪一部分可见， 取决于日期和时刻。<n>盘上的刻度表明， 这件仪器曾用于测定某片海域中的船位。

en: You have now taken all of the governor's documents on board. Take the documents to @T$TOWN$
tr: 你已经把总督的文件全部装上船了。 把文件送到 @T$TOWN$ 。

en: <n><n>You can usually hand back a building permit you have acquired. However, you cannot do so in this case because %1 is the town where you started the game.
tr: <n><n>你手上的建筑许可通常是可以交还的。 但这次不行， 因为 %1 正是你游戏开始时所在的城镇。

en: The %1 buccaneer %2 has attacked the town from land and has looted goods. Many of the town's troops were killed and the status of the town has fallen.
tr: %1 私掠者 %2 从陆路袭击了该城镇并洗劫货物。 镇上的许多士兵丧命， 该镇等级已经下降。

en: So be it. Go in search of transport convoys belonging to @n$HostileNation$ and loot @a$Amount$ of the imported goods on board. You then have until @D$EndDate$ to hand over the goods to a trader, who will be waiting for you at the market. A word of advice: Due to the very tense situation that presently exists in the region, you may only loot the ships and must neither capture nor sink them!
tr: 就这么办。 去寻找 @n$HostileNation$ 的运输船队， 抢下船上 @a$Amount$ 的进口货物。 之后你须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把货物交给一位商人， 他会在市集上等你。 忠告一句： 眼下这一带局势极其紧张， 你只能抢船上的货物， 既不能俘获也不能击沉！

en: As you know, the Spanish treasure fleet always takes a different route when collecting treasures from its colonies and shipping them to Europe. The fleet avoids being ambushed by only ever staying a short time at each town. However, this time Spain has committed a serious blunder, by allowing us to find out the route the Spanish treasure fleet is following at this very moment. Your orders couldn't be simpler. Destroy every last ship!
tr: 你知道， 西班牙珍宝船队每次从殖民地收取珍宝运往欧洲时， 都会走不同的航线。 它只在每座城镇短暂停留， 以避开埋伏。 不过这一次西班牙犯了个严重的错误， 让我们查到了西班牙珍宝船队此刻正在走的航线。 你的命令再简单不过： 把每一艘船都摧毁！

en: Good. The transport convoy will leave the port of @T$TOWN$ on @D$DepartDate$. Sail ahead of it in the direction of Europe and secure its route. Keep a sharp lookout for military convoys from @n$HostileNation$. Your mission will be accomplished if the convoy succeeds in leaving the waters of the New World without being attacked.
tr: 很好。 运输船队将在 @D$DepartDate$ 从 @T$TOWN$ 港口出发。 抢在它前面朝欧洲方向航行， 为它保驾护航。 留心 @n$HostileNation$ 的军事船队。 只要船队平安驶出新世界海域、 没遭攻击， 你的任务就算完成。

en: You were unable to defeat %1, the French buccaneer, and have lost the ship to him.
tr: 你没能击败法国私掠者 %1 ， 船只落入对方手中。

en: You were unable to defeat %1, the Dutch buccaneer, and have lost the ship to him.
tr: 你没能击败荷兰私掠者 %1 ， 船只落入对方手中。

en: You now have a building permit for Cartagena and can establish businesses there. Your next objective is to build two weaving mills in Cartagena. A weaving mill is a business that produces finished goods and requires cotton as a raw material.<n><n>You must always have a supply of raw materials in your warehouse, or the business will be unable to produce any goods. However, the costs will still be high because you have to pay maintenance costs for each business and pay your workers.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Build two weaving mills in the town of Cartagena and produce @a$AmountGoal$ of cloth.
tr: 你现在拿到了卡塔赫纳的建筑许可证， 可以在那里开办产业。 下一个目标是在卡塔赫纳建起两座织造厂。 织造厂是一种生产制成品、 以棉花为原料的产业。<n><n>仓库里必须始终有原料供应， 否则产业无法生产任何货物。 不过费用照样照付： 每座产业都要付维护费， 还要付工人的钱。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>在卡塔赫纳建起两座织造厂， 并生产 @a$AmountGoal$ 的布料。

en: <ts:20>You have become an enemy of a nation for the first time. Here are some useful hints.<n>-<t>You only become an enemy if you attack the convoys and towns of a nation<n>-<t>You can bribe the governors of the nations, in order to improve your reputation. However, your reputation also automatically improves by a small amount every day, as your bad deeds are slowly forgotten<n>-<t>You may not dock in the harbor of enemy nations<n>-<t>If you sail to an enemy town in spite of this, you must anchor your convoy in secret: You can then enter the town, but you cannot trade there.
tr: <ts:20>你第一次与某个国家结为敌。 以下几点也许用得上。<n>-<t>只有攻击某个国家的船队和城镇， 你才会与它结为敌<n>-<t>你可以向各国总督行贿以提升声望。 不过， 恶行会逐渐被淡忘， 你的声望每天也会自动小幅回升<n>-<t>你不得在敌对国家的港口停靠<n>-<t>若你仍要前往敌对城镇， 就必须把船队秘密停泊： 这样你可以进城， 但不能在城中交易。

en: Your captain has won his sword fight with %1. Your men begin searching for the pirate treasure and find %2. While you have destroyed the hideout and successfully eliminated the dangers it posed, there are signs that you may not have destroyed all the ships. The remaining ships might seek out a new hideout.
tr: 你的船长在与 %1 的刀剑比拼中获胜。 你的人开始搜寻海盗宝藏， 找到了 %2 。 你虽然摧毁了藏身处、 除了它带来的威胁， 但显然你没能把所有船都解决掉。 剩下的船可能另寻藏身处。

en: The level of difficulty determines the prices of goods and the damage inflicted in sea battles.<n><n>In addition, with a low level of difficulty, you do not need such a successful trading record in a town before you can purchase a building permit.
tr: 难度等级决定了货物价格和海战中造成的伤害。<n><n>此外， 难度较低时， 你不必在某座城镇拥有那么好的贸易成绩， 就可以购买建筑许可证。

en: Do you want to buy a Letter of Marque for %1 and hunt down the ships of our enemies in the name of France?
tr: 你想为 %1 买一张私掠许可证， 以法国的名义追猎我们的敌人吗？

en: The position is located out of reach to the south of %1.
tr: 那个位置在遥不可及的 %1 以南。

en: The position lies to the south of %1.

<ts:20>You should know the following about goods:<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>-<t>There are five different types of goods: essential goods, raw materials, finished goods, colonial goods and import goods<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>Each town can produce five goods<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>There are two types of town: colonial towns and towns with a governor or viceroy<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>Governor towns produce essential goods and finished goods. They also receive regular deliveries of import goods from Europe. These towns are therefore the best places to find finished goods and import goods.<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>-<t>Governor towns need raw materials to produce finished goods. They also take in colonial goods. These are collected from the transport convoys from Europe.<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>-<t>Colonial towns produce essential goods, raw materials and colonial goods. Each colonial good can only be produced in certain areas of the Caribbean. Coffee, for instance, is only available in the south and west of the Caribbean.<n><n>You should know the following about prices:<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>The greater the demand for a good and the smaller the supply of it in a town, the higher the price will be.<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>The better your reputation in a nation, the lower the price at which you will be able to buy goods in towns belonging to that nation.<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>You should only buy goods in the towns where they are produced.<n><n>The fastest way to get money:<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>buy colonial goods and raw materials in colonial towns<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>sell these goods in governor towns and buy finished products and import goods there.
tr: <ts:20>关于货物， 你需要知道以下这些：<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>-<t>货物分五大类： 生活必需品、 原料、 制成品、 殖民地货物和进口货物<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>每座城镇能生产五种货物<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>城镇分两类： 殖民地城镇， 以及设有总督的城镇<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>总督城生产生活必需品和制成品， 同时定期收到从欧洲运来的进口货物。 所以这两样东西在总督城最容易买到。<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>-<t>总督城需要原料来生产制成品， 同时也收购殖民地货物。 这些货物由从欧洲运来的运输船队送达。<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>-<t>殖民地城镇生产生活必需品、 原料和殖民地货物。 每种殖民地货物只能在加勒比的特定区域生产。 比如咖啡， 就只有加勒比的南部和西部出产。<n><n>关于价格， 你需要知道以下这些：<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>某种货物需求越大、 在某镇供应越少， 价格就越高。<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>你在某国的声望越好， 在该国城镇里买货的价格就越低。<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>只应该在货物的产地城镇进货。<n><n>最快的赚钱路子：<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>在殖民地城镇买进殖民地货物和原料<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>到总督城卖掉这些货， 再买进制成品和进口货物。

en: At the master builder's, you can apply for permission to construct a new building or return your building permit. This is not what you want to do now of course!<n>Look at the different buildings you can construct. You can also use the buttons on the right of the Master Builder window.<n>Click on the Cocoa Plantation button.
tr: 在总建筑师处， 你可以申请建造新建筑的许可， 也可以交还建筑许可证。 当然， 你现在不想这么做！<n>看看你可以建造哪些建筑。 窗口右侧的按钮也可以使用。<n>点击 「可可种植园」 按钮。

en: You can now see how much cocoa your business is producing each day and how many tools this requires.<n>Now build up a supply of @a$SubGoal$ of tools in your warehouse because your warehouse supplies goods to your businesses.
tr: 你现在能看到你的企业每天生产多少可可， 以及这需要多少工具。<n>现在在仓库里囤够 @a$SubGoal$ 个工具， 因为你的仓库要为企业供应货物。

en: %1,<n>you’re new here, aren't you? But I have already heard tell of you, and your good name precedes you. You should pay me a visit now and then, as there is always some work to be done.
tr: %1 ，<n>你是新来这里的吧？ 不过我已经听说过你了， 你的名声传在前头。 你该时不时来拜访我， 总有活儿要干。

en: Click on the goods to activate or cancel purchase.
tr: 点击货物可激活或取消购买。

en: You must not sink or capture the ships.<n><n>You have until @D$EndDate$.<n><n>Remember that transport convoys do not count as trading convoys and that you must have a Letter of Marque if you want to attack traders.
tr: 你不得击沉或俘获那些船只。<n><n>期限是 @D$EndDate$ 。<n><n>记住： 运输船队不算商队， 而且若要攻击商人， 你必须持有私掠许可证。

en: There are no convoys in automatic trading
tr: 自动贸易模式下没有船队

en: <n>Do you want to give me some gold to procure more harbor cannons? One cannon costs %1.
tr: <n>要不要给我点钱， 好让港口多配几门炮？ 每门炮 %1 。

en: Click on the button "Sea chart" to define a route
tr: 点 「海图」 按钮来规划航线

en: What does @n$Nation2$ think it's doing? I have just learned from an informant that transport convoys from Europe en route to my town are being attacked and looted. Will you help me to buy the imported goods we need?
tr: @n$Nation2$ 这是在打什么主意？ 我刚从线人那儿听说， 有一支从欧洲运往我城的船队遭袭被抢。 你愿意帮我买齐所需的进口货物吗？

en: Do you want to buy a Letter of Marque for %1 and hunt down the ships of our enemies in the name of England?
tr: 你想花 %1 买一份私掠许可证， 以英格兰之名追杀我们的敌人吗？

en: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>A large number of barrels of rum are floating in the surrounding waters. Your men retrieve as many of them as your convoy can carry.
tr: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>周围海面上漂着大量朗姆酒桶。 你的人马尽量多地打捞， 能装上船的都装上。

en: After breaking through the harbor defenses, your convoy docks and the sailors make their way through the town. On the way, they encounter the commander of the town guard. He refuses to give way unless he is defeated in a fair duel. Your captain accepts the challenge.
tr: 突破港口防线后， 你的船队靠岸， 水手们穿过城镇。 途中， 他们遇上城镇卫队的指挥官。 除非在公平决斗中击败他， 否则他不肯让路。 你的船长接下了挑战。

en: A trade route already exists with the name '%1'.<n><c>Do you want to overwrite it?
tr: 已有名为 「 %1 」 的贸易路线。<n><c>要覆盖它吗？

en: Keep a lookout for French convoys in the area and destroy @I$NumConvoys$ of them.
tr: 在这一带搜寻法国船队， 摧毁其中 @I$NumConvoys$ 支。

en: Congratulations! You have successfully completed this scenario and rid the Caribbean of the scourge of a notorious pirate.<n><n>Over the course of the game, pirate hideouts will emerge of their own accord. However, the number of pirate convoys depends on how successful they are. Note that pirates only want to loot trading convoys and are very wary of military convoys. For this reason, they avoid waters where too many military convoys are at large.<n><n>You can also hunt down pirates and smoke out their hideouts in free-play mode.
tr: 恭喜！ 你成功完成了这个剧本， 为加勒比除掉了一个臭名昭著的海盗。<n><n>随着游戏推进， 海盗藏身处会自行出现。 不过海盗船队的数量取决于他们袭击的成果。 注意海盗只盯商船队， 对军事船队十分忌惮， 所以他们会避开军事船队出没太多的海域。<n><n>在自由模式下， 你也可以主动追杀海盗、 烧掉他们的藏身处。

en: %1 %2 has destroyed a convoy belonging to the pirate %3.
tr: %1・%2 摧毁了海盗 %3 的一支船队。

en: Now for something rather more difficult. A little bird told me where a pirate convoy commanded by @P$PirateName$ is currently roaming the seas. The convoy consists of only one ship, so it shouldn't prove too difficult for you to destroy it.<n>Do you accept this mission?
tr: 现在来件难一点的。 有只小鸟告诉我， @P$PirateName$ 指挥的一支海盗船队正在海上游荡。 船队只有一艘船， 摧毁它对你来说应该不算太难。<n>你接受这个任务吗？

en: Later on in the game, you can accept numerous missions in order to achieve fame and fortune.<n>First, let's take a look at the town. As you can see from the display at the top center of your screen, we are in Cartagena. The town has roughly 2,000 inhabitants.<n>Click on the button showing the name of the town.
tr: 游戏中你可以接受许多任务， 去博取名声和财富。<n>先看看城镇吧。 屏幕上方中央的显示栏告诉你， 我们现在在卡塔赫纳， 这座城镇约有 2,000 名居民。<n>点那个显示城镇名称的按钮。

en: You can use the arrow keys on your keyboard to move around the town view. Now take a look at the town center within the town walls. It contains buildings, such as the docks, the church and the governor's palace.<n>Click once on any of these buildings.
tr: 你可以用键盘方向键在城镇视图里移动。 现在看看城墙内的城镇中心， 那里有各种建筑， 比如船坞、 教堂和总督宫殿。<n>在其中任意一座上点一下。

en: The shipyard is now displayed in the selection window where the convoy was just displayed.<n>Have a look around the shipyard by clicking on the buttons to the right of the shipyard display.<n>Then return to the display "Buy Ship" and have a look at the ships that are available.<n>Buy any ship you want.
tr: 船坞现在显示在刚才船队所在的这个选择窗口里。<n>点船坞显示栏右侧的按钮， 在船坞里逛一逛。<n>然后回到 「购买船只」 这一栏， 看看有哪些船可选。<n>买你想要的任何一艘。

en: You spend a very pleasant afternoon with %1 and forget about your business affairs for a time.
tr: 你和 %1 度过了一个愉快的下午， 暂时把生意抛在脑后。

en: A convoy has docked unnoticed in the harbor.
tr: 一支船队悄悄靠上了港口。
为贸易路线<n>保留最低<n>库存。

en: You look like someone who can run a tight ship.<n>I have to travel to @T$Town$ urgently, to deliver documents that incriminate one of the local traders there. Unfortunately, the trader has got wind of this and is now trying to get his hands on the documents. Couldn’t you find a way of getting me to @T$Town$?
tr: 你看起来像是个能镇得住场面的人。<n>我必须赶去 @T$Town$ ， 送一份能扳倒当地某位商人的文件。 不幸那商人已经听到风声， 正想抢先拿到文件。 你能不能想个办法把我送到 @T$Town$ ？

en: Congratulations, you have successfully completed your first scenario. You now know how to select convoys and send them to other towns. You have also learned how to enter buildings in a town to perform various actions, such as buying a ship.<n><n>The next section is about making money by trading profitably.
tr: 恭喜， 你已成功完成第一个剧本。 现在你知道了如何挑选船队并把它们派往其他城镇， 也学会了进入城镇里的建筑执行各种操作， 比如购买船只。<n><n>下一节讲的是如何靠贸易赚到钱。

en: the military presence in this town is already very good
tr: 这座城镇的军事实力已经很强了

en: Not far from the town, at the bottom of a cliff, lie the battered remains of an old wrecked ship.
tr: 离城镇不远， 崖底躺着一艘老沉船的残骸， 破败不堪。

en: Not far from the town, at the bottom of a cliff, lie the battered remains of an old wrecked ship.
tr: 离城镇不远， 崖底躺着一艘老沉船的残骸， 破败不堪。

en: You have purchased @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$. Collect the goods at the market in @T$TOWN$.
tr: 你已买下 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 。 到 @T$TOWN$ 的市场去取货。

en: Greetings, %1. Helmsman %2 has offered his services as an experienced captain.
tr: 你好， %1 。 舵手 %2 自荐担任经验丰富的船长。

en: <n><n>And send a captain who has no trading experience.
tr: <n><n>派一名没有贸易经验的船长。

en: <n><n>You have now completed all of the scenario objectives.<n><n>You have another 20 days to accumulate further assets before this scenario ends and your score is displayed.<n><n>Note: All of the events that occurred in this scenario may also occur in free-play mode. When wars are being fought, the nations sometimes dispatch buccaneers to sabotage the towns of hostile nations.
tr: <n><n>你已完成本剧本的全部目标。<n><n>在剧本结束并显示分数之前， 你还有 20 天时间继续累积资产。<n><n>注意： 本剧本中发生的这些事件， 在自由模式里也可能发生。 开战期间， 各国偶尔会派出私掠者去破坏敌国的城镇。

en: A gold mine has been discovered close to %1. The quality of life has risen as a result and the consumption of luxury goods is twice as high for one month.
tr: 在 %1 附近发现了一座金矿。 生活品质随之提高， 一个月内奢侈品的消耗量会翻上一倍。

en: The most important factors influencing the quality of life in a town are the supply and range of goods available. However, you don't have to ensure supplies of all kinds of goods to keep the inhabitants happy.<n><n>The goods in a town can be divided into five groups: essential goods, raw materials, finished goods, colonial goods and import goods. These are listed in the same sequence in the Trade window. A sufficient supply of two to three goods in each group will ensure a good quality of life in your town. <n><n>You have just received a message on the subject of the quality of life in towns. You can display this in the log.<n><n>Because your town is still small, it is particularly easy to achieve a good quality of life because the citizens of small towns are not too demanding. This means that you shouldn't have any problems achieving your objective. However, a town with fewer than 2,000 inhabitants cannot rise above the status “boom”.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Ensure that your town has a supply of five barrels of each good.
tr: 影响城镇生活品质最重要的因素是货物的供应与种类。 不过， 要让居民满意， 并不需要保证所有各类货物的供应。<n><n>城镇里的货物可分为五类： 必需品、 原料、 制成品、 殖民地商品和进口商品。 贸易窗口里也是按这个顺序排列的。 每一类备足两到三种货物， 就能让城镇的生活品质不错。<n><n>你刚收到一条关于城镇生活品质的消息， 可以在日志里查看。<n><n>你的城镇规模还小， 取得良好生活品质格外容易， 因为小城的市民要求不算高。 也就是说， 你达成目标应该不会有困难。 不过， 人口不足 2,000 的城镇无法升到 「繁荣」 之上的等级。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>确保你的城镇备有每种货物各五桶。

en: Let me tell you something about the Navigation Act.
tr: 让我跟你谈谈 《航海条例》。

en: I’d be happy to tell you about some particularly interesting discoveries in the New World.
tr: 我很乐意跟你讲讲新世界里几处特别有意思的发现。

en: I’d be happy to tell you a little about the rise of England in the New World.
tr: 我很乐意跟你略谈英格兰在新世界的崛起。

en: Let me tell you a little about the social system in the Spanish colonies.
tr: 让我跟你略谈西班牙殖民地的社会制度。

en: I would gladly task you with capturing a town belonging to %1, but, unfortunately, I do not have enough military convoys to protect any newly captured area.<n><n>Could you let me have one of your own convoys?
tr: 我很愿意派你去攻占 %1 的一座城镇， 可惜我没有足够的军事船队去防守新占下的地盘。<n><n>你能把你的一支船队借给我吗？

en: The longer I look at these artifacts, the more I get the impression that they have a special significance other than just their practical purpose. I have found strange engravings on some of them. Perhaps you will find even more artifacts and that might help.
tr: 我越看这些文物， 越觉得它们除了实用价值之外还有某种特殊意义。 我在其中几件上发现了奇怪的刻纹。 或许你能找到更多文物， 那会很有帮助。

en: Not all of the local traders' businesses are working to full capacity.
tr: 本地商人的产业并非全部满负荷运转。

en: After breaking through the harbor defenses, your convoy docks and the sailors set off to hunt for the pirate treasure. They are suddenly confronted by pirate %1, who challenges your captain to a duel.
tr: 突破港口防御之后， 你的船队靠岸， 水手们下船去搜寻海盗宝藏。 他们突然撞上海盗 %1 ， 对方向你船长提出决斗。

en: Low level of wealth in the town
Today, the convoy of the French buccaneer %1 was destroyed by %2.
tr: 今天， %2 摧毁了法国私掠者 %1 的船队。

en: Today, the convoy of the Dutch buccaneer %1 was destroyed by %2.
tr: 今天， %2 摧毁了荷兰私掠者 %1 的船队。

en: You ensured safe passage of the  transport convoy to Europe and I am indebted to you. I am therefore presenting you with a @S$ShipType$. She is waiting for you in the harbor.
tr: 你保证了运输船队安全前往欧洲， 我非常感激。 因此我要把一艘 @S$ShipType$ 送给你。 她正在港口等你。

en: Do you want to demolish this business?
You cannot finish the transfer because your convoy is overloaded. Remove some cargo from your convoy or add more ships.
tr: 船队超载， 无法完成移交。 从船队上卸下部分货物， 或者多添几艘船。

en: This displays the quantity of goods in storage and the quantity of goods consumed in the town. Naturally, the level of consumption depends on the town's population.<n>The consumption tells you how many goods can be delivered regularly. Now close the Stock window.
tr: 这里会显示库存货物的数量和城镇消耗货物的数量。 当然， 消耗水平取决于城镇的人口。<n>消耗量能告诉你哪些货物可以长期稳定供应。 现在关闭库存窗口。

en: You have found the remains of the sunken convoy and take the goods on board.
tr: 你找到了沉没船队的残骸， 把货物装上了船。

en: The goods have been sent to your warehouse. Good day to you!
tr: 货物已经送进你的仓库。 祝你安好！

en: All of your production is running smoothly.
tr: 你的所有生产都很顺利。

en: <n>You don't have enough cash. Come back when you can afford it.
tr: <n>你的现金不够。 等你买得起了再来。

en: You have forced your opponent to flee.

The activities of Blackbeard's gang are already on the decline, but we cannot afford to rest on our laurels when it comes to those filthy scoundrels. I am therefore assigning you the task of destroying yet another of Blackbeard's convoys.
tr: 黑胡子那伙人的势头已经在衰退， 但对付这帮脏兮兮的恶棍， 我们可不能躺在功劳簿上休息。 所以我派你去再毁掉黑胡子的一支船队。

en: What rotten luck! I must have regular stocks of colonial goods for the transport convoys from Europe, but we don't have the tools to be able to produce these goods in the first place. Would you not like to help me to supply a town with tools?
tr: 真倒霉！ 从欧洲来的运输船队要带走成批的殖民地货物， 可我们根本没有生产这些货物的工具。 你愿意帮我给某座城镇供应一批工具吗？

en: The place lies somewhere close to %1, up to 1 day’s journey away.
tr: 那个地方在离 %1 不到一天航程的某处。

en: Visit the Spanish viceroy in Port Royale and accept a mission to capture towns on his behalf. After you have accomplished this mission, you can accept his gift of a plot of land.
tr: 拜访皇家港的西班牙副王， 接受一项替他攻占城镇的任务。 完成这个任务后， 就能收下他送的土地。

en: Due to your troops' superiority, the soldiers of the town guard capitulate and your men begin to look for the treasure chamber without meeting any resistance. They loot %1.
tr: 你的军队占尽优势， 城镇卫队的士兵弃械投降， 你的人没遇到任何抵抗就找到了宝库， 洗劫了 %1 。

en: Now ensure that your businesses in Santa Marta and Cartagena are operating at full steam.<n>Don't forget that your weaving mills in Cartagena require a constant supply of cotton.<n>Continue to trade and sell the goods you produce.<n>This scenario will end as soon as you have increased your cash to @g$GoldGoal$.
tr: 现在让你在圣玛尔塔和卡塔赫纳的产业全速运转。<n>别忘了卡塔赫纳的织造厂需要棉花持续供应。<n>继续交易， 卖出你生产的货物。<n>一旦你的现金增加到 @g$GoldGoal$ ， 本剧本即告结束。

en: The %1 buccaneer %2 has poached %3 workers and their families. Many businesses in the town are now no longer operating at full capacity.
tr: %1 私掠者 %2 撬走了 %3 名工人及其家属。 城里许多产业如今都无法满负荷运转了。

en: The captain and crew have disembarked at the harbor. This is going to be some adventure! Which waters shall I prowl?
tr: 船长和船员已在港口下船。 这下可有得忙了！ 咱们去哪片海域转转？

en: %1,<n>do you want me to have to spend all of my time at the inn just for some company? You really should visit me more often!
tr: %1 ，<n>难道要让我整天泡在酒馆里， 就为了有人作陪？ 你真该常来坐坐！

en: You have come across castaways on a raft and have picked up @I$Settlers$ settlers. They are hoping to be put ashore in a town where there is a shortage of workers.
tr: 你遇到一伙漂在木筏上的遇难者， 救起了 @I$Settlers$ 名移民。 他们盼着被送上一座缺人手的城镇。

en: Your adversary's convoy has no escort ships to defend him. You therefore seize the trading ship without a fight.<n><n>You now have to decide which goods you want to take and whether you want to capture the ship or just loot it.
tr: 对手的船队没有护航船保护。 你兵不血刃就抢下了这艘商船。<n><n>现在你得决定取走哪些货物， 以及是俘获这条船， 还是只抢了货。

en: Unfortunately you have no suitable convoys left anchored in the harbor. The convoy must consist of exactly 5 ships and have 150 cannons on board. Come back when you have assembled such a convoy.
tr: 可惜港口里没有符合要求的船队了。 船队必须正好由 5 条船组成， 且船上共带 150 门炮。 等你凑齐这样的船队再来。

en: Accomplish another mission for the Governor of @T$TOWN$.
tr: 再为 @T$TOWN$ 的总督完成一次任务。

en: Hot on the Trail of Blackbeard!

Thank you! @T$Town$ will not find out about our accord. Begin construction by @D$EndDate$. I will then pay for your expenses.<n>Don’t forget that you will need a permit in @T$Town$ if you want to build a school.
tr: 谢谢！ @T$Town$ 不会知道我们的交易。 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前开工， 钱我随后付清。<n>想建学校， 可别忘了在 @T$Town$ 取得建造许可。

en: Well done, you reached your first objective within @I$Days$ days. Your next objective is to increase the number of citizens living in the town. To do this, establish five businesses, one of each kind that is permitted in the town.<n><n>Remember that only a small number of traders visit Tortuga, and you must ensure that the town has sufficient supplies, so that its status is high enough to allow you to take in new settlers. Also, don’t forget to ensure that there is enough living space for the citizens.<n><n>You have 60 days to reach this objective. The sooner you achieve it, the better.<n><n>Hint: Soldiers are part of a town’s population but they don’t count as citizens! You can only increase the number of citizens in a town by creating jobs.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Set up five different businesses in Tortuga and increase the number of inhabitants to 1,500 by @D$EndDate$. Don’t forget to provide sufficient living space! One residential area is required for each business.
tr: 干得好， 你在 @I$Days$ 天内达到了第一个目标。 下一个目标是增加居住在这座城镇里的市民人数。 为此要开设五家产业， 本镇允许的种类各一家。<n><n>别忘了， 来托尔图加的商人很少， 你得保证城镇货源充足、 地位足够高， 才能接纳新的移民。 也别忘了给市民留出足够的居住空间。<n><n>你有 60 天达成这个目标， 越快越好。<n><n>提示： 士兵计入城镇的人口， 但不算市民！ 增加市民人数的唯一办法就是创造工作。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>在托尔图加开设五家不同的产业， 并在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把居民人数增加到 1,500。 别忘了提供足够的居住空间！ 每家产业都要配一处住宅区。

en: A pirate hideout can only be attacked from the sea.
tr: 海盗藏身处只能从海上来攻。

en: Very good! Now you have to make your convoy more powerful so that you'll be able to take on several military convoys. You should have at least three ships in your convoy that are frigates or larger ships.<n><n>You can capture the ships or try to purchase them in the shipyards of the governor towns.<n><n>Make these ships escort ships and ensure that they are fully-armed and fully-manned with sailors.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Arm your convoy so that it has at least three fully-armed and fully-manned escort ships that are frigates or larger ships.
tr: 很好！ 现在你得让船队更加强大， 才能同时应付几支军事船队。 船队里至少要有三艘巡防舰或更大的船。<n><n>你可以俘获这些船， 也可以去总督城的船坞买。<n><n>把这些船设为护航船， 确保武器齐备、 水手配足。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>武装你的船队， 使其拥有至少三艘武器齐备、 水手配足的护航船， 且为巡防舰或更大的船。

en: To display the next scenario objective, you must accomplish your mission to capture the towns.
tr: 要显示下一个剧本目标， 你必须完成占领城镇的任务。

en: As we are once again at war with @n$HostileNation$, I want to assemble a new convoy to protect my town. I have no desire to wait until I am assigned a new military convoy from Europe.<n>Unfortunately, my resources are currently very limited and so I came up with the idea of using our enemy's ships. Do you wish to help me capture several @S$ShipType$ type ships?
tr: 我们又与 @n$HostileNation$ 开战了， 我想编一支新船队来保卫我的城镇。 我可不想干等着欧洲给我派一支新的军事船队。<n>可惜我眼下资源有限， 才想出用敌人的船来充数的办法。 你愿意帮我夺几艘 @S$ShipType$ 级的船吗？

en: Thank you! I suspect that a bounty hunter is watching the entrance to the harbor of @T$Town$.<n>This is what we will do: I will spread a rumor that I am going aboard one of your ships and then you set sail for @T$Town$ and see what happens.<n>Let me know by @D$EndDate$ at the latest that the coast is clear and I will then pay you a reward of @g$Reward$.
tr: 谢谢！ 我怀疑有个赏金猎人正盯着 @T$Town$ 港口的入口。<n>咱们这么办： 我放出风声， 说我要上你的一条船， 然后你开往 @T$Town$ ， 看看会发生什么。<n>最迟在 @D$EndDate$ 之前告诉我路上没事， 我就付你 @g$Reward$ 。

en: Congratulations! You have been entrusted with a mission to capture towns!<n><n>Since towns may be very heavily defended, you should choose an English town with a minimum number of cannon towers in its harbor. The town of @T$SampleTown$ is a perfect target.<n><n>To attack a town, activate the Attack Towns option for your convoy. To do so, select your convoy and click on the Attack Mode button.<n><n>You can attack a town from the sea or from land. However, you should only risk an attack from land if your sailors outnumber the town's soldiers. You should also be able to arm half of your sailors with cutlasses and half with muskets in this case.<n><n>Note: If there is a military convoy in a town's harbor, you have to defeat this convoy before attacking the town itself.<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Accomplish your mission to capture towns.
tr: 恭喜！ 你被委派了一项占领城镇的任务！<n><n>城镇可能防守森严， 所以你该挑一座港口炮塔最少的英格兰城镇。 @T$SampleTown$ 是个完美的目标。<n><n>要攻打城镇， 先为船队启用 「攻击城镇」 选项： 选中船队， 点击 「攻击模式」 按钮。<n><n>你可以从海上或陆上攻打城镇。 但只有在水手人数压过守军时， 才可从陆上强攻； 而且还得让一半水手装备弯刀、 一半装备火枪。<n><n>注意： 如果城镇港口里有军事船队， 你必须先打败这支船队， 才能攻打城镇本身。<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>完成占领城镇的任务。

en: I am once again very satisfied to hear about your renewed defeat of the contemptible Blackbeard. I must also pass on my wife’s very special regards. She wishes to make you a gift of her Spanish galleon, and I don’t mean our cook!<n><n>In addition, I am rewarding you with @g$Reward$.
tr: 再次听说你让那个可鄙的黑胡子败下阵来， 我非常高兴。 我妻子也向我问好， 她想把她那艘西班牙盖伦舰送给你—— 可不是我们家厨子那艘！<n><n>另外再奖你 @g$Reward$ 。

en: The ship carrying the spy set sail from @T$HostileTown$ in the direction of Europe and will leave the Caribbean in the east. Search the route for several documents and bring them to the Governor of @T$TOWN$ by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 载着间谍的船已从 @T$HostileTown$ 出发驶向欧洲， 将从加勒比东面离开。 沿路搜寻几份文件， 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前送到 @T$TOWN$ 的总督手上。

en: <n>You don't have enough cash. Come back when you can afford it.
tr: <n>你带的现金不够。 等你买得起再来。

en: We are in the governor town of Cartagena in the Southern Caribbean.<n>You can enter the various buildings in a town and perform various actions, more about this later on.<n>First, look at the top of the screen. You can see a range of buttons and displays.<n>Now click on the button with the clock, to the very left of the screen.
tr: 我们现在位于南加勒比的总督城卡塔赫纳。<n>你可以走进城镇里的各种建筑， 做各种事情， 稍后再细说。<n>先看看屏幕上方， 那儿有一排按钮和显示栏。<n>现在点最左边那个带时钟的按钮。

en: At the top of the screen, beside the date, is the Log button and next to it, your cash.<n>The log keeps you up-to-date with any information concerning your successes and possessions. In addition, all the messages and missions that you receive are saved here.<n>Open the log.
tr: 屏幕顶部、 日期旁边是日志按钮， 它右边就是你的现金。<n>日志会告诉你所有与成就和财产有关的信息， 你收到的所有消息和任务也都存在这里。<n>打开日志。

en: Four towns are situated around a volcano. The town in the southeast is the one that you are looking for.
tr: 四座城镇环绕着一座火山。 东南面的那座， 就是你要找的。

en: You have reached the highest rank!
The status of the town of @T$TOWN$ has dropped below "flourishing economy".
tr: @T$TOWN$ 的城镇等级已跌到 「经济繁荣」 以下。

en: You have a very good reputation with my nation. However, I know of one way you could improve your reputation even more.<n><n>The hideout of the pirate %1 was discovered a short time ago.  %2<n><n>Perhaps you are the one who will finally rid us all of the scourge of this gang.
tr: 你在我国的声望很高。 不过我知道还有一个办法， 能让你声望更高。<n><n>海盗 %1 的藏身处不久前被发现了。 %2<n><n>也许你正是那个能替我们除掉这伙祸害的人。

en: Pay a visit to the Governor of @T$TOWN$ and collect your reward.
tr: 拜访 @T$TOWN$ 的总督， 领取你的报酬。

en: I can give you some account of the origin of myths and legends.
tr: 我可以跟你讲讲神话与传说的起源。

en: Have you ever visited the Bermuda islands in the far northeast? I can tell you something about them.
tr: 你去过东北方向的百慕大群岛吗？ 我可以跟你聊聊那里。

en: Those who yearned to add to their existing wealth in the early years of the Age of Discovery found that the sugar plantations that had been developed since the early 16th century, mainly in the Caribbean, offered excellent investment opportunities.<n><n>These investments returned an average profit of ten percent and in the best cases (such as on Barbados around 1650) as much as 50 percent! Naturally, these plantations required huge numbers of workers and so hundreds of thousands of slaves were shipped there from Africa. This was because the white man had by now almost completely exterminated the Native American population in many places. <n><n>The Europeans themselves could not endure the climate and, quite apart from that, they were far too dignified to engage in this sort of donkey work. Even the plantation owners preferred to live in London or Madrid and let a couple of their henchmen organize the work in the colonies. By the 18th century, the black proportion of the population of some islands had reached 90 percent!
tr: 在地理大发现的头几年， 那些想让既有财富增值的人发现， 自 16 世纪初以来主要在加勒比地区开发起来的糖种植园， 提供了极好的投资机会。<n><n>这些投资的平均回报率为 10%， 而在最好的情况下(例如 1650 年前后的巴巴多斯)甚至可达 50%！ 自然， 这些种植园需要大量劳力， 于是数十万奴隶从非洲被运往那里。 这是因为白人此时已在许多地方几乎把美洲原住民屠戮殆尽。<n><n>欧洲人自己受不了这种气候； 除此之外， 他们也远远体面， 不肯干这种驴一样的粗活。 就连种植园主也更愿意住在伦敦或马德里， 派几个手下去殖民地组织劳作。 到 18 世纪， 某些岛屿的人口中黑人比例已达 90%！

en: You have handed back your building permit.
tr: 你已经交还了建筑许可。

en: You have reached the number of points you called. You're home and dry!
tr: 你达到了自己报的分数。 你赢得很漂亮！

en: As you can see, you have no cannons or ammunition on board your convoy. You are also in need of a crew.<n>Take on board the largest crew and as many cannons as you can, as well as 10x10 of each of the three types of ammunition for your cannons.<n>There may not be enough space in your convoy because cannons are heavy. If this is the case, you can sell some of the goods you have loaded.
tr: 可以看到， 你的船队上没有火炮， 也没有弹药。 你还缺一批船员。<n>尽可能多地装载船员和火炮， 并按每种 10×10 的数量带上三类火炮弹药。<n>火炮很重， 船队的空间可能不够。 若真不够， 你可以卖掉一部分已装上的货物。

en: Successful battles will boost your reputation more quickly with <o:0xFFFF2FAAD>5%<o>.
tr: 战斗获胜时， 你的声望额外提高 <o:0xFFF2FAAD>5%<o>。

en: How do you want to attack?
It was used to store long patent-leather boots and leather caps.
tr: 这里曾用来存放长筒漆皮靴和皮帽。

en: The main thing the chest contained was an embroidered cover for keeping baguettes warm.
tr: 箱子里最主要的东西， 是一只绣花的长面包保温罩。

en: Stocks and 10-day consumption by citizens and businesses
tr: 库存与市民、 企业的 10 天消耗量

en: Then I look forward to doing business with you.<n>Deliver as much @G$Goods$ as you can to the market in @T$TOWN$. I will also be receiving several deliveries there and I will pay you @g$Price$ immediately.<n>The expeditionary convoy will arrive here on @D$EndDate$. Guarantee this convoy safe passage to Europe and I will pay you the rest of the gold.
tr: 那我就期待与你做生意了。<n>尽可能多地把 @G$Goods$ 送到 @T$TOWN$ 的市场。 我那边也会收到几批货， 会立刻付你 @g$Price$ 。<n>远征船队将在 @D$EndDate$ 抵达这里。 护送它安全前往欧洲， 余下的金子我就付给你。

en: Once the harbor defenses have been breached, your sailors disembark and storm into the town. They look for the treasure chamber without meeting any resistance and loot %1.<n><n>Now choose what goods you want to loot from the town's warehouse.
tr: 港口防御被突破之后， 你的水手登陆并冲进城镇。 他们一路无人阻拦地找到藏宝室， 掠走了 %1 。<n><n>现在选择你要从该镇仓库里抢走哪些货物。

en: %1,<n><n>Your reputation in my nation is not high enough, I'm afraid I cannot sell you any permits.<n><n>Come back when your reputation has improved.
tr: %1 ，<n><n>恐怕你在我国的声望不够高， 我没法卖给你许可证。<n><n>等你声望提升了再来。

en: Pay a visit to the Governor of Cartagena and accomplish his mission.
tr: 去拜访卡塔赫纳总督， 完成他的委托。

en: Greetings. I am organizing an expedition to Europe. I want to exploit the shortage of @G$Goods$ there. I am offering to buy as many goods as you can supply and I will give you a very good price per barrel, let's say @g$FullPrice$. Do we have a deal?
tr: 你好。 我正在组织一次欧洲远征， 想利用那边 @G$Goods$ 短缺的机会。 你供多少我就收多少， 每桶给你很划算的价格， 就 @g$FullPrice$ 吧。 成交？

en: You do not have a convoy in the harbor.
The Graphics card does not meet the minimum system requirements for the game (DirectX 8 functions). This may cause problems under certain circumstances!
tr: 你的显卡未达到游戏的最低系统要求 （DirectX 8 功能）。 这在某些情况下可能引发问题！

en: The convoy of pirate %1 has been destroyed.
tr: 海盗 %1 的船队已被摧毁。

en: Do you want to overwrite it?
Send a captain who does not have much battle experience.
tr: 派一名战斗经验不丰富的船长去。

en: I would like to thank you once again for being so generous as to hand over one of your convoys. It is currently being armed and will be ready to set sail in %1 days.<n><n>If you want to hand over another convoy, you must wait until then.
tr: 我要再次感谢你如此慷慨地交出一支船队。 它正在装配， 预计 %1 天后就能出海。<n><n>如果你还想再交出一支船队， 就得等到那以后。

en: Since we went to war with @n$FoeNation$, their traders have been forbidden to deliver @G$Goods$ to the towns belonging to my nation. I am now faced with a significant shortage of goods. You have many ships and know the seas well. Could you not secure me a large shipment of @G$Goods$?
tr: 自从我们与 @n$FoeNation$ 开战， 他们的商人就被禁止向我国城镇运送 @G$Goods$ 。 我现在面临严重的物资短缺。 你有那么多船， 又熟悉海路， 能帮我弄一大批 @G$Goods$ 来吗？

en: Greetings, @A$USER$. I am interested in buying a large quantity of @G$Goods$, say @a$Amount$. I am offering a unit price of @g$Price$. Are you interested?
tr: 你好， @A$USER$ 。 我想大量采购 @G$Goods$ ， 比如 @a$Amount$ 。 我出单价 @g$Price$ 。 你有兴趣吗？

en: This option disbands the convoy, dismisses the captain and the boarding crew and closes the Transfer window. Do you want to choose this option?
tr: 该选项会解散船队， 解雇船长与登船船员， 并关闭移交窗口。 你要选择该选项吗？

en: Today, the %1 buccaneer %2 sneaked into the town and contaminated several wells. A plague has broken out in the town as a result. The quality of life has worsened and the demand for garments and wood is twice as high for one month.
tr: 今天， %1 的私掠者 %2 潜入城镇， 在几口井里下了毒。 结果镇里爆发了瘟疫， 生活水准一落千丈， 未来一个月衣料和木材的需求翻倍。

en: As we are at war with @n$HostileNation$, I have been ordered by the viceroy to see to it that our enemies suffer a goods shortage.<n><n>I therefore have a looting mission for you. Do you accept?
tr: 我国正与 @n$HostileNation$ 交战， 副王已命我设法让敌人陷入物资短缺。<n><n>所以我给你一个劫掠任务。 你接受吗？

en: The place is located somewhere in the west.
tr: 那个地方在西方的某处。

en: Sorry, I'm afraid I can no longer give you this mission. You have taken too long to think it over.
tr: 抱歉， 这个任务我不能再交给你了。 你考虑得太久。

en: Your reputation in %1 is too low for you to be granted a meeting with the general.
tr: 你在 %1 的声望太低， 不足以获得将军的接见。

en: The place is located somewhere to the south of %1, not far from the coast.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 以南不远处， 离海岸很近。

en: The place is located not far from %1, up to 1 day’s journey away.
tr: 那个地方离 %1 不远， 最多一天航程。

en: The place is located off the coast to the northwest of %1.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 西北方的海岸外。

en: One of your convoys has docked unnoticed in the harbor of  %1.
tr: 你有一支船队悄然停泊在 %1 的港口。

en: Prevents trade routes from breaching the maximum stock level
tr: 防止贸易路线把库存撑到最高线以上

en: You did not manage to deliver the goods in time for the feast.<n><n>%1 is angry with you and never wants to see you again.
tr: 你没能及时交付宴席所需的货物。<n><n>%1 生气透了， 再也不想见到你。

en: This residential area belongs to a trader from the town. You can check how many residential areas are owned by local traders and how many tenants they have. You want to build your own residential area. To do so, open the Construction menu.
tr: 这处住宅区属于城里的一位商人。 你可以查看当地商人拥有多少住宅区、 共有多少住户。 你想自己建一处住宅区。 为此， 打开建造菜单。

en: I'm afraid I have no missions for you. Come back and see me again in a few days.
tr: 恐怕我这里没有委托给你。 几天后再来找我。

en: Thank you for your kind and generous donation.
tr: 谢谢你慷慨而丰厚的捐赠。

en: The treasure fleet is anchored in the harbor.
tr: 宝藏船队已停泊在港口。

en: I see you are a wealthy man, %1. I'm finding it hard to make ends meet and would like to ask you on behalf of my nation whether you could find it in your heart to give me a loan of %2? You will get back %4 in %3 months.
tr: 看得出您是个有钱人， %1 。 我这儿日子过得紧， 想替我的国家向您借 %2 ， 不知您愿不愿意？ %3 个月后， 本息 %4 一并奉还。

en: Good day, @s$USER$. I hear you have an incomplete treasure map in your possession, do you not? I would like to offer you another piece belonging to your map. I'm only asking @g$Price$ for it.
tr: 你好， @s$USER$ 。 听说你手上有一张没凑齐的藏宝图， 是不是？ 我这儿正好有一块能接上你的。 只要 @g$Price$ 。

en: Good! The town in question is @T$TargetTown$. In order to bring them to heel, the Viceroy of @n$TargetNation$ has forbidden all traders to sail to the town. If we can succeed in restoring wealth by supplying the town, then we can certainly count on its citizens' allegiance. You have until @D$EndDate$ to complete this mission.
tr: 好！ 目标城镇是 @T$TargetTown$ 。 @n$TargetNation$ 的副王为逼它就范， 已禁止所有商船驶往该城。 只要我们供货让它的财富恢复， 城中百姓必定会归顺我们。 你须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前完成这项任务。

en: The matter is this: The viceroy has forbidden all traders to sail to the town of @T$TargetTown$. By doing this, he wants to exert pressure on the town council. If you succeed in supplying @T$TargetTown$ enough goods to allow wealth to be restored by @D$EndDate$, I have no doubt that I can arrange a peaceful change of national allegiance.
tr: 事情是这样： 副王禁止所有商船驶往 @T$TargetTown$ 。 他这么做， 是想给镇议会施压。 如果你能在 @D$EndDate$ 之前给 @T$TargetTown$ 送去足够的货物， 让它的财富恢复， 我就有把握促成一个和平的归顺。

en: %1,<n>I was just about to go out to visit someone, as things are rather boring for me around here. But now you’re here. Come, I have something to tell you.
tr: %1 ，<n>我正打算出门拜访一个人， 这地方实在闷得慌。 偏你来了。 来， 我有话跟你说。

en: Your adversary's convoy has no escort ships to defend him. You therefore seize the trading ships without a fight.<n><n>You now have to decide which goods you want to take and whether you want to capture the ships or just loot them.
tr: 对手的船队没有护航船保护。 你兵不血刃就抢下了这些商船。<n><n>现在你得决定取走哪些货物， 以及是俘获这些船， 还是只抢了货。

en: I cannot task you with capturing a town belonging to another nation on my behalf because we are not at war at the present time. However, things may change very quickly. Come back to me if they do.
tr: 眼下我们并未开战， 所以我不能派你替我去攻占别国的城镇。 不过情况也许很快就会变化。 真有变化再来找我。

en: Attack on a Spanish military convoy

<g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>The ship that sank here must have been under the command of a very experienced captain. The chest does not contain any gold, but you find a carefully kept diary belonging to the captain @L$RandLName$. As a result, the experience of the captain of convoy @C$Convoy$ increases by two points.
tr: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>在这里沉没的那条船， 船长必定是个经验丰富的老手。 箱子里没有金币， 只有一本保存得极好的日记， 属于船长 @L$RandLName$ 。 于是船队 @C$Convoy$ 的船长经验提升了两点。

en: <n><n>Do you want to hand back your permit?<n>Remember that I can pay you nothing for it!
tr: <n><n>你要交还许可吗？<n>我可不会为此付你一个子儿！

en: <f:fonts/Tiepolo_black13x13aaFHk.res>Protect the town harbor<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold13x13aaFHk.res>(convoy is in the harbor and an escort ship is present)
tr: <f:fonts/Tiepolo_black13x13aaFHk.res>保卫城镇港口<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold13x13aaFHk.res> （船队在港内， 且有护航船）

en: You cannot add more than 10 ships to the convoy.
tr: 船队最多只能加入 10 艘船。

en: Many thanks for delivering on time, the Governor will be delighted. The wedding banquet is to start this very day!
tr: 多谢你按时送到， 总督一定会很高兴的。 婚宴今天就要开始了！

en: The person who charged you with your task has had goods delivered to the market in @T$Town$.
tr: 托你办这件事的人， 已经把货物送到 @T$Town$ 的市场了。

en: A route is plotted and your convoy sets off.<n>By right-clicking on Port Royale, you have selected it as your convoy's destination.<n>If the convoy is taking too long to reach the town, you can simply fast-forward the game by pressing the space bar (default setting).
tr: 航线规划好了， 船队启航。<n>在皇家港上右键点击， 就把它设成了船队的目的地。<n>如果船队赶到城镇太慢， 可以按空格键快进游戏 （默认设置）。

en: You now want to tell your convoy to interact with the harbor.<n>Right-click on the harbor.
tr: 现在你要让船队与港口互动。<n>在港口上点击右键。

en: You can also assemble another convoy with a new ship by hiring a new captain at the inn.<n>However, you cannot do this at the moment because your rank is not high enough.<n>Now select the convoy’s list of ships. This is the second button.
tr: 你还可以在酒馆雇一位新船长， 用新船再组一支船队。<n>不过现在还不行， 你的等级不够。<n>现在选中船队的船只列表， 就是第二个按钮。

en: You now have a convoy with two ships in the harbor of Port Royale.<n>You can click on the ships in the convoy’s ships list to find out details about the ships.<n>Now send the convoy back to your home town of Cartagena. To do this, go to the sea chart by clicking on the button with the arrow in the extreme top-right of your screen.
tr: 现在皇家港的港口里有一支两艘船的船队了。<n>你可以在船只列表里点船， 查看每艘船的详情。<n>现在把船队派回你的母城卡塔赫纳。 为此， 点屏幕最右上角那个带箭头的按钮打开海图。

en: You spend the evening with %1 and wish your time together would never end.
tr: 你和 %1 共度良宵， 恨不得这一刻永不结束。

en: You didn't put an end to the famine in Tortuga in time. To end a famine, you must ensure that at least three kinds of food must be available in the town for daily consumption. If all four kinds of foods are available, the famine will end sooner.
tr: 你没能在规定时间内结束托尔图加的饥荒。 要结束饥荒， 镇上必须备齐至少三种日常消耗的食物。 四种都备齐的话， 饥荒结束得更快。

en: Have you heard that a plague has broken out in @T$Town$? This could certainly have been prevented if there had been a hospital in the town. Unfortunately, my master builder is a coward and is afraid to enter the town in order to commission the hospital. I therefore propose sending you. Do you accept? I am prepared to pay you @g$Reward$ for your efforts!
tr: 你听说 @T$Town$ 爆发瘟疫了吗？ 要是城里早有一座医院， 这场病本来完全可以避免。 可惜我那位营造师是个懦夫， 不敢进城去接下医院的兴建。 所以我打算派你去。 你接受吗？ 为此我愿意付给你 @g$Reward$ ！

en: Congratulations! You are now familiar with the basics of building a town.<n><n>As soon as your production facility is constructed, it automatically begins to employ workers. Each settler waiting at the harbor to be hired can be converted into one worker and four citizens. This means that one settler actually represents an entire settler family.<n><n>To ensure that your businesses have enough workers, you must ensure that sufficient numbers of settlers are available for work. Transport convoys carry settlers from Europe to the governor towns and are then brought by traders to the other towns<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Ensure that you have enough workers for your business in Santa Marta.
tr: 恭喜！ 你现在已了解城镇建设的基本门道。<n><n>生产设施一旦建成， 就会自动开始雇佣工人。 每个在港口待聘的移民都可以变成一名工人和四名市民。 也就是说， 一名移民实际上代表的是一整户移民家庭。<n><n>要让你的产业有足够的工人， 就得保证有足够多的移民可供雇佣。 运输船队把移民从欧洲运到总督城， 再由商人运往其他城镇<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>确保你在圣玛尔塔的产业有足够的工人。

en: Your convoy with two ships must reach the harbor of the town of Cartagena.
tr: 你那支两艘船的船队必须抵达卡塔赫纳港。

en: The convoy is being repaired. While it is being repaired, the boarding crew has shore leave and therefore does not incur any maintenance costs.
tr: 船队正在维修。 维修期间， 战地船员获准上岸休假， 因此不产生任何维护费用。

en: If you want as many traders as possible to visit your town, you should simply not supply your town with certain goods. You should ideally choose goods that are produced in nearby towns, because traders will take the length of the journey involved into consideration.<n><n>Traders who visit your town automatically buy goods that are in abundance and therefore have low prices in your town. You can sell the goods you have produced to your town directly. As long as the goods are not more expensive than in other towns, they will be purchased regularly by traders.<n><n>The advantage of this is that there are always enough goods available for your citizens and you also don't have to worry about transporting the goods to other towns.
tr: 如果想让尽可能多的商船队来你镇上光顾， 最简单的办法就是某些货物干脆不往镇上供应。 最好挑那些邻近城镇生产的货物， 因为商人会把路程远近算进去。<n><n>来你镇的商人会自动买走那些货源充足、 因而在你镇上价格低廉的货物。 你也可以把镇里生产的货物直接卖给本镇。 只要价格不比别的镇高， 商人就会定期买走。<n><n>这样好处是市民的日常所需总有着落， 你也不必操心把这些货物运到别的城镇去。

en: We have been able to discover the pirate hideout of %1.  %2 How would you like to attack the hideout and destroy this mob for once and for all and thereby restore some semblance of peace to our waters?
tr: 我们发现了海盗 %1 的藏身处。 %2 你打算怎么攻打这个藏身处， 把这伙人彻底消灭， 让我们的海域恢复一点安宁？

en: I am very angry with you because you failed to accomplish the mission I gave you.
tr: 你让我很生气， 你没能完成我交给你的任务。

en: I will tell you a little about Columbus’s great voyage across the Atlantic and the discovery of America.
tr: 我来跟你讲讲哥伦布横渡大西洋、 发现美洲的伟大航程。

en: I would gladly task you with capturing a town belonging to %1, but, unfortunately, %1 still has too many military convoys and is therefore not weak enough.<n><n> In any case, I do not have enough military convoys to protect any newly captured areas.<n><n>Could you let me have one of your own convoys?
tr: 我很愿意派你去攻占 %1 的一座城镇， 可惜 %1 还有太多军事船队， 并不算薄弱。<n><n>况且我也没有足够的军事船队去防守新占下的地盘。<n><n>你能把你的一支船队借给我吗？

en: You cannot reach the number of points you called. You have lost the game.
tr: 你没能达到自己报的分数。 你输了这局。

en: <n><n>Now it is time to strike back:
the military presence in this town is excellent
tr: 这座城镇的军事存在极佳

en: The chest seems to have contained paintings of Spanish bullfighters.
tr: 箱子里似乎装过西班牙斗牛士的画作。

en: You have delivered the goods and have been paid @g$Gold$ for them.
tr: 你已交付货物， 并拿到了 @g$Gold$ 报酬。

en: There are problems in the following towns:<n>(Double-clicking on the town opens the town view)
tr: 以下城镇出了问题：<n>（双击城镇即可打开城镇视图）

en: Call %1 points and lead the game
%1 cannot be assigned because it is already being used by a different function.
tr: %1 无法分配， 因为它已被另一项功能占用。

en: Are you sure you want to delete the saved game?
tr: 你确定要删除这个存档吗？

en: Send a captain who does not have much trading experience.
tr: 派一名贸易经验不丰富的船长去。

en: We have been spied upon by @n$HostileNation$ for a long time. I have discovered that all the information gleaned has been carefully recorded and is now to be sent from @T$HostileTown$ to Europe. I want you to help me ensure that these documents never leave the Caribbean.
tr: @n$HostileNation$ 已经监视我们很久了。 我发现所有搜集到的情报都被详细记录下来， 即将从 @T$HostileTown$ 运往欧洲。 我要你帮我确保这些文件永远离不开加勒比。

en: If you want as many traders as possible to visit your town, you should simply not supply your town with certain goods. You should ideally choose goods that are produced in nearby towns, because traders will take the length of the journey involved into consideration.<n><n>Traders who visit your town automatically buy goods that are in abundance and therefore have low prices in your town. You can also sell the goods you have produced to your town directly. As long as the goods are not more expensive than in other towns, they will be purchased regularly by traders.<n><n>The advantage of this is that there are always enough goods available for your citizens and you also don't have to worry about transporting the goods to other towns.
tr: 如果想让尽可能多的商船队来你镇上光顾， 最简单的办法就是某些货物干脆不往镇上供应。 最好挑那些邻近城镇生产的货物， 因为商人会把路程远近算进去。<n><n>来你镇的商人会自动买走那些货源充足、 因而在你镇上价格低廉的货物。 你也可以把镇里生产的货物直接卖给本镇。 只要价格不比别的镇高， 商人就会定期买走。<n><n>这样好处是市民的日常所需总有着落， 你也不必操心把这些货物运到别的城镇去。

en: The place lies somewhere more than 3 days' journey to the east of %1.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 以东三天以上的航程处。

en: The place is located somewhere up to 1 day’s journey to the northeast of %1.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 东北最多一天航程处的某处。

en: See to it that the status of the town of @T$TargetTown$, which belongs to @n$HostileNation$, drops to "Recession“ by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 设法让属于 @n$HostileNation$ 的 @T$TargetTown$ 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前把等级降到 「衰退」。

en: Your convoy succeeds in breaching the harbor defenses. Your sailors disembark and search for the pirate treasure without meeting any resistance. They loot %1.
tr: 你的船队成功突破了港口防线。 水手们登陆搜寻海盗宝藏， 没遇到任何抵抗， 洗劫了 %1 。

en: The prices of goods that are scarce in a town are shown in red in the trade window. If you sell these goods, you will improve both your trading record in the town and your reputation with the nation to which the town belongs.<n>Click once on the docks to display information on the stock of goods in the town.
tr: 贸易窗口里， 该城镇稀缺货物的价格以红色显示。 卖出这些货物， 能同时提升你在该镇的贸易记录和在该国所属国家的声望。<n>点击一次码头， 查看该镇货物的库存信息。

en: Now establish two weaving mills and build two residential areas.<n>If there are not enough building materials in the town, you must buy these in another town and deliver them to your warehouse at the docks. <n>Don't forget to negotiate a price before you part with your precious gold!
tr: 现在开设两座织造厂， 并建起两处住宅区。<n>如果城里建筑材料不足， 你得去别的城镇买来， 运到码头处的仓库。<n>别忘了在花掉宝贵的金币之前先谈好价钱！

en: The %1 buccaneer %2 sneaked into the town and destroyed large stocks of goods belonging to the town market.
tr: %1 私掠者 %2 偷偷潜入城镇， 毁掉了属于城镇市集的大量存货。

en: I'm delighted! From this day onwards, the hostilities between us are a thing of the past.
tr: 太好了！ 从今天起， 我们之间的敌意一笔勾销。

en: You performed an action that prevents you from completing the scenario successfully.<n><n>Follow the instructions in the Event window.
tr: 你的举动会让这个剧本无法顺利完成。<n><n>请照 「事件」 窗口里的指示去做。

en: Congratulations! You have successfully completed each of the tasks in this scenario in @I$Days$ days and you have amassed total assets of @g$Wealth$.<n><n>Your score is now: @I$Val1$
tr: 恭喜！ 你在 @I$Days$ 天内完成了这个剧本的全部任务， 累计资产已达 @g$Wealth$ 。<n><n>你的得分现在是： @I$Val1$

en: Attack on an English military convoy

The number of citizens (the population minus the number of soldiers) in Tortuga must be restored to @I$Pop$ by @D$EndDate$ at the latest to ensure that all businesses have a full complement of workers.
tr: 最迟须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前， 把托尔图加的市民人数 （总人口减去士兵数） 恢复到 @I$Pop$ ， 这样各产业才能配齐工人。

en: Residential area of a local trader
You have no suitable convoy in the town
tr: 城镇里没有合适的船队

en: Pirates have attacked the town but could not breach the harbor defenses.
tr: 海盗袭击了城镇， 但没能攻破港口防线。

en: This displays the tasks and missions that you have received. At the moment, only the scenario objective is displayed.<n>Using the two buttons at the very top of the Mission window, you can switch between current and completed missions.<n>Now close the log. You can also do this simply by right-clicking.
tr: 这里显示的是你收到的任务。 目前只显示剧本目标。<n>任务窗口最上方有两个按钮， 可以在进行中的任务和已完成的任务之间切换。<n>现在关掉日志。 右键点击也一样。

en: The sea chart now appears. In the center of the screen, you will see the town of Cartagena.<n>You can use the arrow buttons to shift the area of the map that is displayed and view the entire game world.<n>Now look for the town of Port Royale on an island to the north and right-click on the town with your convoy selected.
tr: 海图打开了。 屏幕中央是卡塔赫纳城镇。<n>你可以用方向按钮平移地图显示的区域， 浏览整个游戏世界。<n>现在到北边的岛上找到皇家港， 在选中船队的情况下右键点击该城镇。

en: Congratulations! You have bought your first ship.<n>The ship will be delivered to the town's harbor.<n>Now leave the shipyard and click on the waters in the harbor. The selection window now displays the individual ships in the harbor.<n>Click on your new ship.
tr: 恭喜！ 你买下了第一艘船。<n>船会被送到城镇的港口。<n>现在离开船坞， 点击港口里的水面。 选择窗口会逐一显示港口中的船只。<n>点你的新船。

en: Introductory Scenario<n><n>This introductory scenario is all about goods transport and trade. You will be provided with tips about how to make large trading profits and you will learn how to assemble new convoys.
tr: 入门剧本<n><n>这个入门剧本讲的是货物运输与贸易。 你会得到一些赚取丰厚贸易利润的提示， 并学会如何组建新的船队。

en: We have nothing further to discuss. Come back and see me again in a few days.
tr: 我们没什么好再谈的了。 过几天再来见我。

en: I'm afraid I can't say when would be the best time to see him there. The best thing to do is just to look for him as often as possible in the inns there.
tr: 我怕是说不准什么时候去最合适。 最好的办法就是隔三差五去那儿的旅店找找看。

en: Can you help me arrange a little act of reprisal? I am quite certain that a trader from @T$Town$ was responsible for sabotaging some of my ships. Now I can only sit and wait for my ships to return from the shipyard. I want you to destroy a convoy belonging to my ruthless adversary. I will reward you handsomely!
tr: 你能帮我安排一次小小的报复吗？ 我十分确定是 @T$Town$ 的一个商人破坏了我几条船。 现在我只能坐着等船从船坞回来。 我要你摧毁这个狠心对头的一支船队。 我会重重谢你！

en: <n><n>Remember to send a captain who has no experience of navigation.
tr: <n><n>别忘了派一名没有航海经验的船长。

en: Your captain has won his duel with the commander. Your sailors make their way to the treasure chamber and make off with %1.<n><n>Now choose what goods you want to loot from the town's warehouse.
tr: 你的船长在决斗中击败了指挥官。 你的水手闯进宝库， 卷走 %1 。<n><n>现在挑挑你想从城镇仓库里抢走哪些货物。

en: Secure the route of the transport convoy that will be leaving the harbor of @T$TOWN$ on @D$DepartDate$ bound for Europe. The convoy must not be attacked. Afterwards, report to the governor of @T$TOWN$.
tr: 护送将于 @D$DepartDate$ 从 @T$TOWN$ 港口启航、 前往欧洲的运输船队。 该船队不得受到攻击。 事后向 @T$TOWN$ 的总督复命。

en: The number of citizens (the population minus the number of soldiers) in Tortuga must be restored to @I$Pop$ within 20 days of the plague ending to ensure that all businesses have a full complement of workers.
tr: 瘟疫结束后 20 天内， 必须让托尔图加的市民人数(总人口减去士兵数)恢复到 @I$Pop$ ， 以确保所有企业都能配齐工人。

en: I will tell my men immediately so that they can put to sea. Come back in a few weeks, maybe I will have the first share for you then!
tr: 我立刻通知手下出海。 几周后再来吧， 到时说不定我就分给你第一笔！

en: As the American colonies flourished, so too did the trade across the Atlantic Ocean. Great Britain, the most powerful maritime nation since the time of Queen Elizabeth, had a keen interest in controlling the movement of goods, thereby allowing the domestic economy to share in the trading profits.<n><n>Under the Lord Protector, Oliver Cromwell, the “First Navigation Act” of 1651 decreed that only English ships could be used to transport goods from the colonies to Europe. This measure was aimed principally at the emerging power of Holland and benefited the domestic trading fleet.<n><n>In 1663, the provisions of this act were made even more stringent: Colonial ships wishing to transport goods to Europe had to call at English ports and pay a toll there. However, this attempt to control the trade between the colonies soon ran aground. As the British army could scarcely be expected to watch the entire coastline, the result was a flourishing contraband trade. <n><n>It was precisely this ongoing conflict with the mother country regarding the conditions governing the exporting and importing of goods that, particularly in the North American colonies, resulted in the formation of a separate identity among the settlers there and was later to become a significant motivation behind the independence movement.
tr: 随着美洲殖民地繁荣起来， 跨大西洋的贸易也随之兴盛。 自伊丽莎白女王时代以来最强大的航海国家大不列颠， 对管控货物流动怀有浓厚兴趣， 好让本国经济分得贸易利润。<n><n>在护国公奥利弗·克伦威尔治下， 1651 年的 《第一航海条例》 规定只有英国船只才能把货物从殖民地运往欧洲。 这项措施主要针对正在崛起的荷兰， 并让本国商船队受益。<n><n>1663 年， 该条例的规定变得更严： 殖民地船只若想把货运往欧洲， 必须先到英国港口停靠并缴纳税费。 然而， 这种管控殖民地贸易的企图很快搁浅了。 英国陆军根本不可能监视整条海岸线， 结果走私贸易反而蓬勃发展起来。<n><n>正是这种围绕货物进出口条件的持续冲突， 使殖民者在尤其是在北美殖民地逐渐形成了独立的认同， 日后成为独立运动的一项重要推动力。

en: The pirate %1 has become more powerful.
tr: 海盗 %1 变得更强大了。

en: Apparently the chest contained a collection of lipsticks from Paris, among other things.
tr: 箱子里似乎装了一批巴黎来的口红之类的东西。

en: This small metal table is made of solid brass and is constructed in such a way that its surface always remains horizontal regardless of the pitch of the ship. The outer metal ring is engraved with markings that seem to indicate directions. However, you cannot identify the region in which the table was once used.
tr: 这张小金属桌由实心黄铜制成， 构造使得无论船身如何倾斜， 台面始终保持水平。 外圈的金属环上刻着似乎标示方向的刻度， 但你无法判断这张桌子曾在哪片海域使用。

en: Greetings, %1. Do you have the goods for the big wedding banquet with you?
tr: 你好， %1 。 大婚宴的货品你都带齐了吗？

en: In Tortuga, the town's stocks have been destroyed by saboteurs. Many of the town's supplies have been lost, and the quality of life for the town's citizens has fallen dramatically as a result.<n><n>Your objective is to replenish the town's supplies as quickly as possible so the town's status can rise again.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>The town must reach the status "boom" by @D$EndDate$.
tr: 托尔图加的库存被破坏者摧毁， 城镇的大量物资已经损失， 市民的生活质量因此大幅下降。<n><n>你的目标是尽快补足物资， 好让城镇的等级重新上升。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>该城镇必须在 @D$EndDate$ 之前达到 「繁荣」 状态

en: You have not loaded the maximum cargo your ship can hold.<n>Are you sure you want to finish the transfer?
tr: 你还没有装满船只的最大载货量。<n>你确定要完成移交吗？

en: Click on the ships and move them using the mouse
tr: 点击船只， 用鼠标拖动它们

en: The convoy cannot set sail because some of your ships are in very poor condition. Have your convoy repaired in the shipyard before sending it to sea again. Alternatively, you can take the damaged ships out of the convoy and have them repaired separately.
tr: 船队无法出海， 因为你有些船只的状况非常糟糕。 出海前请先在船坞把船队修好。 或者， 你也可以把受损的船只从船队中撤出， 单独送修。

en: Your business in Santa Marta should employ a full complement of workers.
tr: 你在圣玛尔塔的产业应该配齐全部工人。

en: Thank you for smoking out this pirate hideout. I hope the hideout contained enough gold to reimburse you for your troubles. All of the nations are grateful to you!
tr: 谢谢你端掉了这个海盗巢穴。 希望巢穴里的金币足够补偿你这一番辛苦。 列国都感激你！

en: Pirates have broken through the town's harbor defenses and have looted various finished goods.
tr: 海盗已经突破城镇的港口防御， 洗劫了各种制成品。

en: What misfortune has befallen me. Since the outbreak of war with @n$FoeNation$, I have not been able to accumulate enough colonial goods for the transport convoys. Can you assist by providing me with a large shipment of @G$Goods$?
tr: 什么倒霉事落到我头上了。 自从与 @n$FoeNation$ 开战以来， 我一直无法为运输船队备足殖民地货物。 你能帮我弄一大批 @G$Goods$ 来吗？

en: The %1 buccaneer %2 sneaked into the town and destroyed large stocks of goods belonging to several of the town's traders. The town council refuses to accept liability.
tr: %1 私掠者 %2 偷偷潜入城镇， 毁掉了城镇里好几位商人大量存货。 镇议会拒绝承担赔偿责任。

en: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>Unfortunately you cannot take the flotsam on board as your convoy has no available storage space.
tr: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>你的船队没有空余的储存空间， 可惜无法装载漂浮物。

en: <n>I would advise you to pay me a visit so that we can discuss your relationship with my nation.
tr: <n>我建议你来见我一面， 我们谈谈你与我国的关系。

en: Captain %1 has replaced the previous captain.
tr: 船长 %1 接替了前任船长。

en: The place is located to the west of %1.
The place is located not far from %1, at most 1 day’s journey away.
tr: 那个地方离 %1 不远， 最多一天航程。

en: The place is located not far from %1, at most 1 day’s journey away.
tr: 那个地方离 %1 不远， 最多一天航程。

en: The place is located not far from %1, at most 1 day’s journey away.
tr: 那个地方离 %1 不远， 最多一天航程。

en: Very good!<n>To ensure that you always have enough raw materials for your weaving mills, you should now establish a cotton business in Santa Marta.<n>One production facility can supply enough raw materials for two manufacturing facilities.
tr: 很好！<n>为了让织造厂始终有足够的原料， 你現在应该在圣玛尔塔开设一家棉花产业。<n>一座生产设施足以供应两座制造设施的原料。

en: The convoy is being repaired and cannot be dispatched.<n>Do you want to stop repairs to the convoy?<n>You will not get back any gold!
tr: 船队正在维修， 无法派出。<n>要中止船队的维修吗？<n>已花的钱不会退还！
