en: You cannot disband the convoy because there are still goods or cargo on board.
tr: 船上还装着货物或压舱货， 船队无法解散。

en: You have reached the rank of “Sailor”. As of today, you must do something to maintain your high reputation with a nation.<n><n> You can improve your reputation with the nations by trading, donating to the church, organizing celebrations, destroying pirates as well as by accomplishing missions and Letters of Marque.<n><n>If your reputation with a nation does not improve, it diminishes by a very small amount every day. Note that the number of buildings you have built in the towns of a nation determines how low your reputation can become in this way.<n><n>Your reputation influences both the trading prices and the assignment of missions in the towns. If your reputation is low, you should also beware of military convoys!
tr: 你已经晋升为 「水手」。 从今天起， 你必须做点什么， 才能保住与该国的高声望。<n><n>提升声望的办法有： 贸易、 向教堂捐献、 筹办庆典、 清剿海盗， 以及完成总督任务和私掠许可证。<n><n>若声望没有改善， 它每天都会略微下降。 注意： 你在某国城镇里建造的房屋数量， 决定了这套机制下声望能跌到多低。<n><n>声望既影响贸易价格， 也决定城镇给不给你派任务。 声望低了， 也得提防军事船队！

en: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>Your convoy has come across a large wooden chest. It is immediately brought on board and opened. Some real treasure at last, thinks the captain as he catches a glimpse of the @g$Gold$.
tr: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>船队发现了一口大木箱， 立刻搬上船打开。 船长一眼瞥见 @g$Gold$ ， 心想： 这回可真是实打实的宝藏。

en: Look here. I have just received a message from my ambassador informing me that %1 has made us a unexpected peace offering. This means that we will probably make peace as early as today. <n><n>Therefore, I can no longer assign you a mission to capture a town.
tr: 听着。 我刚收到大使的来信， 说 %1 向我们递上了和谈的橄榄枝。 这意味着我们今天就有可能议和。<n><n>所以， 我不能再派你攻打城镇的任务了。

en: After your troops have destroyed the town gate, they are confronted by the commander of the town guard. He challenges your captain to a duel.
tr: 你的部队攻破城门后， 迎面撞上城镇卫队的指挥官。 他向你的船长提出决斗。

en: Your troops break down the town gate and storm into the town. When the town's soldiers see this, they capitulate and your men begin looking for the treasure chamber without meeting any resistance. They loot %1.
tr: 你的部队撞开城门， 冲进城里。 城里的士兵见状立刻投降， 你的人开始寻找宝库， 没遇到任何抵抗。 他们搜出了 %1 。

en: This is the Chronicle. It contains a record of all the events and occurrences in the Caribbean, rather like a daily newspaper.<n>There are some buttons to right of the Chronicle window. You can use these to display information about the Caribbean. However, this is not important for the moment.<n>Now close the Chronicle by clicking on the button marked "X".
tr: 这就是编年史， 记着加勒比发生的所有事件和轶事， 就像一份日报。<n>编年史窗口右侧有几个按钮， 可以用来查看加勒比的相关信息， 不过现在还用不上。<n>现在点标着 「X」 的按钮关闭编年史。

en: Do not allow<n>trade routes <n> to breach maximum stock level.
tr: 不允许贸易路线<n>超过<n>最高库存。

en: Arm your convoy and accomplish the new mission assigned to you by the Governor of Cartagena.
tr: 武装你的船队， 完成卡塔赫纳总督交给你的新任务。

en: and the harbor is very well defended.
Do you want to demolish this residential building?
tr: 你要拆掉这栋住宅建筑吗？

en: Let me tell you a little about Jamaica, the island on which the town of Port Royale is situated.
tr: 让我跟你略谈牙买加， 皇家港就坐落在这座岛上。

en: Our enemies have looted English traders numerous times in recent days.
tr: 近日我们的敌人多次劫掠英格兰商人。

en: I've been waiting for you, %1. Where should the goods be brought to?
tr: 我一直等你， %1 。 货物该送到哪儿？

en: %1 %2 has destroyed the hideout of the pirate %3. None of the ships managed to escape.
tr: %1・%2 摧毁了海盗 %3 的据点， 没有一艘船逃走。

en: The chest contained little ballet tutus and perfumed handkerchiefs.
tr: 箱子里有小小的芭蕾舞裙和香手帕。

en: The chest contained a particularly attractive pinafore with ribbons.
tr: 箱子里有一条格外漂亮的系带围裙。

en: As the towns belonging to my nation do not produce enough, I was forced to rely on deliveries from English towns.
tr: 由于我国的城镇产量不足， 我不得不依赖英格兰城镇的供货。

en: As the towns belonging to my nation do not produce enough, I was forced to rely on deliveries from Spanish towns.
tr: 由于我国的城镇产量不足， 我不得不依赖西班牙城镇的供货。

en: You have not delivered the goods on time.
In the shipyard, purchase a small ship. Don't spend too much money because you'll need to keep some for trading and for maintaining your ship.
tr: 在船坞里买一艘小船。 别花太多钱， 因为还要留些钱用来贸易和维持你的船。

en: It was a pleasure doing business with you. Good day to you!
tr: 和你做生意很愉快。 祝你安好！

en: I shall begin preparations straight away. Please deliver the goods no later than %1.
tr: 我马上就着手准备。 请不迟于 %1 交付货物。

en: You have not delivered the goods in time.
Growth of settlers in the town

@s$USER$, you are sure to be interested in a new treasure map, are you not? I'm afraid I can only give you a small piece of it, but I'm sure you'll find a few other pieces, with all the traveling you do.<n>I'm only asking @g$Price$ for it.
tr: @s$USER$ ， 你肯定对新的藏宝图有兴趣吧？ 可惜我这儿只有一小块， 不过你四处跑商， 总能捡到别的碎片。<n>只收你 @g$Price$ 。

en: You have taken too long to search for the treasure.
tr: 你找宝藏花的时间太长了。

en: <n>I would advise you to pay one of my Governors a visit in order to improve your relationship with my nation.
tr: <n>我建议你拜访我方的一位总督， 以改善你与我国的关系。

en: Your next battle is going be a little more difficult because this time the enemy will resist. Your mission is to track down and kill a pirate for the governor.<n><n>But first you have to arm your convoy for the battle. Buy a ship, add it to your convoy and take new weapons and sailors on board.<n><n>You can press the F1 button at any time during the sea battle to display the keyboard and mouse configuration. <n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Arm your convoy and accomplish the new mission assigned to you by the Governor of Cartagena.
tr: 你下一场战斗会难一些， 因为这次敌人会还手。 你的任务是替总督追踪并杀死一名海盗。<n><n>但首先你得为战斗武装船队。 买一艘船， 把它编入船队， 再装上新的武器和水手。<n><n>海战期间随时可以按 F1 查看键鼠设置。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>武装你的船队， 完成卡塔赫纳总督交给你的新任务。

en: The place is located somewhere out of reach to the south of %1.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 以南遥远处的某处。

en: The place is located somewhere to the south of %1.
tr: 那个地方在 %1 以南的某处。

en: You have not delivered the goods in time.
Now accomplish the mission assigned to you by the Governor of @T$TOWN$.
tr: 现在去完成 @T$TOWN$ 的总督交给你的任务。

en: You can now see how many building materials are required and what the construction costs will be.<n>You can also see how many building materials you currently have in your warehouse and how many you'll have to buy from the town.<n>You have enough materials at present.<n>Position your cursor on an available construction site and left-click on it.
tr: 你现在能看到需要多少建筑材料、 建造要花多少钱。<n>你也能看到仓库里现有多少建筑材料， 以及还需向城镇购买多少。<n>你目前的材料充足。<n>把鼠标移到可用的建造位置上， 左键点击。

en: Have you heard the latest story about the Bermuda Islands? A trader wanted to use the route leading past the islands to sail to Europe, but he never arrived there. His brother set out to search for him, but he found nothing but a few pieces of wreckage to the south of the islands.
tr: 你听说过百慕大群岛最新的传闻吗？ 一个商人想借道群岛附近航线前往欧洲， 却始终没有抵达。 他的哥哥出发去找他， 只在群岛以南找到几块残骸。

en: Do you want to overwrite the saved game?

But don’t forget: It’s only goods you’re after! You must not sink or capture any ships because you don’t want to provoke the enemy any more than is necessary.<n><n>You have until @D$EndDate$.<.<n><n>Remember that transport convoys do not count as trading convoys and that you must have a Letter of Marque if you want to attack traders.
tr: 但别忘了： 你要的只是货物！ 没必要把敌人得罪得太深， 所以不得击沉或俘获任何船只。<n><n>期限是 @D$EndDate$.<。<n><n>记住： 运输船队不算商队， 而且若要攻击商人， 你必须持有私掠许可证。

en: The last convoy from Europe informed me that my town is going to run short of imported goods in the next few weeks.<n><n>Can you help me? I cannot rely on the possibility of other traders bringing these goods to the town.
tr: 欧洲来的最后一支船队通知我， 未来几周我的城镇会缺进口货物。<n><n>你能帮我吗？ 我不能指望别的商人把这些货运来。

en: Attack on a Dutch military convoy

That's good. Start building the school by @D$EndDate$. I will then pay for your expenses.<n>Don’t forget that you will need a permit in @T$Town$ if you want to build a school.<n>Don't breathe a word about this mission to my sister.
tr: 很好。 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前开工建学校， 钱我就付给你。<n>想建学校， 可别忘了在 @T$Town$ 取得建造许可。<n>这事别让我姐姐知道。

en: Thank you! Improvement of the harbor defenses will begin as soon as there is enough wood and bricks in the town.
tr: 谢谢！ 镇上的木材和砖块备齐后， 港口防线的提升就会开始。

en: <n><n>You can usually hand back a building permit you have acquired. However, you cannot do so in this case because %1 is the town where you started the game.
tr: <n><n>你通常可以交还已获得的建筑许可。 但这次不行， 因为 %1 正是你开局所在的城镇。

en: My darling %1,<n>I can barely contain my impatience. Please hurry to the market and deliver the goods for the wedding, so we can have the banquet soon.
tr: 亲爱的 %1 ，<n>我实在等不及了。 快去市场把婚礼用的货送到， 好让宴席早些开席。

en: The convoy cannot set sail because there are too many goods on board. Sell some of your goods or move them to your warehouse so you do not exceed the maximum loading capacity of the convoy.
tr: 船队无法起航， 因为船上的货物太多了。 卖掉一些货物， 或把它们挪进仓库， 别超过船队的最大载货量。

en: Your task was to establish five different businesses in Tortuga and increase the number of citizens to 1,500. You didn't complete this task successfully.<n><n>Obtain the raw materials you need to construct the buildings. As soon as construction is under way, you should start to acquire the settler families you need. You need 30 settler families for each business and this will give you 120 new citizens.
tr: 你的任务是在托尔图加开设五家不同的产业， 并把市民人数增加到 1,500。 你没能完成。<n><n>先弄到建造所需的原材料。 一开工， 就去招你需要的移民家庭。 每家产业需要 30 户移民家庭， 这样能新增 120 名市民。

en: Now find the town of Cartagena in the south and send your convoy there by right-clicking on the town.<n>This scenario will end as soon as the convoy arrives at the town.
tr: 在南方找到卡塔赫纳城镇， 右键点击它， 把船队派过去。<n>船队一到城镇， 本剧本就结束。

en: Attack the town of @T$TargetTown$, which belongs to @n$HostileNation$, by @D$EndDate$ in order to free the younger daughter of the governor.
tr: 在 @D$EndDate$ 之前攻打属于 @n$HostileNation$ 的城镇 @T$TargetTown$ ， 以解救总督的小女儿。

en: You have failed to breach the defenses of the pirate hideout.
tr: 你未能攻破海盗藏身处的防御。

en: Your warships have forced the attackers to flee.
tr: 你的战舰逼退了来犯者。

en: Although there were no white slaves in North and Central America, there were plenty of Europeans who found themselves working under conditions that differed very little from those of the slaves.<n><n>Many young men (predominantly from the uneducated lower classes) wanted to emigrate but did not have the money to pay for the crossing. They therefore borrowed the money to pay for their passage, on the understanding that they would then settle the debt by working for a certain period on a sugar plantation (or somewhere similar). <n><n>However, what seemed a perfectly logical arrangement also had a catch: Many plantation owners tried to work these contract workers as hard as they possibly could during their period of employment. Added to this was the Caribbean climate that most Europeans found so hard to endure.<n><n>This system of “indentured labor” was also frequently used for convicts who had been expelled from their native countries. The British used this method later on, most notably against the Indians, whom they forced to work in the African colonies.
tr: 尽管北美和中美洲没有白人奴隶， 却有大量欧洲人发现自己的劳动条件与奴隶相差无几。<n><n>许多年轻男子(大多来自未受教育的底层阶级)想移民， 却没钱支付横渡的费用。 于是他们借钱支付船款， 约定日后再到糖种植园(或类似的地方)做工一段时间来还债。<n><n>然而， 这份看似完全合理的安排也有陷阱： 许多种植园主在他们受雇期间使足了劲压榨他们。 更别提加勒比的气候， 大多数欧洲人都难以忍受。<n><n>这种 「契约劳工」 制度也被频繁用于那些被逐出本国的囚犯。 英国人后来也用过这一手段， 最突出的例子是对付印第安人—— 他们强迫印第安人在非洲殖民地劳作。

en: Our enemies have looted Spanish traders numerous times in recent days.
tr: 近日我们的敌人多次劫掠西班牙商人。

en: Governor %1 %2 of the town of %3 has been dismissed.
tr: %3 城的总督 %1・%2 已被免职。

en: It seems the chest had been used to tuck away some tigerprint pantyhose, silk pajamas and riding breeches.
tr: 这箱子似乎曾用来藏过豹纹连裤袜、 丝绸睡衣和骑马裤。

en: In particular, the chest contained unusually large high-heeled shoes.
tr: 箱子里特别有一双格外大的高跟鞋。

en: Piece of a treasure map found
As the towns belonging to my nation do not produce enough, I was forced to rely on deliveries from Dutch towns.
tr: 由于我国的城镇产量不足， 我不得不依赖荷兰城镇的供货。

en: The pair of compasses sits beautifully in your hand and is very easy to use. It seems to be made entirely of gold and is decorated with an intricate pattern.
tr: 这副罗盘握在手中极为妥帖， 也很好使。 它似乎通体纯金， 还饰着精细的纹样。

en: This is a good opportunity for us. A town belonging to @n$TargetNation$ wishes to align itself with our nation because it appears to be continuously beset with various conflicts. I want you to support the town until such time as it decides to change its nationality.
tr: 这是个好机会。 @n$TargetNation$ 的一座城镇因为似乎一直纠纷不断， 希望改投我国的国籍。 我要你支援这座城镇， 直到它决定改变国籍为止。

en: The position is located close to %1.
The position is located not far from %1.
The place is located to the south of %1.

The scaffolding of the cocoa production facility is now displayed and construction begins.<n>It will take a couple of days for construction to be completed. In the meantime, you should organize accommodation for your new workers.<n>Close the Construction menu and look for a residential area in Santa Marta.
tr: 可可生产设施的脚手架已经搭好， 开工了。<n>建造需要几天时间才能完工。 在此期间， 你该为新来的工人安排住处。<n>关闭建造菜单， 在圣玛尔塔寻找一处住宅区。

en: Here you can see if there are any settlers waiting to be hired in the town or if the town needs new workers. This will be the case as soon as construction of your business has been completed.<n>Go to the surrounding governor towns and bring settlers to Santa Marta until your business is employing a full complement of workers.
tr: 在这里你能看到城里是否有待雇的移民， 或者城镇是否需要新工人。 你的企业一建成， 就会是这个情况。<n>去周边总督城， 把移民带到圣玛尔塔， 直到你的企业配齐工人。

en: Your next objective is to produce your own supply of @a$SubGoal$ of cloth for the warehouse in Cartagena and wait for your weaving mills to be constructed.<n>For @a$SubGoal$ of cloth, you need exactly @a$SubGoal$ of cotton.
tr: 你的下一个目标是为卡塔赫纳的仓库自产 @a$SubGoal$ 的布料， 并等织造厂建成。<n>每 @a$SubGoal$ 布料， 正好需要 @a$SubGoal$ 棉花。

en: %1: Loss of goods due to rat infestation
%1,<n>l allow all the visiting traders to be in and out here all day long, just so I can have some company. Could you not manage to drop by more often?
tr: %1 ，<n>我任由来往的商人进进出出， 就为图个有人作陪。 你就不能常过来看看？

en: Attack on a French military convoy
The convoy cannot set sail because there are too many sailors on board. Fire some of your sailors so you do not exceed the maximum number of crew allowed.
tr: 船队无法起航， 因为船上的水手太多了。 解雇一些水手， 别超过允许的船员上限。

en: The buildings in which you can perform various actions are always located within the town walls. Your warehouse is an exception, and there will be more about this in the next scenario.<n>Now leave the building and use the arrow keys to display the harbor and the convoy named “Santa Maria”. Click on it.
tr: 能进行各种操作的建筑都在城墙之内。 你的仓库是个例外， 下个剧本再说。<n>现在离开建筑， 用方向键找到港口， 以及名为 「Santa Maria」 的船队。 点它一下。

en: As you can see, information on your convoy now appears in the bottom center of your screen.<n>The convoy has already loaded goods: 10 barrels of wheat and 15 barrels of corn.<n>There are several buttons to the right of the convoy display. Click on the second button (the one with the ship icon).
tr: 你看， 现在屏幕下方中央显示的是船队信息。<n>船队已经装好货： 10 桶小麦和 15 桶玉米。<n>船队显示栏右侧有几个按钮。 点第二个 （带船图标的那个）。

en: Collect reward from the governor of @T$TOWN$
tr: 向 @T$TOWN$ 的总督领取奖励

en: Then set off on your journey. Head for the waters off the town of @T$TargetTown$.
tr: 那就启程吧。 前往 @T$TargetTown$ 城外的海域。

en: As the towns belonging to my nation do not produce enough, I was forced to rely on deliveries from French towns.
tr: 由于我国的城镇产量不足， 我不得不依赖法国城镇的供货。

en: The convoy cannot set sail because there are too many cannons on board. Sell some of your cannons or move them to your warehouse so you do not exceed the maximum number of cannons.
tr: 船队无法启航， 因为船上火炮太多。 卖掉一些火炮， 或把它们移进仓库， 别让火炮数量超过上限。

en: You didn't accomplish the mission assigned to you by the Governor, which means the scenario objective is not achieved.
tr: 你没有完成总督交给你的任务， 也就是说剧本目标未能达成。

en: You performed an action that prevents you from completing the scenario successfully.<n><n>Follow the instructions in the Event window.
tr: 你采取的行动使你无法成功完成本剧本。<n><n>请遵循事件窗口里的说明。

en: Would you be interested in @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$? I would only charge you a unit price of @g$Price$, but you would have to take the lot. Do you want to buy the goods?
tr: 你对 @a$Amount$ 的 @G$Goods$ 有兴趣吗？ 单价只收你 @g$Price$ ， 但你得全部拿走。 这批货你买吗？

en: <g:INTEXT_SCHATZKISTE_800x600.screen><n>You have found the hideout containing the Governor's treasure. You find @g$Gold$.
tr: <g:INTEXT_SCHATZKISTE_800x600.screen><n>你找到了总督藏宝的地点， 找到了 @g$Gold$ 。

en: The position is located at most 1 day’s journey from %1.
tr: 那个位置离 %1 最多一天航程。

en: One of our transport convoys was recently attacked and captured by pirates. I am concerned about the fate of the settler families on board the captured ships. We are currently searching the area around the location where the attack took place. Could you also take on the task of searching another area?
tr: 我们有一支运输船队最近遭海盗袭击并被俘。 我很担心船上那些移民家庭的命运。 我们正在搜寻袭击发生地附近的区域。 你能不能也接手搜寻另一个区域？

en: Well done!<n>The lower the average price of the raw materials your require, the lower your production costs for the goods you produce.<n>Now continue to produce cocoa until you have a supply of @a$AmountGoal$ in your warehouse.
tr: 干得好！<n>你所需原料的平均价格越低， 所产货物的生产成本就越低。<n>现在继续生产可可， 直到仓库里囤够 @a$AmountGoal$ 。

en: You have offered exemplary support to @T$TargetTown$ and made a very good name for yourself in the town. Thankfully, you have been given a building permit and a warehouse.
tr: 你对 @T$TargetTown$ 提供了莫大的支持， 在该城镇声名大振。 幸而你获发了建筑许可证与一座仓库

en: You have not taken control of all of your opponent’s ships. However, in the case of pirate convoys or military convoys, you have the option of sinking the abandoned ships.<n>Do you want to choose this option?
tr: 你还没能控制对手的全部船只。 不过海盗船队或军事船队留下的残船， 你可以选择直接击沉。<n>要这么办吗？

en: You have won the sea battle. Do you want to call off the attack?
tr: 海战获胜。 要取消这次进攻吗？

en: %1 has been weakened as a result.
There is not enough %1 in the town.
Select the allocation of weapons to your sailors.
tr: 选择分配给水手的武器。

en: I have some information for you on the Bahamas.
tr: 我有关于巴哈马的消息。

en: Our enemies have looted French traders numerous times in recent days.
tr: 近日我们的敌人多次劫掠法国商人。

en: Our enemies have looted Dutch traders numerous times in recent days.
tr: 近日我们的敌人多次劫掠荷兰商人。

en: Now accomplish the mission assigned to you by the Governor.
tr: 现在去完成总督交给你的委托。

en: There is something you could do for me.<n><n>
Thank you for the punctual delivery! The feast will be announced right away and shall begin this very day!
tr: 谢谢你准时送到！ 庆典马上宣布， 今天就正式开始！

en: The number of soldiers will increased by %1 in the coming days, provided that sufficient living space is available.
tr: 只要有足够的居住空间， 接下来几天士兵人数将增加 %1 。

en: Send a captain who does not have much experience of navigation.
tr: 派一名航海经验不丰富的船长去。

en: For the loan of %1 which you granted me, you will receive the agreed sum of  %3 on %2.
tr: 承蒙你借给我 %1 ， 你在 %2 会收到约定的 %3 。

en: %1 is waiting for you at the inn.
The position is located to the west of %1.
No workers are needed in the town.
Unfortunately, you are an enemy of the nation to which the town belongs and have therefore sneaked into the harbor.
tr: 可惜你与这座城镇所属的国家为敌， 只好偷偷潜进了港口。

en: We must act quickly, for I have just learned of the whereabouts of one of the convoys belonging to the pirate @P$PirateName$. Find and destroy this convoy.
tr: 我们必须抓紧， 我刚得知海盗 @P$PirateName$ 的一支船队的下落。 找到它并摧毁它。

en: A trader in %1 has demolished a business because the continuing low price of %2 in the town meant that production was no longer viable.
tr: %1 的一名商人关掉了店： 镇上 %2 持续低价， 再生产下去已无利可图。

en: …the many participants in the Port Royale forum, whose ideas and suggestions made the second part of Port Royale possible.<n>...the beta testers of Port Royale 2, who showed a tireless commitment to the project during open beta testing. Nicole Jeannette Pescher, Don Geraldo and BMP from the beta test for the logos they sent.
tr: …… Port Royale 论坛上众多参与者， 正是他们的想法与建议成就了 Port Royale 续作。<n>…… Port Royale 2 公测期间的测试者， 他们为这个项目投入了不懈的热情。

en: I could tell you something about the sugar cane plantations.
tr: 我可以跟你谈谈甘蔗种植园。

en: I’d be happy to give you some information on the viceroys here in the New World.
tr: 我很乐意跟你讲讲新世界这里的副王们。

en: Let me tell you a little about how the American Indian population was treated by the Europeans.
tr: 让我跟你讲讲欧洲人是如何对待美洲原住民的。

en: Costs have built up in the warehouse
%1 is waiting for you at the marketplace.
I have nothing further to say to you, other than this warning: watch out for the military convoys of my nation, for they are hunting you!
tr: 我唯一要提醒你的就是： 小心我国的军事船队， 它们正在追捕你！

en: Have you heard tell of this pirate Blackbeard? His real name is Edward Teach and he is in possession of several convoys and for some time now they have been attacking traders of all nations with a great deal of success. However, no one has yet managed to arrest him.<n><n>I am therefore assigning you the task of tracking down one of his convoys and destroying it.
tr: 你听说过这个海盗黑胡子吗？ 他本名爱德华·蒂奇， 手里握着好几支船队， 近来一直很顺手地袭击各国商人， 却至今没人能抓住他。<n><n>所以我派你去追踪他的一支船队并将其摧毁。

en: The place lies somewhere close to %1, at most 1 day’s journey away.
tr: 那个地方紧靠 %1 ， 最多一天航程。

en: Military ships belonging to %1 have attacked a trading convoy belonging to %2.
tr: 属于 %1 的军舰袭击了属于 %2 的商船队。

en: The Governor urgently wants to speak to you.
Are you sure you want to quit the current game and return to the main menu?
tr: 确定要退出当前游戏并返回主菜单吗？

en: As you can see, the log immediately displays all the messages that you have received so far. At the moment, the log only displays the instructions for this scenario.<n>There are more buttons to the right of the Log window. Click on the third button.
tr: 你看， 日志立刻列出了你至今收到的所有消息。 目前里面只有本剧本的说明。<n>日志窗口右侧还有别的按钮。 点第三个。

en: Tips on buying and selling goods
His home town is somewhere in the Eastern Caribbean.
tr: 他的家乡在加勒比海东部。

en: The town is suffering from a rat infestation
The convoy cannot set sail because it is currently in the shipyard for repair. Wait until the repairs have finished.
tr: 船队目前正在船坞维修， 无法启航。 请等维修结束。

en: As you know, @n$Nation1$ and @n$Nation2$ are at war.<n>For this reason, I will still not be getting any imported goods from Europe for the coming weeks.  I therefore have no choice but to buy up the goods in @n$Nation2$.<n><n>I have already employed some other traders to do so but I would like to be able to rely on your help also.
tr: 你知道， @n$Nation1$ 和 @n$Nation2$ 正在交战。<n>所以未来几周， 我照样拿不到欧洲的进口货物， 只能到 @n$Nation2$ 去收买。<n><n>我已经雇了几个商人去办， 但还希望能靠上你。

en: Terminate this game and load the saved game?
In duels you will receive a bonus of <o:0xFFF2FAAD>5%<o> for the damage you inflict on your opponent.
tr: 决斗时， 你对敌人造成的伤害提高 <o:0xFFF2FAAD>5%<o>。

en: Do you want to chance another game?
The Spanish treasure fleet has moored in the town of %1
tr: 西班牙珍宝船队已停泊在 %1

en: The Spanish treasure fleet has anchored in the town of %1
tr: 西班牙宝藏船队已在 %1 抛锚

en: You did not deliver the goods on time.
The convoy that was supposed to carry out this mission has been destroyed.
tr: 本该执行这项任务的船队已被摧毁。

en: You have reached the maximum number of convoys.
tr: 你已达到船队数量上限。

en: You cannot perform a transfer with a convoy that is being repaired.
tr: 正在维修的船队无法进行转移。

en: As soon as you change a logo, the changed logo is automatically used in the game.<n>You can also create your own logos. You have to create these in the correct format in a specific directory (see the handbook).
tr: 每次更换徽标后， 新徽标会自动用于游戏中。<n>你也可以自己制作徽标， 但必须按规定格式创建。

en: My country is prepared to pay you %1 for the release of %2.
tr: 我国愿为释放 %2 支付你 %1 。

en: The hideout of the pirate %1 has been discovered. Which heroic adventurer dares to attack and destroy the hideout?
tr: 海盗 %1 的巢穴已被发现哪位英雄冒险家敢去攻毁它？

en: The deadline for the goods handover has expired.
There are currently no new ships for sale in the shipyard.
tr: 船厂目前没有新船出售。

en: You should ensure that you have a supply of @a$SubGoal$ of cotton in the warehouse by the time your weaving mills have been built, so that the new businesses can start weaving cloth from cotton straight away.
tr: 你要确保在织造厂建成之时， 仓库里备有 @a$SubGoal$ 的棉花， 好让新企业一开张就能用棉花织布。

en: Introductory scenario<n><n>In this scenario, you will command your first sea battles. Initially, you will wage a battle against a practice convoy, but, later in the scenario, you will take on pirate ships and even attack a pirate’s den.
tr: 序章<n><n>在本剧本中， 你将指挥自己的首次海战。 起初你要与一支演习船队交战， 而在剧本的后半段，

en: Hot on the Trail of Blackbeard!
Production and consumption by your own businesses
tr: 自有企业的生产与消耗

en: The deadline for the goods handover has expired.
Do you want to demolish the most recently constructed warehouse?
tr: 要拆除最近建成的仓库吗？

%1 has been promoted to the rank of %2

Introductory Scenario<n><n>In Port Royale 2, your objective is to rise from being a humble trader to become an influential businessman. To help you achieve the status you seek, you can transport goods as well as trade, build, and engage in politics and piracy.<n:25>The introductory scenario will teach you the basics of how to play the game. This scenario, like all the others, involves several different objectives.
tr: 序章<n><n>在 Port Royale 2 中， 你的目标是从一个默默无闻的商人，<n:25>成长为举足轻重的实业家。 为助你达成地位，

en: There are not enough raw materials
